Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yām vā adhvaryuś ca yajamānaś ca devatām antaritas tasyā ā vṛścyete

Sentence: 2 prājāpatyam dadhigraham gṛhṇīyāt

Sentence: 3 prajāpatiḥ sarvā devatās \\

Sentence: 4 devatābhya eva ni hnuvāte

Sentence: 5 jyeṣṭho vā eṣa grahāṇām \\

Sentence: 6 yasyaiṣa gṛhyate jyaiṣṭhyam eva gachati

Sentence: 7 sarvāsām vā etad devatānāṁ rūpam yad eṣa grahas \\

Sentence: 8 yasyaiṣa gṛhyate sarvāṇy evainaṁ rūpāṇi paśūnām upa tiṣṭhante \\

Sentence: 9 upayāmagṛhītaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 asi prajāpataye tvā jyotiṣmate jyotiṣmantam gṛhṇāmīty āha

Sentence: 2 jyotir evainaṁ samānānām karoti \\

Sentence: 3 agnijihvebhyas tvartāyubhya ity āha \\

Sentence: 4 etāvatīr vai devatās

Sentence: 5 tābhya evainaṁ sarvābhyo gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 6 apendra dviṣato mana ity āha

Sentence: 7 bhrātṛvyāpanuttyai

Sentence: 8 prāṇāya tvāpānāya tvety āha

Sentence: 9 prāṇān eva yajamāne dadhāti

Sentence: 10 tasmai tvā prajāpataye vibhūdāvne jyotiṣmate jyotiṣmantam juhomi //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ity āha

Sentence: 2 prajāpatiḥ sarvā devatāḥ

Sentence: 3 sarvābhya evainam devatābhyo juhoti \\

Sentence: 4 ājyagraham gṛhṇīyāt tejaskāmasya

Sentence: 5 tejo vā ājyam \\

Sentence: 6 tejasvy ṝva bhavati

Sentence: 7 somagraham gṛhṇīyād brahmavarcasakāmasya

Sentence: 8 brahmavarcasam vai somas \\

Sentence: 9 brahmavarcasy ṝva bhavati

Sentence: 10 dadhigraham gṛhṇīyāt paśukāmasya \\

Sentence: 11 ūrg vai dadhi \\

Sentence: 12 ūrk paśavas \\

Sentence: 13 ūrjaivāsmā ūrjam paśūn ava runddhe //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a tve kratum api vṛñjanti viśve dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmāḥ / svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā sam ata ū ṣu madhu madhunābhi yodhi //

Sentence: 2=b upayāmagṛhīto ‘si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭam gṛhṇāmy eṣa te yoniḥ prajāpataye tvā /

Sentence: 3 prāṇagrahān gṛhṇāty etāvad vā asti yāvad ete grahā stomāś chandāṁsi pṛṣṭhāni diśo yāvad evāsti tat //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ava runddhe

Sentence: 2 jyeṣṭhā vā etān brāhmaṇāḥ purā vidvām akran tasmāt teṣāṁ sarvā diśo ‘bhijitā abhūvan yasyaite gṛhyante jyaiṣṭhyam eva gachaty abhi diśo jayati

Sentence: 3 pañca gṛhyante pañca diśaḥ sarvāsv eva dikṣv ṛdhnuvanti

Sentence: 4 navanava gṛhyante nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ prāṇān eva yajamāneṣu dadhati

Sentence: 5 prāyaṇīye codayanīye ca gṛhyante prāṇā vai prāṇagrahāḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 prāṇair eva prayanti prāṇair ud yanti

Sentence: 2 daśame ‘han gṛhyante prāṇā vai prāṇagrahāḥ prāṇebhyaḥ khalu vā etat prajā yanti yad vāmadevyam yoneś cyavate daśame ‘han vāmadevyam yoneś cyavate yad daśame ‘han gṛhyante prāṇebhya eva tat prajā na yanti //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a pra devam devyā dhiyā bharatā jātavedasam / havyā no vakṣad ānuṣak //

Sentence: 2=b ayam u ṣya pra devayur hotā yajñāya nīyate / ratho na yor abhīvṛto ghṛṇīvān cetati tmanā //

Sentence: 3=c ayam agnir uruṣyaty amṛtād iva janmanaḥ / sahasaś cit sahīyān devo jīvātave kṛtaḥ //

Sentence: 4=d iḍāyās tvā pade vayam nābhā pṛthivyā adhi / jātavedo ni dhīmahy agne havyāya voḍhave //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1=e agne viśvebhiḥ svanīka devair ūrṇāvantam prathamaḥ sīda yonim / kulāyinam ghṛtavantaṁ savitre yajñam naya yajamānāya sādhu //

Sentence: 2=f sīda hotaḥ sva u loke cikitvānt sādayā yajñaṁ sukṛtasya yonau / devāvīr devān haviṣā yajāsy agne bṛhad yajamāne vayo dhāḥ //

Sentence: 3=g ni hotā hotṛṣadane vidānas tveṣo dīdivāṁ asadat sudakṣaḥ / adabdhavratapramatir vasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ //

Sentence: 4=h tvam dūtas tvam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 u naḥ paraspās tvam vasya ā vṛṣabha praṇetā / agne tokasya nas tane tanūnām aprayuchan dīdyad bodhi gopāḥ //

Sentence: 2=i abhi tvā deva savitar īśānam vāryāṇām / sadāvan bhāgam īmahe //

Sentence: 3=k mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imam yajñam mimikṣatām / pipṛtām no bharīmabhiḥ //

Sentence: 4=l tvām agne puṣkarād adhy atharvā nir amanthata / mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ //

Sentence: 5=m tam u //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 tvā dadhyaṅṅ ṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ / vṛtrahaṇam puramdaram //

Sentence: 2=n tam u tvā pāthyo vṛṣā sam īdhe dasyuhantamam dhanamjayaṁ raṇeraṇe //

Sentence: 3=o uta bruvantu jantava ud agnir vṛtrahājani / dhanamjayo raṇeraṇe //

Sentence: 4=p ā yaṁ haste na khādinaṁ śiśum jātam na bibhrati / viśām agniṁ svadhvaram //

Sentence: 5=q pra devam devavītaye bharatā vasuvittamam / ā sve yonau ni ṣīdatu //

Sentence: 6=r ā //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 jātam jātavedasi priyaṁ śiśītātithim / syona ā gṛhapatim //

Sentence: 2=s agnināgniḥ sam idhyate kavir gṛhapatir yuvā / havyavāḍ juhvāsyaḥ //

Sentence: 3=t tvaṁ hy agne agninā vipro vipreṇa sant satā / sakaḥ sakhyā samidhyase //

Sentence: 4=u tam marjayanta sukratum puroyāvānam ājiṣu / sveṣu kṣayeṣu vājinam //

Sentence: 5=v yajñena yajñam ayajanta devās tāni dharmāṇi prathamāny āsan / te ha nākam mahimānaḥ sacante yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ //

## Book: 4

## Chapter: 1

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a yuñjānaḥ prathamam manas tatvāya savitā dhiyaḥ / agnim jyotir nicāyya pṛthivyā adhy ābharat //

Sentence: 2=b yuktvāya manasā devānt suvar yato dhiyā divam / bṛhaj jyotiḥ kariṣyataḥ savitā pra suvati tān //

Sentence: 3=c yuktena manasā vayam devasya savituḥ save / suvargeyāya śaktyai //

Sentence: 4=d yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ / vi hotrā dadhe vayuṇāvid eka it //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 mahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ //

Sentence: 2=e yuje vām brahma pūrvyam namobhir vi ślokā yanti pathyṝva sūrāḥ / śṛṇvanti viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ //

Sentence: 3=f yasya prayāṇam av anya id yayur devā devasya mahimānam arcataḥ / yaḥ pārthivāni vimame sa etaśo rajāṁsi devaḥ savitā mahitvanā //

Sentence: 4=g deva savitaḥ pra suva yajñam pra suva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 yajñapatim bhagāya divyo gandharvaḥ ketapūḥ ketam naḥ punātu vācas patir vācam adya svadāti naḥ //

Sentence: 2=h imam no deva savitar yajñam pra suva devāyuvaṁ sakhividaṁ satrājitam dhanajitaṁ suvarjitam //

Sentence: 3=i ṛcā stomaṁ sam ardhaya gāyatreṇa rathamtaram / bṛhad gāyatravartani //

Sentence: 4=k devasya tvā savituḥ prasavṝ ‘śvinor bāhubhyām pūṣṇo hastābhyām gāyatreṇa chandasā dade ‘ṅgirasvat \\

Sentence: 5=l abhrir asi nāriḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 asi pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthād agnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvad ā bhara traiṣṭubhena tvā chandasā dade ‘ṅgirasvat \\

Sentence: 2=m babhrir asi nārir asi tvayā vayaṁ sadhastha āgniṁ śakema khanitum purīṣyam jāgatena tvā chandasā dade ‘ṅgirasvat \\

Sentence: 3=n hasta ādhāya savitā bibhrad abhriṁ hiraṇyayīm / tayā jyotir ajasram id agnim khātvī na ā bharānuṣṭubhena tvā chandasā dade ‘ṅgirasvat //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a imām agṛbhṇan raśanām ṛtasya pūrva āyuṣi vidatheṣu kavyā / tayā devāḥ sutam ā babhūvur ṛtasya sāmant saram ārapantī //

Sentence: 2=b pratūrtam {F vājinn} {W vajinn} {ASS vājinn} {BI vājinn} {GOLS -} ā drava variṣṭhām anu samvatam / divi te janma paramam antarikṣe nābhiḥ pṛthivyām adhi yoniḥ //

Sentence: 3=c yuñjāthāṁ rāsabham yuvam asmin yāme vṛṣaṇvasū / agnim bharantam asmayum //

Sentence: 4=d yogeyoge tavastaram vāje-vāje havāmahe / sakhāya indram ūtaye //

Sentence: 5=e pratūrvan //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ehy avakrāmann aśastī rudrasya gāṇapatyān mayobhūr ehi / urv antarikṣam anv ihi svastigavyūtir abhayāni kṛṇvan //

Sentence: 2=f pūṣṇā sayujā saha pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthād agnim puriṣyam aṅgirasvad achehi \\

Sentence: 3=g agnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvad achemas \\

Sentence: 4=h agnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvad bhariṣyāmas \\

Sentence: 5=i agnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvad bharāmaḥ /

Sentence: 6=k anv agnir uṣasām agram akhyad anv ahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ / anu sūryasya //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 purutrā ca raśmīn anu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatāna //

Sentence: 2=l āgatya vājy adhvanaḥ sarvā mṛdho vi dhūnute / agniṁ sadhasthe mahati cakṣuṣā ni cikīṣate //

Sentence: 3=m ākramya vājin pṛthivīm agnim icha rucā tvam / bhūyā vṛtvāya no brūhi yataḥ khanāma tam vayam //

Sentence: 4=n dyaus te pṛṣṭham pṛthivī sadhastham ātmāntarikṣaṁ samudras te yoniḥ / vikhyāya cakṣuṣā tvam abhi tiṣṭha //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 pṛtanyataḥ //

Sentence: 2=o ut krāma mahate saubhagāyāsmād āsthānād draviṇodā vājin / vayaṁ syāma sumatau pṛthivyā agnim khaniṣyanta upasthe asyāḥ //

Sentence: 3=p ud akramīd draviṇodā vājy arvākaḥ sa lokaṁ sukṛtam pṛthivyāḥ / tataḥ khanema supratīkam agniṁ suvo ruhāṇā adhi nāka uttame //

Sentence: 4=q {F apo} {W apo} {ASS apo} {BI apo} {GOLS -} devīr upa sṛja madhumatīr ayakṣmāya prajābhyaḥ / tāsāṁ sthānād uj jihatām oṣadhayaḥ supippalāḥ //

Sentence: 5=r jigharmi //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 agnim manasā ghṛtena pratikṣyantam bhuvanāni viśvā / pṛthum tiraścā vayasā bṛhantam vyaciṣṭham annaṁ rabhasam vidānam //

Sentence: 2=s ā tvā jigharmi vacasā ghṛtenārakṣasā manasā taj juṣasva / maryaśrī spṛhayadvarṇo agnir nābhimṛśe tanuvā jarhṛṣāṇaḥ //

Sentence: 3=t pari vājapatiḥ kavir agnir havyāny akramīt / dadhad ratnāni dāśuṣe //

Sentence: 4=u pari tvāgne puram vayam vipraṁ sahasya dhīmahi / dhṛṣadvarṇam divedive bhettāram bhaṅgurāvataḥ //

Sentence: 5=v tvam agne dyubhis tvam āśuśukṣaṇis tvam adbhyas tvam aśmanasa pari / tvam vanebhyas tvam oṣadhībhyas tvam nṛṇām nṛpate jāyase śuciḥ //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a devasya tvā savituḥ prasavṝ ‘śvinor bāhubhyām pūṣṇo hastābhyām pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe ‘gnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvat khanāmi //

Sentence: 2=b jyotiṣmantam tvāgne supratīkam ajasreṇa bhānunā dīdyānam / śivam prajābhyo ‘hiṁsantam pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe ‘gnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvat khanāmi //

Sentence: 3=c apām pṛṣṭham asi saprathā urv agnim bhariṣyad aparāvapiṣṭham / vardhamānam maha ā ca puṣkaram divo mātrayā variṇā prathasva //

Sentence: 4=d śarma ca sthaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 varma ca stho achidre bahule ubhe / vyacasvatī sam vasāthām bhartam agnim purīṣyam //

Sentence: 2=e sam vasāthāṁ suvarvidā samīcī urasā tmanā / agnim antar bhariṣyantī jyotiṣmantam ajasram it //

Sentence: 3=f purīṣyo ‘si viśvabharāḥ / atharvā tvā prathamo nir amanthad agne

Sentence: 4=g tvām agne puṣkarād adhy atharvā nir amanthata / mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ //

Sentence: 5=h tam u tvā dadhyaṅṅ ṛṣiḥ putra īdhe //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 atharvaṇaḥ / vṛtrahaṇam puram daram //

Sentence: 2=i tam u tvā pāthyo vṛṣā sam īdhe dasyuhantamam / dhanamjayaṁ raṇeraṇe //

Sentence: 3=k sīda hotaḥ sva u loke cikitvānt sādayā yajñaṁ sukṛtasya yonau / devāvīr devān haviṣā yajāsy agne bṛhad yajamāne vayo dhāḥ //

Sentence: 4=l ni hotā hotṛṣadane vidānas tveṣo dīdivāṁ asadat sudakṣaḥ / adabdhavratapramatir vasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ //

Sentence: 5=m saṁ sīdasva mahāṁ asi śocasva //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 devavītamaḥ / vi dhūmam agne aruṣam miyedhya sṛja praśasta darśatam //

Sentence: 2=n janiṣvā hi jenyo agre ahnām hito hiteṣv aruṣo vaneṣu / damedame sapta ratnā dadhāno ‘gnir hotā ni ṣasādā yajīyān //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a sam te vāyur mātariśvā dadhātūttānāyai hṛdayam yad viliṣṭam / devānām yaś carati prāṇathena tasmai ca devi vaṣaḍ astu tubhyam //

Sentence: 2=b sujāto jyotiṣā saha śarma varūtham āsadaḥ suvaḥ / vāso agne viśvarūpaṁ sam vyayasva vibhāvaso //

Sentence: 3=c ud u tiṣṭha svadhvarāvā no devyā kṛpā / dṛśe ca bhāsā bṛhatā suśukvanir āgne yāhi suśastibhiḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1=d ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā / ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yad añjibhir vāghadbhir vihvayāmahe //

Sentence: 2=e sa jāto garbho asi rodasyor agne cārur vibhṛta oṣadhīṣu / citraḥ śiśuḥ pari tamāṁsy aktaḥ pra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradad gāḥ //

Sentence: 3=f sthiro bhava vīḍvaṅga āśur bhava vājy arvan / pṛthur bhava suṣadas tvam agneḥ purīṣavāhanaḥ //

Sentence: 4=g śivo bhava //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 prajābhyo mānuṣībhyas tvam aṅgiraḥ / mā dyāvāpṛthivī abhi śūśuco māntarikṣam mā vanaspatīn //

Sentence: 2=h praitu vājī kanikradan nānadad rāsabhaḥ patvā / bharann agnim purīṣyam mā pādy āyuṣaḥ purā //

Sentence: 3=i rāsabho vām kanikradat suyukto vṛṣaṇā rathe / sa vām agnim purīṣyam āśur dūto vahād itaḥ //

Sentence: 4=k vṛṣāgnim vṛṣaṇam bharann apām garbhaṁ samudriyam / agna ā yāhi //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vītaya ṛtaṁ satyam //

Sentence: 2=l oṣadhayaḥ prati gṛhṇītāgnim etaṁ śivam āyantam abhy atra yuṣmān / vyasyan viśvā amatīr arātīr niṣīdan no apa durmatiṁ hanat //

Sentence: 3=m oṣadhayaḥ prati modadhvam enam puṣpāvatīḥ supippalāḥ / ayam vo garbha ṛtviyaḥ pratnaṁ sadhastham āsadat //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a vi pājasā pṛthunā śośucāno bādhasva dviṣo rakṣaso amīvāḥ / suśarmaṇo bṛhataḥ śarmaṇi syām agner ahaṁ suhavasya praṇītau //

Sentence: 2=b āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvas tā na ūrje dadhātana / mahe raṇāya cakṣase //

Sentence: 3=c yo vaḥ śivatamo rasas tasya bhājayate ‘ha naḥ / uśatīr iva mātaraḥ //

Sentence: 4=d tasmā aram gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha / āpo janayathā ca naḥ //

Sentence: 5=e mitraḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 saṁsṛjya pṛthivīm bhūmim ca jyotiṣā saha / sujātam jātavedasam agnim vaiśvānaram vibhum //

Sentence: 2=f ayakṣmāya tvā saṁ sṛjāmi prajābhyaḥ / viśve tvā devā vaiśvānarāḥ saṁ sṛjantv ānuṣṭubhena chandasāṅgirasvat //

Sentence: 3=g rudrāḥ sambhṛtya pṛthivīm bṛhaj jyotiḥ sam īdhire / teṣām bhānur ajasra ic chukro deveṣu rocate //

Sentence: 4=h saṁsṛṣṭām vasubhī rudrair dhīraiḥ karmaṇyām mṛdam / hastābhyām mṛdvīm kṛtvā sinīvālī karotu //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 tām //

Sentence: 2=i sinīvalī sukapardā sukrīrā svaupaśā / sā tubhyam adite maha okhām dadhātu hastayoḥ //

Sentence: 3=k ukhām karotu śaktyā bāhubhyām aditir dhiyā / mātā putram yathopasthe sāgnim bibhartu garbha ā //

Sentence: 4=l makhasya śiro ‘si

Sentence: 5=m yajñasya pade sthaḥ /

Sentence: 6=n vasavas tvā kṛṇvantu gāyatreṇa chandasāṅgirasvat pṛthivy asi rudrās tvā kṛṇvantu traiṣṭubhena chandasāṅgirasvad antarikṣam asi //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ādityās tvā kṛṇvantu jāgatena chandasāṅgirasvad dyaur asi viśve tvā devā vaiśvānarāḥ kṛṇvantv ānuṣṭubhena chandasāṅgirasvad diśo ‘si dhruvāsi dhārayā mayi prajāṁ rāyas poṣam gaupatyaṁ surīryaṁ sajātān yajamānāya \\

Sentence: 2=o adityai rāsnāsi \\

Sentence: 3=p aditis te bilam gṛhṇātu pāṅktena chandasāṅgirasvat /

Sentence: 4=q kṛtvāya sā mahīm ukhām mṛnmayīm yonim agnaye / tām putrebhyaḥ sam prāyachad aditiḥ śrapayān iti //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a vasavas tvā dhūpayantu gāyatreṇa chandasāṅgirasvad rudrās tvā dhūpayantu traiṣṭubhena chandasāṅgirasvad ādityās tvā dhūpayantu jāgatena chandasāṅgirasvad viśve tvā devā vaiśvānarā dhūpayantv ānuṣṭubhena chandasāṅgirasvad indras tvā dhūpayatv aṅgirasvad viṣṇus tvā dhūpayatv aṅgirasvad varuṇas tvā dhūpayatv aṅgirasvat \\

Sentence: 2=b aditis tvā devī viśvadevyāvatī pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe ‘ṅgirasvat khanatv avaṭa

Sentence: 3=c devānām tvā patnīḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 devīr viśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe ‘ṅgirasvad dadhatūkhe

Sentence: 2=d dhiṣaṇās tvā devīr viśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe ‘ṅgirasvad abhīndhatām ukhe gnās tvā devīr viśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe ‘ṅgirasvac chrapayantūkhe varūtrayo janayas tvā devīr viśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe ‘ṅgirasvat pacantūkhe /

Sentence: 3=e mitraitām ukhām pacaiṣā mā bhedi /

Sentence: 4=f etām te pari dadāmy abhittyai

Sentence: 5=g abhīmām //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 mahinā divam mitro babhūva saprathāḥ / uta śravasā pṛthivīm //

Sentence: 2=h mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ śravo devasya sānasim / dyumnam citraśravastamam //

Sentence: 3=i devas tvā savitod vapatu supāṇiḥ svaṅguriḥ / subāhur uta śaktyā //

Sentence: 4=k apadyamānā pṛthivy āśā diśa ā pṛṇa / ut tiṣṭha bṛhatī bhavordhvā tiṣṭha dhruvā tvam //

Sentence: 5=l vasavas tvā chṛndantu gāyatreṇa chandasāṅgirasvad rudrās tvā chṛndantu traiṣṭubhena chandasāṅgirasvad ādityās tvā chṛndantu jāgatena chandasāṅgirasvad viśve tvā devā vaiśvānarā ā chṛndantv ānuṣṭubhena chandasāṅgirasvat //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a samās tvāgna ṛtavo vardhayantu samvatsarā ṛṣayo yāni satyā / sam divyena dīdihi rocanena viśvā ā bhāhi pradiśaḥ pṛthivyāḥ //

Sentence: 2=b sam cedhyasvāgne pra ca bodhayainam uc ca tiṣṭha mahate saubhagāya / mā ca ṛṣad upasattā te agne brahmāṇas te yaśasaḥ santu mānye //

Sentence: 3=c tvām agne vṛṇate brāhmaṇā ime śivo agne //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 samvaraṇe bhavā naḥ / sapatnahā no abhimātijic ca sve gaye jāgṛhy aprayuchan //

Sentence: 2=d ihaivāgne adhi dhārayā rayim mā tvā ni kran pūrvacito nikāriṇaḥ / kṣatram agne suyamam astu tubhyam upasattā vardhatām te aniṣṭṛtaḥ //

Sentence: 3=e kṣatreṇāgne svāyuḥ saṁ rabhasva mitreṇāgne mitradheye yatasva / sajātānām madhyamasthā edhi rājñām agne vihavyo dīdihīha //

Sentence: 4=f ati //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 nibo ati sridho ‘ty acittim aty arātim agne / viśvā hy agne duritā sahasvāthāsmabhyaṁ sahavīrāṁ rayim dāḥ //

Sentence: 2=g anādhṛṣyo jātavedā aniṣṭṛto virāḍ agne kṣatrabhṛd dīdihīha / viśvā āśāḥ pramuñcan mānuṣīr bhiyaḥ śivābhir adya pari pāhi no vṛdhe //

Sentence: 3=h bṛhaspate savitar bodhayainaṁ saṁśitam cit samtarāṁ saṁ śiśādhi / vardhayainam mahate saubhagāya //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 viśva enam anu madantu devāḥ //

Sentence: 2=i amutrabhūyād adha yad yamasya bṛhaspate abhiśaster amuñcaḥ / praty auhatām aśvinā mṛtyum asmād devānām agne bhiṣajā śacībhiḥ //

Sentence: 3=k ud vayam tamasas pari paśyanto jyotir uttaram / devam devatrā sūryam aganma jyotir uttamam //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ūrdhvā asya samidho bhavanty ūrdhvā śukrā śocīṁṣy agneḥ / dyumattamā supratīkasya sūnoḥ //

Sentence: 2=b tanūnapād asuro viśvavedā devo deveṣu devaḥ / patha ānakti madhvā ghṛtena //

Sentence: 3=c madhvā yajñam nakṣase prīṇāno narāśaṁso agne / sukṛd devaḥ savitā viśvavāraḥ //

Sentence: 4=d achāyam eti śavasā ghṛteneḍāno vahnir namasā / agniṁ sruco adhvareṣu prayatsu //

Sentence: 5=e sa yakṣad asya mahimānam agneḥ saḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ī mandrāsu prayasaḥ / vasuś cetiṣṭho vasudhātamaś ca //

Sentence: 2=f dvāro devīr anv asya viśve vratā dadante agneḥ / uruvyacaso dhāmnā patyamānāḥ //

Sentence: 3=g te asya yoṣaṇe divye na yonāv uṣāsānaktā / imam yajñam avatām adhvaram naḥ //

Sentence: 4=h daivyā hotārāv ūrdhvam adhvaram no ‘gner jihvām abhi gṛṇītam / kṛṇutam naḥ svṅṣṭim //

Sentence: 5=i tisro devīr barhir edaṁ sadantv iḍā sarasvatī //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 bhāratī mahī gṛṇānā //

Sentence: 2=k tan nas turīpam adbhutam purukṣu tvaṣṭā suvīram / rāyas poṣam vi ṣyatu nābhim asme //

Sentence: 3=l vanaspate ‘va sṛjā rarāṇas tmanā deveṣu / agnir havyaṁ śamitā sūdayāti //

Sentence: 4=m agne svāhā kṛṇuhi jātaveda indrāya havyam / viśve devā havir idam juṣantām //

Sentence: 5=n hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sam avartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patir eka āsīt / sa dādhāra pṛthivīm dyām //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 utemām kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 2=o yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika id rājā jagato babhūva / ya īśe asya dvipadaś catuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 3=p ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣam yasya devāḥ / yasya chāyāmṛtam yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 4=q yasyeme hima vanto mahitvā yasya samudraṁ rasayā saha //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 āhuḥ / yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya baviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 2=r yam krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhyaikṣetām manasā rejamāne / yatrādhi sūra uditau vyeti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 3=s yena dyaur ugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḍhe yena suva stabhitam yena nākaḥ / yo antarikṣe rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 4=t āpo ha yan mahatīr viśvam //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 āyan dakṣam dadhānā janayantīr agnim / tato devānām nir avartatāsur ekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 2=u yaś cid āpo mahinā paryapaśyad dakṣam dadhānā janayantīr agnim / yo deveṣv adhi deva eka āsīt kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ākūtim agnim prayujaṁ svāhā mano medhām agnim prayujaṁ svāhā cittam vijñātam agnim prayujaṁ svāhā vāco vidhṛtim agnim prayujaṁ svāhā prajāpataye manave svāhāgnaye vaiśvānarāya svāhā

Sentence: 2=b viśve devasya netur marto vṛṇīta sakhyam viśve rāya iṣudhyasi dyumnam vṛṇīta puṣyase svāhā

Sentence: 3=c mā su bhitthā mā su riṣo dṛṁhasva vīḍayasva su / amba dhṛṣṇu vīrayasva //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 agniś cedam kariṣyathaḥ //

Sentence: 2=d dṛṁhasva devi pṛthivi svastaya āsurī māyā svadhayā kṛtāsi / juṣṭam devānām idam astu havyam ariṣṭā tvam ud ihi yajñe asmin //

Sentence: 3=e mitraitām ukhām tapaiṣā mā bhedi /

Sentence: 4=f etām te pari dadāmy abhittyai /

Sentence: 5=g drvannaḥ sarpirāsutiḥ pratno hotā vareṇyaḥ / sahasas putro adbhutaḥ //

Sentence: 6=h parasyā adhi samvato ‘varāṁ abhy ā //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 tara / yatrāham asmi tāṁ ava //

Sentence: 2=i paramasyāḥ parāvato rhidaśva ihā gahi / purīṣyaḥ purupriyo ‘gne tvam tarā mṛdhaḥ //

Sentence: 3=k sīda tvam mātur asyā upasthe viśvāny agne vayunāni vidvān / mainām arciṣā mā tapasābhi śūśuco ‘ntar asyāṁ śukrajyotir vi bhāhi //

Sentence: 4=l antar agne rucā tvam ukhāyai sadane sve / tasyās tvaṁ harasā tapaṅ jātavedaḥ śivo bhava //

Sentence: 5=m śivo bhūtvā mahyam agne ‘tho sīda śivas tvam / śivāḥ kṛtvā diśaḥ sarvāḥ svām yonim ihāsadaḥ //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a yad agne yāni kāni cā te dārūṇi dadhmasi / tad astu tubhyam id ghṛtam taj juṣasva yaviṣṭhya //

Sentence: 2=b yad atty upajihvikā yad vamro atisarpati / sarvam tad astu te ghṛtam taj juṣasva yaviṣṭhya //

Sentence: 3=c rātriṁrātrim aprayāvam bharatno ‘śvāyeva tiṣṭhate ghāsam asmai / rāyas poṣeṇa sam iṣā madanto ‘gne mā te prativeśā riṣāma //

Sentence: 4=d nābhā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pṛthivyāḥ samidhānam agniṁ rāyas poṣāya bṛhate havāmahe / irammadam bṛhaduktham yajatram jetāram agnim pṛtanāsu sāsahim //

Sentence: 2=e yāḥ senā abhītvarīr āvyādhinīr ugaṇā uta / ye stenā ye ca taskarās tāṁs te agne ‘pi dadhāmy āsyṝ //

Sentence: 3=f daṁṣṭrābhyām malimlūñ jambhyais taskarāṁ uta / hanūbhyāṁ stenān bhagavas tāṁs tvam khāda sukhāditān //

Sentence: 4=g ye janeṣu malimlava stenāsas taskarā vane / ye //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 kakṣeṣv aghāyavas tāṁs te dadhāmi jambhayoḥ //

Sentence: 2=h yo asmabhyam arātīyād yaś ca no dveṣate janaḥ / nindād yo asmān dipsāc ca sarvam tam masmasā kuru //

Sentence: 3=i saṁśitam me brahma saṁśitam vīryam balam / saṁśitam kṣatram jiṣṇu yasyāham asmi purohitaḥ //

Sentence: 4=k ud eṣām bāhū atiram ud varca ud ū balam / kṣiṇomi brahmaṇāmitrān un nayāmi //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 svāṁ aham /

Sentence: 2=l dṛśāno rukma urvyā vy adyaud durmarṣam āyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ / agnir amṛto abhavad vayobhir yad enam dyaur ajanayat suretāḥ //

Sentence: 3=m viśvā rūpāṇi prati muñcate kaviḥ prāsāvīd bhadram dvipade catuṣpade / vi nākam akhyat savitā vareṇyo ‘nu prayāṇam uṣaso vi rājati //

Sentence: 4=n naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśum ekaṁ samīcī / dyāvā kṣāmā rukmaḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 antar vi bhāti devā agnim dhārayan draviṇodāḥ //

Sentence: 2=o suparṇo ‘si garutmān trivṛt te śiro gāyatram cakṣu stoma ātmā sāma te tanūr vāmadevyam bṛhadrathantare pakṣau yajñāyajñiyam pucham chandāṁsy aṅgāni dhiṣṇiyāḥ śaphā yajūṁṣi nāma /

Sentence: 3=p suparṇo ‘si garutmān divam gacha suvaḥ pata //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a agne yam yajñam adhvaram viśvataḥ paribhūr asi / sa id deveṣu gachati //

Sentence: 2=b soma yās te mayobhuva ūtayaḥ santi dāśuṣe / tābhir no ‘vitā bhava //

Sentence: 3=c agnir mūrdhā

Sentence: 4=d bhuvaḥ /

Sentence: 5=e tvam naḥ soma

Sentence: 6=f yā te dhāmāni /

Sentence: 7=g tat savitur vareṇyam bhargo devasya dhīmahi / dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt //

Sentence: 8=h acittī yac cakṛmā daivye jane dīnair dakṣaiḥ prabhūtī pūruṣatvatā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 deveṣu ca savitar mānuṣeṣu ca tvam no atra suvatād anāgasaḥ //

Sentence: 2=i codayitrī sūnṛtānām cetantī sumatīnām / yajñam dadhe sarasvatī //

Sentence: 3=k pāvīravī kanyā citrāyuḥ sarasvatī vīrapatnī dhiyam dhāt / gnābhir achidraṁ śaraṇaṁ sajoṣā durādharṣam gṛṇate śarma yaṁsat //

Sentence: 4=l pūṣā gā anv etu naḥ pūṣā rakṣatv arvataḥ / pūṣā vājaṁ sanotu naḥ //

Sentence: 5=m śukram te anyad yajatam te anyat //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 viṣurūpe ahanī dyaur ivāsi / viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvo bhadrā te pūṣann iha rātir astu //

Sentence: 2=n tṝ ‘vardhanta svatavaso mahitvanā nākam tasthur uru cakrire sadaḥ / viṣṇur yad dhāvad vṛṣaṇam madacyutam vayo na sīdann adhi barhiṣi priye /

Sentence: 3=o pra citram arkam gṛṇate turāya mārutāya svatavase bharadhvam / ye sahāṁsi sahasā sahante //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 rejate agne pṛthivī makhebhyaḥ //

Sentence: 2=p viśve devās \\

Sentence: 3=q viśve devāḥ /

Sentence: 4=r dyāvā naḥ pṛthivī imaṁ sidhram adya divispṛśam / yajñam deveṣu yachatām //

Sentence: 5=s pra pūrvaje pitarā navyasībhir gīrbhiḥ kṛṇudhvaṁ sadane ṛtasya / ā no dyāvāpṛthivī daivyena janena yātam mahi vām varūtham //

Sentence: 6=t agniṁ stomena bodhaya samidhāno amartyam / havyā deveṣu no dadhat //

Sentence: 7=u sa havyavāḍ amartya uśig dūtaś canohitaḥ / agnir dhiyā sam ṛṇvati //

Sentence: 8=v śam no bhavantu

Sentence: 9=w vājevāje //

## Chapter: 2

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a viṣṇoḥ kramo ‘sy abhimātihā gāyatram chanda ā roha pṛthivīm anu vi kramasva nirbhaktaḥ sa yam dviṣmo viṣṇoḥ kramo ‘sy abhiśastihā traiṣṭubham chanda ā rohāntarikṣam anu vi kramasva nirbhaktaḥ sa yam dviṣmo viṣṇoḥ kramo ‘sy arātīyato hantā jāgatam chanda ā roha divam anu vi kramasva nirbhaktaḥ sa yam dviṣmo viṣṇoḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 kramo ‘si śatrūyato hantānuṣṭubham chanda ā roha diśo ‘nu vi kramasva nirbhaktaḥ sa yam dviṣmaḥ /

Sentence: 2=b akrandad agni stanayann iva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihad vīrudhaḥ samañjan / sadyo jajñāno vi hīm iddho akhyad ā rodasī bhānunā bhāty antaḥ //

Sentence: 3=c agne ‘bhyāvartinn abhi na ā vartasvāyuṣā varcasā sanyā medhayā prajayā dhanena //

Sentence: 4=d agne //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 aṅgiraḥ śatam te santv āvṛtaḥ sahasram ta upāvṛtaḥ / tāsām poṣasya poṣeṇa punar no naṣṭam ā kṛdhi punar no rayim ākṛdhi //

Sentence: 2=e punar ūrjā ni vartasva punar agna iṣāyuṣā / punar naḥ pāhi viśvataḥ //

Sentence: 3=f saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā / viśvapsniyā viśvatas pari //

Sentence: 4=g ud uttamam varuṇa pāśam asmad avādhamam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vi madhyamaṁ śrathāya / athā vayam āditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma //

Sentence: 2=h ā tvāhārṣam antar abhūr dhruvas tiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ / viśas tvā sarvā vāñchantv asmin rāṣṭram adhi śraya //

Sentence: 3=i agre bṛhann uṣasām ūrdhvo asthān nirjagmivān tamaso jyotiṣāgāt / agnir bhānunā ruśatā svaṅga ā jāto viśvā sadmāny aprāḥ //

Sentence: 4=k sīda tvam mātur asyāḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 upasthe viśvāny agne vayunāni vidvān / mainām arciṣā mā tapasābhi śūśuco ‘ntar asyāṁ śukrajyotir vi bhāhi //

Sentence: 2=l antar agne rucā tvam ukhāyai sadane sve / tasyās tvaṁ harasā tapañ jātavedaḥ śivo bhava //

Sentence: 3=m śivo bhūtvā mahyam agne ‘tho sīda śivas tvam / śivāḥ kṛtvā diśaḥ sarvāḥ svām yonim ihāsadaḥ //

Sentence: 4=n haṁsaḥ śuciṣad vasur antarikṣasad dhotā vediṣad atithir duroṇasat / nṛṣad varasad vyomasad abjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtam bṛhat //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a divas pari prathamam jajñe agnir asmad dvitīyam pari jātavedāḥ / tṛtīyam apsu nṛmaṇā ajasram indhāna enam jarate svādhīḥ //

Sentence: 2=b vidmā te agne tredhā trayāṇi vidmā te sadma vibhṛtam purutrā / vidmā te nāma paramam guhā yad vidmā tam utsam yata ājagantha //

Sentence: 3=c samudre tvā nṛmaṇā apsv antar nṛcakṣā īdhe divo agna ūdhan / tṛtīye tvā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 rajasi tasthivāṁsam ṛtasya yonau mahiṣā ahinvan //

Sentence: 2=d akrandad agni stanayann iva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihad vīrudhaḥ samañjan / sadyo jajñāno vi hīm iddho akhyad ā rodasī bhānunā bhāty antaḥ //

Sentence: 3=e uśik pāvako aratiḥ sumedhā marteṣv agnir amṛto nidhāyi / iyarti dhūmam aruṣam bharibhrad uc chukreṇa śociṣā dyām inakṣat //

Sentence: 4=f viśvasya ketur bhuvanasya garbha ā //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 rodasī apṛṇāj jāyamānaḥ / vīḍum cid adrim abhinat parāyañ janā yad agnim ayajanta pañca //

Sentence: 2=g śrīṇām udāro dharuṇo rayīṇām mahīṣāṇām prārpaṇaḥ somagopāḥ / vasoḥ sūnuḥ sahaso apsu rājā vi bhāty agra uṣasām idhānaḥ //

Sentence: 3=h yas te adya kṛṇavad bhadraśoce ‘pūpam deva ghṛtavantam agne / pra tam naya pratarām vasyo achābhi dyumnam devabhaktam yaviṣṭha //

Sentence: 4=i ā //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 tam bhaja sauśravaseṣv agna ukthauktha ā bhaja śasyamāne / priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavāty uj jātena bhinadad uj janitvaiḥ //

Sentence: 2=k tvām agne yajamānā anu dyūn viśvā vasūni dadhire vāryāṇi / tvayā saha draviṇam ichamānā vrajam gomantam uśijo vi vavruḥ //

Sentence: 3=l dṛśāno rukma urvyā vy adyaud durmarṣam āyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ / agnir amṛto abhavad vayobhir yad enam dyaur ajanayat suretāḥ //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a annapate ‘nnasya no dehy anamīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ / pra pradātāram tāriṣa ūrjam no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade //

Sentence: 2=b ud u tvā viśve devā agne bharantu cittibhiḥ / sa no bhava śivatamaḥ supratīko vibhāvasuḥ //

Sentence: 3=c pred agne jyotiṣmān yāhi śivebhir arcibhis tvam / bṛhadbhir bhānubhir bhāsan mā hiṁsīs tanuvā prajāḥ //

Sentence: 4=d samidhāgnim duvasyata ghṛtair bodhayatātithim / ā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 asmin havyā juhotana //

Sentence: 2=e praprāyam agnir bharatasya śṛṇve vi yat sūryo na rocate bṛhad bhāḥ / abhi yaḥ pūrum pṛtanāsu tasthau dīdāya daivyo atithiḥ śivo naḥ //

Sentence: 3=f āpo devīḥ prati gṛhṇīta bhasmaitat syone kṛṇudhvaṁ surabhāv u loke / tasmai namantām janayaḥ supatnīr māteva putram bibhṛtā sv ṝnam //

Sentence: 4=g apsv agne sadhiṣ ṭava //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 sauṣadhīr anu rudhyase / garbhe sañ jāyase punaḥ //

Sentence: 2=h garbho asy oṣadhīnām garbho vanaspatīnām / garbho viśvasya bhūtasyāgne garbho apām asi //

Sentence: 3=i prasadya bhasmanā yonim apaś ca pṛthivīm agne / saṁsṛjya mātṛbhis tvam jyotiṣmān punar āsadaḥ //

Sentence: 4=k punar āsadya sadanam apaś ca pṛthivīm agne / śeṣe mātur yathopasthe ‘ntar asyāṁ śivatamaḥ //

Sentence: 5=l punar ūrjā //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ni vartasva punar agna iṣāyuṣā / punar naḥ pāhi viśvataḥ //

Sentence: 2=m saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā / viśvapsniyā viśvatas pari //

Sentence: 3=n punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sam indhatām punar brahmāṇo vasunītha yajñaiḥ / ghṛtena tvam tanuvo vardhayasva satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ //

Sentence: 4=o bodhā no asya vacaso yaviṣṭha maṁhiṣṭhasya prabhṛtasya svadhāvaḥ / pīyati tvo anu tvo gṛṇāti vandārus te tanuvam vande agne //

Sentence: 5=p sa bodhi sūrir maghavā vasudāvā vasupatiḥ / yuyodhy asmad dveṣāṁsi //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto ye ‘tra stha purāṇā ye ca nūtanāḥ / adād idam yamo ‘vasānam pṛthivyā akrann imam pitaro lokam asmai //

Sentence: 2=b agner bhasmāsy agneḥ purīṣam asi

Sentence: 3=c samjñānam asi kāmadharaṇam mayi te kāmadharaṇam bhūyāt

Sentence: 4=d sam yā vaḥ priyās tanuvaḥ sam priyā hṛdayāni vaḥ / ātmā vo astu //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 sampriyaḥ sampriyās tanuvo mama //

Sentence: 2=e ayaṁ so agnir yasmint somam indraḥ sutam dadhe jaṭhare vāvaśānaḥ / sahasriyam vājam atyam na saptiṁ sasavānt sant stūyase jātavedaḥ //

Sentence: 3=f agne divo arṇam achā jigāsy achā devāṁ ūciṣe dhiṣṇiyā ye / yāḥ parastād rocane sūryasya yāś cāvastād upatiṣṭhanta āpaḥ //

Sentence: 4=g agne yat te divi varcaḥ pṛthivyām yad oṣadhīṣu //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 apsu vā yajatra / yenāntarikṣam urv ātatantha tveṣaḥ sa bhānur arṇavo nṛcakṣāḥ //

Sentence: 2=h purīṣyāso agnayaḥ prāvaṇebhiḥ sajoṣasaḥ / juṣantāṁ havyam āhutam anamīvā iṣo mahīḥ //

Sentence: 3=i iḍām agne purudaṁsaṁ sanim goḥ śaśvattamaṁ havamānāya sādha / syān naḥ sunus tanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatir bhūtv asme //

Sentence: 4=k ayam te yonir ṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ / tam jānan //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 agna ā rohāthā no vardhayā rayim //

Sentence: 2=l cid asi tayā devatayāṅgiravad dhruvā sīda

Sentence: 3=m paricid asi tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda

Sentence: 4=n lokam pṛṇa chidram pṛṇātho sīda śivā tvam / indrāgnī tvā bṛhaspatir asmin yonāv asīṣadan //

Sentence: 5=o tā asya sūdadohasaḥ somaṁ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ / janman devānām viśas triṣv ā rocane divaḥ //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a sam itaṁ sam kalpethāṁ sampriyau rociṣṇū sumanasyamānau / iṣam ūrjam abhi samvasānau śam vām manāṁsi sam vratā sam u cittāny ākaram //

Sentence: 2=b agne purīṣyādhipā bhavā tvam naḥ / iṣam ūrjam yajamānāya dhehi //

Sentence: 3=c purīṣyas tvam agne rayimān puṣṭimāṁ asi / śivāḥ kṛtvā diśaḥ sarvāḥ svām yonim ihāsadaḥ //

Sentence: 4=d bhavatam naḥ samanasau samokasau //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 arepasau / mā yajñaṁ hiṁsiṣṭam mā yajñapatim jātavedasau śivau bhavatam adya naḥ //

Sentence: 2=e māteva putram pṛthivī purīṣyam agniṁ sve yonāv abhār ukhā / tām viśvair devair ṛtubhiḥ samvidānaḥ prajāpatir viśvakarmā vi muñcatu //

Sentence: 3=f yad asya pāre rajasaḥ śukram jyotir ajāyata / tan naḥ parṣad ati dviśo ‘gne vaiśvānara svāhā //

Sentence: 4=g namaḥ su te nirṛte viśvarūpe //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ayasmayam vi cṛtā bandham etam / yamena tvam yamyā samvidānottamam nākam adhi rohayemam //

Sentence: 2=h yat te devī nirṛtir ābabandha dāma grīvāsv avicartyam / idam te tad vi ṣyāmy āyuṣo na madhyād athā jīvaḥ pitum addhi pramuktaḥ //

Sentence: 3=i yasyās te asyāḥ krūra āsañ juhomy eṣām bandhānām avasarjanāya / bhūmir iti tvā janā vidur nirṛtiḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 iti tvāham pari veda viśvataḥ //

Sentence: 2=k asunvantam ayajamānam icha stenasyetyām taskarasyānv eṣi / anyam asmad icha ṣa ta ityā namo devi nirṛte tubhyam astu //

Sentence: 3=l devīm aham nirṛtim vandamānaḥ piteva putram dasaye vacobhiḥ / viśvasya yā jāyamānasya veda śiraḥśiraḥ prati sūrī vi caṣṭe //

Sentence: 4=m niveśanaḥ samgamano vasūnām viśvā rūpābhi caṣṭe //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 śacībhiḥ / deva iva savitā satyadharmendro na tasthau samare pathīnām //

Sentence: 2=n sam varatrā dadhātana nir āhāvān kṛṇotana / siñcāmahā avaṭam udriṇam vayam viśvāhādastam akṣitam //

Sentence: 3=o niṣkṛtāhāvam avaṭaṁ suvaratraṁ suṣecanam / udriṇaṁ siñce akṣitam //

Sentence: 4=p sīrā yuñjanti kavayo yugā vi tanvate pṛthak / dhīrā deveṣu sumnayā

Sentence: 5=q yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanota kṛte yonau vapateha //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 bījam / girā ca śruṣṭiḥ sabharā asan no nedīya it sṛṇyā pakvam āyat //

Sentence: 2=r lāṅgalam pavīravaṁ suśevaṁ sumatitsaru / ud it kṛṣati gām avim prapharvayam ca pīvarīm / prasthāvad rathavāhanam //

Sentence: 3=s śunam naḥ phālā vi tudantu bhūmiṁ śunam kīnāśā abhi yantu vāhān / śunam parjanyo madhunā payobhiḥ śunāsīrā śunam asmāsu dhattam //

Sentence: 4=t kāmam kāmadughe dhukṣva mitrāya varuṇāya ca / indrāyāgnaye pūṣṇa oṣadhībhyaḥ prajābhyaḥ //

Sentence: 5=u ghṛtena sītā madhunā samaktā viśvair devair anumatā marudbhiḥ / ūrjasvatī payasā pinvamānāsmānt sīte payasābhyāvavṛtsva //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a yā jātā oṣadhayo devebhyas triyugam purā / mandāmi babhrūṇām ahaṁ śatam dhāmāni sapta ca //

Sentence: 2=b śatam vo amba dhāmāni sahasram uta vo ruhaḥ / athā śatakratvo yūyam imam me agadam kṛta //

Sentence: 3=c puṣpāvatīḥ prasūvatīḥ phalinīr aphalā uta / aśvā iva sajitvarīr vīrudhaḥ pārayiṣṇavaḥ //

Sentence: 4=d oṣadhīr iti mātaras tad vo devīr upa bruve / rapāṁsi vighnatīr ita rapaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 cātayamānāḥ //

Sentence: 2=e aśvatthe vo niṣadanam parṇe vo vasatiḥ kṛtā / gobhāja it kilāsatha yat sanavatha pūruṣam //

Sentence: 3=f yad aham vājayann imā oṣadhīr hasta ādadhe / ātmā yakṣmasya naśyati purā jīvagṛbho yathā //

Sentence: 4=g yad oṣadhayaḥ samgachante rājānaḥ samitāv iva / vipraḥ sa ucyate bhiṣag rakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ //

Sentence: 5=h niṣkṛtir nāma vo mātāthā yūyaṁ stha samkṛtīḥ / sarāḥ patatriṇīḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 sthana yad āmayati niṣ kṛta //

Sentence: 2=i anyā vo anyām avatv anyānyasyā upāvata / tāḥ sarvā oṣadhayaḥ samvidānā idam me prāvatā vacaḥ //

Sentence: 3=k uc chuṣmā oṣadhīnām gāvo goṣṭhād iverate / dhanaṁ saniṣyantīnām ātmānam tava pūruṣa //

Sentence: 4=l ati viśvāḥ pariṣṭhā stena iva vrajam akramuḥ / oṣadhayaḥ prācucyavur yat kim ca tanuvāṁ rapaḥ //

Sentence: 5=m yāḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ta ātasthur ātmānam yā āviviśuḥ paruḥparuḥ / tās te yakṣmam vi bādhantām ugro madhyamaśīr iva //

Sentence: 2=n sākam yakṣma pra pata śyenena kikidīvinā / sākam vātasya dhrājyā sākam naśya nihākayā //

Sentence: 3=o aśvāvatīṁ somavatīm ūrjayantīm udojasam / ā vitsi sarvā oṣadhīr asmā ariṣṭatātaye //

Sentence: 4=p yāḥ phalinīr yā aphalā apuṣpā yāś ca puṣpiṇīḥ / bṛhaspatiprasūtās tā no muñcantv aṁhasaḥ //

Sentence: 5=q yāḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 oṣadhayaḥ somarājñīḥ praviṣṭāḥ pṛthivīm anu / tāsām tvam asy uttamā pra ṇo jīvātave suva //

Sentence: 2=r avapatantīr avadan diva oṣadhayaḥ pari / yam jīvam aśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ //

Sentence: 3=s yāś cedam upaśṛṇvanti yāś ca dūram parāgatāḥ / iha samgatya tāḥ sarvā asmai sam datta bheṣajam //

Sentence: 4=t mā vo riṣat khanitā yasmai cāham khanāmi vaḥ / dvipac catuṣpad asmākaṁ sarvam astv anāturam //

Sentence: 5=u oṣadhayaḥ sam vadante somena saha rājñā / yasmai karoti brāhmaṇas taṁ rājan pārayāmasi //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a mā no hiṁsīj janitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṁ satyadharmā jajāna / yaś cāpaś candrā bṛhatīr jajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 2=b abhyāvartasva pṛthivi yajñena payasā saha / vapām te agnir iṣito ‘va sarpatu //

Sentence: 3=c agne yat te śukram yac candram yat pūtam yad yajñiyam / tad devebhyo bharāmasi //

Sentence: 4=d iṣam ūrjam aham ita ā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 dada ṛtasya dhāmno amṛtasya yoneḥ / ā no goṣu viśatv auṣadhīṣu jahāmi sedim anirām amīvām //

Sentence: 2=e agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājanty arcayo vibhāvaso / bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājam ukthyam dadhāsi dāsuṣe kave //

Sentence: 3=f irajyann agne prathayasva jantubhir asme rāyo amartya / sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṁ rayim //

Sentence: 4=g ūrjo napāj jātavedaḥ suśastibhir mandasva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 dhītibhir hitaḥ / tve iṣaḥ sam dadhur bhūriretasaś citrotayo vāmajātāḥ //

Sentence: 2=h pāvakavarcāḥ śukravarcā anūnavarcā ud iyarṣi bhānunā / putraḥ pitarā vicarann upāvasy ubhe pṛṇakṣi rodasī //

Sentence: 3=i ṛtāvānam mahiṣam viśvacarṣaṇim agniṁ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ / śrutkarṇaṁ saprathastamam tvā girā daivyam mānuṣā yugā //

Sentence: 4=k niṣkartāram adhvarasya pracetasam kṣayantaṁ rādhase mahe / rātim bhṛgūṇām uśijam kavikratum pṛṇakṣi sānasim //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 rayim //

Sentence: 2=l cita stha paricita ūrdhvacitaḥ śrayadhvam tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvāḥ sīdata //

Sentence: 3=m ā pyāyasva sam etu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇiyam / bhavā vājasya samgathe //

Sentence: 4=n sam te payāṁsi sam u yantu vājāḥ sam vṛṣṇiyāny abhimātiṣāhaḥ / āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravānsy uttamāni dhiṣva //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a abhy asthād viśvāḥ pṛtanā arātīs tad agnir āha tad u soma āha / bṛhaspatiḥ savitā tan ma āha puṣā mādhāt sukṛtasya loke //

Sentence: 2=b yad akrandaḥ prathamam jāyamāna udyant samudrād uta vā purīṣāt / śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutam janima tat te arvan //

Sentence: 3=c apām pṛṣṭham asi yonir agneḥ samudram abhitaḥ pinvamānam / vardhamānam mahaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ā ca puṣkaram divo mātrayā varṇā prathasva //

Sentence: 2=d brahma jajñānam prathamam purastād vi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ / sa budhniyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataś ca yonim asataś ca vivaḥ //

Sentence: 3=e hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sam avartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patir eka āsīt / sa dādhāra pṛthivīm dyām utemām kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 4=f drapsaś caskanda pṛthivīm anu //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 dyām imam ca yonim anu yaś ca pūrvaḥ / tṛtīyam yonim anu samcarantam drapsam juhomy anu sapta hotrāḥ //

Sentence: 2=g namo astu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivīm anu / ye antarikṣe ye divi tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ //

Sentence: 3=h yṝ ‘do rocane divo ye vā sūryasya raśmiṣu / yeṣām apsu sadaḥ kṛtam tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ //

Sentence: 4=i yā iṣavo yātudhānānām ye vā vanaspatīṁr anu / ye vāvaṭeṣu śerate tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a dhruvāsi dharuṇāstṛtā viśvakarmaṇā sukritā / mā tvā samudra ud vadhīn mā suparṇo ‘vyathamānā pṛthivīm dṛṁha //

Sentence: 2=b prajāpatis tvā sādayatu pṛthivyāḥ pṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīm prathasvatīm pratho ‘si pṛthivy asi bhūr asi bhūmir asy aditir asi viśvadhāyā viśvasya bhuvanasya dhartrī pṛthivīm yacha pṛthivīm dṛṁha pṛthivīm mā hiṁsīr viśvasmai prāṇāya vyānāyodānāya pratiṣṭhāyai //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 caritrāyāgnis tvābhi pātu mahyā svastyā chardiṣā śamtamena tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda

Sentence: 2=c kāṇḍātkāṇḍāt prarohantī paruṣaḥparuṣaḥ pari / evā no dūrve pra tanu sahasreṇa śatena ca //

Sentence: 3=d yā śatena pratanoṣi sahasreṇa virohasi tasyās te devīṣṭake vidhema haviṣā vayam //

Sentence: 4=e aṣāḍhāsi sahamānā sahasvārātīḥ sahasvārātīyataḥ

Sentence: 5=f sahasva pṛtanāḥ sahasva pṛtanyataḥ sahasravīryā //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 asi sā mā jinva //

Sentence: 2=g madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ / mādhvīr naḥ santv oṣadhīḥ //

Sentence: 3=h madhu naktam utoṣasi madhumat pārthivaṁ rajaḥ / madhu dyaur astu naḥ pitā //

Sentence: 4=i madhumān no vanaspatir madhumāṁ astu sūryaḥ / mādhvīr gāvo bhavantu naḥ //

Sentence: 5=k mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imam yajñam mimikṣatām / pipṛtām no bharīmabhiḥ //

Sentence: 6=l tad viṣṇoḥ paramam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 padaṁ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ / divīva cakṣur ātatam //

Sentence: 2=m dhruvāsi pṛthivi sahasva pṛtanyataḥ / syūtā devebhir amṛtenāgāḥ //

Sentence: 3=n yās te agne sūrye ruca udyato divam ātanvanti raśmibhiḥ / tābhiḥ sarvābhī ruce janāya nas kṛdhi //

Sentence: 4=o yā vo devāḥ sūrye ruco goṣv aśveṣu yā rucaḥ / indrāgnī tābhiḥ sarvābhī rucam no dhatta bṛhaspate

Sentence: 5=p virāṭ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 jyotir adhārayat samrāḍ jyotir adhārayat svarāḍ jyotir adhārayat

Sentence: 2=q agne yukṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhavaḥ / aram vahanty āśavaḥ //

Sentence: 3=r yukṣvā hi devahūtamāṁ aśvāṁ agne rathīr iva / ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ //

Sentence: 4=s drapsaś caskanda pṛthivīm anu dyām imam ca yonim anu yaś ca pūrvaḥ / tṛtīyam yonim anu samcarantam drapsam juhomy anu sapta //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 hotrāḥ //

Sentence: 2=t abhūd idam viśvasya bhuvanasya vājinam agner vaiśvānarasya ca / agnir jyotiṣā jyotiṣmān rukmo varcasā varcasvān //

Sentence: 3=u ṛce tvā ruce tvā

Sentence: 4=v sam it sravanti sarito na dhenāḥ / antar hṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ / ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi / hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām //

Sentence: 5=w tasmint suparṇo madhukṛt kulāyī bhajann āste madhu devatābhyaḥ / tasyāsate harayaḥ sapta tīre svadhām duhānā amṛtasya dhārām //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ādityam garbham payasā samañjant sahasrasya pratimām viśvarūpam / pari vṛṅgdhi harasā mābhi mṛkṣaḥ śatāyuṣam kṛṇuhi cīyamānaḥ //

Sentence: 2=b imam mā hiṁsīr dvipādam paśūnāṁ sahasrākṣa medha ā cīyamānaḥ / mayum āraṇyam anu te diśāmi tena cinvānas tanuvo ni ṣīda //

Sentence: 3=c vātasya dhrājim varuṇasya nābhim aśvam jajñānaṁ sarirasya madhye / śiśum nadīnāṁ harim adribuddham agne mā hiṁsīḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 parame vyoman //

Sentence: 2=d imam mā hiṁsīr ekaśapham paśūnām kanikradam vājinam vājineṣu / gauram āraṇyam anu te diśāmi tena cinvānas tanuvo ni ṣīda //

Sentence: 3=e ajasram indum aruṣam bhuraṇyum agnim īḍe pūrvacittau namobhiḥ / sa parvabhir ṛtuśaḥ kalpamāno gām mā hiṁsīr aditim virājam //

Sentence: 4=f imaṁ samudraṁ śatadhāram utsam vyacyamānam bhuvanasya madhye / ghṛtam duhānām aditim janāyāgne mā //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 hiṁsīḥ parame vyoman / gavayam āraṇyam anu te diśāmi tena cinvānas tanuvo ni ṣīda //

Sentence: 2=g varūtrim tvaṣṭur varuṇasya nābhim avim jajñānāṁ rajasaḥ parasmāt / mahīṁ sahasrīm asurasya mayām agne mā hiṁsīḥ parame vyoman //

Sentence: 3=h imām ūrṇāyum varuṇasya māyām tvacam paśūnām dvipadām catuṣpadām / tvaṣṭuḥ prajānām prathamam janitram agne mā hiṁsīḥ parame vyoman / uṣṭram āraṇyam anu //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 te diśāmi tena cinvānas tanuvo ni ṣīda //

Sentence: 2=i yo agnir agnes tapaso ‘dhi jātaḥ śocāt pṛthivyā uta vā divas pari / yena prajā viśvakarmā vyānaṭ tam agne heḍaḥ pari te vṛṇaktu //

Sentence: 3=k ajā hy agner ajaniṣṭa garbhāt sā vā apaśyaj janitāram agre / tayā roham āyann upa medhyāsaḥ tayā devā devatām agra āyan / śarabham āraṇyam ānu te diśāmi tena cinvānas tanuvo ni ṣīda //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ pari vājeṣu bhūṣathaḥ / tad vām ceti pra rīvyam //

Sentence: 2=b śnathad vṛtram uta sanoti vājam indrā yo agnī sahurī saparyāt / irajyantā vasavyasya bhūreḥ sahastamā sahasā vājayantā //

Sentence: 3=c pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ pṛtanā haveṣu pra pṛthivyā riricāthe divaś ca / pra sindhubhyaḥ pra giribhyo mahitvā prendrāgnī viśvā bhuvanāty anyā //

Sentence: 4=d maruto yasya hi //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ / sa sugopātamo janaḥ //

Sentence: 2=e yajñair vā yajñavāhaso viprasya vā matīnām / marutaḥ śriṇutā havam //

Sentence: 3=f śriyase kam bhānubhiḥ sam mimikṣire te raśmibhis ta ṛkvabhiḥ sukhādayaḥ / te vāśīmanta iṣmiṇo abhīravo vidre priyasya mārutasya dhāmnaḥ //

Sentence: 4=g ava te heḍa

Sentence: 5=h ud uttamam /

Sentence: 6=i kayā naś citra ā bhuvad ūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā / kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1=k ko adya yuṅkte dhuri gā ṛtasya śimīvato bhāmino durhṛṇāyūn / āsanniṣūn hṛtsvaso mayobhūn ya eṣām bhṛtyām ṛṇadhat sa jīvāt //

Sentence: 2=l agne naya \\

Sentence: 3=m ā devānām \\

Sentence: 4=n śam no bhavantu

Sentence: 5=o vājevāje

Sentence: 6=p apsv agne sadhiṣ ṭava sauṣadhīr anu rudhyase garbhe sañ jāyase punaḥ //

Sentence: 7=q vṛṣā soma dyumāṁ asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ / vṛṣā dharmāṇi dadhiṣe //

Sentence: 8=r imam me varuṇa

Sentence: 9=s tat tvā yāmi

Sentence: 10=t tvam no agne

Sentence: 11=u sa tvam no agne //

## Chapter: 3

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a apām tvemant sādayāmy apām tvodmant sādayāmy apām tvā bhasmant sādayāmy apām tvā jyotiṣi sādayāmy apām tvāyane sādayāmi \\

Sentence: 2=b arṇave sadane sīda samudre sadane sīda salile sadane sīdāpām kṣaye sīdāpāṁ sadhiṣi sīda \\

Sentence: 3=c apām tvā sadane sādayāmy apām tvā sadhasthe sādayāmy apām tvā purīṣe sādayāmy apām tvā yonau sādayāmy apām tvā pāthasi sādayāmi

Sentence: 4=d gāyatrī chandas triṣṭup chando jagatī chando ‘nuṣṭup chandaḥ paṅktiś chandaḥ //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ayam puro bhuvas tasya prāṇo bhauvāyano vasantaḥ prāṇāyano gāyatrī vāsantī gāyatriyai gāyatram gāyatrād upāṁśur upāṁśos trivṛt trivṛto rathamtaraṁ rathamtarād vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā prāṇam gṛhṇāmi prajābhyas \\

Sentence: 2=b ayam dakṣiṇā viśvakarmā tasya mano vaiśvakarmaṇam grīṣmo mānasas triṣṭug graiṣmī triṣṭubha aiḍam aiḍād antaryāmo ‘ntaryāmāt pañcadaśaḥ pañcadaśād bṛhad bṛhato bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā manaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 gṛhṇāmi prajābhyas \\

Sentence: 2=c ayam paścād viśvavyācās tasya cakṣur vaiśvavyacasam varṣāṇi cākṣuṣāṇi jagatī vārṣī jagatyā ṛkṣamam ṛkṣamāc chukraḥ śukrāt saptadaśaḥ saptadaśād vairūpam vairūpād viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā cakṣur gṛhnāmi prajābhyas \\

Sentence: 3=d idam uttarāt suvas tasya śrotraṁ sauvaṁ śarac chrautry anuṣtūp śārady anuṣṭubhaḥ svāraṁ svārān manthī manthina ekaviṁśa ekaviṁśād vairājam vairājāj jamadagnir ṛṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 tvayā śrotram gṛhṇāmi prajābhyas \\

Sentence: 2=e iyam upari matis tasyai vāṅ mātī hemanto vācyāyanaḥ paṅktir haimantī paṅktyai nidhanavan nidhanavata āgrayaṇa āgrayaṇāt triṇavatrayastriṁśau triṇavatrayastriṁśābhyāṁ śākvararaivate śākvararaivatābhyām viśvakarmarṣiḥ prajāpatigṛhītayā tvayā vācam gṛhṇāmi pr

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a prācī diśām vasanta ṛtūnām agnir devatā brahma draviṇam trivṛt stomaḥ sa u pañcadaśavartanis tryavir vayaḥ kṛtam ayānām purovāto vātaḥ sānaga ṛṣis \\

Sentence: 2=b daksiṇā diśām grīṣma rtūnām indro devatā kṣatram draviṇam pañcadaśa stomaḥ sa u saptadaśavartanir dityavāḍ vayas tretāyānām dakṣiṇādvāto vātaḥ sanātana ṛṣiḥ

Sentence: 3=c prātīcī diśām varṣā ṛtūnām viśve devā devatā viṭ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 draviṇaṁ saptadaśa stomaḥ su uv ekaviṁśavartanis trivatso vayo dvāparo ‘yānām paścādvāto vāto ‘habhūna ṛṣis \\

Sentence: 2=d udicī diśāṁ śarad ṛtūnām mitrāvaruṇau devatā puṣṭam draviṇam ekaviṁśa stomaḥ sa u triṇavavartanis turyavāḍ vaya āskando ‘yānām uttarādvāto vātaḥ pratna ṛṣis \\

Sentence: 3=e ūrdhvā diśāṁ hemantaśiśirāv ṛtūnām bṛhaspatir devatā varco draviṇam triṇava stomaḥ sa u trayastriṁśavartaniḥ paṣṭhavād vayo ‘bhibhūr ayānām viṣvagvāto vātaḥ suparṇa ṛṣiḥ

Sentence: 4=f pitaraḥ pitāmahāḥ pare ‘vare te naḥ pāntu te no ‘vantv asmin brahmann asmin kṣatrṝ ‘syām āśiṣy asyām purodhāyām asmin karmann asyām devahūtyām //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a dhruvakṣitir dhruvayonir dhruvāsi dhruvām yonim ā sīda sādhyā / ukhyasya ketum prathamam purastād aśvinādhvaryū sādayatām iha tvā //

Sentence: 2=b sve dakṣe dakṣapiteha sīda devatrā pṛthivī bṛhatī rarāṇā / svāsasthā tanuvā sam viśasva pitevaidhi sūnava āsuśevāśvinādhvaryū sādayatām iha tvā //

Sentence: 3=c kulāyinī vasumatī vayodhā rayim no vardha bahulaṁ suvīram //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 apāmatim durmatim bādhamānā rāyas poṣe yajñapatim ābhajantī suvar dhehi yajamānāya poṣam aśvinādhvaryū sādayatām iha tvā //

Sentence: 2=d agneḥ purīṣam asi devayānī tām tvā viśve abhi gṛṇantu devāḥ / stomapṛṣṭhā ghṛtavatīha sīda prajāvad asme draviṇāyajasvāśvinādhvaryū sādayatām iha tvā //

Sentence: 3=e divo mūrdhāsi pṛthivyā nābhir viṣṭambhanī diśām abhipatnī bhuvanānām //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1=a iyam eva sā yā prathamā vyauchad antar asyām carati praviṣṭā / vadhūr jajāna navagaj janitrī traya enām mahimānaḥ sacante //

Sentence: 2=b chandasvatī uṣasā pepiśāne samānam yonim anu samcaratnī / sūryapatnī vi carataḥ prajānatī ketum kṛṇvāne ajare bhūriretasā //

Sentence: 3=c ṛtasya panthām anu tisra āgus trayo gharmāso anu yotiṣāguḥ / prajām ekā rakṣaty ūrjam ekā //

Sentence: 3=e pañcabhir dhātā vi dadhāv idam yat tāsāṁ svasṝr ajanayat pañcapañca / tāsām u yanti prayaveṇa pañca nānā rūpāṇi kratavo vasānāḥ //

Sentence: 4=f triṁśat svasāra upa yanti niṣkṛtaṁ samānam ketum pratimuñcamānāḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 2=g jyotiṣmatī prati muñcate nabho rātrī devī sūryasya vratāni / vi paśyanti paśavo jāyamānā nānārūpā mātur asyā upasthe //

Sentence: 3=h ekāṣṭakā tapasā tapyamānā jajāna garbham mahimānam indram / tena dasyūn vy asahanta devā hantāsurāṇām abhavac chacībhiḥ //

Sentence: 4=i anānujām anujām mām akarta satyam vadanty anv icha etat / bhūyāsam //

Sentence: 1 asya sumatau yathā yūyam anyā vo anyām ati mā pra yukta //

Sentence: 2=k abhūn mama sumatau viśvavedā āṣṭa pratiṣṭhām avidad dhi gādham / bhūyāsam asya sumatau yathā yūyam anyā vo anyām ati mā pra yukta //

Sentence: 3=l pañca vyḥṣṭīr anu pañca dohā gām pañcanāmnīm ṛtavo ‘nu pañca / pañca diśaḥ pañcadaśena kḷptāḥ samānamūrdhnīr abhi lokam ekam //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1=m ṛtasya garbhaḥ prathamā vyūṣuṣy apām ekā mahimānam bibharti / sūryasyaikā carati niṣkṛteṣu gharmasyaikā savitaikām ni yachati //

Sentence: 2=n yā prathamā vyauchat sā dhenur abhavad yame / sā naḥ payasvatī dhukṣvottarāmuttarāṁ samām //

Sentence: 3=o śukrarṣabhā nabhasā jyotiṣāgād viśvarūpā śabalīr agniketuḥ / samānam arthaṁ svapasyamānā bibhratī jarām ajara uṣa āgāḥ //

Sentence: 4=p ṛtūnām patnī prathameyam āgād ahnām netrī janitrī prajānām / ekā satī bahudhoṣo vy ḥchasy ajīrṇā tvam jarayasi sarvam anyat //

Sentence: 2=b sahasā jātān pra ṇudā naḥ sapatnān praty ajātāñ jātavedo nudasva / adhi no brūhi sumanasyamāno vayaṁ syāma pra ṇudā naḥ sapatnān //

Paragraph: 13

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanad draviṇasyur vipanyayā / samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ //

Sentence: 2=b tvaṁ somāsi satpatis tvaṁ rājota vṛtrahā / tvam bhadro asi kratuḥ //

Sentence: 3=c bhadrā te agne svanīka samdṛg ghorasya sato viṣuṇasya cāruḥ / na yat te śocis tamasā varanta na dhvasmānas tanuvi repa ā dhuḥ //

Sentence: 4=d bhadram te agne sahasinn anīkam upāka ā rocate sūryasya //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ruśad dṛśe dadṛśe naktayā cid arūkṣitam dṛśa ā rūpe annam //

Sentence: 2=e sainānīkena suvidatro asme yaṣṭā devāṁ āyajiṣṭhaḥ svasti / adabdho gopā uta naḥ paraspā agne dyumad uta revad didīhi //

Sentence: 3=f svasti no divo agne pṛthivyā viśvāyur dhehi yajathāya deva / yat sīmahi divijāta praśastam tad asmāsu draviṇam dhehi citram //

Sentence: 4=g yathā hotar manuṣaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 devatātā yajñebhiḥ sūno sahaso yajāsi / evāno adya samanā samānān uśann agna uśato yakṣi devān //

Sentence: 2=h agnim īḍe purohitam yajñasya devam ṛtvijam / hotāraṁ ratnadhātamam //

Sentence: 3=i vṛṣā soma dyumāṁ asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ / vṛṣā dharmāṇi dadhiṣe //

Sentence: 4=k sāmtapanā idaṁ havir marutas taj jujuṣṭana / yuṣmākotī riśādasaḥ //

Sentence: 5=l yo no marto vasavo durhṛṇāyus tiraḥ satyāni marutaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 jighāṁsāt / druhaḥ pāśam prati sa mucīṣṭa tapiṣṭhena tapasā hantanā tam //

Sentence: 2=m samvatsarīṇā marutaḥ svarkā urukṣayāḥ sagaṇā mānuṣeṣu / tṝ ‘smat pāśān pra muñcantv aṁhasaḥ sāmtapanā madirā mādayiṣṇavaḥ //

Sentence: 3=n piprīhi devāṁ uśato yaviṣṭha vidvāṁ ṛtūṁr ṛtupate yajeha / ye daivyā ṛtvijas tebhir agne tvaṁ hotṛṇām asy āyajiṣṭhaḥ //

Sentence: 4=o agne yad adya viśo adhvarasya hotaḥ pāvaka //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 śoce veṣ ṭvaṁ hi yajvā / ṛtā yajāsi mahinā vi yad bhūr havyā vaha yaviṣṭha yā te adya //

Sentence: 2=p agninā rayim aśnavat poṣam eva divedive / yaśasam vīravattamam //

Sentence: 3=q gayasphāno amīvahā vasuvit puṣṭivardhanaḥ / sumitraḥ soma no bhava //

Sentence: 4=r gṛhamedhāsa ā gata maruto māpa bhūtana / pramuñcanto no aṁhasaḥ //

Sentence: 5=s pūrvībhir hi dadāśima śaradbhir maruto vayam / mahobhiḥ //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 carṣaṇīnām //

Sentence: 2=t pra budhniyā īrate vo mahāṁsi pra ṇāmāni prayajyavas tiradhvam / sahasriyam damyam bhāgam etam gṛhamedhīyam maruto juṣadhvam //

Sentence: 3=u upa yam eti yuvatiḥ sudakṣam doṣā vastor haviṣmatī ghṛtācī / upa svainam aramatir vasūyuḥ //

Sentence: 4=v imo agne vītatamāni havyājasro vakṣi devatātim acha / prati na īṁ surabhīṇi viyantu

Sentence: 5=w krīḍam vaḥ śardho mārutam anarvāṇaṁ ratheśubham //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 kaṇvā abhi pra gāyata //

Sentence: 2=x atyāso na ye marutaḥ svañco yakṣadṛśo na śubhayanta maryāḥ / te harmyeṣṭhāḥ śiśavo na śubhrā vatsāso na prakrīḍinaḥ payodhāḥ //

Sentence: 3=y praiṣām ajmeṣu vithureva rejate bhūmir yāmeṣu yad dha yuñjate śubhe / te krīḍayo dhunayo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ svayam mahitvam panayanta dhūtayaḥ //

Sentence: 4=z upahvareṣu yad acidhvam yayim vaya iva marutaḥ kena //

Verse: 8

Sentence: 1 cit pathā / ścotanti kośā upa vo ratheṣv ā ghṛtam ukṣatā madhuvarṇam arcate //

Sentence: 2=aa agnimagniṁ havīmabhiḥ sadā havanta viśpatim / havyavāham purupriyam //

Sentence: 3=bb taṁ hi śaśvanta īḍate srucā devam ghṛtaścutā / agniṁ havyāya voḍhave //

Sentence: 5=dd śnathad vṛtram

Sentence: 6=ee indram vo viśvatas pari \\

Sentence: 8=gg viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānas \\

Sentence: 9=hh viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena //

## Chapter: 4

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a raśmir asi kṣayāya tvā kṣayam jinva pretir asi dharmāya tvā dharmam jinvānvitir asi dive tvādivam jinva samdhir asy antarikṣāya tvāntarikṣam jinva pratidhir asi pṛthivyai tvā pṛthivīm jinva viṣṭambho ‘si vṛṣṭyai tvā vṛṣṭim jinva pravāsy ahne tvāhar jinva \\

Sentence: 2=b anuvāsi rātriyai tvā rātrim jinvośig asi //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 vasubhyas tvā vasūñ jinva tantur asi prajābhyas tvā prajā jinva pṛtanāṣāḍ asi paśubhyas tvā paśūñ jinva

Sentence: 2=c revad asy oṣadhībhyas tvauṣadhīr jinvābhijid asi yuktagrāvendrāya tvendram jinvādhipatir asi prāṇāya //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 tvā prāṇam jinva yantāsy apānāya tvāpānam jinva saṁsarpo ‘si cakṣuṣe tvā cakṣur jinva vayodhā asi śrotrāya tvā śrotram jinva trivṛd asi

Sentence: 2=d pravṛd asi samvṛd asi vivṛd asi saṁroho ‘si nīdroho ‘si praroho ‘si anuroho ‘si

Sentence: 3=e vasuko ‘si veṣaśrir asi vasyaṣṭir asi //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a rājñy asi prācī dig vasavas te devā adhipatayo ‘gnir hetīnām pratidhartā trivṛt tvā stomaḥ pṛthivyāṁ śrayatv ājyam uktham avyathayat stabhnātu rathamtaraṁ sāma pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 2=b virāḍ asi dakṣiṇā dig rudrās te devā adhipataya indro hetīnām pratidhartā pañcadaśas tvā stomaḥ pṛthivyāṁ śrayatu praugam uktham avyathayat stabhnātu bṛhat sāma pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 3=c samrāḍ asi prācīcī dik //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ādityās te devā adhipatayaḥ somo hetīnām pratidhartā saptadaśas tvā stomaḥ pṛthivyāṁ śrayatu marutvatīyam uktham avyathayat stabhnātu vairūpaṁ sāma pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 2=d svarāḍ asy udīcī dig viśve te devā adhipatayo varuṇo hetīnām pratidhartaikaviṁśas tvā stomaḥ pṛthivyāṁ śrayatu niṣkevalyam uktham avyathayat stabhnātu vairājaṁ sāma pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 3=e adhipatny asi bṛhatī diṅ marutas te devā adhipatayaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 bṛhaspatir hetīnām pratidhartā triṇavatrayastriṁśau tvā stomau pṛthivyāṁ śrayatām vaiśvadevāgnimārute ukthe avyathayantī stabhnītāṁ śākvararaivate sāmanī pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 2=f antarikṣāyarṣayas tvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā variṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyam adhpatiś ca te tvā sarve samvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe suvarge loke yajamānam ca sādayantu //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ayam puro harikeśaḥ sūryaraśmis tasya rathagṛtsaś ca rathaujāś ca senānigrāmaṇyau puñjikasthalā ca kṛtasthalā cāpsarasau yātudhānā hetī rakṣāṁsi prahetis \\

Sentence: 2=b ayam dakṣiṇā viśvakarmā tasya rathasvanaś ca rathecitraś ca senānigrāmaṇyau menakā ca sahajanyā cāpsarasau daṅkṣṇavaḥ paśavo hetiḥ pauruṣeyo vadhaḥ prahetis \\

Sentence: 3=c ayam paścād viśvavyacās tasya ratheprotaś cāsamarathaś ca senānigrāmaṇyau pramlocantī ca //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 anumlocantī cāpsarasau sarpā hetir vyāghrāḥ prahetis \\

Sentence: 2=d ayam uttarāt samyadvasus tasya senajic ca suṣeṇaś ca senānigrāmaṇyau viśvācī ca ghṛtācī cāpsarasāv āpo hetir vātaḥ prahetis \\

Sentence: 3=e ayam upary arvāgvasus tasya tārkṣyaś cāriṣṭanemiś ca senānigrāmaṇyāv urvaśī ca pūrvacittiś cāpsarasau vidyud dhetir avasphūrjan prahetis

Sentence: 4=f tebhyo namas te no mṛḍayantu te yam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭi tam vo jambhe dadhāmi \\

Sentence: 2=g āyos tvā sadane sādayāmy avataś chāyāyām namaḥ samudrāya namaḥ samudrasya cakṣase

Sentence: 3=h parameṣṭhī tvā sādayatu divaḥ pṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīm prathasvatīm vibhūmatīm prabhūmatīm paribhūmatīm divam yacha divam dṛṁha divam mā hiṁsīr viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāyodānāya pratiṣṭhāyai caritrāya sūryas tvābhi pātu mahyā svastyā chardiṣā śamtamena tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda

Sentence: 4=i prothad aśvo na yavase aviṣyan yadā mahaḥ samvaraṇād vyasthā / ād asy vāto anu vāti śocir adha sma te vrajanam kṛṣṇam asti //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a agnir mūrdhā divaḥ kakut patiḥ pṛthivyā ayam / apāṁ retāṁsi jinvati //

Sentence: 2=b tvām agne puṣkarād adhy atharvā nir amanthata / mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ //

Sentence: 3=c ayam agniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinas patiḥ / mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām //

Sentence: 4=d bhuvo yajñasya rajasaś ca netā yatrā niyudbhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ / divi mūrdhānam dadhiṣe suvarṣām jihvām agne cakṛṣe havyavāham //

Sentence: 5=e abodhy agniḥ samidhā janānām //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 prati dhenum ivāyatīm uṣāsam / yahvā iva pra vayām ujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sisrate nākam acha //

Sentence: 2=f avocāma kavaye medhyāya vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe / gaviṣṭhiro namasā stomam agnau divīva rukmam urvyañcam aśret //

Sentence: 3=g janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛvir agniḥ sudakṣaḥ suvitāya navyase / ghṛtapratīko bṛhatā divispṛśā dyumad vi bhāti bharatebhyaḥ śuciḥ //

Sentence: 4=h tvām agne aṅgirasaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 guhā hitam anv avindañ chiśriyāṇam vanevane / sa jāyase mathyamānaḥ saho mahat tvām āhuḥ sahasas putram aṅgiraḥ //

Sentence: 2=i yajñasya ketum prathamam putohitam agnim naras triṣadhasthe sam indhate / indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṁ sa barhiṣi sīdan ni hotā yajathāya sukratuḥ //

Sentence: 3=k tvām citraśravastama havante vikṣu jantavaḥ / śociṣkeśam purupriyāgne havyāya voḍhave //

Sentence: 4=l sakhāyaḥ sam vaḥ samyañcam iṣam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 stomam cāgnaye / varṣiṣṭhāya kṣitīnām ūrjo naptre sahasvate //

Sentence: 2=m saṁsam id yuvase vṛṣann agne viśvāny arya ā / iḍas pade sam idhyase sa no vasūny ā bhara //

Sentence: 3=n enā vo agnim namasorjo napātam ā huve / priyam cetiṣṭham aratiṁ svadhvaram viśvasya dūtam amṛtam //

Sentence: 4=o sa yojate aruṣo viśvabhojasā sa dudravat svāhutaḥ / subrahmā yajñaḥ suśamī //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 vasūnām devaṁ rādho janānām //

Sentence: 2=p ud asya śocir asthād ājuhvānasya mīḍhuṣaḥ / ud dhumāso aruṣāso divispṛśaḥ sam agnim indhate naraḥ //

Sentence: 3=q agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho / asme dhehi jātavedo mahi śravaḥ //

Sentence: 4=r sa idhāno vasuṣ kavir agnir īḍenyo girā / revad asmabhyam purvaṇīka dīdihi //

Sentence: 5=s kṣapo rājann uta tmanāgne vastor utoṣasaḥ / sa tigmajambha //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 rakṣaso daha prati //

Sentence: 2=t ā te agna idhīmahi dyumantam devājaram / yad dha syā te panīyasī samid dīdayati dyavīṣaṁ stotṛbhya ā bhara //

Sentence: 3=u ā te agna ṛcā haviḥ śukrasya jyotiṣas tape / suścandra dasma viśpate havyavāṭ tubhyaṁ hūyata iṣaṁ stotṛbhya ā bhara //

Sentence: 4=v ubhe suścandra sarpiṣo darvī śrīṇīṣa āsani / uto na ut pupūryāḥ //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 uktheṣu śavasas pata iṣaṁ stotṛbhya ā bhara //

Sentence: 2=w agne tam adyāśvam na stomaiḥ kratum na bhadraṁ hṛdispṛśam / ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ //

Sentence: 3=x adhā hy agne krator bhadrasya dakṣasya sādhoḥ / rathīr ṛtasya bṛhato babhūtha //

Sentence: 4=y ābhiṣ ṭe adya gīrbhir gṛṇanto ‘gne dāśema / pra te divo na stanayanti śuṣmāḥ //

Sentence: 5=z ebhir no arkair bhavā no arvāñ //

Verse: 8

Sentence: 1 suvar na jyotiḥ / agne viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ //

Sentence: 2=aa agniṁ hotāram manye dāsvantam vasoḥ sūmuṁ sahaso jātavedasam / vipram na jātavedasam //

Sentence: 3=bb ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā / ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭim anu śukraśociṣa ājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ //

Sentence: 4=cc agne tvam no antamaḥ / uta trātā śivo bhava varūthyaḥ //

Sentence: 5=dd tam tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ / sumnāya nūnam īmahe sakhibhyaḥ //

Sentence: 6=ee vasur agnir vasuśravāḥ / achā nakṣi dyumattamo rayim dāḥ //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a indrāgnibhyām tvā sayujā yujā yunajmy āghārābhyām tejasā varcasokthebhi stomebhiś chandobhī rayyai poṣāya sajātānām madhyamastheyāya mayā tvā sayujā yujā yunajmi \\

Sentence: 2=b ambā dulā nitatnir abhrayantī meghayantī varṣayantī cupuṇīkā nāmāsi prajāpatinā tvā viśvābhir dhībhir upa dadhāmi

Sentence: 3=c pṛthivy ḥpapuram annena viṣṭā manuṣyās te goptāro ‘gnir viyatto ‘syām tām aham pra padye sā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 me śarma ca varma cāstu \\

Sentence: 2=d adhidyaur antarikṣam brahmaṇā viṣṭā marutas te goptāro vāyur viyatto ‘syām tām aham pra padye sā me śarma ca varma cāstu

Sentence: 3=e dyaur aparājitām ṛtena viṣṭādityās te goptāraḥ sūryo viyatto ‘syām tām aham pra padye sā me śarma ca varma cāstu //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a bṛhaspatis tvā sādayatu pṛthivyāḥ pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya viśvam jyotir yachāgnis te ‘dhipatis \\

Sentence: 2=b viśvakarmā tvā sādayatv antarikṣasya pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya viśvam jyotir yacha vāyus te ‘dhipatiḥ

Sentence: 3=c prajāpatis tvā sādayatu divaḥ pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāyaviśvam jyotir yacha parameṣṭhī te ‘dhipatiḥ

Sentence: 4=d purovātasanir asy abhrasanir asi vidyutsaniḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 asi stanayitnusanir asi vṛṣṭisanir asi \\

Sentence: 2=e agner yāny asi devānām agneyāny asi

Sentence: 3=f vāyor yāny asi devānām vāyoyāny asi \\

Sentence: 4=g antarikṣasya yāny asi devānām antarikṣayāny asi \\

Sentence: 5=h antarikṣam asy antarikṣāya tvā

Sentence: 6=i salilāya tvā sarṇīkāya tvā satīkāya tvā ketāya tvā pracetase tvā vivasvate tvā divas tvā jyotiṣa ādityebhyas tvā \\

Sentence: 7=k ṛce tvā ruce tvā dyute tvā bhāse tvā jyotiṣe tvā

Sentence: 8=l yaśodām tvā yaśasi tejodām tvā tejasi payodām tvā payasi varcodām tvā varcasi draviṇodām tvā draviṇe sādayāmi tenarṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a bhūyaskṛd asi varivaskṛd asi prācy asy ūrdhvāsy antarikṣasad asy antarikṣe sīda \\

Sentence: 2=b apsuṣad asi śyenasad asi gṛdhrasad asi suparṇasad asi nākasad asi

Sentence: 3=c pṛthivyās tvā draviṇe sādayāmy antarikṣasya tvā draviṇe sādayāmi divas tvā draviṇe sādayāmi diśām tvā draviṇe sādayāmi draviṇodām tvā draviṇe sādayāmi

Sentence: 4=d prāṇam me pāhy apānam me pāhi vyānam me //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pāhy āyur me pāhi viśvāyur me pāhi sarvāyur me pāhi \\

Sentence: 2=e agne yat te paraṁ hṛn nāma tāv ehi saṁ rabhāvahai pāñcajanyeṣv apy edhy agne

Sentence: 3=f yāvā ayāvā evā ūmāḥ sabdaḥ sagaraḥ sumekaḥ //

Sentence: 7 asuraḥ krīyamāṇas \\

Sentence: 10 naramdhiṣaḥ prohyamānas \\

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a kṛttikā nakṣatram agnir devatāgne ruca stha prajāpater dhatuḥ somasyarce tvā ruce tvā dyute tvā bhāse tvā jyotiṣe tvā

Sentence: 2=b rohiṇī nakṣatram prajāpatir devatā mṛgaśīrṣam nakṣatraṁ somo devatārdrā nakṣatraṁ rudro devatā punarvasū nakṣatram aditir devatā tiṣyo nakṣatram bṛhaspatir devatāśreṣā nakṣatraṁ sarpā devatā maghā nakṣatram pitaro devatā phalgunī nakṣatram //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 aryamā devatā phalgunī nakṣatram bhago devatā hasto nakṣatraṁ savitā devatā citrā nakṣatram indro devatā svātī nakṣatram vāyur devatā viśākhe nakṣatram indrāgnī devatā anūrādhā nakṣatram mitro devatā rohiṇī nakṣatram indro devatā vicṛtau nakṣatram pitaro devatāṣāḍhā nakṣatram āpo devatāṣāḍhā nakṣatram viśve devā devatā śroṇā nakṣattram viṣṇur devatā śraviṣṭhā nakṣatram vasavaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 devatā śatabhiṣaṅ nakṣatram indro devatā proṣṭhapadā nakṣatram aja ekapād devatā proṣṭhapadā nakṣatram ahir budhniyo devatā revatī nakṣatram pūṣā devatāśvayujau nakṣatram aśvinau devatāpabharaṇīr nakṣatram yamo devatā

Sentence: 2=c pūrṇā paścād yat te devā adadhuḥ //

Paragraph: 11

Sentence: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a madhuś ca mādhavaś ca vāsantikāv ṛtū

Sentence: 2=b śukraś ca śuciś ca graiṣmāv ṛtū

Sentence: 3=c nabhaś ca nabhasyaś ca vārṣikāv ṛtū

Sentence: 4=d iṣaś corjaś ca śāradāv ṛtū

Sentence: 5=e sahaś ca sahasyaś ca haimantikāv ṛtū

Sentence: 6=f tapaś ca tapasyaś ca śaiśirāv ṛtū

Sentence: 7=g agner antaḥśleṣo ‘si kalpetām dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantām āpa oṣadhīḥ kalpantām agnayaḥ pṛthaṅ mama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yṝ ‘gnayaḥ samanaso ‘ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī śaiśirāv ṛtū abhi kalpamānā indram iva devā abhi sam viśantu

Sentence: 2=h samyac ca pracetāś cāgneḥ somasya sūryasya \\

Sentence: 3=i ugrā ca bhīmā ca pitṛṇām yamasyendrasya

Sentence: 4=k dhruvā ca pṛthivī ca devasya savitur marutām varuṇasya

Sentence: 5=l dhartrī ca dharitrī ca mitrāvaruṇayor mitrasya dhātuḥ

Sentence: 6=m prācī ca prātīcī ca vasūnāṁ rudrāṇām //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ādityānām \\

Sentence: 2=n te te ‘dhipatayas tebhyo namas te no mṛḍayantu te yam dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭi tam vo jambhe dadhāmi

Sentence: 3=o sahasrasya pramā asi sahasrasya pratimā asi sahasrasya vimā asi sahasrasyonmā asi sāhasro ‘si sahasrāya tvā \\

Sentence: 4=p imā me agna iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santv ekā ca śatam ca sahasram cāyutam ca //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 niyutam ca prayutam cārbudam ca nyarbudam ca samudraś ca madhyam cāntaś ca parārdhaś cemā me agna iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santu ṣaṣṭhiḥ sahasram ayutam akṣīyamāṇā ṛtasthā sthartāvṛdho ghṛtaścuto madhuścuta ūrjasvatīḥ svadhāvinīs tā me agna iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santu virājo nāma kāmadughā amutrāmuṣmiṁ loke //

Paragraph: 12

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a samid diśām āśayā naḥ suvarvin madhor ato mādhavaḥ pātv asmān / agnir devo duṣṭarītur adābhya idam kṣatraṁ rakṣatu pātv asmān //

Sentence: 2=b rathamtaraṁ sāmabhiḥ pātv asmān gāyatrī chandasām viśvarūpā / trivṛn no viṣṭhayā stomo ahnāṁ samudro vāta idam ojaḥ pipartu //

Sentence: 3=c ugrā diśām abhibhūtir vayodhāḥ śuciḥ śukre ahany ojasīnā / indrādhipatiḥ pipṛtād ato no mahi //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 kṣatram viśvato dhārayedam //

Sentence: 2=d bṛhat sāma kṣatrabhṛd vṛddhavṛṣṇiyam triṣṭubhaujaḥ śubhitam ugravīram / indra stomena pañcadaśena madhyam idam vātena sagareṇa rakṣa //

Sentence: 3=e prācī diśāṁ sahayaśā yaśasvatī viśve devāḥ prāvṛṣāhnāṁ suvarvatī / idam kṣatram duṣṭaram astv ojo ‘nādhṛṣṭaṁ sahasriyaṁ sahasvat //

Sentence: 4=f vairūpe sāmann iha tac chakema jagatyainam vikṣv ā veśayāmaḥ / viśve devāḥ saptadaśena //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 varca idam kṣatraṁ salilavātam ugram //

Sentence: 2=g dhartrī diśām kṣatram idam dādhāropasthāśānām mitravad astv ojaḥ / mitrāvaruṇā śaradāhnām cikitnū asmai rāṣṭrāya mahi śarma yachatam //

Sentence: 3=h vairāje sāmann adhi me manīṣānuṣṭubhā sambhṛtam vīryaṁ sahaḥ / idam kṣatram mitravad ārdradānu mitrāvaruṇā rakṣatam ādhipatyaiḥ //

Sentence: 4=i samrāḍ diśāṁ sahasāmnī sahasvaty ṛtur hemanto viṣṭhayā naḥ pipartu / avasyuvātāḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 bṛhatīr nu śakvarīr imam yajñam avantu no ghṛtācīḥ //

Sentence: 2=k suvarvatī sudughā naḥ payasvatī diśām devy avatu no ghṛtācī / tvam gopāḥ puraetota paścād bṛhaspate yāmyām yuṅgdhi vācam //

Sentence: 3=l ūrdhvā diśāṁ rantir āśauṣadhīnāṁ samvatsareṇa savitā no ahnām / revat sāmātichandā u chandojātaśatruḥ syonā no astu //

Sentence: 4=m stomatrayastriṁśe bhuvanasya patni vivasvadvāte abhi naḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 gṛṇāhi / ghṛtavatī savitar ādhipatyaiḥ payasvatī rantir āśā no astu //

Sentence: 2=n dhruvā diśām viṣṇupatny aghorāsyeśānā sahaso yā manotā / bṛhaspatir mātariśvota vāyuḥ samdhuvānā vātā abhi no gṛṇantu //

Sentence: 3=o viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyā asyeśānā jagato viṣṇupatnī / viśvavyacā iṣayantī subhūtiḥ śivā no astv aditir upasthe //

Sentence: 4=p vaiśvānaro na ūtyā

Sentence: 5=q pṛṣṭo divi \\

Sentence: 6=r anu no ‘dyānumatis \\

Sentence: 7=s anv id anumate tvam \\

Sentence: 8=t kayā naś citra ā bhuvat

Sentence: 9=u ko adya yuṅkte //

## Chapter: 5

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a namas te rudra manyava uto ta iṣave namaḥ / namas te astu dhanvane bāhubhyām uta te namaḥ //

Sentence: 2=b yā ta iṣuḥ śivatamā śivam babhūva te dhanuḥ / śivā śaravyā yā tava tayā no rudra mṛḍaya //

Sentence: 3=c yā te rudra śivā tanūr aghorāpāpakāśinī / tayā nas tanuvā śamtamayā giriśantābhi cākaśīhi //

Sentence: 4=d yām iṣum giriśanta haste //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 bibharṣy astave / śivām giritra tām kuru mā hiṁsīḥ puruṣam jagat //

Sentence: 2=e śivena vacasā tvā giriśāchā vadāmasi / yathā naḥ sarvam ij jagad ayakṣmaṁ sumanā asat //

Sentence: 3=f adhy avocad adhivaktā prathamo daivyo bhiṣak / ahīṁś ca sarvāñ jambhayant sarvāś ca yātu dhānyaḥ //

Sentence: 4=g asau yas tāmro aruṇa uta babhruḥ sumaṅgalaḥ / ye cemāṁ rudrā abhito dikṣu //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 śritāḥ sahasraśo ‘vaiṣāṁ heḍa īmahe //

Sentence: 2=h asau yo ‘vasarpati nīlagrīvo vilohitaḥ / utainam gopā adṛśann adṛśann udahāryaḥ / utainam viśvā bhūtāni sa dṛṣṭo mṛḍayāti naḥ //

Sentence: 3=i namo astu nīlagrīvāya sahasrākṣāya mīḍuṣe / atho ye asya satvāno ‘ham tebhyo ‘karam namaḥ //

Sentence: 4=k pra muñca dhanvanas tvam ubhayor ārtniyor jyām / yāś ca te hasta iṣavaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 parā tā bhagavo vapa //

Sentence: 2=l avatatya dhanus tvaṁ sahasrākṣa śateṣudhe / niśīrya śalyānām mukhā śivo naḥ sumanā bhava //

Sentence: 3=m vijyam dhanuḥ kapardino viśalyo bāṇavāṁ uta / aneśann asyeṣava ābhur asya niṣaṅgathiḥ //

Sentence: 4=n yā te hetir mīḍhuṣṭama haste babhūva te dhanuḥ / tayāsmān viśvatas tvam ayakṣamayā pari bhuja //

Sentence: 5=o namas te astv āyudhāyānātatāya dhṛṣṇave / ubhābhyām uta te namo bāhubhyām tava dhanvane //

Sentence: 6=p pari te dhanvano hetir asmān vṛṇaktu viśvataḥ / atho ya iṣudhis tavāre asman ni dhehi tam //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a namo hiraṇyabāhave senānyṝ diśām ca pataye namas \\

Sentence: 2=b namo vṛkṣebhyo harikeśebhyaḥ paśūnām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 3=c namaḥ saspiñjarāya tviṣīmate pathīnām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 4=d namo babhluśāya vivyādhine ‘nnānām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 5=e namo harikeśāyopavītine puṣṭānām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 6=f namo bhavasya hetyai jagatām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 7=g namo rudrāyātatāvine kṣetrāṇām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 8=h namaḥ sūtāyāhantyāya vanānām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 9=i namaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 rohitāya sthapataye vṛkṣāṇām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 2=k namo mantriṇe vāṇijāya kakṣāṇām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 3=l namo bhuvantaye vārivaskṛtāyauṣadhīnām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 4=m nama uccairghoṣāyākrandayate pattīnām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 5=n namaḥ kṛtsnavītāya dhāvate satvanām pataye namaḥ //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a namaḥ sahamānāya nivyādhina āvyādhinīnām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 2=b namaḥ kakubhāya niṣaṅgiṇe stenānām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 3=c namo niṣaṅgiṇa eṣudhimate taskarāṇām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 4=d namo vañcate parivañcate stāyūnām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 5=e namo nicerave paricarāyāraṇyānām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 6=f namaḥ sṛkāvibhyo jighāṁsadbhyo muṣṇatām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 7=g namo ‘simadbhyo ñaktam caradbhyaḥ prakṛntānām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 8=h nama uṣṇīṣiṇe giricarāya kuluñcānām pataye namas \\

Sentence: 9=i namaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 iṣumadbhyo dhanvāvibhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 2=k nama ātanvānebhyaḥ pratidadhānebhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 3=l nama āyachadbhyo visṛjadbhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 4=m namo ‘syadbhyo vidhyadbhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 5=n nama āsīnebhyaḥ śayānebhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 6=o namaḥ svapadbhyo jāgradbhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 7=p namas tiṣṭhadbhyo dhāvadbhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 8=q namaḥ sabhābhyaḥ sabhāpatibhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 9=r namo aśvebhyo ‘śvapatibhyaś ca vo namaḥ //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a nama āvyādhinībhyo vividhyantībhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 2=b nama ugaṇābhyas tṛṁhatībhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 3=c namo gṛtsebhyo gṛtsapatibhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 4=d namo vrātebhyo vrātapatibhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 5=e namo gaṇebhyo gaṇapatibhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 6=f namo virūpebhyo viśvarūpebhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 7=g namo mahadbhyaḥ kṣullakebhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 8=h namo rathibhyo ‘rathebhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 9=i namo rathebhyaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 rathapatibhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 2=k namaḥ senābhyaḥ senānibhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 3=l namaḥ kṣattṛbhyaḥ samgrahītṛbhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 4=m namas takṣabhyo rathakārebhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 5=n namaḥ kulālebhyaḥ karmārebhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 6=o namaḥ puñjiṣṭebhyo niṣādebhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 7=p nama iṣukṛdbhyo dhanvakṛdbhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 8=q namo mṛgayubhyaḥ śvanibhyaś ca vo namas \\

Sentence: 9=r namaḥ śvabhyaḥ śvapatibhyaś ca vo namaḥ //
