Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a drāpe andhasas pate daridran nīlalohita / eṣām puruṣāṇām eṣām paśūnām mā bher māro mo eṣām kim canāmamat //

Sentence: 2=b yā te rudra śivā tanūḥ śivā viśvāhabheṣajī / śivā rudrasya bheṣajī tayā no mṛḍa jīvase //

Sentence: 3=c imāṁ rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matim / yathā naḥ śam asad dvipade catuṣpade viśvam puṣṭam grāme asmin //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 anāturam //

Sentence: 2=d mṛḍā no rudrota no mayas kṛdhi kṣayadvīrāya namasā vidhema te / yac cham ca yoś ca manur āyaje pitā tad aśyāma tava rudra praṇītau //

Sentence: 3=e mā no mahāntam uta mā no arbhakam mā na ukṣantam uta mā na ukṣitam / mā no vadhīḥ pitaram mota mātaram priyā mā nas tanuvaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 rudra rīriṣaḥ //

Sentence: 2=f mā nas toke tanaye mā na āyuṣi mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ / vīrān mā no rudra bhāmito vadhīr haviṣmanto namasā vidhema te //

Sentence: 3=g ārāt te goghna uta pūruṣaghne kṣayadvīrāya sumnam asme te astu / rakṣā ca no adhi ca deva brūhy adhā ca naḥ śarma yacha dvibarhāḥ //

Sentence: 4=h stuhi //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 śrutam gartasadam yuvānam mṛgam na bhīmam upahatnum ugram / mṛḍā jaritre rudra stavāno anyam te asman ni vapantu senāḥ //

Sentence: 2=i pari ṇo rudrasya hetir vṛṇaktu pari tveṣasya durmatir aghāyoḥ / ava sthirā maghavadbhyas tanuṣva mīḍhvas tokāya tanayāya mṛḍaya //

Sentence: 3=k mīḍuṣṭama śivatama śivo naḥ sumanā bhava / parame vṛkṣa āyudham nidhāya kṛttim vasāna ā cara pinākam //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 bibhrad ā gahi //

Sentence: 2=l vikirida vilohita namas te astu bhagavaḥ / yās te sahasraṁ hetayo ‘nyam asman ni vapantu tāḥ //

Sentence: 3=m sahasrāṇi sahasradhāḥ bāhuvos tava hetayaḥ / tāsām īśāno bhagavaḥ parācīnā mukhā kṛdhi //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a sahasrāṇi sahasraśo ye rudrā adhi bhūmyām / teṣāṁ sahasrayojane ‘va dhanvāni tanmasi //

Sentence: 2=b asmin mahaty arṇavṝ ‘ntarikṣe bhavā adhi /

Sentence: 3=c nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhāḥ śarvā adhaḥ kṣamācarāḥ //

Sentence: 4=d nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhā divaṁ rudrā upaśritāḥ /

Sentence: 5=e ye vṛkṣeṣu saspiñjarā nīlagrīvā vilohitāḥ /

Sentence: 6=f ye bhūtānām adhipatayo viśikhāsaḥ kapardinaḥ /

Sentence: 7=g ye anneṣu vividhyanti pātreṣu pibato janān /

Sentence: 8=h ye pathām pathirakṣaya ailabṛdā yavyudhaḥ /

Sentence: 9=i ye tīrthāni //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pracaranti sṛkāvanto niṣaṅgiṇaḥ /

Sentence: 2=k ya etāvantaś ca bhūyāṁsaś ca diśo rudrā vitasthire / teṣāṁ sahasrayojane ‘va dhanvāni tanmasi //

Sentence: 3=lmn namo rudrebhyo ye pṛthivyām yṝ ‘ntarikṣe ye divi yeṣām annam vāto varṣam iṣavas tebhyo daśa prācīr daśa dakṣiṇā daśa prātīcīr daśodīcīr daśordhvās tebhyo namas te no mṛḍayantu te yam dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭi tam vo jambhe dadhāmi //

## Chapter: 6

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a aśmann ūrjam parvate śiśriyāṇām vāte parjanye varuṇasya śuṣme / adbhya oṣadhībhyo vanaspatibhyo ‘dhi sambhṛtām tām na iṣam ūrjam dhatta marutaḥ saṁrarāṇāḥ //

Sentence: 2=b aśmaṁs te kṣud amum te śug ṛchatu yam dviṣmaḥ

Sentence: 3=c samudrasya tvāvākayāgne pari vyayāmasi / pāvako asmabhyaṁ śivo bhava //

Sentence: 4=d himasya tvā jarāyuṇāgne pari vyayāmasi / pāvako asmabhyaṁ śivo bhava //

Sentence: 5=e upa //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 jmann upa vetase ‘vattaram nadīṣv ā / agne pittam apām asi //

Sentence: 2=f maṇḍūki tābhir ā gahi semam no yajñam / pāvakavarṇaṁ śivam kṛdhi //

Sentence: 3=g pāvaka ā citayantyā kṛpā / kṣāman ruruca uṣaso na bhānunā //

Sentence: 4=h tūrvan na yāmann etaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe / na tatṛṣāṇo ajaraḥ //

Sentence: 5=i agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā / ā devān //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 vakṣi yakṣi ca //

Sentence: 2=k sa naḥ pāvaka dīdivo ‘gne devāṁ ihā vaha / upa yajñaṁ haviś ca naḥ //

Sentence: 3=l apām idam nyayanaṁ samudrasya niveśanam / anyam te asmat tapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṁ śivo bhava //

Sentence: 4=m namas te harase śociṣe namas te astv arciṣe / anyam te asmat tapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṁ śivo bhava //

Sentence: 5=n nṛṣade vaṭ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 apsuṣade vaḍ vanasade vaḍ barhiṣade vaṭ suvarvide vaṭ //

Sentence: 2=o ye devā devānām yajñiyā yajñiyānāṁ samvatsarīṇam upa bhāgam āsate / ahutādo haviṣo yajñe asmint svayam juhudhvam madhuno ghṛtasya //

Sentence: 3=p ye devā deveṣv adhi devatvam āyan ye brahmaṇaḥ puraetāro asya / yebhyo narte pavate dhāma kim cana na te divo na pṛthivyā adhi snuṣu //

Sentence: 4=q prāṇadāḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 apānadā vyānadāś cakṣurdā varcodā varivodāḥ / anyam te asmat tapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṁ śivo bhava //

Sentence: 2=r agnis tigmena śociṣā yaṁsad viśvam ny atriṇam / agnir no vaṁsate rayim //

Sentence: 3=s {F sainānīkena} {W sainānīkena} {ASS saiṣānīkena} {BI sainānīkena} {GLOS -} suvidatro asme yaṣṭā devāṁ āyajiṣṭhaḥ svasti / adabdho gopā uta naḥ paraspā agne dyumad uta revad didīhi //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvad ṛṣir hotā niṣasādā pitā naḥ / sa āśiṣā draviṇam ichamānaḥ paramachado vara ā viveśa //

Sentence: 2=b viśvakarmā manasā yad vihāyā dhātā vidhātā paramota samdṛk / teṣām iṣṭāni sam iṣā madanti yatra saptarṣīn para ekam āhuḥ //

Sentence: 3=c yo naḥ pitā janitā yo vidhātā yo naḥ sato abhy ā saj jajāna //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yo devānām nāmadhā eka eva taṁ sampraśnam bhuvanā yanty anyā //

Sentence: 2=d ta āyajanta draviṇaṁ sam asmā ṛṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāro na bhūnā / asūrtā sūrtā rajaso vimāne ye bhūtāni samakṛṇvann imāni //

Sentence: 3=e na tam vidātha ya idam jajānānyad yuṣmākam antaram bhavāti / nīhāreṇa prāvṛtā jalpyā cāsutṛpa ukthaśāsaś caranti //

Sentence: 4=f paro divā para enā //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 pṛthivyā paro devebhir asurair guhā yat / kaṁ svid garbham prathamam dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samagachanta viśve //

Sentence: 2=g tam id garbham prathamam dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samagachanta viśve / ajasya nābhāv adhy ekam arpitam yasminn idam viśvam bhuvanam adhi śritam //

Sentence: 3=h viśvakarmā hy ajaniṣṭa deva ād id gandharvo abhavad dvitīyaḥ / tṛtīyaḥ pitā janitauṣadhīnām //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 apām garbham vy adadhāt purutrā //

Sentence: 2=i cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtam ene ajanan namnamāne / yaded antā adadṛṁhanta pūrva ād id dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām //

Sentence: 3=k viśvataścakṣur uta viśvatomukho viśvatohasta uta viśvataspāt / sam bāhubhyām namati sam patatrair dyāvāpṛthivī janayan deva ekaḥ //

Sentence: 4=l kiṁ svid āsīd adhiṣṭhānam ārambhaṇam katamat svit kim āsīt / yadī bhūmim janayan //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 viśvakarmā vi dyām aurṇon mahinā viśvacakṣāḥ //

Sentence: 2=m kiṁ svid vanam ka u sa vṛkṣa āsīd yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ / manīṣiṇo manasā pṛchated u tad yad adhyatiṣṭhad bhuvanāni dhārayan //

Sentence: 3=n yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yāvamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmann utemā / śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayam yajasva tanuvam juṣāṇaḥ //

Sentence: 4=o vācas patim viśvakarmāṇam ūtaye //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 manoyujam vāje adyā huvema / sa no nediṣṭhā havanāni joṣate viśvaśambhūr avase sādhukarmā //

Sentence: 2=p viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayam yajasva tanuvam juṣāṇaḥ / muhyantv anye abhitaḥ sapatnā ihāsmākam maghavā sūrir astu //

Sentence: 3=q viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāram indram akṛṇor avadhyam / tasmai viśaḥ sam anamanta pūrvīr ayam ugro vihavyo yathāsat //

Sentence: 4=r samudrāya vayunāya sindhūnām pataye namaḥ / nadīnāṁ sarvāsām pitre juhutā viśvakarmaṇe viśvāhāmartyaṁ haviḥ //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ud enam uttarām nayāgne ghṛtenāhuta / rāyas poṣeṇa saṁ sṛja prajayā ca dhanena ca //

Sentence: 2=b indremam pratarām kṛdhi sajātānām asad vaśī / sam enam varcasā sṛja devebhyo bhāgadhā asat //

Sentence: 3=c yasya kurmo havir gṛhe tam agne vardhayā tvam / tasmai devā adhi bravann ayam ca brahmaṇas patiḥ //

Sentence: 4=d ud u tvā viśve devāḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 agne bharantu cittibhiḥ / sa no bhava śivatamaḥ supratīko vibhāvasuḥ //

Sentence: 2=e pañca diśo daivīr yajñam avantu devīr apāmatim durmatim bādhamānāḥ / rāyas poṣe yajñapatim ābhajantīḥ //

Sentence: 3=f rāyas poṣe adhi yajño asthāt samiddhe agnāv adhi māmahānaḥ / ukthapattra īḍyo gṛbhītas taptam gharmam parigṛhyāyajanta //

Sentence: 4=g ūrjā yad yajñam aśamanta devā daivyāya dhartre joṣṭre / devaśrīḥ śrīmaṇāḥ śatapayāḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 parigṛhya devā yajñam āyan //

Sentence: 2=h sūryaraśmir harikeśaḥ purastāt savitā jyotir ud ayāṁ ajasram / tasya pūṣā prasavam yāti devaḥ sampaśyan viśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ //

Sentence: 3=i devā devebhyo adhvaryanto asthur vītaṁ śamitre śamitā yajadhyai / turīyo yajño yatra havyam eti tataḥ pāvakā aśiṣo no juṣantām //

Sentence: 4=k vimāna eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivān rodasī antarikṣam / sa viśvācīr abhi //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 caṣṭe ghṛtācīr antarā pūrvam aparam ca ketum //

Sentence: 2=l ukṣā samudro aruṇaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yonim pitur ā viveśa / madhye divo nihitaḥ pṛśnir aśmā vi cakrame rajasaḥ pāty antau //

Sentence: 3=m indram viśvā avīvṛdhant samudravyacasam giraḥ / rathītamaṁ rathīnām vājānāṁ satpatim patim //

Sentence: 4=n sumnahūr yajño devāṁ ā ca vakṣad yakṣad agnir devo devāṁ ā ca vakṣat /

Sentence: 5=o vājasya mā prasavenodgrābheṇod agrabhīt / athā sapatnāṁ indro me nigrābheṇādharāṁ akaḥ //

Sentence: 6=p udgrābham ca nigrābham ca brahma devā avīvṛdhan / athā sapatnān indrāgnī me viṣūcīnān vy asyatām //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na yudhmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaś carṣaṇīnām / samkrandano ‘nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṁ senā ajayat sākam indraḥ //

Sentence: 2=b samkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yutkāreṇa duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā / tad indreṇa jayata tat sahadhvam yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā //

Sentence: 3=c sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhir vāśī saṁsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena / saṁsṛṣṭajit somapā bāhuśardhy ūrdhvadhanvā pratihitābhir astā //

Sentence: 4=d bṛhaspate pari dīya //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 rathena rakṣohāmitrāṁ apabādhamānaḥ / prabhañjant senāḥ pramṛṇo yudhā jayann asmākam edhy avitā rathānām //

Sentence: 2=e gotrabhidam govidam vajrabāhum jayantam ajma pramṛṇantam ojasā / imaṁ sajātā anu vīrayadhvam indraṁ sakhāyo ‘nu saṁ rabhadhvam //

Sentence: 3=f balavijñāya sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvān vājī sahamāna ugraḥ / abhivīro abhisatvā sahojā jaitram indra ratham ā tiṣṭha govit //

Sentence: 4=g abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno ‘dāyaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 vīraḥ śatamanyur indraḥ / duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḍ ayudhyo ‘smākaṁ senā avatu pra yutsu //

Sentence: 2=h indra āsām netā bṛhaspatir dakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ / devasenānām abhibhañjatīnām jayantīnām maruto yantv agre //

Sentence: 3=i indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānām marutāṁ śardha ugram / mahāmanasām bhuvanacyavānām ghoṣo devānām jayatām ud asthāt //

Sentence: 4=k asmākam indraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣv asmākam yā iṣavas tā jayantu //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 asmākam vīrā uttare bhavantv asmān u devā avatā haveṣu //

Sentence: 2=l ud dharṣaya maghavann āyudhāny ut satvanām māmakānām mahāṁsi / ud vṛtrahan vājinām vājināny ud rathānām jayatām etu ghoṣaḥ //

Sentence: 3=m upa preta jayatā nara sthirā vaḥ santu bāhavaḥ / indro vaḥ śarma yachatv anādhṛṣyā yathāsatha //

Sentence: 4=n avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṁśitā / gachāmitrān pra //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 viśa maiṣām kam canoc chiṣaḥ //

Sentence: 2=o marmāṇi te varmabhiś chādayāmi somas tvā rājāmṛtenābhi vastām / uror varīyo varivas te astu jayantam tvām anu madantu devāḥ //

Sentence: 3=p yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārā viśikhā iva / indro nas tatra vṛtrahā viśvāhā śarma yachatu //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a prācīm anu prādiśam prehi vidvān agner agne puroagnir bhaveha / viśvā āśā dīdyāno vi bhāhy ūrjam no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade //

Sentence: 2=b kramadhvam agninā nākam ukhyaṁ hasteṣu bibhrataḥ / divaḥ pṛṣṭhaṁ suvar gatvā miśrā devebhir āddhvam //

Sentence: 3=c pṛthivyā aham ud antarikṣam āruham antarikṣād divam āruham / divo nākasya pṛṣṭhāt suvar jyotir agām //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 aham //

Sentence: 2=d suvar yanto nāpekṣanta ā dyāṁ rohanti rodasī / yajñam ye viśvatodhāraṁ suvidvāṁso vitenire //

Sentence: 3=e agne prehi prathamo devayatām cakṣur devānām uta martyānām / iyakṣamāṇā bhṛgubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ suvar yantu yajamānāḥ svasti //

Sentence: 4=f naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśum ekaṁ samīcī / dyāvā kṣāmā rukmo antar vibhāti devā agnim dhārayan draviṇodāḥ //

Sentence: 5=g agne sahasrākṣa //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 śatamūrdhañ chatam te prāṇāḥ sahasram apānāḥ / tvaṁ sāhasrasya rāya īśiṣe tasmai te vidhema vājāya svāhā //

Sentence: 2=h suparṇo ‘si garutmān pṛthivyāṁ sīda pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyāḥ sīda bhāsāntarikṣam ā pṛṇa jyotiṣā divam ut tabhāna tejasā diśa ud dṛṁha //

Sentence: 3=i ājuhvānaḥ supratīkaḥ purastād agne svām yonim ā sīda sādhyā / asmint sadhasthe adhy uttarasmin viśve devāḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 yajamānaś ca sīdata //

Sentence: 2=k preddho agne dīdihi puro no ‘jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha / tvāṁ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ //

Sentence: 3=l vidhema te parame janmann agne vidhema stomair avare sadhasthe / yasmād yoner udārithā yaje tam pra tve havīṁṣi juhure samiddhe //

Sentence: 4=m tāṁ savitur vareṇyasya citrām āham vṛṇe sumatim viśvajanyām / yām asya kaṇvo aduhat prapīnāṁ sahasradhārām //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 payasā mahīm gām //

Sentence: 2=n sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvāḥ saptarṣayaḥ sapta dhāma priyāṇi / sapta hotrāḥ saptadhā tvā yajanti sapta yonīr ā pṛṇasvā ghṛtena //

Sentence: 3=o īdṛṅ cānyādṛṅ caitādṛṅ ca pratidṛṅ ca mitaś ca sammitaś ca sabharāḥ /

Sentence: 4=p śukrajyotiś ca citrajyotiś ca satyajyotiś ca jyotiṣmāṁś ca satyaś cartapāś cātyaṁhāḥ //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1=q ṛtajic ca satyajic ca senajic ca suṣeṇaś cāntyamitraś ca dūreamitraś ca gaṇaḥ /

Sentence: 2=r ṛtaś ca satyaś ca dhruvaś ca dharuṇaś ca dhartā ca vidhartā ca vidhārayaḥ /

Sentence: 3=s īdṛkṣāsa etādṛkṣāsa ū ṣu ṇaḥ sadṛkṣāsaḥ pratisadṛkṣāsa etana /

Sentence: 4=t mitāsaś ca sammitāsaś ca na ūtaye sabharaso maruto yajñe asmin \\

Sentence: 5=u indram daivīr viśo maruto ‘nuvartmāno yathendram daivīr viśo maruto ‘nuvartmāna evam imam yajamānam daivīś ca viśo mānuṣīś cānuvartmāno bhavantu //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkam yad varmī yāti samadām upasthe / anāviddhayā tanuvā jaya tvaṁ sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu //

Sentence: 2=b dhanvanā gā dhanvanājim jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema / dhanuḥ śatror apakāmam kṛṇoti dhanvanā sarvāḥ pradiśo jayema //

Sentence: 3=c vakṣyantīved ā ganīganti karṇam priyaṁ sakhāyam pariṣasvajānā / yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvan //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 jyā iyaṁ samane pārayantī //

Sentence: 2=d te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putram bibhṛtām upasthe / apa śatrūn vidhyatāṁ samvidāne ārtnī ime viṣphurantī amitrān //

Sentence: 3=e bahvīnām pitā bahur asya putraś ciścā kṛṇoti samanāvagatya / iṣudhiḥ saṅkāḥ pṛtanāś ca sarvāḥ pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ //

Sentence: 4=f rathe tiṣṭhan nayati vājinaḥ puro yatrayatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ / abhīśūnām mahimānam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 panāyata manaḥ paścād anu yachanti raśmayaḥ //

Sentence: 2=g tīvrān ghoṣān kṛṇvate vṛṣapāṇayo ‘śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ / avakrāmantaḥ prapadair amitrān kṣiṇanti śatrūṁr anapavyayantaḥ //

Sentence: 3=h rathavāhanaṁ havir asya nāma yatrāyudham nihitam asya varma / tatrā ratham upa śagmaṁ sadema viśvāhā vayaṁ sumanasyamānāḥ //

Sentence: 4=i svāduṣaṁsadaḥ pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛchreśritaḥ śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ / citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ //

Sentence: 5=k brāhmaṇāsaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā / pūṣā naḥ pātu duritād ṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākir no aghaśaṁsa īśata //

Sentence: 2=l suparṇam vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhiḥ samnaddhā patati prasūtā / yatrā naraḥ sam ca vi ca dravanti tatrāsmabhyam iṣavaḥ śarma yaṁsan //

Sentence: 3=m ṛjīte pari vṛṅgdhi no ‘śmā bhavatu nas tanūḥ / somo adhi bravītu no ‘ditiḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 śarma yachatu //

Sentence: 2=n ā jaṅghanti sānv eṣām jaghanāṁ upa jighnate / aśvājani pracetaso ‘śvānt samatsu codaya //

Sentence: 3=o ahir iva bhogaiḥ pary eti bāhum jyāyā hetim paribādhamānaḥ / hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvān pumān pumāṁsam pari pātu viśvataḥ //

Sentence: 4=p vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ / gobhiḥ samnaddho asi vīḍayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni //

Sentence: 5=q divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ pari //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 oja udbhṛtam vanaspatibhyaḥ pary ābhṛtaṁ sahaḥ / apām ojmānam pari gobhir āvṛtam indrasya vajraṁ haviṣā ratham yaja //

Sentence: 2=r indrasya vajro marutām anīkam mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ / semām no havyadātim juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya //

Sentence: 3=s upa śvāsaya pṛthivīm uta dyām purutrā te manutām viṣṭhitam jagat / sa dundubhe sajūr indreṇa devair dūrāt //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 davīyo apa sedha śatrūn //

Sentence: 2=t ā krandaya balam ojo na ā dhā ni ṣṭanihi duritā bādhamānaḥ / apa protha dundubhe duchunāṁ ita indrasya muṣṭir asi vīḍayasva //

Sentence: 3=u āmūr aja pratyāvartaye ‘māḥ ketumad dundubhir vāvadīti / sam aśvaparṇāś caranti no naro ‘smākam indra rathino jayantu //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a yad akrandaḥ prathamam jāyamāna udyant samudrād uta vā purīṣāt / śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyam mahi jātam te arvan //

Sentence: 2=b yamena dattam trita enam āyunag indra eṇam prathamo adhy atiṣṭhat / gandharvo asya raśanām agṛbhṇāt sūrād aśvam vasavo nir ataṣṭa //

Sentence: 3=c asi yamo asy ādityo arvann asi trito guhyena vratena / asi somena samayā vipṛktaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 āhus te trīṇi divi bandhanāni //

Sentence: 2=d trīṇi ta āhur divi bandhanāni trīṇy apsu trīṇy antaḥ samudre / uteva me varuṇaś chantsy arvan yatrā ta āhuḥ paramam janitram //

Sentence: 3=e imā te vājinn avamārjanānīmā śaphānāṁ sanitur nidhānā / atrā te bhadrā raśanā apaśyam ṛtasya yā abhirakṣanti gopāḥ //

Sentence: 4=f ātmānam te manasārād ajānām avo divā //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 patayantam patamgam / śiro apaśyam pathibhiḥ sugebhir areṇubhir jehamānam patatri //

Sentence: 2=g atrā te rūpam uttamam apaśyam jigīṣamāṇam iṣa ā pade goḥ / yadā te marto anu bhogam ānaḍ ād id grasiṣṭha oṣadhīr ajīgaḥ //

Sentence: 3=h anu tvā ratho anu maryo arvann anu gāvo ‘nu bhagaḥ kanīnām / anu vrātāsas tava sakhyam īyur anu devā mamire vīryam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 te //

Sentence: 2=i hiraṇyaśṛṅgo ‘yo asya pādā manojavā avara indra āsīt / devā id asya haviradyam āyan yo arvantam prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat //

Sentence: 3=k īrmāntāsaḥ silikamadhyamāsaḥ saṁ śūraṇāso divyāso atyāḥ / haṁsā iva śreṇiśo yatante yad ākṣiṣur divyam ajmam aśvāḥ //

Sentence: 4=l tava śarīram patayiṣṇv arvan tava cittam vāta iva dhrajīmān / tava śṛṅgāṇi viṣṭhitā purutrāraṇyeṣu jarbhurāṇā caranti //

Sentence: 5=m upa //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 prāgāc chasanam vājy arvā devadrīcā manasā dīdhyānaḥ / ajaḥ puro nīyate nābhir asyānu paścāt kavayo yanti rebhāḥ //

Sentence: 2=n upa prāgāt paramam yat sadhastham arvāṁ achā pitaram mātaram ca / adyā devāñ juṣṭatamo hi gamyā athā śāste dāśuṣe vāryāṇi //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a mā no mitro varuṇo aryamāyur indra ṛbhukṣā marutaḥ pari khyan / yad vājino devajātasya sapteḥ pravakṣyāmo vidathe vīryāṇi //

Sentence: 2=b yan nirṇijā rekṇasā prāvṛtasya rātim gṛbhītām mukhato nayanti / suprāṅ ajo memyad viśvarūpa indrāpūṣṇoḥ priyam apy eti pāthaḥ //

Sentence: 3=c eṣa chāgaḥ puro aśvena vājinā pūṣṇo bhāgo nīyate viśvadevyaḥ / abhipriyam yat puroḍāśam arvatā tvaṣṭet //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 enaṁ sauśravasāya jinvati

Sentence: 2=d yad dhaviṣyam ṛtuśo devayānam trir mānuṣāḥ pary aśvam nayanti / atrā pūṣṇaḥ prathamo bhāga eti yajñam devebhyaḥ prativedayann ajaḥ //

Sentence: 3=e hotādhvaryur āvayā agnimindho grāvagrābha uta śaṁstā suvipraḥ / tena yajñena svaramkṛtena svṅṣṭena vakṣaṇā ā pṛṇadhvam //

Sentence: 4=f yūpavraskā uta ye yūpavāhāś caṣālam ye aśvayūpāya takṣati / ye cārvate pacanaṁ sambharanty uto //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 teṣām abhigūrtir na invatu //

Sentence: 2=g upa prāgāt suman me ‘dhāyi manma devānām āśā upa vītapṛṣṭhaḥ / anv enam viprā ṛṣayo madanti devānām puṣṭe cakṛmā subandhum //

Sentence: 3=h yad vājino dāma samdānam arvato yā śīrṣaṇyā raśanā rajjur asya / yad vā ghāsya prabhṛtam āsyṝ tṛṇaṁ sarvā tā te api deveṣv astu //

Sentence: 4=i yad aśvasya kraviṣaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 makṣikāśa yad vā svarau svadhitau riptam asti / yad dhastayoḥ śamitur yan nakheṣu sarvā tā te api deveṣv astu //

Sentence: 2=k yad ūvadhyam udarasyāpavāti ya āmasya kraviṣo gandho asti / sukṛtā tac chamitāraḥ kṛṇvantūta medhaṁ śṛtapākam pacantu //

Sentence: 3=l yat te gātrād agninā pacyamānād abhi śūlam nihatasyāvadhāvati / mā tad bhūmyām ā śriṣan mā tṛṇeṣu devebhyas tad uśadbhyo rātam astu //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ye vājinam paripaśyanti pakvam ya īm āhuḥ surabhir nir hareti / ye cārvato māṁsabhikṣām upāsata uto teṣām abhigūrtir na invatu //

Sentence: 2=b yan nīkṣaṇam māṁspacanyā ukhāyā yā pātrāṇi yūṣṇa āsecanāni / ūṣmaṇyāpidhānā carūṇām aṅkāḥ sūnāḥ pari bhūṣanty aśvam //

Sentence: 3=c nikramaṇam niṣadanam vivartanam yac ca paḍbīśam arvataḥ / yac ca papau yac ca ghāsim //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 jaghāsa sarvā tā te api deveṣv astu //

Sentence: 2=d mā tvāgnir dhvanayid dhūmagandhir mokhā bhrājanty abhi vikta jaghriḥ / iṣṭam vītam abhigūrtam vaṣaṭkṛtam tam devāsaḥ prati gṛbhṇanty aśvam //

Sentence: 3=e yad aśvāya vāsa upastṛṇanty adhīvāsam yā hiraṇyāny asmai / samdānam arvantam paḍbīśam priyā deveṣv ā yāmayanti //

Sentence: 4=f yat te sāde mahasā śūkṛtasya pārṣṇiyā vā kaśayā //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 vā tutoda / sruceva tā haviṣo adhvareṣu sarvā tā te brahmaṇā sūdayāmi //

Sentence: 2=g catustriṁśad vājino devabandhor vaṅkrīr aśvasya svadhitiḥ sam eti / achidrā gātrā vayunā kṛṇota paruṣparur anughuṣyā vi śasta //

Sentence: 3=h ekas tvaṣṭur aśvasyā viśastā dvā yantārā bhavatas tathartuḥ / yā te gātrāṇām ṛtuthā kṛṇomi tātā piṇḍānām pra juhomy agnau //

Sentence: 4=i mā tvā tapat //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 priya ātmāpiyantam mā svadhitis tanuva ā tiṣṭhipat te / mā te gṛdhnur aviśastātihāya chidrā gātrāṇy asinā mithū kaḥ //

Sentence: 2=k na vā uv etan mriyase na riṣyasi devāṁ id eṣi pathibhiḥ sugebhiḥ / harī te yuñjā pṛṣatī abhūtām upāsthād vājī dhuri rāsabhasya //

Sentence: 3=l sugavyam no vājī svaśviyam puṁsaḥ putrāṁ uta viśvāpuṣaṁ rayim / anāgāstvam no aditiḥ kṛṇotu kṣatram no aśvo vanatāṁ haviṣmān //

Paragraph: 12

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a vājo naḥ sapta pradiśaś catasro vā parāvataḥ / vājo no viśvair devair dhanasātāv ihāvatu //

Sentence: 2=b viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantv agnayaḥ samiddhāḥ / viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvam astu draviṇam vājo asme //

Sentence: 3=c vājasya prasavam devā rathair yātā hiraṇyayaiḥ / agnir indro bṛhaspatir marutaḥ somapītaye //

Sentence: 4=d vājevāje ‘vata vājino no dhaneṣu //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ / asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvam tṛptā yāta pathibhir devayānaiḥ //

Sentence: 2=e vājaḥ purastād uta madhyato no vājo devāṁ ṛtubhiḥ kalpayāti / vājasya hi prasavo namnamīti viśvā āśā vājapatir bhaveyam //

Sentence: 3=f payaḥ pṛthivyām paya oṣadhīṣu payo divy antarikṣe payo dhām / payasvatīḥ pradiśaḥ santu mahyam //

Sentence: 4=g sam mā sṛjāmi payasā ghṛtena sam mā sṛjāmy apaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 oṣadhībhiḥ / so ‘ham vājaṁ saneyam agne //

Sentence: 2=h naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśum ekaṁ samīcī / dyāvā kṣāmā rukmo antar vi bhāti devā agnim dhārayan draviṇodāḥ //

Sentence: 3=i samudro ‘si nabhasvān ārdradānuḥ śambhūr mayobhūr abhi mā vāhi svāhā māruto ‘si marutām gaṇaḥ śambhūr mayobhūr abhi mā vāhi svāhāvasyur asi duvasvāñ chambhūr mayobhūr abhi mā vāhi svāhā //

Paragraph: 13

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a agnim yunajmi śavasā ghṛtena divyaṁ suparṇam vayasā bṛhantam / tena vayam patema bradhnasya viṣṭapaṁ suvo ruhāṇā adhi nāka uttame //

Sentence: 2=b imau te pakṣāv ajarau patatriṇo yābhyāṁ rakṣāṁsy apahaṁsy agne / tābhyām patema sukṛtām u lokam yatrarṣayaḥ prathamajā ye purāṇāḥ //

Sentence: 3=c cid asi samudrayonir indur dakṣaḥ śyena ṛtāvā / hiraṇyapakṣaḥ śakuno bhuraṇyur mahānt sadhasthe dhruvaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ā niṣattaḥ //

Sentence: 2=d namas te astu mā mā hiṁsīr viśvasya mūrdhann adhi tiṣṭhasi śritaḥ / samudre te hṛdayam antar āyur dyāvāpṛthivī bhuvaneṣv arpite //

Sentence: 3=e udno dattodadhim bhintta divaḥ parjanyād antarikṣāt pṛthivyās tato no vṛṣṭyāvata / divo mūrdhāsi pṛthivyā nābhir ūrg apām oṣadhīnām / viśvāyuḥ śarma saprathā namas pathe //

Sentence: 4=f yenarṣayas tapasā sattram //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 āsatendhānā agniṁ suvar ābharantaḥ / tasminn aham ni dadhe nāke agnim etam yam āhur manava stīrṇabarhiṣam //

Sentence: 2=g tam patnībhir anu gachema devāḥ putrair bhrātṛbhir uta vā hiraṇyaiḥ / nākam gṛhṇānāḥ sukṛtasya loke tṛtīye pṛṣṭhe adhi rocane divaḥ //

Sentence: 3=h ā vaco madhyam aruhad bhuraṇyur ayam agniḥ satpatiś cekitānaḥ / pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyā nihito davidyutad adhaspadam kṛṇute //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ye pṛtanyavaḥ //

Sentence: 2=i ayam agnir vīratamo vayodhāḥ sahasriyo dīpyatām aprayuchan / vibhrājamānaḥ sarirasya madhya upa pra yāta divyāni dhāma //

Sentence: 3=k sam pra cyavadhvam anu sam pra yātāgne patho devayānān kṛṇudhvam / asmint sadhasthe adhy uttarasmin viśve devā yajamānaś ca sīdata //

Sentence: 4=l yenā sahasram vahasi yenāgne sarvavedasam / tenemam yajñam no vaha devayāno yaḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 uttamaḥ //

Sentence: 2=m ud budhyasvāgne prati jāgṛhy enam iṣṭāpūrte saṁ sṛjethām ayam ca / punaḥ kṛṇvaṁs tvā pitaram yuvānam anvātāṁsīt tvayi tantum etam //

Sentence: 3=n ayam te yonir ṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ / tam jānann agna ā rohāthā no vardhayā rayim //

Paragraph: 14

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a mamāgne varco vihaveṣv astu vayam tvendhānās tanuvam puṣema / mahyam namantām pradiśaś catasras tvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema //

Sentence: 2=b mama devā vihave santu sarva indrāvanto maruto viṣṇur agniḥ / mamāntarikṣam uru gopam astu mahyam vātaḥ pavatām kāme asmin //

Sentence: 3=c mayi devā draviṇam ā yajantām mayy āśīr astu mayi devahūtiḥ / daivyā hotārā vaniṣanta //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pūrveriṣṭāḥ syāma tanuvā suvīrāḥ //

Sentence: 2=d mahyam yajantu mama yāni havyākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu / eno mā ni gām katamac canāham viśve devāso adhi vocatā me //

Sentence: 3=e devīḥ ṣaḍurvīr uru naḥ kṛnota viśve devāsa iha vīrayadhvam / mā hāsmahi prajayā mā tanūbhir mā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan //

Sentence: 4=f agnir manyum pratinudan purastāt //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 adabdho gopāḥ pari pāhi nas tvam / pratyañco yantu nigutaḥ punas tṝ ‘maiṣām cittam prabudhā vi neśat //

Sentence: 2=g dhātā dhātṛṇām bhuvanasya yas patir devaṁ savitāram abhimātiṣāham / imam yajñam aśvinobhā bṛhaspatir devāḥ pāntu yajamānam nyarthāt //

Sentence: 3=h uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yaṁsad asmin have puruhūtaḥ purukṣu / sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḍayendra mā //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ //

Sentence: 2=i ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantv indrāgnibhyām ava bādhāmahe tān / vasavo rudrā ādityā uparispṛśam mogram cettāram adhirājam akran //

Sentence: 3=k arvāñcam indram amuto havāmahe yo gojid dhanajid aśvajid yaḥ / imam no yajñam vihave juṣasvāsya kurmo harivo medinam tvā //

Paragraph: 15

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a agner manve prathamasya pracetaso yam pāñcajanyam bahavaḥ samindhate / viśvasyām viśi praviviśivāṁsam īmahe sa no muñcatv aṁhasaḥ //

Sentence: 2=b yasyedam prāṇan nimiṣad yad ejati yasya jātam janamānam ca kevalam / staumy agnim nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatv aṁhasaḥ //

Sentence: 3=c indrasya manve prathamasya pracetaso vṛtraghna stomā upa mām upāguḥ / yo dāśuṣaḥ sukṛto havam upa gantā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 sa no muñcatv aṁhasaḥ //

Sentence: 2=d yaḥ samgrāmam nayati sam vāśī yudhe yaḥ puṣṭāni saṁsṛjati trayāṇi / staumīndram nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatv aṁhasaḥ //

Sentence: 3=e manve vām mitrāvaruṇā tasya vittaṁ satyaujasā dṛṁhaṇā yam nudethe / yā rājānaṁ saratham yātha ugrā tā no muñcatam āgasaḥ //

Sentence: 4=f yo vāṁ ratha ṛjuraśmiḥ satyadharmā mithuś carantam upayāti dūṣayan / staumi //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 mitrāvaruṇā nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatam āgasaḥ //

Sentence: 2=g vāyoḥ savitur vidathāni manmahe yāv ātmanvad bibhṛto yau ca rakṣataḥ / yau viśvasya paribhū babhūvatus tau no muñcatam āgasaḥ //

Sentence: 3=h upa śreṣṭhā na āśiṣo devayor dharme asthiran / staumi vāyuṁ savitāram nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatam āgasaḥ //

Sentence: 4=i rathītamau rathīnām ahva ūtaye śubham gamiṣṭhau suyamebhir aśvaiḥ / yayoḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vām devau deveṣv aniśitam ojas tau no muñcatam āgasaḥ //

Sentence: 2=k yad ayātam vahatuṁ sūryāyās tricakreṇa saṁsadam ichamānau / staumi devāv aśvinau nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatam āgasaḥ //

Sentence: 3=l marutām manve adhi no bruvantu premām vācam viśvām avantu viśve / āśūn huve suyamān ūtaye te no muñcantv enasaḥ //

Sentence: 4=m tigmam āyudham vīḍitaṁ sāhasvad divyaṁ śardhaḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 pṛtanāsu jiṣṇu / staumi devān maruto nāthito johavīmi te no muñcantv enasaḥ //

Sentence: 2=n devānām manve adhi no bruvantu premām vācam viśvām avantu viśve / āśūn huve suyamān ūtaye te no muñcantvenasaḥ //

Sentence: 3=o yad idam mābhiśocati pauruṣeyeṇa daivyena / staumi viśvān devān nāthito johavīmi te no muñcantv enasaḥ //

Sentence: 4=p anu no ‘dyānumatis \\

Sentence: 5=q anu //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 id anumate tvam \\

Sentence: 2=r vaiśvānaro na ūtyā

Sentence: 3=s pṛṣṭo divi

Sentence: 4=t ye aprathetām amitebhir ojobhir ye pratiṣṭhe abhavatām vasūnām / staumi dyāvāpṛthivī nāthito johavīmi te no muñcatam aṁhasaḥ //

Sentence: 5=u urvī rodasī varivaḥ kṛṇotam kṣetrasya patnī adhi no brūyātam / staumi dyāvāpṛthivī nāthito johavīmi te no muñcatam aṁhasaḥ //

Sentence: 6=v yat te vayam puruṣatrā yaviṣṭhāvidvāṁsaś cakṛmā kac cana //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 āgaḥ / kṛdhī sv asmāṁ aditer anāgā vy enāṁsi śiśratho viṣvag agne //

Sentence: 2=w yathā ha tad vasavo gauryam cit padi ṣitām amuñcatā yajatrāḥ / evā tvam asmat pra muñcā vy aṁhaḥ prātāry agne pratarām na āyuḥ //

Sentence: 10 tebhya etac caturgṛhītam adhārayan

Sentence: 11 puro’nuvākyāyai yājyāyai devatāyai vaṣaṭkārāya

Sentence: 12 yac caturgṛhītam juhoti chandāṁsy eva tat prīṇāti

Sentence: 13 tāny asya prītāni devebhyo havyam vahanti

Sentence: 14 yam kāmayeta //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pāpīyānt syād ity ekaikam tasya juhuyāt \\

Sentence: 2 āhutībhir evainam apa gṛhṇāti pāpīyān bhavati

Sentence: 3 yam kāmayeta

Sentence: 4 vasīyānt syād iti sarvāṇi tasyānudrutya juhuyāt \\

Sentence: 5 āhutyaivainam abhi kramayati vasīyān bhavati \\

Sentence: 6 atho yajñasyaivaiṣābhikrāntis \\

Sentence: 7 eti vā eṣa yajñamukhād ṛddhyā yo ‘gner devatāyā eti \\

Sentence: 8 aṣṭāv etāni sāvitrāṇi bhavanti \\

Sentence: 9 aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī

Sentence: 10 gāyatraḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 agnis

Sentence: 2 tenaiva yajñamukhād ṛddhyā agner devatāyai naiti \\

Sentence: 3 aṣṭau sāvitrāṇi bhavanty āhutir navamī

Sentence: 4 trivṛtam eva yajñamukhe vi yātayati

Sentence: 5 yadi kāmayeta

Sentence: 6 chandāṁsi yajñayaśasenārpayeyam ity ṛcam antamām kuryāt \\

Sentence: 7 chandāṁsy eva yajñayaśasenārpayati

Sentence: 8 yadi kāmayeta

Sentence: 9 yajamānam yajñayaśasenārpayeyam iti yajur antamam kuryāt \\

Sentence: 10 yajamānam eva yajñayaśasenārpayati \\

Sentence: 11 ṛcā stomaṁ sam ardhayeti //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 āha

Sentence: 2 samṛddhyai

Sentence: 3 caturbhir abhrim ā datte

Sentence: 4 catvāri chandāṁsi

Sentence: 5 chandobhir eva

Sentence: 6 devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ity āha

Sentence: 7 prasūtyai \\

Sentence: 8 agnir devebhyo nilāyata

Sentence: 9 sa veṇum prāviśat

Sentence: 10 sa etām ūtim anu sam acarad yad veṇoḥ suṣiram \\

Sentence: 11 suṣirābhrir bhavati sayonitvāya

Sentence: 12 sa yatrayatrāvasat tat kṛṣṇam abhavat

Sentence: 13 kalmāsī bhavati rūpasamṛddhyai \\

Sentence: 14 ubhayataḥkṣṇūr bhavati \\

Sentence: 15 itaś cāmutaś cārkasyāvaruddhyai

Sentence: 16 vyāmamātrī bhavati \\

Sentence: 17 etāvad vai puruṣe vīryam \\

Sentence: 18 vīryasammitā \\

Sentence: 19 aparimitā bhavati \\

Sentence: 20 aparimitasyāvaruddhyai

Sentence: 21 yo vanaspatīnām phalagrahiḥ sa eṣām vīryāvān

Sentence: 22 phalagrahir veṇus \\

Sentence: 23 vaiṇavī bhavati vīryasyāvaruddhyai //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 vyṛddham vā etad yajñasya yad ayajuṣkeṇa kriyate \\

Sentence: 2 imām agṛbhṇan raśanām ṛtasyety aśvābhidhānīm ā datte

Sentence: 3 yajuṣkṛtyai yajñasya samṛddhyai

Sentence: 4 pratūrtam vājinn ā dravety aśvam abhi dadhāti

Sentence: 5 rūpam evāsyaitan mahimānam vyācaṣṭe

Sentence: 6 yuñjāthāṁ rāsabham yuvam iti gardabham

Sentence: 7 asaty eva gardabham prati ṣṭhāpayati

Sentence: 8 tasmād aśvād gardabho ‘sattaras \\

Sentence: 9 yogeyoge tavastaram ity āha //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yoge yoga evainam yuṅkte

Sentence: 2 vājevāje havāmaha ity āha \\

Sentence: 3 annam vai vājas \\

Sentence: 4 annam evāva runddhe

Sentence: 5 sakhāya indram ūtaya ity āha \\

Sentence: 6 indriyam evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 7 agnir devebhyo nilāyata

Sentence: 8 tam prajāpatir anv avindat

Sentence: 9 prājāpatyo ‘śvas \\

Sentence: 10 aśvena sam bharaty anuvittyai

Sentence: 11 pāpavasyasam vā etat kriyate yac chreyasā ca pāpīyasā ca samānam karma kurvanti

Sentence: 12 pāpīyān //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 hy aśvād gardabhas \\

Sentence: 2 aśvam pūrvam nayanti pāpavasyasasya vyāvṛttyai

Sentence: 3 tasmāc chreyāṁsam pāpīyān paścād anv eti

Sentence: 4 bahur vai bhavato bhrātṛvyas \\

Sentence: 5 bhavatīva khalu vā eṣa yo ‘gnim cinute

Sentence: 6 vajry aśvaḥ

Sentence: 7 pratūrvann ehy avakrāmann aśastīr ity āha

Sentence: 8 vajreṇaiva pāpmānam bhrātṛvyam ava krāmati

Sentence: 9 rudrasya gāṇapatyād ity āha

Sentence: 10 raudrā vai paśavo rudrād eva //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 paśūn niryācyātmane karma kurute

Sentence: 2 pūṣṇā sayujā sahety āha

Sentence: 3 pūṣā vā adhvanāṁ samnetā

Sentence: 4 samaṣṭyai

Sentence: 5 purīṣāyatano vā eṣa yad agnis \\

Sentence: 6 aṅgiraso vā etam agre devatānāṁ sam abharan

Sentence: 7 pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthād agnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvad achehīty āha

Sentence: 8 sāyatanam evainam devatābhiḥ sam bharati \\

Sentence: 9 agnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvad achema ity āha

Sentence: 10 yena //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 samgachate vājam evāsya vṛṅkte

Sentence: 2 prajāpataye pratiprocyāgniḥ sambhṛtya ity āhus \\

Sentence: 3 iyam vai prajāpatis

Sentence: 4 tasyā etac chrotram yad valmīkas \\

Sentence: 5 agnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvad bhariṣyāma iti valmīkavapām upa tiṣṭhate

Sentence: 6 sākṣād eva prajāpataye pratiprocyāgniṁ sam bharati \\

Sentence: 7 agnim purīṣyam aṅgirasvad bharāma ity āha

Sentence: 8 yena samgachate vājam evāsya vṛṅkte \\

Sentence: 9 anv agnir uṣasām agram //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 akhyad ity āha \\

Sentence: 2 anukhyātyai \\

Sentence: 3 āgatya vājy adhvana ākramya vājin prāthivīm ity āha \\

Sentence: 4 ichaty evainam pūrvayā vindaty uttarayā

Sentence: 5 dvābhyām ā kramayati

Sentence: 6 pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 7 anurūpābhyām \\

Sentence: 8 tasmād anurūpāḥ paśavaḥ pra jāyante

Sentence: 9 dyaus te pṛṣṭham pṛthivī sadhastham ity āha \\

Sentence: 10 ebhyo vā etam lokebhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ sam airayat \\

Sentence: 11 rūpam evāsyaitan mahimānam vyācaṣṭe

Sentence: 12 vajrī vā eṣa yad aśvas \\

Sentence: 13 dadbhir anyatodadbhyo bhūyāṁ lomabhir ubhayādadbhyas \\

Sentence: 14 yam dviṣyāt tam adhaspadam dhyāyet \\

Sentence: 15 vajreṇaivainaṁ stṛṇute //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ut krāmod akramīd iti dvābhyām ut kramayati

Sentence: 2 pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 3 anurūpābhyām \\

Sentence: 4 tasmād anurūpāḥ paśavaḥ pra jāyante \\

Sentence: 5 apa upa sṛjati

Sentence: 6 yatra vā āpa upagachanti tad oṣadhayaḥ prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 7 oṣadhīḥ pratitiṣṭhantīḥ paśavo ‘nu prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 8 paśūn yajñas \\

Sentence: 9 yajñam yajamānas \\

Sentence: 10 yajamānam prajās

Sentence: 11 tasmād apa upa sṛjati

Sentence: 12 pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 13 yad adhvaryur anagnāv āhutim juhuyād andho ‘dhvaryuḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 syād rakṣāṁsi yajñaṁ hanyus \\

Sentence: 2 hiraṇyam upāsya juhoti \\

Sentence: 3 agnivaty eva juhoti

Sentence: 4 nāndho ‘dhvaryur bhavati na yajñaṁ rakṣāṁsi ghnanti

Sentence: 5 jigharmy agnim manasā ghṛtenety āha

Sentence: 6 manasā hi puruṣo yajñam abhigachati

Sentence: 7 pratikṣyantam bhuvanāni viśvety āha

Sentence: 8 sarvaṁ hy ṝṣa pratyaṅ kṣeti

Sentence: 9 pṛthum tiraścā vayasa bṛhantam ity āha \\

Sentence: 10 alpo hy ṝṣa jāto mahān //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 bhavati

Sentence: 2 vyaciṣṭham annaṁ rabhasam vidānam ity āha \\

Sentence: 3 annam evāsmai svadayati

Sentence: 4 sarvam asmai svadate ya evam veda \\

Sentence: 5 ā tvā jigharmi vacasā ghṛtenety āha

Sentence: 6 tasmād yat puruṣo manasābhigachati tad vācā vadati \\

Sentence: 7 arakṣasety āha

Sentence: 8 rakṣasām apahatyai

Sentence: 9 martyaśrī spṛhayadvarṇo agnir ity āha \\

Sentence: 10 apacitim evāsmin dadhāti \\

Sentence: 11 apacitimān bhavati ya evam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 veda

Sentence: 2 manasā tvai tām āptum arhati yām adhvaryur anagnāv āhutim juhoti

Sentence: 3 manasvatībhyām juhoti \\

Sentence: 4 āhutyor āptyai

Sentence: 5 dvābhyām

Sentence: 6 pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 7 yajñamukheyajñamukhe vai kriyamāṇe yajñaṁ rakṣāṁsi jighāṁsanti \\

Sentence: 8 etarhi khalu vā etad yajñamukham yarhy enad āhutir aśnute

Sentence: 9 pari likhati

Sentence: 10 rakṣasām apahatyai

Sentence: 11 tisṛbhiḥ pari likhati

Sentence: 12 trivṛd vā agnis \\

Sentence: 13 yāvān evāgnis tasmād rakṣāṁsy apa hanti //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 gāyatriyā pari likhati

Sentence: 2 tejo vai gāyatrī

Sentence: 3 tejasaivainam pari gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 4 triṣṭubhā pari likhati \\

Sentence: 5 indriyam vai { triṣṭug ^ triṣtubh }

Sentence: 6 indriyeṇaivainam pari gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 7 anuṣṭubhā pari likhati \\

Sentence: 8 anuṣṭup sarvāṇi chandāṁsi paribhūḥ paryāptyai

Sentence: 9 madhyato ‘nuṣṭubhā

Sentence: 10 vāg vā { anuṣṭup ^ anuṣṭubh }

Sentence: 11 tasmān madhyato vācā vadāmas \\

Sentence: 12 gāyatriyā prathamayā pari likhaty athānuṣṭubhātha triṣṭubhā

Sentence: 13 tejo vai gāyatrī yajño ‘nuṣṭug indriyam { triṣṭup ^ triṣṭubh }

Sentence: 14 tejasā caivendriyeṇa cobhayato yajñam pari gṛhṇāti //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti khanati prasūtyā atho dhūmam evaitena janayati

Sentence: 2 jyotiṣmantam tvāgne supratīkam ity āha jyotir evaitena janayati

Sentence: 3 so ‘gnir jātaḥ prajāḥ śucārpayat tam devā ardharcenāśamayan \\

Sentence: 4 śivam prajābhyo ‘hiṁsantam ity āha prajābhya evainaṁ śamayati

Sentence: 5 dvābhyām khanati pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 6 apām pṛṣṭham asīti puṣkaraparṇam ā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 haraty apām vā etat pṛṣṭham yat puṣkaraparṇaṁ rūpeṇaivainad ā harati

Sentence: 2 puṣkaraparṇena sam bharati yonir vā agneḥ puṣkaraparṇaṁ sayonim evāgniṁ sam bharati

Sentence: 3 kṛṣṇājinena sam bharati yajño vai kṛṣṇājinam yajñenaiva yajñaṁ sam bharati

Sentence: 4 yad grāmyāṇām paśūnām carmaṇā sambhared grāmyān paśūñ chucārpayet kṛṣṇājinena sam bharaty āraṇyān eva paśūn //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 śucārpayati

Sentence: 2 tasmāt samāvat paśūnām prajāyamānānām āraṇyāḥ paśavaḥ kanīyāṁsaḥ śucā hy ṛtās \\

Sentence: 3 lomataḥ sam bharaty ato hy asya medhyam \\

Sentence: 4 kṛṣṇājinam ca puṣkaraparṇam ca saṁ stṛṇātīyam vai kṛṣṇājinam asau puṣkaraparṇam ābhyām evainam ubhayataḥ pari gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 5 agnir devebhyo nilāyata tam atharvānv apaśyat \\

Sentence: 6 atharvā tvā prathamo nir amanthad agna iti //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 āha ya evainam anvapaśyat tenaivainaṁ sam bharati

Sentence: 2 tvām agne puṣkarād adhīty āha puṣkaraparṇe hy enam upaśritam avindat

Sentence: 3 tam u tvā dadhyaṅṅ ṛṣir ity āha dadhyaṅ vā ātharvaṇas tejasvy āsīt teja evāsmin dadhāti

Sentence: 4 tam u tvā pāthyo vṛṣety āha pūrvam evoditam uttareṇābhi gṛṇāti //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 catasṛbhiḥ sam bharati catvāri chandāṁsi chandobhir eva

Sentence: 2 gāyatrībhir brāhmaṇasya gāyatro hi brāhmaṇas

Sentence: 3 triṣṭugbhī rājanyasya traiṣṭubho hi rājanyo

Sentence: 4 yam kāmayeta vasīyānt syād ity ubhayībhis tasya sam bharet tejaś caivāsmā indriyam ca samīcī dadhāty

Sentence: 5 aṣṭābhiḥ sam bharaty aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī gāyatro ‘gnir yāvān evāgnis taṁ sam bharati

Sentence: 6 sīda hotar ity āha devatā evāsmai saṁ sādayati

Sentence: 7 ni hoteti manuṣyānt saṁ sīdasveti vayāṁsi

Sentence: 8 janiṣvā hi jenyo agre ahnām ity āha devamanuṣyān evāsmai saṁsannān pra janayati //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 krūram iva vā asyā etat karoti yat khanati \\

Sentence: 3 āpo vai śāntāḥ

Sentence: 4 śāntābhir evāsyai śucaṁ śamayati

Sentence: 5 sam te vāyur mātariśvā dadhātv ity āha

Sentence: 6 prāṇo vai vāyuḥ

Sentence: 7 prāṇenaivāsyai prāṇaṁ sam dadhāti

Sentence: 8 sam te vayur ity āha

Sentence: 9 tasmād vāyupracyutā divo vṛṣṭir īrte

Sentence: 10 tasmai ca devi vaṣaḍ astu //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 tubhyam ity āha

Sentence: 4 tasmāt sarvān ṛtūn varṣati

Sentence: 5 yad vaṣaṭkuryād rakṣāṁsi yajñaṁ hanyus \\

Sentence: 6 vaḍ ity āha

Sentence: 7 paro’kṣam eva vaṣaṭ karoti

Sentence: 8 nāsya yātayāmā vaṣaṭkāro bhavati na yajñaṁ rakṣāṁsi ghanati

Sentence: 9 sujāto jyotiṣā sahety anuṣṭubhopa nahyati \\

Sentence: 10 anuṣṭup //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 sarvāṇi chandāṁsi

Sentence: 2 chandāṁsi khalu vā agneḥ priyā tanūḥ

Sentence: 3 priyayaivainam tanuvā pari dadhāti

Sentence: 4 veduko vāso bhavati ya evam veda vāruṇo vā agnir upanaddhas \\

Sentence: 5 ud u tiṣṭha svadhvarordhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaya iti sāvitrībhyām ut tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 6 savitṛprasūta evāsyordhvām varuṇa menim ut sṛjati

Sentence: 7 dvābhyām

Sentence: 8 pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 9 sa jāto garbho asi //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 rodasyor ity āha \\

Sentence: 2 ime vai rodasī

Sentence: 3 tayor eṣa garbho yad agnis

Sentence: 4 tasmād evam āha \\

Sentence: 5 agne cārur vibhṛta oṣadhīṣv ity āha

Sentence: 6 yadā hy ṝtam vibharanty atha cārutaro bhavati

Sentence: 7 pra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradad gā ity āha \\

Sentence: 8 oṣadhayo vā asya mātaras

Sentence: 9 tābhya evainam pra cyāvayati

Sentence: 10 sthiro bhava vīḍvaṅga iti gardabha ā sādayati //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 sam nahyaty evainam etayā sthemne

Sentence: 2 gardabhena sam bharati

Sentence: 3 tasmād gardabhaḥ paśūnām bhārabhāritamas \\

Sentence: 4 gardabhena sam bharati

Sentence: 5 tasmād gardabho ‘py anāleśety anyān paśūn medyati \\

Sentence: 6 annaṁ hy ṝnenārkaṁ sambharanti

Sentence: 7 gardabhena sam bharati

Sentence: 8 tasmād gardabho dviretāḥ san kaniṣṭham paśūnām pra jāyate \\

Sentence: 9 agnir hy asya yonim nirdahati

Sentence: 10 prajāsu vā eṣa etarhy ārūḍhaḥ //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 sa īśvaraḥ prajāḥ śucā pradahaḥ

Sentence: 2 śivo bhava prajābhya ity āha

Sentence: 3 prajābhya evainaṁ śamayati

Sentence: 4 mānuṣībhyas tvam aṅgira ity āha

Sentence: 5 mānavyo hi prajās \\

Sentence: 6 mā dyāvāpṛthivī abhi śūśuco māntarikṣam mā vanaspatīn ity āha \\

Sentence: 7 ebhya evainam lokebhyaḥ śamayati

Sentence: 8 praitu vājī kanikradad ity āha

Sentence: 9 vājī hy { ṝṣa ^ ṝṣas }

Sentence: 10 nānadad rāsabhaḥ patveti //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 āha

Sentence: 2 rāsabha iti hy ṝtam ṝṣayo ‘vadan

Sentence: 3 bharann agnim purīṣyam ity āha \\

Sentence: 5 mā pādy āyuṣaḥ purety āha \\

Sentence: 6 āyur evāsmin dadhāti

Sentence: 7 tasmād gardabhaḥ sarvam āyur eti

Sentence: 8 tasmād gardabhe purāyuṣaḥ pramīte bibhyati

Sentence: 9 vṛṣāgnim vṛṣaṇam bharann ity āha

Sentence: 10 vṛṣā hy { ṝṣa ^ ṝṣas }

Sentence: 11 vṛṣāgnis \\

Sentence: 12 apām garbham //

Verse: 8

Sentence: 1 samudriyam ity āha \\

Sentence: 2 apāṁ hy ṝṣa garbho yad agnis \\

Sentence: 3 agna ā yāhi vītaya iti vā imau lokau vy aitām

Sentence: 4 agna ā yāhi vītaya iti yad āha \\

Sentence: 5 anayor lokayor vītyai

Sentence: 6 pracyuto vā eṣa āyatanād agataḥ pratiṣṭhām \\

Sentence: 7 sa etarhy adhvaryum ca yajamānam ca dhyāyati \\

Sentence: 8 ṛtaṁ satyam ity āha \\

Sentence: 9 iyam vā ṛtam asau //

Verse: 9

Sentence: 1 satyam

Sentence: 2 anayor evainam prati ṣṭhāpayati nārtim ārchaty adhvaryur na yajamānas \\

Sentence: 3 varuṇo vā eṣa yajamānam abhy aiti yad agnir upanaddhas \\

Sentence: 4 oṣadhayaḥ prati gṛhṇītāgnim etam ity āha

Sentence: 5 śāntyai

Sentence: 6 vyasyan viśvā amatīr arātīr ity āha

Sentence: 7 rakṣasām apahatyai

Sentence: 8 niṣīdan no apa durmatiṁ hanad ity āha

Sentence: 9 pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 10 oṣadhayaḥ prati modadhvam //

Verse: 10

Sentence: 1 enam ity āha \\

Sentence: 2 oṣadhayo vā agner bhāgadheyam \\

Sentence: 3 tābhir evainaṁ sam ardhayati

Sentence: 4 puṣpāvatīḥ supippalā ity āha

Sentence: 5 tasmād oṣadhayaḥ phalam gṛhṇanti \\

Sentence: 6 ayam vo garbha ṛtviyaḥ pratnaṁ sadhastham āsadad ity āha

Sentence: 7 yābhya evainam pracyāvayati tāsv evainam prati ṣṭhāpayati

Sentence: 8 dvābhyām upāvaharati

Sentence: 9 pratiṣṭhityai //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 vāruṇo vā agnir upanaddhas \\

Sentence: 3 savitṛprasūta evāsya viṣūcīm varuṇamenim vi sṛjati \\

Sentence: 1 enaṁ saṁ sṛjati

Sentence: 9 ambarīṣād annakāmasyāva dadhyāt \\

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 ava runddhe

Sentence: 2 muñjān ava dadhāti \\

Sentence: 10 etad vā agneḥ priyam dhāma yad ājyam

Sentence: 11 priyeṇaivainam dhāmnā sam ardhayaty atho tejasā //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 vaikamkarīm ā dadhāti

Sentence: 2 bhā evāva runddhe

Sentence: 3 śamīmayīm ā dadhāti

Sentence: 6 traya ime lokās \\

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 na ha sma vai purāgnir aparaśuvṛkṇam dahati

Sentence: 2 tad asmai prayoga evarṣir asvadayat \\

Sentence: 4 aparaśuvṛkṇam evāsmai svadayati

Sentence: 5 sarvam asmai svadate ya evam veda \\

Sentence: 6 audumbarīm ā dadhāti \\

Sentence: 7 ūrg vā udumbaras \\

Sentence: 8 ūrjam evāsmā api dadhāti

Sentence: 9 prajāpatir agnim asṛjata

Sentence: 10 taṁ sṛṣṭaṁ rakṣāṁsi //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ajighāṁsan \\

Sentence: 2 sa etad rākṣoghnam apaśyat

Sentence: 3 tena vai sa rakṣāṁsy apāhata

Sentence: 4 yad rākṣoghnam bhavaty agner eva tena jātād rakṣāṁsy apa hanti \\

Sentence: 5 āśvatthīm ā dadhāti \\

Sentence: 6 aśvattho vai vanaspatīnāṁ sapatnasāho vijityai

Sentence: 7 vaikaṅkatīm ā dadhāti

Sentence: 8 bhā evāva runddhe

Sentence: 9 śamīmayīm ā dadhāti

Sentence: 10 śāntyai

Sentence: 11 saṁśitam me brahmod eṣām bāhū atiram ity uttame audumbarī //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 vācayati

Sentence: 2 brahmaṇaiva kṣatraṁ saṁ śayati kṣatreṇa brahma

Sentence: 3 tasmād brāhmaṇo rājanyavān aty anyam brāhmaṇam tasmād rājanyo brāhmaṇavān aty anyaṁ rājanyam

Sentence: 4 mṛtyur vā eṣa yad agnis \\

Sentence: 5 amṛtaṁ hiraṇyam \\

Sentence: 6 rukmam antaram prati muñcate \\

Sentence: 7 amṛtam eva mṛtyor antar dhatte \\

Sentence: 8 ekaviṁśatinirbādho bhavati \\

Sentence: 9 ekaviṁśatir vai devalokā dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv ādityaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ekaviṁśa etāvanto vai devalokās

Sentence: 4 tan nirbādhānām nirbādhatvam \\

Sentence: 5 nirbādhī bhavati

Sentence: 6 bhrātṛvyān eva nirbādhe kurute

Sentence: 7 sāvitriyā prati muñcate

Sentence: 8 prasūtyai

Sentence: 9 naktoṣāsety uttarayā \\

Sentence: 10 ahorātrābhyām evainam ud yachate

Sentence: 11 devā agnim dhārayan draviṇodā ity āha

Sentence: 12 prāṇā vai devā draviṇodās \\

Sentence: 13 ahorātrābhyām evainam udyatya //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 prāṇair dādhāra \\

Sentence: 2 āsīnaḥ prati muñcate

Sentence: 3 tasmād āsīnāḥ prajāḥ pra jāyante

Sentence: 4 kṛṣṇājinam uttaram \\

Sentence: 5 tejo vai hiraṇyam brahma kṛṣṇājinam \\

Sentence: 6 tejasā caivainam brahmaṇā cobhayataḥ pari gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 7 ṣaḍudyāmaṁ śikyam bhavati

Sentence: 8 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 9 ṛtubhir evainam ud yachate

Sentence: 10 yad dvādaśodyāmaṁ samvatsareṇaiva

Sentence: 11 mauñjam bhavati \\

Sentence: 12 ūrg vai muñjās \\

Sentence: 13 ūrjaivainaṁ sam ardhayati

Sentence: 14 suparṇo ‘si garutmān ity avekṣate

Sentence: 15 rūpam evāsyaitan mahimānam vyācaṣṭe

Sentence: 16 divam gacha suvaḥ patety āha

Sentence: 17 suvargam evainam lokam gamayati //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a samiddho añjan kṛdaram matīnām ghṛtam agne madhumat pinvamānaḥ / vājī vahan vājinam jātavedo devānām vakṣi piryam ā sadhastham //

Sentence: 2=b ghṛtenāñjant sam patho devayānān prajānan vājy apy etu devān / anu tvā sapte pradiśaḥ sacantāṁ svadhām asmai yajamānāya dhehi //

Sentence: 3=c īḍyaś cāsi vandyaś ca vājinn āśuś cāsi medhyaś ca sapte / agniṣ ṭvā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 devair vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ prītam vahnim vahatu jātavedāḥ //

Sentence: 2=d stīrṇam barhiḥ suṣṭarīmā juṣāṇoru pṛthu prathamānam pṛthivyām / devebhir yuktam aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ syonam kṛṇvānā suvite dadhātu //

Sentence: 3=e etā u vaḥ subhagā viśvarūpā vi pakṣobhiḥ śrayamāṇā ud ātaiḥ / ṛṣvāḥ satīḥ kavaṣaḥ śumbhamānā dvāro devīḥ suprāyaṇā bhavantu //

Sentence: 4=f antarā mitrāvaruṇā carantī mukham yajñānām abhi samvidāne / uṣāsā vām //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 suhiraṇye suśilpe ṛtasya yonāv iha sādayāmi //

Sentence: 2=g prathamā vāṁ sarathinā suvarṇā devau paśyantau bhuvanāni viśvā / apiprayam codanā vām mimānā hotārā jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā //

Sentence: 3=h ādityair no bhāratī vaṣṭu yajñaṁ sarasvatī saha rudrair na āvīt / iḍopahūtā vasubhiḥ sajoṣā yajñam no devīr amṛteṣu dhatta //

Sentence: 4=i tvaṣṭā vīram devakāmam jajāna tvaṣṭur arvā jāyata āśur aśvaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 tvaṣṭedam viśvam bhuvanam jajāna bahoḥ kartāram iha yakṣi hotaḥ //

Sentence: 2=k aśvo ghṛtena tmanyā samakta upa devāṁ ṛtuśaḥ pātha etu / vanaspatir devalokam prajānann agninā havyā svaditāni vakṣat //

Sentence: 3=l prajāpates tapasā vāvṛdhānaḥ sadyo jāto dadhiṣe yajñam agne / svāhākṛtena haviṣā purogā yāhi sādhyā havir adantu devāḥ //

## Chapter: 2

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 viṣṇumukhā vai devāś chandobhir imāṁ lokān anapajayyam abhy ajayan

Sentence: 2 yad viṣṇukramān kramate viṣṇur eva bhūtvā yajamānaś chandobhir imāṁ lokān anapajayyam abhi jayati

Sentence: 3 viṣṇoḥ kramo ‘sy abhimātihety āha

Sentence: 4 gāyatrī vai pṛthivī

Sentence: 5 traiṣṭhubham antarikṣam \\

Sentence: 6 jāgatī dyaus \\

Sentence: 7 ānuṣṭubhīr diśas \\

Sentence: 8 chandobhir evemāṁ lokān yathāpūrvam abhi jayati

Sentence: 9 prajāpatir agnim asṛjata

Sentence: 10 so ‘smāt sṛṣṭaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 parāṅ ait

Sentence: 2 tam etayānv ait \\

Sentence: 3 akrandat iti

Sentence: 4 tayā vai so ‘gneḥ priyam dhāmāvārunddha

Sentence: 5 yad eṭam anvāhāgner evaitayā priyam dhāmāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 6 īśvaro vā eṣa parāṅ pradagho yo viṣṇukramān kramate

Sentence: 7 catasṛbhir ā vartate

Sentence: 8 catvāri chandāṁsi

Sentence: 9 chandāṁsi khalu vā agneḥ priyā tanūḥ

Sentence: 10 priyām evāsya tanuvam abhi //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 paryāvartate

Sentence: 2 dakṣiṇā paryāvartate

Sentence: 3 svam eva vīryam anu paryāvartate

Sentence: 4 tasmād dakṣiṇo ‘rdha ātmano vīryāvattaras \\

Sentence: 5 atho ādityasyaivāvṛtam anu paryāvartate

Sentence: 6 śunaḥśepam ājīgartim varuṇo ‘gṛhṇāt

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Verse: 3

Verse: 1

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 so ‘gneḥ kṛṣṇo rūpam kṛtvod āyata

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a gāyatrī triṣṭub jagaty anuṣṭuk paṅktyā saha / bṛhaty ḥṣṇihā kakut sūcībhiḥ śimyantu tvā //

Sentence: 2=b dvipadā yā catuṣpadā tripadā yā ca ṣaṭpadā / sachandā yā ca vichandāḥ sūcībhiḥ śimyantu tvā //

Sentence: 3=c mahānāmnī revatayo viśvā āśāḥ prasūvarīḥ / meghyā vidyuto vācaḥ sūcībhiḥ śimyantu tvā //

Sentence: 4=d rajatā hariṇīḥ sīsā yujo yujyante karmabhiḥ / aśvasya vājinas tvaci sūcībhiḥ śimyantu tvā //

Sentence: 5=e nārīḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 te patnayo loma vi cinvantu manīṣayā / devānām patnīr diśaḥ sūcībhiḥ śimyantu tvā //

Paragraph: 12

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a kas tvā chyati kas tvā vi śāsti kas te gātrāṇi śimyati / ka u te śamitā kaviḥ //

Sentence: 2=b ṛtavas ta ṛtudhā paruḥ śamitāro vi śāsatu / samvatsarasya dhāyasā śimībhiḥ śimyantu tvā //

Sentence: 3=c daivyā adhvaryavas tvā chyantu vi ca śāsatu / gātrāṇi parvaśas te śimāḥ kṛṇvantu śimyantaḥ //

Sentence: 4=d ardhamāsāḥ parūṁṣi te māsāś chyantu śimyantaḥ / ahorātrāṇi maruto viliṣṭam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 sūdayantu te //

Sentence: 2=e pṛthivī te ‘ntarikṣeṇa vāyuś chidram bhiṣajyatu / dyaus te nakṣatraiḥ saha rūpam kṛṇotu sādhuyā //

Sentence: 3=f śam te parebhyo gātrebhyaḥ śam astv avarebhyaḥ / śam asthabhyo majjabhyaḥ śam u te tanuve bhuvat //

Sentence: 5 yam dviṣyāt tam upadadhad dhyāyet \\

Sentence: 6 etābhya evainam devatābhya ā vṛścati

Sentence: 7 tājag ārtim ārchati \\

Sentence: 8 uttarā nākasadbhya upa dadhāti

Sentence: 9 yathā jāyām ānīya gṛheṣu niṣādayati tādṛg eva tat //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 paścāt prācīm uttamām upa dadhāti tasmāt paścāt prācī patny anv āste

Sentence: 2 svayamātṛṇṇām ca vikarṇīm cottame upa dadhāti

Sentence: 3 prāṇo vai svayamātṛṇṇāyur vikarṇī

Sentence: 4 prāṇam caivāyuś ca prāṇānām uttamau dhatte

Sentence: 5 tasmāt prāṇaś cāyuś ca prāṇānām uttamau

Sentence: 6 nānyām uttarām iṣṭakām upa dadhyāt \\

Sentence: 7 yad anyām uttarām iṣṭakām upadadhyāt paśūnām //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ca yajamānasya ca prāṇam cāyuś cāpi dadhyāt

Sentence: 2 tasmān nānyottareṣṭakopadheyā

Sentence: 3 svayamātṛṇṇām upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 4 asau vai svayamātṛṇṇāmūm evopa dhatte \\

Sentence: 5 aśvam upa ghrāpayati prāṇam evāsyām dadhāti \\

Sentence: 6 atho prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ prajāpatinaivāgnim cinute

Sentence: 7 svayamātṛṇṇā bhavati prāṇānām utsṛṣṭyā atho suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai \\

Sentence: 8 eṣā vai devānām vikrāntir yad vikarṇī

Sentence: 9 yad vikarṇīm upadadhāti devānām eva vikrāntim anu vi kramate \\

Sentence: 10 uttarata upa dadhāti

Sentence: 11 tasmād uttarataupacāro ‘gnis \\

Sentence: 12 vāyumatī bhavati

Sentence: 13 samiddhyai //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 chandāṁsy upa dadhāti

Sentence: 2 paśavo vai chandāṁsi

Sentence: 3 paśūn evāva runddhe

Sentence: 4 chandāṁsi vai devānām vāmam paśavas \\

Sentence: 5 vāmam eva paśūn ava runddhe \\

Sentence: 6 etāṁ ha vai yajñasenaś caitriyāyaṇaś citim vidām cakāra

Sentence: 7 tayā vai sa paśūn avārunddha

Sentence: 8 yad etām upadadhāti paśūn evāva runddhe

Sentence: 9 gāyatrīḥ purastād upa dadhāti

Sentence: 10 tejo vai gāyatrī

Sentence: 11 teja eva //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 mukhato dhatte

Sentence: 2 mūrdhanvatīr bhavanti

Sentence: 3 mūrdhānam evainaṁ samānānām karoti

Sentence: 4 triṣṭubha upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 5 indriyam vai { triṣṭug ^ triṣṭubh }

Sentence: 6 indriyam eva madhyato dhatte

Sentence: 7 jagatīr upa dadhāti

Sentence: 8 jāgatā vai paśavaḥ

Sentence: 9 paśūn evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 10 anuṣṭubha upa dadhāti

Sentence: 11 prāṇā vā { anuṣṭup ^ anuṣṭubh }

Sentence: 12 prāṇānām utsṛṣṭyai

Sentence: 13 bṛhatīr uṣṇihāḥ paṅktīr akṣarapaṅktīr iti viṣurūpāṇi chandāṁsy upa dadhāti

Sentence: 14 viṣurūpā vai paśavaḥ

Sentence: 15 paśavaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 chandāṁsi

Sentence: 2 viṣurūpān eva paśūn ava runddhe

Sentence: 3 viṣurūpam asya gṛhe dṛśyate yasyaitā upadhīyante ya u cainā evam veda \\

Sentence: 4 atichandasam upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 5 atichandā vai sarvāṇi chandāṁsi

Sentence: 6 sarvebhir evainam chandobhiś cinute

Sentence: 7 varṣma vā eṣā chandasām yad atichandās \\

Sentence: 8 yat atichandasam upadadhāti varṣmaivainaṁ samānānām karoti

Sentence: 9 dvipadā upa dadhāti

Sentence: 10 dvipād yajamānaḥ

Sentence: 11 pratiṣṭhityai //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 sarvābhyo vai devatābhyo ‘gniś cīyate

Sentence: 2 {F yat} {W yat} sayujo nopadadhyād devatā asyāgnim vṛñjīran

Sentence: 3 yat sayuja upadadhāty ātmanaivainaṁ sayujam cinute nāgninā vy ṛdhyate \\

Sentence: 4 atho yathā puruṣaḥ snāvabhiḥ samtata evam evaitābhir agniḥ samtatas \\

Sentence: 5 agninā vai devāḥ suvargam lokam āyan tā amūḥ kṛttikā abhavan

Sentence: 6 yasyaitā upadhīyante suvargam eva //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 lokam eti gachati prakāśam citram eva bhavati

Sentence: 2 maṇḍaleṣṭakā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 3 ime vai lokā maṇḍaleṣṭakās \\

Sentence: 4 ime khalu vai lokā devapurās \\

Sentence: 5 devapurā eva pra viśati nārtim ārchaty agnim cikyānas \\

Sentence: 6 viśvajyotiṣa upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 7 imān evaitābhir lokāñ jyotiṣmataḥ kurute \\

Sentence: 8 atho prāṇān evaitā yajamānasya dādhrati \\

Sentence: 9 etā vai devatāḥ suvargyās

Sentence: 10 tā evānvārabhya suvargam lokam eti //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 vṛṣṭisanīr upa dadhāti

Sentence: 2 vṛṣṭim evāva runddhe

Sentence: 3 yad ekadhopadadhyād ekam ṛtum varṣet \\

Sentence: 4 anuparihāraṁ sādayati tasmāt sarvān ṛtūn varṣati

Sentence: 5 purovātasanir asīty āha \\

Sentence: 6 etad vai vṛṣṭyai rūpam \\

Sentence: 7 rūpeṇaiva vṛṣṭim ava runddhe

Sentence: 8 samyānībhir vai devā imāṁ lokānt sam ayus

Sentence: 9 tat samyānīnāṁ samyānitvam \\

Sentence: 10 yat samyānīr upadadhāti yathāpsu nāvā samyāty evam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 evaitābhir yajamāna imāṁ lokānt sam yāti

Sentence: 2 plavo vā eṣo ‘gner yat samyānīs \\

Sentence: 3 yat samyānir upadadhāti plavam evaitam agnaya upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 4 uta yasyaitāsūpahitāsv āpo ‘gniṁ haranty ahṛta evāsyāgnis \\

Sentence: 5 ādityeṣṭakā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 6 ādityā vā etam bhūtyai prati nudante yo ‘lam bhūtyai san bhūtim na prāpnoti \\

Sentence: 7 ādityāḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 evainam bhūtim gamayanti \\

Sentence: 2 asau vā etasyādityo rucam ā datte yo ‘gnim citvā na rocate

Sentence: 3 yad ādityeṣṭakā upadadhāy asāv evāsminn ādityo rucam dadhāti

Sentence: 4 yathāsau devānāṁ rocata evam evaiṣa manuṣyāṇāṁ rocate

Sentence: 5 ghṛteṣṭakā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 6 etad vā agneḥ priyam dhāma yad ghṛtam

Sentence: 7 priyeṇaivainam dhāmnā sam ardhayati //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 atho tejasā \\

Sentence: 2 anuparihāraṁ sādayati \\

Sentence: 3 aparivargam evāsmin tejo dadhāti

Sentence: 4 prajāpatir agnim acinuta

Sentence: 5 sa yaśasā vy ārdhyata

Sentence: 6 sa etā yaśodā apaśyat

Sentence: 7 tā upādhatta

Sentence: 8 tābhir vai sa yaśa ātmann adhatta

Sentence: 9 yad yaśodā upadadhāti yaśa eva tābhir yajamāna ātman dhatte

Sentence: 10 pañcopa dadhāti

Sentence: 11 pāṅktaḥ puruṣas \\

Sentence: 12 yāvān eva puruṣas tasmin yaśo dadhāti //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 devāsurāḥ samyattā āsan

Sentence: 2 kanīyāṁso devā āsan bhūyāṁso ‘surās

Sentence: 3 te devā etā iṣṭakā apaśyan

Sentence: 4 tā upādadhata

Sentence: 5 bhūyaskṛd asīty eva bhūyāṁso ‘bhavan vanaspatibhir oṣadhībhis \\

Sentence: 6 varivaskṛd asītīmām ajayan

Sentence: 7 prācy asīti prācīm diśam ajayan \\

Sentence: 8 ūrdhvāsīty amūm ajayan \\

Sentence: 9 antarikṣasad asy antarikṣe sīdety antarikṣam ajayan

Sentence: 10 tato devā abhavan //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 parāsurās \\

Sentence: 2 yasyaitā upadhīyante bhūyān eva bhavati \\

Sentence: 3 abhīmāṁ lokāñ jayati

Sentence: 4 bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati \\

Sentence: 5 apsuṣad asi śyenasad asīty āha \\

Sentence: 6 etad vā agne rūpam \\

Sentence: 7 rūpeṇaivāgnim ava runddhe

Sentence: 8 pṛthivyās tvā draviṇe sādayāmīty āha \\

Sentence: 9 imān evaitābhir lokān draviṇāvataḥ kurute \\

Sentence: 10 āyuṣyā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 11 āyur eva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 asmin dadhāti \\

Sentence: 2 agne yat te paraṁ hṛn nāmety āha \\

Sentence: 3 etad vā agneḥ priyam dhāma

Sentence: 4 priyam evāsya dhāmopāpnoti

Sentence: 5 tāv ehi saṁ rabhāvahā ity āha

Sentence: 6 vy ṝvainena pari dhatte

Sentence: 7 pāñcajanyeṣv apy edhy agna ity āha \\

Sentence: 8 eṣa vā agniḥ pāñcajanyo yaḥ pañcacitīkas

Sentence: 9 tasmād evam āha \\

Sentence: 10 ṛtvayā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 11 etad vā ṛtūnām priyam dhāma yad ṛtavyās \\

Sentence: 12 ṛtūnām eva priyam dhāmāva runddhe

Sentence: 13 sumeka ity āha

Sentence: 14 samvatsaro vai sumekaḥ

Sentence: 15 samvatsarasyaiva priyam dhāmopāpnoti //

Paragraph: 12

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpater akṣy aśvayat

Sentence: 2 tat parāpatat

Sentence: 3 tad aśvo ‘bhavat \\

Sentence: 4 yad aśvayat tad aśvasyāśvatvam \\

Sentence: 5 tad devā aśvamedhenaiva praty adadhus \\

Sentence: 6 eṣa vai prajāpatiṁ sarvam karoti yo ‘śvamedhena yajate

Sentence: 7 sarva eva bhavati

Sentence: 8 sarvasya vā eṣā prāyaścittiḥ sarvasya bheṣajam \\

Sentence: 9 sarvam vā etena pāpmānam devā ataran \\

Sentence: 10 api vā etena brahmahatyām ataran \\

Sentence: 11 sarvam pāpmānam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 tarati tarati brahmahatyām yo ‘śvamedhena yajate ya u cainam evam veda \\

Sentence: 2 uttaram vai tat prajāpater akṣy aśvayat

Sentence: 3 tasmād aśvasyottarato ‘va dyanti dakṣiṇato ‘nyeṣām paśūnām \\

Sentence: 4 vaitasaḥ kaṭo bhavati \\

Sentence: 5 apsuyonir vā aśvas \\

Sentence: 6 apsujo vetasaḥ

Sentence: 7 sva evainam yonau prati ṣṭhāpayati

Sentence: 8 catuṣṭoma stomo bhavati

Sentence: 9 saraḍ ḍha vā aśvasya sakthy āvṛhat

Sentence: 10 tad devāś catuṣṭomenaiva praty adadhus \\

Sentence: 11 yac catuṣṭoma stomo bhavaty aśvasya sarvatvāya //

## Chapter: 4

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 devāsurāḥ samyattā āsan

Sentence: 2 te na vy ajayanta

Sentence: 3 sa etā indras tanūr apaśyat

Sentence: 4 tā upādhatta

Sentence: 5 tābhir vai sa tanuvam indriyam vīryam ātmann adhatta

Sentence: 6 tato devā abhavan parāsurās \\

Sentence: 7 yad indratanūr upadadhāti tanuvam eva tābhir indriyam vīryam yajamāna ātman dhatte \\

Sentence: 8 atho sendram evāgniṁ satanum cinute

Sentence: 9 bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 bhavati

Sentence: 2 yajño devebhyo ‘pākrāmat

Sentence: 3 tam avarudham nāśaknuvan

Sentence: 4 ta etā yajñatanūr apaśyan

Sentence: 5 tā upādadhata

Sentence: 6 tābhir vai te yajñam avārundhata

Sentence: 7 yad yajñatanūr upadadhāti yajñam eva tābhir yajamāno ‘va runddhe

Sentence: 8 trayastriṁśatam upa dadhāti

Sentence: 9 trayastriṁśad vai devatās \\

Sentence: 10 devatā evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 11 atho sātmānam evāgniṁ satanum cinute

Sentence: 12 sātmāmuṣmiṁ loke //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 bhavati ya evam veda

Sentence: 2 jyotiṣmatīr upa dadhāti

Sentence: 3 jyotir evāsmin dadhāti \\

Sentence: 4 etābhir vā agniś cito jvalati

Sentence: 5 tābhir evainaṁ sam inddhe \\

Sentence: 6 ubhayor asmai lokayor jyotir bhavati

Sentence: 7 nakṣatreṣṭakā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 8 etāni vai divo jyotīṁṣi

Sentence: 9 tāny evāva runddhe

Sentence: 10 sukṛtām vā etāni jyotīṁṣi yan nakṣatrāṇi

Sentence: 11 tāny evāpnoti \\

Sentence: 12 atho anūkāśam evaitāni //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 jyotīṁṣi kurute suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai

Sentence: 2 yat saṁspṛṣṭā upadadhyād vṛṣṭyai lokam api dadhyād avarṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāt \\

Sentence: 3 asaṁspṛṣṭā upa dadhāti vṛṣṭyā eva lokam karoti varṣukaḥ parjanyo bhavati

Sentence: 4 purastād anyāḥ pratīcīr upa dadhāti paścād anyāḥ prācīs

Sentence: 5 tasmāt prācīnāni ca pratīcīnāni ca nakṣatrāṇy ā vartante //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ṛtavyā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 2 ṛtūnām k??ptyai

Sentence: 3 dvamdvam upa dadhāti

Sentence: 4 tasmād dvamdvam ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 5 adhṛteva vā eṣā yan madhyamā citis \\

Sentence: 6 antarikṣam iva vā eṣā

Sentence: 7 dvamdvam anyāsu citīṣūpa dadhāti catasro madhye dhṛtyai \\

Sentence: 8 antaḥśleṣaṇam vā etāś citīnām yad ṛtavyās \\

Sentence: 9 yad ṛtavyā upadadhāti citīnām vidhṛtyai \\

Sentence: 10 avakām anūpa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 11 eṣā vā agner yoniḥ

Sentence: 12 sayonim //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 evāgnim cinute \\

Sentence: 2 uvāca ha viśvāmitras \\

Sentence: 3 adad it sa brahmaṇānnam yasyaitā upadhīyāntai ya u cainā evam vedad iti

Sentence: 4 samvatsaro vā etam pratiṣṭhāyai nudate yo ‘gnim citvā na pratitiṣṭhati

Sentence: 5 pañca pūrvāś citayo bhavanty atha ṣaṣṭhīm citim cinute

Sentence: 6 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ samvatsaras \\

Sentence: 7 ṛtuṣv eva samvatsare prati tiṣṭhati \\

Sentence: 8 etā vai //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 adhipatnīr nāmeṣṭakās \\

Sentence: 2 yasyaitā upadhīyante ‘dhipatir eva samānānām bhavati

Sentence: 3 yam dviṣyāt tam upadadhad dhyāyet \\

Sentence: 4 etābhya evainam devatābhya ā vṛścati

Sentence: 5 ārtim ārchati \\

Sentence: 6 aṅgirasaḥ suvargam lokam yanto yā yajñasya niṣkṛtir āsīt tām ṛṣibhyaḥ praty auhan

Sentence: 7 tad dhiraṇyam abhavat \\

Sentence: 8 yad dhiraṇyaśalkaiḥ prokṣati yajñasya niṣkṛtyai \\

Sentence: 9 atho bheṣajam evāsmai karoti //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 atho rūpeṇaivainaṁ sam ardhayati \\

Sentence: 2 atho hiraṇyajyotiṣaiva suvargam lokam eti

Sentence: 3 sāhasravatā prokṣati

Sentence: 4 sāhasraḥ prajāpatiḥ

Sentence: 5 prajāpater āptyai \\

Sentence: 6 imā me agna iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santv ity āha \\

Sentence: 7 dhenūr evaināḥ kurute

Sentence: 8 tā enam kāmadughā amutrāmuṣmiṁ loka upa tiṣṭhante //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 rudro vā eṣa yad agniḥ

Sentence: 2 sa etarhi jāto yarhi sarvaś citaḥ

Sentence: 3 sa yathā vatso jāta stanam prepsaty evam vā eṣa etarhi bhāgadheyam prepsati

Sentence: 4 tasmai yad āhutim na juhuyād adhvaryum ca yajamānam ca dhyāyet \\

Sentence: 5 śatarudrīyam juhoti

Sentence: 6 bhāgadheyenaivainaṁ śamayati

Sentence: 7 nārtim ārchaty adhvaryur na yajamānas \\

Sentence: 8 yad grāmyāṇām paśūnām //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 payasā juhuyād grāmyān paśūñ chucārpayet \\

Sentence: 2 yad āraṇyānām āraṇyān \\

Sentence: 3 jartilayavāgvā vā juhuyād gavīdhukayavāgvā vā

Sentence: 4 na grāmyān paśūn hinasti nāraṇyān

Sentence: 5 atho khalv āhus \\

Sentence: 6 anāhutir vai jartilāś ca gavīdhukāś ceti \\

Sentence: 7 ajakṣīreṇa juhoti \\

Sentence: 8 āgneyī vā eṣā yad ajā \\

Sentence: 9 āhutyaiva juhoti

Sentence: 10 na grāmyān paśūn hinasti nāraṇyān

Sentence: 11 aṅgirasaḥ suvargam lokam yantaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ajāyām gharmam prāsiñcan \\

Sentence: 2 sā śocantī parṇam parājihīta

Sentence: 3 so ‘rko ‘bhavat

Sentence: 4 tad arkasyārkatvam

Sentence: 5 arkaparṇena juhoti sayonitvāya \\

Sentence: 6 udaṅ tiṣṭhañ juhoti \\

Sentence: 7 eṣā vai rudrasya { dik ^ diś }

Sentence: 8 svāyām eva diśi rudram niravadayate

Sentence: 9 caramāyām iṣṭakāyām juhoti \\

Sentence: 10 antata eva rudram niravadayate

Sentence: 11 tredhāvibhaktam juhoti

Sentence: 12 traya ime lokās \\

Sentence: 13 imān eva lokānt samāvadvīryān karoti \\

Sentence: 14 iyaty agre juhoti //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 atheyaty atheyati

Sentence: 2 traya ime lokās \\

Sentence: 3 ebhya evainam lokebhyaḥ śamayati

Sentence: 4 tisra uttarā āhutīr juhoti

Sentence: 5 ṣaṭ sam padyante

Sentence: 6 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 7 ṛtubhir evainaṁ śamayati

Sentence: 8 yad anuparikrāmam juhuyād antaravacāriṇaṁ rudram kuryāt \\

Sentence: 9 atho khalv āhuḥ

Sentence: 10 kasyām vāha diśi rudraḥ kasyām veti \\

Sentence: 11 anuparikrāmam eva hotavyam

Sentence: 12 aparivargam evainaṁ śamayati //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 etā vai devatāḥ suvargyā yā uttamās

Sentence: 2 tā yajamānam vācayati

Sentence: 3 tābhir evainaṁ suvargam lokam gamayati

Sentence: 4 yam dviṣyāt tasya samcare paśūnām ny asyet \\

Sentence: 5 yaḥ prathamaḥ paśur abhitiṣṭhati sa ārtim ārchati //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 aśmann ūrjam iti pari ṣiñcati

Sentence: 2 mārjayaty evainam

Sentence: 3 atho tarpayaty eva

Sentence: 4 sa enam tṛpto ‘kṣudhyann aśocann amuṣmiṁ loka upa tiṣṭhate

Sentence: 5 tṛpyati prajayā paśubhir ya evam veda

Sentence: 6 tām na iṣam ūrjam dhatta marutaḥ saṁrarāṇā ity āha \\

Sentence: 7 annam vā ūrj \\

Sentence: 8 annam marutas \\

Sentence: 9 annam evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 10 aśmaṁs te kṣudh \\

Sentence: 11 amum te śuk //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ṛchatu yam dviṣma ity āha

Sentence: 2 yam eva dveṣṭi tam asya kṣudhā ca śucā cārpayati

Sentence: 3 triḥ pariṣiñcan pary eti

Sentence: 4 trivṛd vā agnis \\

Sentence: 5 yāvān evāgnis tasya śucaṁ śamayati

Sentence: 6 triḥ punaḥ pary eti

Sentence: 7 ṣaṭ sam padyante

Sentence: 8 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 9 ṛtubhir evāsya śucaṁ śamayati \\

Sentence: 10 apām vā etat puṣpam yad vetasas \\

Sentence: 11 apām //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 śaro ‘vakās \\

Sentence: 2 vetasaśākhayā cāvakābhiś ca vi karṣati \\

Sentence: 3 āpo vai śāntāḥ

Sentence: 4 śāntābhir evāsya śucaṁ śamayati

Sentence: 5 yo vā agnim citam prathamaḥ paśur adhikrāmatīśvaro vai taṁ śucā pradahas \\

Sentence: 6 maṇḍūkena vi karṣati \\

Sentence: 7 eṣa vai paśūnām anupajīvanīyas \\

Sentence: 8 na vā eṣa grāmyeṣu paśuṣu hito nāraṇyeṣu

Sentence: 9 tam eva śucārpayati \\

Sentence: 9 yad etābhir vyāhṛtībhiḥ svayamātṛṇṇā upadadhātīmān eva lokān upadhāyaiṣu //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 lokeṣv adhi pra jāyate

Sentence: 2 prāṇāya vyānāyāpānāya vāce tvā cakṣuṣe tvā tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda \\

Sentence: 3 agninā vai devāḥ suvargam lokam ajigāṁsan

Sentence: 4 tena patitum nāśaknuvan

Sentence: 5 ta etāś catasraḥ svayamātṛṇṇā apaśyan

Sentence: 6 tā dikṣūpādadhata

Sentence: 7 tena sarvataścakṣuṣā suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 8 yac catasraḥ svayamātṛṇṇā dikṣūpadadhāti sarvataścakṣuṣaiva tad agninā yajamānaḥ suvargam lokam eti //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a agna ā yāhi vītaye \\

Sentence: 2 ity āhāhvataivainam

Sentence: 3=b agnim dūtam vṛṇīmahe \\

Sentence: 4 ity āha hutvaivainam vṛṇīte \\

Sentence: 5=c agnināgniḥ sam idhyate \\

Sentence: 6 ity āha sam inddha evainam

Sentence: 7=d agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanat \\

Sentence: 8 ity āha samiddha evāsminn indriyam dadhāti \\

Sentence: 9=e agne stomam manāmahe \\

Sentence: 10 ity āha manuta evainam

Sentence: 11 etāni vā ahnāṁ rūpāṇi //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 anvaham evainam cinute \\

Sentence: 2 avāhnāṁ rūpāṇi runddhe

Sentence: 3 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 4 kasmāt satyād yātayāmnīr anyā iṣṭakā ayatayāmnī lokampṛṇety aindrāgnī hi bārhaspatyeti brūyāt \\

Sentence: 5 indrāgnī ca hi devānām bṛhaspatiś cāyātayāmānas \\

Sentence: 6 anucaravatī bhavati \\

Sentence: 7 ajāmitvāya \\

Sentence: 8 anuṣṭubhānu carati \\

Sentence: 9 ātmā vai lokampṛṇā prāṇo ‘nuṣṭup tasmāt prāṇaḥsarvāṇy aṅgāny anu carati

Sentence: 10 tā asya sūdadohasaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ity āha

Sentence: 2 tasmāt paruṣiparuṣi rasaḥ

Sentence: 3 somaṁ śrīṇanti pṛśunaya ity āha \\

Sentence: 4 annam vai pṛśny annam evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 5 arko vā agnir akro ‘nnam annam evāva runddhe

Sentence: 6 janman devānām viśas tṛṣv ā rocane diva ity āha \\

Sentence: 7 imān evāsmai lokāñ jyotiṣmataḥ karoti

Sentence: 8 yo vā iṣṭakānām pratiṣṭhām veda praty eva tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 9 tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīdety āha \\

Sentence: 10 eṣā vā iṣṭakānām pratiṣṭhā ya evam veda praty eva tiṣṭhati //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 suvargāya vā eṣa lokāya cīyate yad agnis \\

Sentence: 2 vajra ekādaśinī

Sentence: 3 yad agnāv ekādaśinīm minuyād vajreṇainaṁ suvargāl lokād antar dadhyāt \\

Sentence: 4 yan na minuyāt svarubhiḥ paśūn vy ardhayet \\

Sentence: 5 ekayūpam minoti

Sentence: 6 nainam vajreṇa suvargāl lokād antardadhāti na svarubhiḥ paśūn vy ardhayati

Sentence: 7 vi vā eṣa indriyeṇa vīryṝṇardhyate yo ‘gnim cinvann adhikrāmati \\

Sentence: 8 aindriyā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ṛcākramaṇam pratīṣṭakām upa dadhyāt \\

Sentence: 2 nendriyeṇa vīryṝṇa vy ṛdhyate

Sentence: 3 rudro vā eṣa yad agnis

Sentence: 4 tasya tisraḥ śaravyāḥ pratīcī tiraścy anūcī

Sentence: 5 tābhyo vā eṣa ā vṛścyate yo ‘gnim cinute \\

Sentence: 6 agnim citvā tisṛdhanvam ayācitam brāhmaṇāya dadyāt

Sentence: 7 tābhya eva namas karoti \\

Sentence: 8 atho tābhya evātmānam niṣ krīnīte

Sentence: 9 yat te rudra puraḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 dhanus tad vāto anu vātu te

Sentence: 2 tasmai te rudra samvatsareṇa namas karomi

Sentence: 3 yat te rudra dakṣiṇā dhanus tad vāto anu vātu te

Sentence: 4 tasmai te rudra parivatsareṇa namas karomi

Sentence: 5 yat te rudra paścād dhanus tad vāto anu vātu te

Sentence: 6 tasmai te rudredāvatsareṇa namas karomi

Sentence: 7 yat te rudrottarād dhanus tat //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vāto anu vātu te

Sentence: 2 tasmai te rudreduvatsareṇa namas karomi

Sentence: 3 yat te rudropari dhanus tad vāto anu vātu te

Sentence: 4 tasmai te rudra vatsareṇa namas karomi

Sentence: 5 rudro vā eṣa yad agniḥ

Sentence: 6 sa yathā vyāghraḥ kruddhas tiṣṭhaty evam vā eṣa etarhi

Sentence: 7 samcitam etair upa tiṣṭhate

Sentence: 8 namaskārair evainaṁ śamayati

Sentence: 9 ye ‘gnayaḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 purīṣyāḥ praviṣṭāḥ pṛthivīm anu /

Sentence: 2 teṣām tvam asy uttamaḥ pra ṇo jīvātave suva //

Sentence: 3 āpam tvāgne manasā \\

Sentence: 4 āpam tvāgne tapasā \\

Sentence: 5 āpam tvāgne dīkṣayā \\

Sentence: 6 āpam tvāgna upasadbhis \\

Sentence: 7 āpam tvāgne sutyayā \\

Sentence: 8 āpam tvāgne dakṣiṇābhis \\

Sentence: 9 āpam tvāgne ‘vabhṛthena \\

Sentence: 10 āpam tvāgne vaśayā \\

Sentence: 11 āpam tvāgne svagākāreṇety āha \\

Sentence: 12 eṣā vā agner āptis

Sentence: 13 tayaivainam āpnoti //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 gāyatreṇa purastād upa tiṣṭhate prāṇam evāsmin dadhāti

Sentence: 2 bṛhadrathamtarābhyām pakṣāv oja evāsmin dadhāti \\

Sentence: 3 ṛtusthāyajñāyajñiyena pucham ṛtuṣv eva prati tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 4 pṛṣṭhair upa tiṣṭhate

Sentence: 5 tejo vai pṛṣṭhāni

Sentence: 6 teja evāsmin dadhāti

Sentence: 7 prajāpatir agnim asṛjata

Sentence: 8 so ‘smāt sṛṣṭaḥ parāṅ ait

Sentence: 9 tam vāravantīyenāvārayata tad vāravantīyasya vāravantīyatvam \\

Sentence: 10 śyaitena śyetī akuruta tac chyaitasya śyaitatvam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yad vāravantīyenopatiṣṭhate vārayata evainam \\

Sentence: 2 śyaitena śyetī kurute

Sentence: 3 prajāpater hṛdayenāpipakṣam praty upa tiṣṭhate

Sentence: 4 premāṇam evāsya gachati

Sentence: 5 prācyā tvā diśā sādayāmi gāyatreṇa chandasāgninā devatayāgneḥ śīrṣṇāgneḥ śira upa dadhāmi

Sentence: 6 dakṣiṇayā tvā diśā sādayāmi traiṣṭubhena chandasendreṇa devatayāgneḥ pakṣeṇāgneḥ pakṣam upa dadhāmi

Sentence: 7 pratīcyā tvā diśā sādayāmi //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 jāgatena chandasā savitrā devatayāgneḥ puchenāgneḥ pucham upa dadhāmi \\

Sentence: 2 udīcyā tvā diśā sādayāmy ānuṣṭubhena chandasā mitrāvaruṇābhyām devatayāgneḥ pakṣeṇāgneḥ pakṣam upa dadhāmi \\

Sentence: 3 ūrdhvayā tvā diśā sādayāmi pāṅktena chandasā bṛhaspatinā devatayāgneḥ pṛṣṭhenāgneḥ pṛṣṭham upa dadhāmi

Sentence: 4 yo vā apātmānam agnim cinute ‘pātmāmuṣmiṁ loke bhavati

Sentence: 5 yaḥ sātmānam {F cinute} {W cinute} {GLOS cinute} sātmāmuṣmiṁ loke bhavati \\

Sentence: 6 ātmeṣṭakā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 7 eṣa vā agner ātmā

Sentence: 8 sātmānam evāgnim cinute

Sentence: 9 sātmāmuṣmiṁ loke bhavati ya evam veda //

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 tanuvā me saha namas te astu mā mā hiṁsīs \\

Sentence: 4=i yo rudro agnau yo apsu ya oṣadhīṣu yo rudro viśvā bhuvanāviveśa tasmai rudrāya namo astu \\

Sentence: 5=k āhutibhāgā vā anye rudrā havirbhāgāḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 anye śatarudrīyaṁ hutvā gāvīdhukam carum etena yajuṣā caramāyām iṣṭakāyām ni dadhyād bhāgadheyenaivainaṁ śamayati tasya tvai śatarudrīyaṁ hutam

Sentence: 2 ity āhur yasyaitad agnau kriyata iti

Sentence: 3=l vasavas tvā rudraiḥ purastāt pāntu pitaras tvā yamarājānaḥ pitṛbhir dakṣiṇataḥ pāntv ādityās tvā viśvair devaiḥ paścāt pāntu dyutānas tvā māruto marudbhir uttarataḥ pātu /=5 devās tvendrajyeṣṭhā varuṇarājāno ‘dhastāc copariṣṭhāc ca pāntu

Sentence: 1 no dveṣṭi tam vām jambhe dadhāmi \\

Sentence: 8 bhāgadheyenaivainān prīṇāti \\

Sentence: 4=e utsam juṣasva madhumantam ūrva samudriyaṁ sadanam ā viśasva //

Sentence: 5=f yo vā agnim prayujya na vimuñcati yathāśvo yukto ‘vimucyamānaḥ kṣudhyan parābhavaty evam asyāgniḥ parā bhavati

Sentence: 6 tam parābhavantam yajamāno ‘nu parā bhavati

Sentence: 7 so ‘gnim citvā lūkṣaḥ //

Sentence: 1 bhavati \\

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ kaśyapo yāsv indraḥ / agnim garbham dadhire virūpās tā na āpaḥ śaṁ syonā bhavantu //

Sentence: 2=b yāsāṁ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyañ janānām / madhuścutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakās tā na āpaḥ śaṁ syonā bhavantu //

Sentence: 3=c yāsām devā divi kṛṇvanti bhakṣam yā antarikṣe bahudhā bhavanti / yāḥ pṛthivīm payaso ‘ndanti //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 śukrās tā na āpaḥ śaṁ syonā bhavantu //

Sentence: 2=d śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatāpaḥ śivayā tanuvo ‘pa spṛśata tvacam me / sarvāṁ agnīṁr apsuṣado huve vo mayi varco balam ojo ni dhatta //

Sentence: 3=e yad adaḥ samprayatīr ahāv anadatā hate / tasmād ā nadyo nāma stha tā vo nāmāni sindhavaḥ //

Sentence: 4=f yat preṣitā varuṇena tāḥ śībhaṁ samavalgata //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 tad āpnod indro vo yatīs tasmād āpo anu sthana //

Sentence: 2=g apakāmaṁ syandamānā avīvarata vo hikam / indro vaḥ śaktibhir devīs tasmād vār ṇāma vo hitam //

Sentence: 3=h eko devo apy atiṣṭhat syandamānā yathāvaśam / ud āniṣur mahīr iti tasmād udakam ucyate //

Sentence: 4=i āpo bhadrā ghṛtam id āpa āsur agnīṣomau bibhraty āpa it tāḥ / tīvro raso madhupṛcām //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 aramgama ā mā prāṇena saha varcasā gan //

Sentence: 2=k ād it paśyāmy uta vā śṛṇomy ā mā ghoṣo gachati vāṅ na āsām / manye bhejāno amṛtasya tarhi hiraṇyavarṇā atṛpam yad vaḥ //

Sentence: 3=l āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvas tā na ūrje dadhātana / mahe raṇāya cakṣase //

Sentence: 4=m yo vaḥ śivatamo rasas tasya bhājayateha naḥ / uśatīr iva mātaraḥ //

Sentence: 5=n tasmā aram gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha / āpo janayathā ca naḥ //

Sentence: 6=o divi śrayasvāntarikṣe yatasva pṛthivyā sam bhava brahmavarcasam asi brahmavarcasāya tvā //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 apām grahān gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 2 etad vāva rājasūyam yad ete grahāḥ savo ‘gnis \\

Sentence: 3 varuṇasavo rājasūyam agnisavaś cityas

Sentence: 4 tābhyām eva sūyate \\

Sentence: 5 atho ubhāv eva lokāv abhi jayati yaś ca rājasūyenejānasya yaś cāgnicite \\

Sentence: 6 āpo bhavanti \\

Sentence: 7 āpo vā agner bhrātṛvyās \\

Sentence: 8 yad apo ‘gner adhastād upadadhāti bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai

Sentence: 9 bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati \\

Sentence: 10 amṛtam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 vā āpas

Sentence: 2 tasmād adbhir avatāntam abhi ṣiñcanti

Sentence: 3 nārtim ārchati sarvam āyur eti yasyaitā upadhīyante ya u cainā evam veda \\

Sentence: 4 annam vā āpaḥ

Sentence: 5 paśava āpas \\

Sentence: 6 annam paśavas \\

Sentence: 7 annādaḥ paśumān bhavati yasyaitā upadīyante ya u cainā evam veda

Sentence: 8 dvādaśa bhavanti

Sentence: 9 dvādaśa māsāḥ samvatsaraḥ

Sentence: 10 samvatsarenaivāsmai //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 annam ava runddhe

Sentence: 2 pātrāṇi bhavanti

Sentence: 3 pātre vā annam adyate

Sentence: 4 sayony evānnam ava runddhe \\

Sentence: 5 ā dvādaśāt puruṣād annam atty atho pātrān na chidyate yasyaitā upadhīyante ya u cainā evam veda

Sentence: 6 kumbhāś ca kumbhīś ca mithunāni bhavanti

Sentence: 7 mithunasya prajātyai

Sentence: 8 pra prajayā paśubhir mithunair jāyate yasyaitā upadhīyante ya u //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 cainā evam veda

Sentence: 2 śug vā agniḥ

Sentence: 3 so ‘dhvaryum yajamānam prajāḥ śucārpayati

Sentence: 4 yad apa upadadhāti śucam evāsya śamayati

Sentence: 5 nārtim ārchaty adhvaryur na yajamānaḥ śāmyanti prajā yatraitā upadhīyante \\

Sentence: 6 apām vā etāni hṛdayāni yad etā āpas \\

Sentence: 7 yad etā apa upadadhāti divyābhir evaināḥ saṁ sṛjati varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 bhavati

Sentence: 2 yo vā etāsām āyatanam k??ptim vedāyatanavān bhavati kalpate ‘smai \\

Sentence: 3 anusītam upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 4 etad vā āsām āyatanam eṣā k??ptis \\

Sentence: 5 ya evam vedāyatanavān bhavati kalpate ‘smai

Sentence: 6 dvamdvam anyā upa dadhāti catasro madhye dhṛtyai \\

Sentence: 7 annam vā iṣṭakās \\

Sentence: 8 etat khalu vai sākṣād annam yad eṣa carus \\

Sentence: 9 yad etam carum upadadhāti sākṣāt //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 evāsmā annam ava runddhe

Sentence: 2 madhyata upa dadhāti

Sentence: 3 madhyata evāsmā annam dadhāti

Sentence: 4 tasmān madhyato ‘nnam adyate

Sentence: 5 bārhaspatyo bhavati

Sentence: 6 brahma vai devānām bṛhaspatis \\

Sentence: 7 brahmaṇaivāsmā annam ava runddhe

Sentence: 8 brahmavarcasam asi brahmavarcasāya tvety āha

Sentence: 9 tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati yasyaiṣa upadhīyate ya u cainam evam veda //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 bhūteṣṭakā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 2 atrātra vai mṛtyur jāyate

Sentence: 3 yatrayatraiva mṛtyur jāyate tata evainam ava yajate

Sentence: 4 tasmād agnicit sarvam āyu eti sarve hy asya mṛtyavo ‘veṣṭās

Sentence: 5 tasmād agnicin nābhicaritavai pratyag enam abhicāra stṛṇute

Sentence: 6 sūyate vā eṣa yo ‘gnim cinute

Sentence: 7 devasuvām etāni havīṁṣi bhavanti \\

Sentence: 8 etāvanto vai devānāṁ savās

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 asmai savān pra yachanti

Sentence: 2 ta enaṁ suvante
