Sentence: 4 devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ity āha

Sentence: 5 savitṛprasūta evainam brahmaṇā devatābhir abhi ṣiñcati \\

Sentence: 6 annasyānnasyābhi ṣiñcati \\

Sentence: 7 annasyānnasyāvaruddhyai

Sentence: 8 purastāt pratyañcam abhi ṣiñcati

Sentence: 9 purastād dhi pratīcīnam annam adyate

Sentence: 10 śīrṣato ‘bhi ṣiñcati

Sentence: 11 śīrṣato hy annam adyate \\

Sentence: 12 ā mukhād anvavasrāvayati //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 mukhata evāsmā annādyam dadhāti \\

Sentence: 2 agnes tvā sāmrājyenābhi ṣiñcāmīty āha \\

Sentence: 3 eṣa vā agneḥ savas

Sentence: 4 tenaivainam abhi ṣiñcati

Sentence: 5 bṛhaspates tvā sāmrājyenābhi ṣiñcāmīty āha

Sentence: 6 brahma vai devānām bṛhaspatis \\

Sentence: 7 brahmaṇaivainam abhi ṣiñcati \\

Sentence: 8 indrasya tvā sāmrājyenābhi ṣiñcāmīty āha \\

Sentence: 9 indriyam evāsminn upariṣṭād dadhāti \\

Sentence: 10 etat //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vai rājasūyasya rūpam \\

Sentence: 2 ya evam vidvān agnim cinuta ubhāv eva lokāv abhi jayati yaś ca rājasūyenejānasya yaś cāgnicitas \\

Sentence: 3 indrasya suṣuvāṇasya daśadhendriyam vīryam parāpatat

Sentence: 4 tad devāḥ sautrāmaṇyā sam abharan \\

Sentence: 5 sūyate vā eṣa yo ‘gnim cinute \\

Sentence: 6 agnim citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajetendriyam eva vīryaṁ sambhṛtyātman dhatte //

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 sajūr abdo ‘yāvabhiḥ

Sentence: 5 sajūr agnir vaiśvānara iḍābhis \\

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 vā asyā amṛtam yad vīryam tad darbhās

Sentence: 3 praiva jāyate ‘nnādo bhavati yasyaivam juhvati \\

Sentence: 4 etā vai devatā agneḥ purastādbhāgās

Sentence: 5 tā eva prīṇāti \\

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 pratiṣṭhām nāvindata

Sentence: 2 sa etad apām kulāyam apaśyat

Sentence: 3 tasminn agnim acinuta

Sentence: 4 tad iyam abhavat

Sentence: 5 tato vai sa praty atiṣṭhat \\

Sentence: 6 yām purastād upādadhāt tac chiro ‘bhavat sā prācī { dig ^ diś }

Sentence: 7 yām dakṣiṇata upādadhāt sa dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣo ‘bhavat sā dakṣiṇā { dig ^ diś }

Sentence: 8 yām paścād upādadhāt tat pucham abhavat sā pratīcī { dig ^ diś }

Sentence: 9 yām uttarata upādadhāt //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 sa uttaraḥ pakṣo ‘bhavat sodīcī { dig ^ diś }

Sentence: 2 yām upariṣṭād upādadhāt tat pṛṣṭham abhavat sordhvā { dig ^ diś }

Sentence: 4 tasmād yad asyām khananty abhīṣṭakām tṛndanty abhi śarkarām \\

Sentence: 5 sarvā vā iyam vayobhyo naktam dṛśe dīpyate

Sentence: 6 tasmād imām vayāṁsi naktam nādhy āsate

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvān agnim cinute praty eva //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 tiṣṭhaty abhi diśo jayati \\

Sentence: 2 āgneyo vai brāhmaṇas

Sentence: 3 tasmād brāhmaṇāya sarvāsu dikṣv ardhukam \\

Sentence: 4 svām eva tad diśam anv eti \\

Sentence: 5 apām vā agniḥ kulāyam \\

Sentence: 6 tasmād āpo ‘gniṁ hārukāḥ

Sentence: 7 svām eva tad yonim pra viśanti //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 samvatsaram ukhyam bhṛtvā dvitīye samvatsara āgneyam aṣṭākapālam nir vaped aindram ekādaśakapālam vaiśvadevam dvādaśakapālam bārhaspatyam carum vaiṣṇavam trikapālam \\

Sentence: 2 tritīye samvatsarṝ ‘bhijitā yajeta

Sentence: 3 yad aṣṭākapālo bhavaty aṣṭākṣarā gāyatry āgneyam gāyatram prātaḥsavanam

Sentence: 4 prātaḥsavanam eva tena dādhāra gāyatrīm chandas \\

Sentence: 5 yad ekādaśakapālo bhavaty ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭug aindram traiṣṭubham mādhyamdinaṁ savanam

Sentence: 6 mādhyamdinam eva savanam tena dādhāra triṣṭubham //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 chandas \\

Sentence: 2 yad dvādaśakapālo bhavati dvādaśākṣarā jagatī vaiśvadevam jāgatam tṛtīyasavanam \\

Sentence: 3 tṛtīyasavanam eva tena dādhāra jagatīm chandas \\

Sentence: 4 yad bārhaspatyaś carur bhavati brahma vai devānām bṛhaspatis \\

Sentence: 5 brahmaiva tena dādhāra

Sentence: 6 yad vaiṣṇavas trikapālo bhavati yajño vai viṣṇus \\

Sentence: 7 yajñam eva tena dādhāra

Sentence: 8 yat tṛtīye samvatsarṝ ‘bhijitā yajate ‘bhijityai

Sentence: 9 yat samvatsaram ukhyam bibhartīmam eva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 tena lokaṁ spṛṇoti

Sentence: 2 yad dvitīye samvatsarṝ ‘gnim cinutṝ ‘ntarikṣam eva tena spṛṇoti

Sentence: 3 yat tṛtīye samvatsare yajate ‘mum eva tena lokaṁ spṛṇoti \\

Sentence: 4 etam vai para {F āṭṇāraḥ} {W ātṇāraḥ} {GLOS āṭṇāraḥ} kakṣīvāṁ auśijo vītahavyaḥ śrāyasas trasadasyuḥ paurukutsyaḥ prajākāmā acinvata

Sentence: 5 tato vai te sahasraṁsahasram putrān avindanta

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatir agnim acinuta

Sentence: 3 tam devā bibhyato nopāyan

Sentence: 4 te chandobhir ātmānam chādayitvopāyan

Sentence: 5 tac chandasām chandastvam

Sentence: 6 brahma vai chandāṁsi

Sentence: 7 brahmaṇa etad rūpam yat kṛṣṇājinam \\

Sentence: 9 devanidhir vā eṣa ni dhīyate yad agniḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 anye vā vai nidhim aguptam vindanti na vā prati pra jānāti \\

Sentence: 2 ukhām ā krāmaty ātmānam evādhipām kurute guptyai \\

Sentence: 3 atho khalv āhus \\

Sentence: 4 nākramyeti

Sentence: 7 atho yathā brūyāt \\

Sentence: 8 etan me gopāyeti tādṛg eva tat //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 prajāpatir vā atharvā \\

Sentence: 2 agnir eva dadhyaṅṅ ātharvaṇas

Sentence: 3 tasyeṣṭakā asthāni \\

Sentence: 4 etaṁ ha vāva tad ṛṣir abhyanūvāca \\

Sentence: 5 indro dadhīco asthabhir iti

Sentence: 6 yad iṣṭakābhir agnim cinoti sātmānam evāgnim cinute

Sentence: 7 sātmāmuṣmiṁ loke bhavati ya evam veda

Sentence: 8 śarīram vā etad agner yac citya ātmā vaiśvānaras \\

Sentence: 9 yac cite vaiśvānaram juhoti śarīram eva saṁskṛtya //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 abhyārohati

Sentence: 2 śarīram vā etad yajamānaḥ saṁs kurute yad agnim cinute

Sentence: 3 yac cite vaiśvānaram juhoti śasīram eva saṁskṛtyātmanābhyārohati

Sentence: 4 tasmāt tasya nāva dyanti jīvann eva devān apy eti

Sentence: 6 iyam vā agnir vaiśvānaras

Sentence: 7 tasyaiṣā citir yat purīṣam

Sentence: 8 agnim eva vaiśvānaram cinute \\

Sentence: 9 eṣā vā agneḥ priyā tanūr yad vaiśvānaraḥ

Sentence: 10 priyām evāsya tanuvam ava runddhe //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a suvargāya vā eṣa lokāya cīyate yad agnis

Sentence: 2 tam yan nānvārohet suvargāl lokād yajamāno hīyeta

Sentence: 3 pṛthivīm ākramiṣam prāṇo mā mā hāsīt \\

Sentence: 4 antarikṣam ākramiṣam prajā mā mā hāsīt \\

Sentence: 5 divam ākramiṣaṁ suvar aganma \\

Sentence: 6 ity āha \\

Sentence: 7 eṣa vā agner anvārohas

Sentence: 8 tenaivainam anvārohati

Sentence: 9 suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 kanīyāṁsam yajñakratum upeyāt pāpīyasy asyātmanaḥ prajā syāt \\

Sentence: 2 vedisammitām minoti

Sentence: 3 jyāyāṁsam eva yajñakratum upaiti

Sentence: 4 nāsyātmanaḥ pāpīyasī prajā bhavati

Sentence: 5=c sāhasram cinvīta prathamam cinvānaḥ

Sentence: 6 sahasrasammito vā ayam lokas \\

Sentence: 7 imam eva lokam abhi jayati

Sentence: 8 dviṣāhasram cinvīta dvitīyam cinvānas \\

Sentence: 9 dviṣāhasram vā antarikṣam

Sentence: 10 antarikṣam evābhi jayati

Sentence: 11 triṣāhasram cinvīta tṛtīyam cinvānaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 triṣāhasro vā asau loko ‘mum eva lokam abhi jayati

Sentence: 2=d jānudaghnam cinvīta prathamam civānas \\

Sentence: 3 gāyatriyaivemam lokam abhyārohati

Sentence: 4 nābhidaghnam cinvīta dvitīyam cinvānas

Sentence: 5 triṣṭubhaivāntarikṣam abhyārohati

Sentence: 6 grīvadaghnam cinvīta tṛtīyam cinvānas \\

## Chapter: 7

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yo vā ayathādevatam agnim cinuta ā devatābhyo vṛścyate pāpīyān bhavati

Sentence: 2 yo yathādevatam na devatābhya ā vṛścyate vasīyān bhavati \\

Sentence: 3 āgneyyā gāyatriyā prathamām citim abhi mṛśet triṣṭubhā dvitīyām jagatyā tṛtīyām anuṣṭubhā caturthīm paṅktyā pañcamīm \\

Sentence: 4 yathādevatam evāgnim cinute na devatābhya ā vṛścyate vasīyān bhavati \\

Sentence: 5 iḍāyai vā eṣā vibhaktiḥ

Sentence: 6 paśava iḍā

Sentence: 7 paśubhir enam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 cinute

Sentence: 2 yo vai prajāpataye pratiprocyāgnim cinoti nārtim ārchati \\

Sentence: 3 aśvāv abhitas tiṣṭhetām kṛṣṇa uttarataḥ śveto dakṣiṇas

Sentence: 4 tāv ālabhyeṣṭakā upa dadhyāt \\

Sentence: 5 etad vai prajāpate rūpam

Sentence: 6 prājāpatyo ‘śvaḥ

Sentence: 7 sākṣād eva prajāpataye pratiprocyāgnim cinoti nārtim ārchati \\

Sentence: 8 etad vā ahno rūpam yac chveto ‘śvo rātriyai kṛṣṇas \\

Sentence: 9 etad ahnaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 rūpam yad iṣṭakā rātriyai purīṣam

Sentence: 2 iṣṭakā upadhāsyañ chvetam aśvam abhi mṛśet purīṣam upadhāsyan kṛṣṇam

Sentence: 3 ahorātrābhyām evainam cinute

Sentence: 4 hiraṇyapātram madhoḥ pūrṇam dadāti

Sentence: 5 madhavyo ‘sānīti

Sentence: 6 sauryā citravatyāvekṣate

Sentence: 7 citram eva bhavati madhyamdine \\

Sentence: 8 aśvam ava ghrāpayati \\

Sentence: 9 asau vā āditya indra eṣa prajāpatiḥ

Sentence: 10 prājāpatyo ‘śvas

Sentence: 11 tam eva sākṣād ṛdhnoti //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a tvām agne vṛṣabham cekitānam punar yuvānam janayann upāgām / asthūri ṇo gārhapatyāni santu tigmena no brahmaṇā saṁ śiśādhi //

Sentence: 2 paśavo vā ete yad iṣṭakāś cityāmcityām ṛṣabham upa dadhāti mithunam evāsya tad yajñe karoti prajananāya tasmād yūthe-yūtha ṛṣabhaḥ

Sentence: 3=b samvatsarasya pratimām yām tvā rātry upāsate / prajāṁ suvīrām kṛtvā viśvam āyur vy aśnavat //

Sentence: 4 prājāpatyām //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 etām upa dadhātīyam vāvaiṣaikāṣṭakā yad evaikāṣṭakāyām annam kriyate tad evaitayāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 2 eṣā vai prajāpateḥ kāmadughā tayaiva yajamāno ‘muṣmiṁ lokṝ ‘gnim duhe

Sentence: 3=c yena devā jyotiṣordhvā udāyan yenādityā vasavo yena rudrāḥ / yenāṅgiraso mahimānam ānaśus tenaitu yajamānaḥ svasti //

Sentence: 4 suvargāya vā eṣa lokāya //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 cīyate yad agnis \\

Sentence: 2 yena devā jyotiṣordhvā udāyann ity ukhyaṁ sam inddha iṣṭakā evaitā upa dhatte vānaspatyāḥ suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai

Sentence: 3=d śatāyudhāya śatavīryāya śatotaye ‘bhimātiṣāhe / śatam yo naḥ śarado ajītān indro neṣad ati duritāni viśvā //

Sentence: 4=e ye catvāraḥ pathayo devayānā antarā dyāvāpṛthivī viyanti / teṣām yo ajyānim ajītim āvahāt tasmai no devāḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 pari datteha sarve //

Sentence: 2=f grīṣmo hemanta uta no vasantaḥ śarad varṣāḥ suvitam no astu / teṣām ṛtūnāṁ śataśāradānām nivāta eṣām abhaye syāma //

Sentence: 3=g iduvatsarāya parivatsarāya samvatsarāya kṛṇutā bṛhan namaḥ / teṣām vayaṁ sumatau yajñiyānām jyog ajītā ahatāḥ syāma //

Sentence: 4=h bhadrān naḥ śreyaḥ sam anaiṣṭa devās tvayāvasena sam aśīmahi tvā / sa no mayobhūḥ pito //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 ā viśasva śam tokāya tanuve syonaḥ //

Sentence: 2 ajyānīr etā upa dadhāty etā vai devatā aparājitās tā eva pra viśati naiva jīyate

Sentence: 3 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 4 yad ardhamāsā māsā ṛtavaḥ samvatsara oṣadhīḥ pacanty atha kasmād anyābhyo devatābhya āgrayaṇam nir upyata iti \\

Sentence: 5 etā hi tad devatā udajayan yad ṛtubhyo nirvaped devatābhyaḥ samadam dadhyāt \\

Sentence: 6 āgrayaṇam nirupyaitā āhutīr juhoti \\

Sentence: 7 ardhamāsān eva māsān ṛtūnt samvatsaram prīṇāti na devatābhyaḥ samadam dadhāti

Sentence: 8 bhadrān naḥ śreyaḥ sam anaiṣṭa devā ity āha hutādyāya yajamānasyāparābhāvāya //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a indrasya vajro ‘si vārtraghnas tanūpā naḥ pratispaśaḥ / yo naḥ purastād dakṣiṇataḥ paścād uttarato ‘ghāyur abhidāsaty etaṁ so ‘śmānam ṛchatu //

Sentence: 2 devāsurāḥ samyattā āsan

Sentence: 3 te ‘surā digbhya ābādhanta

Sentence: 4 tān devā iṣvā ca vajreṇa cāpānudanta

Sentence: 5 yad vajriṇīr upadadhātīṣvā caiva tad vajreṇa ca yajamāno bhrātṛvyān apa nudate

Sentence: 6 dikṣūpa //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 dadhāti

Sentence: 2 devapurā evaitās tanūpānīḥ pary ūhate \\

Sentence: 3=b agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasemā vardhantu vām giraḥ / dyumnair vājebhir ā gatam //

Sentence: 4 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 5 yan na devatāyai juhvaty atha kimdevatyā vasor dhāreti \\

Sentence: 6 agnir vasus tasyaiṣā dhārā

Sentence: 7 viṣṇur vasus tasyaiṣā dhārā \\

Sentence: 8 āgnāvaiṣṇavyarcā vasor dhārām juhoti

Sentence: 9 bhāgadheyenaivainau sam ardhayati \\

Sentence: 10 atho etām //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 evāhutim āyatanavatīm karoti

Sentence: 2 yatkāma enām juhoti tad evāva runddhe

Sentence: 3 rudro vā eṣa yad agnis

Sentence: 4 tasyaite tanuvau ghorānyā śivānayā

Sentence: 5 yac chatarudrīyam juhoti yaivāsya ghorā tanūs tām tena śamayati

Sentence: 6 yad vasor dhārām juhoti yaivāsya śivā tanūs tām tena prīṇāti

Sentence: 7 yo vai vasor dhārayai //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 pratiṣṭhām veda praty eva tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 2 yad ājyam ucchiṣyeta tamsin brahmaudanam pacet

Sentence: 3 tam brāhmaṇāś catvāraḥ prāśnīyus \\

Sentence: 4 eṣa vā agnir vaiśvānaro yad brāhmaṇas \\

Sentence: 5 eṣā khalu vā agneḥ priyā tanūr yad vaiśvānaraḥ

Sentence: 6 priyāyām evainām tanuvām prati ṣṭhāpayati

Sentence: 7 catasro dhenūr dadyāt

Sentence: 8 tābhir eva yajamāno ‘muṣmiṁ lokṝ ‘gnim duhe //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a cittim juhomi manasā ghṛtena \\

Sentence: 2 ity āha \\

Sentence: 3 adābhyā vai nāmaiṣāhutir vaiśvakarmaṇī

Sentence: 4 nainam cikyānam bhrātṛvyo dabhnoti \\

Sentence: 5 atho devatā evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 7 iti paṅktyā juhoti

Sentence: 9=c sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvās \\

Sentence: 10 ity āha

Sentence: 11 hotrā evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 12 agnir devebhyo ‘pākrāmad bhāgadheyam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 2 tasmā etad bhāgadheyam prāyachan \\

Sentence: 3 etad vā agner agnihotram

Sentence: 4 etarhi khalu vā eṣa jāto yarhi sarvaś citas \\

Sentence: 7 vasīyān bhavati

Sentence: 8=d brahmavādino vadanti yad eṣa gārhapatyaś cīyate ‘tha kvāsyāhavanīya iti \\

Sentence: 9 asāv āditya iti brūyāt \\

Sentence: 10 etasmin hi sarvābhyo devatābhyo juhvati //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ya evam vidvān agnim cinute sākṣād eva devatā ṛdhnoti \\

Sentence: 2=e agne yaśasvin yaśasemam arpayendrāvatīm apacitīm ihā vaha / ayam mūrdhā parameṣṭhī suvarcāḥ samānānām uttamaśloko astu //

Sentence: 3 bhadram paśyanta upa sedur agre tapo dīkṣām ṛṣayaḥ suvarvidaḥ / tataḥ kṣatram balam ojaś ca jātam ad asmai devā abhi sam namantu //

Sentence: 4 dhātā vidhātā paramā //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 uta samdṛk prajāpatiḥ parameṣṭhī virājā / stomāś chandāṁsi nivido ma āhur etasmai rāṣṭram abhi sam namāma //

Sentence: 2 abhyāvartadhvam upa meta sākam ayaṁ śāstādhipatir vo astu / asya vijñānam anu saṁ rabhadhvam imam paścād anu jīvātha sarve //

Sentence: 3 rāṣṭrabhṛta etā upa dadhāti \\

Sentence: 4 eṣā vā agneś citī rāṣṭrabhṛt

Sentence: 5 tayaivāsmin rāṣṭram dadhāti

Sentence: 6 rāṣṭram eva bhavati

Sentence: 7 nāsmād rāṣṭram bhraṁśate //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a yathā vai putro jāto mriyata evam vā eṣa mriyate yasyāgnir ukhya udvāyati

Sentence: 2 yan nirmanthyam kuryād vi chindyād bhrātṛvyam asmai janayet

Sentence: 3 sa eva punaḥ parīdhyaḥ

Sentence: 4 svād evainam yoner janayati

Sentence: 5 nāsmai bhrātṛvyam janayati

Sentence: 6 tamo vā etam gṛhṇāti yasyāgnir ukhya udvāyati

Sentence: 7 mṛtyus tamaḥ

Sentence: 8 kṛṣṇam vāsaḥ kṛṣṇā dhenur dakṣiṇā

Sentence: 9 tamasā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 eva tamo mṛtyum apa hate

Sentence: 2 hiraṇyam dadāti

Sentence: 3 jyotir vai hiraṇyam \\

Sentence: 4 jyotiṣaiva tamo ‘pa hate \\

Sentence: 5 atho tejo vai hiraṇyam \\

Sentence: 6 teja evātman dhatte

Sentence: 7=b suvar na gharmaḥ svāhā

Sentence: 8=b suvar nārkaḥ svāhā

Sentence: 9=b suvar na śukraḥ svāhā

Sentence: 10=b suvar na jyotiḥ svāhā

Sentence: 11=b suvar na sūryaḥ svāhā \\

Sentence: 12 arko vā eṣa yad agnir asāv ādityaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 aśvamedhas \\

Sentence: 2 yad etā āhutīr juhoty arkāśvamedhayor eva jyotīṁṣi sam dadhāti \\

Sentence: 3 eṣa ha tvā arkāśvamedhī yasyaitad agnau kriyate \\

Sentence: 4=c āpo vā idam agre salilam āsīt

Sentence: 5 sa etām prajāpatiḥ prathamām citim apaśyat tām upādhatta tad iyam abhavat

Sentence: 6 tam viśvakarmābravīt \\

Sentence: 7 upa tvāyānīti

Sentence: 8 neha loko ‘stīti //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 abravīt

Sentence: 2 sa etām dvitīyām citim apaśyat tām upādhatta tad antarikṣam abhavat

Sentence: 3 sa yajñaḥ prajāpatim bravīt \\

Sentence: 4 upa tvāyānīti

Sentence: 5 neha loko ‘stīty abravīt

Sentence: 6 sa viśvakarmāṇam abravīt \\

Sentence: 7 upa tvāyānīti

Sentence: 8 kena mopaiṣyasīti

Sentence: 9 diśyābhir ity abravīt

Sentence: 10 tam diśyābhir upait

Sentence: 11 tā upādhatta

Sentence: 12 tā diśaḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 abhavan \\

Sentence: 2 sa parameṣṭhī prajāpatim abravīt \\

Sentence: 3 upa tvāyānīti

Sentence: 4 neha loko ‘stīty abravīt

Sentence: 5 sa viśvakarmāṇam ca yajñam cābravīt \\

Sentence: 6 upa vām āyānīti

Sentence: 7 neha loko ‘stīty abrūtām \\

Sentence: 8 sa etām tṛtīyām citim apaśyat

Sentence: 9 tām upādhatta

Sentence: 10 tad asāv abhavat

Sentence: 11 sa ādityaḥ prajāpatim abravīt \\

Sentence: 12 upa tvā //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 āyānīti

Sentence: 2 neha loko ‘stīty abravīt

Sentence: 3 sa viśvakarmāṇam ca yajñam cābravīt \\

Sentence: 4 upa vām āyānīti

Sentence: 5 neha loko ‘stīty abrūtām \\

Sentence: 6 sa parameṣṭhinam abravīt \\

Sentence: 7 upa tvāyānīti

Sentence: 8 kena mopaiṣyasīti

Sentence: 9 lokampṛṇayety abravīt

Sentence: 10 tam lokampṛṇayopait

Sentence: 11 tasmād ayātayāmnī lokampṛṇā \\

Sentence: 12 ayātayāmā hy asau //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 ādityas

Sentence: 2 tān ṛṣayo ‘bruvan \\

Sentence: 3 upa va āyāmeti

Sentence: 4 kena na upaiṣyatheti

Sentence: 5 bhūmnety abruvan

Sentence: 6 tān dvābhyām citībhyām upāyan \\

Sentence: 7 sa pañcacitīkaḥ sam apadyata

Sentence: 8 ya evam vidvān agnim cinute bhūyān eva bhavaty abhīmāṁ lokāñ jayati vidur enam devās \\

Sentence: 9 atho etāsām eva devatānāṁ sāyujyam gachati //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a vayo vā agnir yad agnicit pakṣiṇo ‘śnīyāt tam evāgnim adyād ārtim ārchet

Sentence: 2 samvatsaram vratam caret

Sentence: 3 samvatsaraṁ hi vratam nāti

Sentence: 4=b paśur vā eṣa yad agnis \\

Sentence: 5 hinasti khalu vai tam paśur ya enam purastāt pratyañcam upacarati

Sentence: 6 tasmāt paścāt prāṅ upacarya ātmano ‘hiṁsāyai

Sentence: 7=c tejo ‘si tejo me yacha pṛthivīm yacha //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pṛthivyai mā pāhi jyotir asi jyotir me yachāntarikṣam yachāntarikṣān mā pāhi suvar asi suvar me yacha divam yacha divo mā pāhi \\

Sentence: 2 iti āhaitābhir vā ime lokā vidhṛtās \\

Sentence: 3 yad etā upadadhāty eṣām lokānām vidhṛtyai

Sentence: 4 svayamātṛṇṇā upadhāya hiraṇyeṣṭakā upa dadhātīme vai lokāḥ svayamātṛṇṇā jyotir hiraṇyam \\

Sentence: 5 yat svayamātṛṇṇā upadhāya //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 hiraṇyeṣṭakā upadadhātīmān evaitābhir lokāñ jyotiṣmataḥ kurute ‘tho etābhir evāsmā ime lokāḥ pra bhānti

Sentence: 2=e yās te agne sūrye ruca udyato divam ātanvanti raśmibhiḥ / tābhiḥ sarvābhī ruce janāya nas kṛdhi //

Sentence: 3 yā vo devāḥ sūrye ruco goṣv aśveṣu yā rucaḥ / indrāgnī tābhiḥ sarvābhī rucam no dhatta bṛhaspate //

Sentence: 4 rucam no dhehi //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 brāhmaṇeṣu rucaṁ rājasu nas kṛdhi / rucam viśyṝṣu śūdreṣu mayi dhehi rucā rucam //

Sentence: 2 dvedhā vā agnim cikyānasya yaśa indriyam gachaty agnim vā citam ījānam vā

Sentence: 3 yad etā āhutīr juhoti \\

Sentence: 4 ātmann eva yaśa indriyam dhatte \\

Sentence: 5=e īśvaro vā eṣa ārtim ārtor yo ‘gnim cinvann adhikrāmati

Sentence: 6 tat tvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānas \\

Sentence: 7 iti vāruṇyarcā //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 juhuyāc chāntir evaiṣāgner guptir ātmanas \\

Sentence: 2=f haviṣkṛto vā eṣa yo ‘gnim cinute

Sentence: 3 yathā vai havi skandaty evam vā eṣa skandati yo ‘gnim citvā striyam upaiti maitrāvaruṇyāmikṣayā yajeta maitrāvaruṇatām evopaity ātmano ‘skandāya

Sentence: 4=g yo vā agnim ṛtusthām vedarturṛtur asmai kalpamāna eti praty eva tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 5 samvatsaro vā agniḥ //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 ṛtusthās tasya vasantaḥ śiro grīṣmo dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣo varṣāḥ puchaṁ śarad uttaraḥ pakṣo hemanto madhyam pūrvapakṣāś citayo ‘parapakṣāḥ purīṣam ahorātrāṇīṣtakā eṣa vā agnir ṛtusthā ya evam vedarturṛtur asmai kalpamāna eti praty eva tiṣṭhai

Sentence: 2=h prajāpatir vā etam jyaiṣṭhyakāmo ny adhatta

Sentence: 3 tato vai sa jyaiṣṭhyam agachat \\

Sentence: 4 ya evam vidvān agnim cinute jyaiṣṭhyam eva gachati //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a yad ākūtāt samasusrod dhṛdo vā manaso vā sambhṛtam cakṣuṣo vā / tam anu prehi sukṛtasya lokam yatrarṣayaḥ prathamajā ye purāṇāḥ //

Sentence: 2=b etaṁ sadhastha pari te dadāmi yam āvahāc chevadhim jātavedāḥ / anvāgantā yajñapatir vo atra taṁ sama jānīta parame vyoman //

Sentence: 3=c jānītād enam parame vyoman devāḥ sadhasthā vida rūpam asya / yad āgachāt //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pathibhir devayānair iṣṭāpūrte kṛṇutād āvir asmai //

Sentence: 2=d sam pra cyavadhvam anu sam pra yātāgne patho devayānān kṛṇudhvam / asmint sadhasthe adhy uttarasmin viśve devā yajamānaś ca sīdata //

Sentence: 3=e prastareṇa paridhinā srucā vedyā ca barhiṣā / ṛcemam yajñam no vaha suvar deveṣu gantave //

Sentence: 4=f yad iṣṭam yat parādānam yad dattam yā ca dakṣiṇā / tat //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 agnir vaiśvakarmaṇaḥ suvar deveṣu no dadhat //

Sentence: 2=g yenā sahasram vahasi yenāgne sarvavedasam / tenemam yajñam no vaha suvar deveṣu gantave //

Sentence: 3=h yenāgne dakṣiṇā yuktā yajñam vahanty ṛtvijaḥ / tenemam yajñam no vaha suvar deveṣu gantave //

Sentence: 4=i yenāgne sukṛtaḥ pathā madhor dhārā vyānaśuḥ / tenemam yajñam no vaha suvar deveṣu gantave //

Sentence: 5=k yatra dhārā anapetā madhor ghṛtasya ca yāḥ / tad agnir vaiśvakarmaṇaḥ suvar deveṣu no dadhat //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a yās te agne samidho yāni dhāma yā jihvā jātavedo yo arciḥ / ye te agne meḍayo ya indavas tebhir ātmānam cinuhi prajānan //

Sentence: 2 utsannayajño vā eṣa yad agniḥ kim vāhaitasya kriyate kim vā na yad vā adhvaryur agneś cinvann antarety ātmano vai tad antar eti yās te agne samidho yāni //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 dhāmety āhaiṣā vā agneḥ svayamcitir agnir eva tad agnim cinoti nādhvaryur ātmano ‘ntar eti

Sentence: 2 catasra āśāḥ pra carantv agnaya imam no yajñam nayatu prajānan / ghṛtam pinvann ajaraṁ suvīram brahma samid bhavaty āhutīnām //

Sentence: 3 suvargāya vā eṣa lokāyopa dhīyate yat kūrmaś catasra āśāḥ pra carantv agnaya ity āha //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 diśa evaitena pra jānātīmam no yajñam nayatu prajānann ity āha suvargasya lokasyābhinītyai brahma samid bhavaty āhutīnām ity āha brahmaṇā vai devāḥ suvargam lokam āyan yad brahmaṇvatyopadadhāti brahmaṇaiva tad yajamānaḥ suvargam lokam eti

Sentence: 2 prajāpatir vā eṣa yad agnis tasya prajāḥ paśavaś chandāṁsi rūpaṁ sarvān varṇān iṣṭakānām kuryād rūpeṇaiva prajām paśūñ chandāṁsy ava runddhe ‘tho prajābhya evainam paśubhyaś chandobhyo ‘varuddhya cinute //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a mayi gṛhṇāmy agre agniṁ rāyas poṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya / mayi prajām mayi varco dadhāmy ariṣṭāḥ syāma tanuvā suvīrāḥ //

Sentence: 2 yo no agniḥ pitaro hṛtsv antar amartyo martyāṁ āviveśa / tam ātman pari gṛhṇīmahe vayam mā so asmāṁ avahāya parā gāt //

Sentence: 3 yad adhvaryur ātmann agnim agṛhītvāgnim cinuyād yo ‘sya svo ‘gnis tam api //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yajamānāya cinuyād agnim khalu vai paśavo ‘nūpa tiṣṭhante ‘pakrāmukā asmāt paśavaḥ syur mayi gṛhṇāmy agre agnim ity āhātmann eva svam agnim dādhāra nāsmāt paśavo ‘pa krāmanti

Sentence: 2 brahmavādino vadanti yan mṛc cāpaś cāgner anādyam atha kasmān mṛdā cādbhiś cāgniś cīyata iti yad adbhiḥ samyauti //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 āpo vai sarvā devatā devatābhir evainaṁ saṁ sṛjati yan mṛdā cinotīyam vā agnir vaiśvānaro ‘gninaiva tad agnim cinoti

Sentence: 2 brahmavādino vadanti yan mṛdā cādbhiś cāgniś cīyatetha kasmād agnir ucyata iti yac chandobhiś cinoty agnayo vai chandāṁsi tasmād agnir ucyate ‘tho iyam vā agnir vaiśvānaro yat //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 mṛdā cinoti tasmād agnir ucyate

Sentence: 2 hiraṇyeṣṭakā upa dadhāti jyotir vai hiraṇyam jyotir evāsmin dadhāty atho tejo vai hiraṇyam teja evātman dhatte

Sentence: 3 yo vā agniṁ sarvatomukham cinute sarvāsu prajāsv annam atti sarvā diśo ‘bhi jayati gāyatrīm purastād upa dadhāti tṛṣṭubham dakṣiṇato jagatīm paścād anuṣṭubham uttarataḥ paṅktim madhya eṣa vā agniḥ sarvatomukhas tam ya evam vidvāṁś cinute sarvāsu prajāsv annam atti sarvā diśo ‘bhi jayaty atho diśy ṝva diśam pra vayati tasmād diśi dik protā //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatir agnim asṛjata

Sentence: 2 so ‘smāt sṛṣṭaḥ prāṅ prādaravat tasmā aśvam praty āsyat

Sentence: 3 sa dakṣiṇāvartata tasmai vṛṣṇim praty āsyat

Sentence: 4 sa pratyaṅṅ āvartata tasmā ṛṣabham praty āsyat

Sentence: 5 sa udaṅṅ āvartata tasmai bastam praty āsyat

Sentence: 6 sa ūrdhvo ‘dravat tasmai puruṣam praty āsyat \\

Sentence: 7 yat paśuśīrṣāṇy upadadhāti sarvata evainam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 avarudhya cinute \\

Sentence: 2 etā vai prāṇabhṛtaś cakṣuṣmatīr iṣṭakā yat paśuśīrṣāṇi

Sentence: 3 yat paśuśīrṣāṇy upadadhāti tābhir eva yajamāno ‘muṣmiṁ loke prāṇity atho tābhir evāsmā ime lokāḥ pra bhānti

Sentence: 4 mṛdābhilipyopa dadhāti medhyatvāya

Sentence: 5 paśur vā eṣa yad agnir annam paśavas \\

Sentence: 6 eṣa khalu vā agnir yat paśuśīrṣāṇi

Sentence: 7 yam kāmayeta

Sentence: 8 kanīyo ‘syānnam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 syād itisamtarām tasya paśuśīrṣāṇy upa dadhyāt kanīya evāsyānnam bhavati

Sentence: 2 yam kāmayeta

Sentence: 3 samāvad asyānnaṁ syād iti madhyatas tasyopa dadhyāt samāvad evāsyānnam bhavati

Sentence: 4 yam kāmayeta

Sentence: 5 bhūyo ‘syānnaṁ syād ity anteṣu tasya vyudūhyopa dadhyād antata evāsmā annam ava runddhe bhūyo ‘syānnam bhavati //

Verse: 1

Sentence: 2 maṇḍūkāñ jambhyebhis \\

Sentence: 6 dūṣīkābhir hrādunim

Sentence: 7 aśrubhiḥ pṛṣvām \\

Sentence: 8 divaṁ rūpeṇa

Sentence: 9 nakṣatrāṇi pratirūpeṇa

Sentence: 10 pṛthivīm carmaṇā

Sentence: 11 chavīm chavyā \\

Sentence: 12 upākṛtāya svāhā \\

Sentence: 13 ālabdhāya svāhā

Sentence: 14 hutāya svāhā //

Paragraph: 21

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 agneḥ pakṣatiḥ

Sentence: 2 sarasvatyai nipakṣatiḥ

Sentence: 3 somasya tṛtīyā \\

Sentence: 4 apām caturthī \\

Sentence: 5 oṣadhīnām pañcamī

Sentence: 6 samvatsarasya ṣaṣṭhī

Sentence: 7 marutāṁ saptamī

Sentence: 8 bṛhaspater aṣṭamī

Sentence: 9 mitrasya navamī

Sentence: 10 varuṇasya daśamī \\

Sentence: 11 indrasyaikādaśī

Sentence: 12 viśveṣām devānām dvādaśī

Sentence: 13 dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ pārśvam \\

Sentence: 14 yamasya pāṭūraḥ //

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 vāyoḥ pakṣatiḥ

Sentence: 2 sarasvato nipakṣatis \\

Sentence: 3 candramasas tṛtīyā

Sentence: 4 nakṣatrāṇām caturthī

Sentence: 5 savituḥ pañcamī

Sentence: 6 rudrasya ṣaṣṭhī

Sentence: 7 sarpāṇāṁ saptamī \\

Sentence: 8 aryamṇo ‘ṣṭamī

Sentence: 10 indrāṇyā ekādaśī \\

Sentence: 12 dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ pārśvam \\

Sentence: 13 yamyai pāṭūraḥ //

Paragraph: 23

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 panthām anūvṛgbhyām \\

Sentence: 2 samtatiṁ snāvanyābhyām \\

Sentence: 3 śukān pittena

Sentence: 4 harimāṇam yaknā

Sentence: 5 halīkṣṇān pāpavatena

Sentence: 6 kūśmāñ chakabhiḥ

Sentence: 7 śavartān ūvadhyena

Sentence: 8 śuno viśasanena

Sentence: 9 sarpāṁ lohitagandhena

Sentence: 10 vayāṁsi pakvagandhena

Sentence: 11 pipīlikāḥ praśādena //

Sentence: 1=a dyaus te pṛṣṭham

## Book: 6

## Chapter: 1

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prācīnavaṁśam karoti

Sentence: 2 devamanuṣyā diśo vy abhajanta

Sentence: 3 prācīm devā dakṣiṇā pitaraḥ pratīcīm manuṣyā udīcīṁ rudrās \\

Sentence: 4 yat prācīnavaṁśam karoti devalokam eva tad yajamāna upāvartate

Sentence: 5 pari śrayati \\

Sentence: 6 antarhito hi devaloko manuṣyalokāt \\

Sentence: 7 nāsmāl lokāt svṝtavyam ivety āhuḥ

Sentence: 8 ko hi tad veda yady amuṣmiṁ loke ‘sti vā na veti

Sentence: 9 dhikṣv atīkāśān karoti //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ubhayor lokayor abhijityai

Sentence: 2 keśaśmaśru vapate nakhāni ni kṛntate

Sentence: 3 mṛtā vā eṣā tvag amedhyā yat keśaśmaśru

Sentence: 4 mṛtām eva tvacam amedhyām apahatya yajñiyo bhūtvā medham upaiti \\

Sentence: 5 aṅgirasaḥ suvargam lokam yanto ‘psu dīkṣātapasī prāveśayan \\

Sentence: 6 apsu snāti

Sentence: 7 sākṣād eva dīkṣātapasī ava runddhe

Sentence: 8 tīrthe snāti

Sentence: 9 tīrthe hi te tām prāveśayan

Sentence: 10 tīrthe snāti //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 tīrtham eva samānānām bhavati \\

Sentence: 2 apo ‘śnāti \\

Sentence: 3 antarata eva medhyo bhavati

Sentence: 4 vāsasā dīkṣayati

Sentence: 5 saumyam vai kṣaumam devatayā

Sentence: 6 somam eṣa devatām upaiti yo dīkṣate

Sentence: 7 somasya tanūr asi tanuvam me pāhīty āha

Sentence: 8 svām eva devatām upaiti \\

Sentence: 9 atho āśiṣam evaitām ā śāste \\

Sentence: 10 agnes tūṣādhānam \\

Sentence: 11 vāyor vātapānam

Sentence: 12 pitṛṇām nīvis \\

Sentence: 13 oṣadhīnām praghātaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ādityānām prācīnatānas \\

Sentence: 2 viśveṣām devānām otus \\

Sentence: 3 nakṣatrāṇām atīkāśās

Sentence: 4 tad vā etat sarvadevatyam yad vāsas \\

Sentence: 5 yad vāsasā dīkṣayati sarvābhir evainam devatābhir dīkṣayati

Sentence: 6 bahiḥprāṇo vai manuṣyas

Sentence: 7 tasyāśanam prāṇas \\

Sentence: 8 aśnāti saprāṇa eva dīkṣate \\

Sentence: 9 āśito bhavati

Sentence: 10 yāvān evāsya prāṇas tena saha medham upaiti

Sentence: 11 ghṛtam devānām

Sentence: 12 mastu pitṛṇām \\

Sentence: 13 niṣpakvam manuṣyāṇām \\

Sentence: 14 tad vai //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 etat sarvadevatyam yan navanītam \\

Sentence: 2 yan navanītenābhyaṅkte sarvā eva devatāḥ prīṇāti

Sentence: 3 pracyuto vā eṣo ‘smāl lokād agato devalokam yo dīkṣitas \\

Sentence: 4 antareva navanītam \\

Sentence: 5 tasmān navanītenābhy aṅkte \\

Sentence: 6 anulomam \\

Sentence: 7 yajuṣā

Sentence: 8 vyāvṛttyai \\

Sentence: 9 indro vṛtram ahan

Sentence: 10 tasya kanīnikā parāpatat

Sentence: 11 tad āñjanam abhavat \\

Sentence: 12 yad āṅkte cakṣur eva bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte

Sentence: 13 dakṣiṇam pūrvam āṅkte //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 savyaṁ hi pūrvam manuṣyā āñjate

Sentence: 2 na ni dhāvate

Sentence: 3 nīva hi manuṣyā dhāvante

Sentence: 4 pañca kṛtva āṅkte

Sentence: 5 pañcākṣarā paṅktiḥ

Sentence: 6 pāṅkto yajñas \\

Sentence: 7 yajñam evāva runddhe

Sentence: 8 parimitam āṅkte \\

Sentence: 9 aparimitaṁ hi manuṣyā āñjate

Sentence: 10 satūlayāṅkte \\

Sentence: 11 apatūlayā hi manuṣyā āñjate

Sentence: 12 vyāvṛttyai

Sentence: 13 yad apatūlayāñjīta vajra iva syāt

Sentence: 14 satūlayāṅkte mitratvāya //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 indro vṛtram ahan \\

Sentence: 2 so ‘po ‘bhyy amriyata

Sentence: 3 tāsām yan medhyam yajñiyaṁ sadevam āsīt tad apod akrāmat

Sentence: 4 te darbhā abhavan

Sentence: 5 yad darbhapuñjīlaiḥ pavayati yā eva medhyā yajñiyāḥ sadevā āpas tābhir evainam pavayati

Sentence: 6 dvābhyām pavayati \\

Sentence: 7 ahorātrābhyām evainam pavayati

Sentence: 8 tribhiḥ pavayati

Sentence: 9 traya ime lokās \\

Sentence: 10 ebhir evainam lokaiḥ pavayati

Sentence: 11 pañcabhiḥ //

Verse: 8

Sentence: 1 pavayati

Sentence: 2 pañcākṣarā paṅktiḥ

Sentence: 3 pāṅkto yajñas \\

Sentence: 4 yajñāyaivainam pavayati

Sentence: 5 ṣaḍbhiḥ pavayati

Sentence: 6 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 7 ṛtubhir evainam pavayati

Sentence: 8 saptabhiḥ pavayati

Sentence: 9 sapta chandāṁsi

Sentence: 10 chandobhir evainam pavayati

Sentence: 11 navabhiḥ pavayati

Sentence: 12 nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ

Sentence: 13 saprāṇam evainam pavayati \\

Sentence: 14 ekaviṁśatyā pavayati

Sentence: 15 daśa hastyā aṅgulayo daśa padyā ātmaikaviṁśas \\

Sentence: 16 yāvān eva puruṣas tam aparivargam //

Verse: 9

Sentence: 1 pavayati

Sentence: 2 citpatis tvā punātv ity āha

Sentence: 3 mano vai citpatis \\

Sentence: 4 manasaivainam pavayati

Sentence: 5 vākpatis tvā punātv ity āha

Sentence: 6 vācaivainam pavayati

Sentence: 7 devas tvā savitā punātv ity āha

Sentence: 8 savitṛprasūta evainam pavayati

Sentence: 9 tasya te pavitrapate pavitreṇa yasmai kam pune tac chakeyam ity āha \\

Sentence: 10 āśiṣam evaitām ā śāste //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yāvanto vai devā yajñāyāpunata ta evābhavan

Sentence: 2 ya evam vidvān yajñāya punīte bhavaty eva

Sentence: 3 bahiḥ pavayitvāntaḥ pra pādayati

Sentence: 4 manuṣyaloka evainam pavayitvā pūtam devalokam pra ṇayati \\

Sentence: 5 adīkṣita ekayāhutyety āhuḥ

Sentence: 6 sruveṇa catasro juhoti dīkṣitatvāya srucā pañcamīm

Sentence: 7 pañcākṣarā paṅkitiḥ

Sentence: 8 pāṅkto yajñas \\

Sentence: 9 yajñam evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 10 ākūtyai prayuje ‘gnaye //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 svāhety āha \\

Sentence: 2 ākūtyā hi puruṣo yajñam abhi prayuṅkte

Sentence: 3 yajeyeti

Sentence: 4 medhāyai manase ‘gnaye svāhety āha

Sentence: 5 medhayā hi manasā puruṣo yajñam abhigachati

Sentence: 6 sarasvatyai pūṣṇṝ ‘gnaye svāhety āha

Sentence: 7 vāg vai sarasvatī pṛthivī pūṣā

Sentence: 8 vācaiva pṛthivyā yajñam pra yuṅkte \\

Sentence: 9 āpo devīr bṛhatīr viśvaśambhuva ity āha

Sentence: 10 yā vai varṣyās tāḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 āpo devīr bṛhatīr viśvaśambhuvas \\

Sentence: 2 yad etad yajur na brūyād divyā āpo ‘śāntā imam lokam ā gacheyus \\

Sentence: 3 āpo devīr bṛhatīr viśvaśambhuva ity āha \\

Sentence: 4 asmā evainā lokāya śamayati

Sentence: 5 tasmāc chāntā imam lokam ā gachanti

Sentence: 6 dyāvāpṛthivī ity āha

Sentence: 7 dyāvāpṛthivyor hi yajñas \\

Sentence: 8 urv antarikṣam ity āha \\

Sentence: 9 antarikṣe hi yajñas \\

Sentence: 10 bṛhaspatir no haviṣā vṛdhātu //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ity āha

Sentence: 2 brahma vai devānām bṛhaspatis \\

Sentence: 3 brahmaṇaivāsmai yajñam ava runddhe

Sentence: 4 yad brūyāt \\

Sentence: 5 vidher iti yajñasthāṇum ṛchet \\

Sentence: 6 vṛdhātv ity āha yajñasthāṇum eva pari vṛṇakti

Sentence: 7 prajāpatir yajñam asṛjata

Sentence: 8 so ‘smāt sṛṣṭaḥ parāṅ ait

Sentence: 9 sa pra yajur avlīnāt pra sāma

Sentence: 10 tam ṛg ud ayachat \\

Sentence: 11 yad ṛg udayachat tad audgrahaṇasyaudgrahaṇatvam

Sentence: 12 ṛcā //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 juhoti yajñasyodyatyai \\

Sentence: 2 anuṣṭup chandasām ud ayachad ity āhus

Sentence: 3 tasmād anuṣṭubhā juhoti

Sentence: 4 yajñasyodyatyai

Sentence: 5 dvādaśa vātsabandhāny ud ayachann ity āhus

Sentence: 6 tasmād dvādaśabhir vātsabandhavido dīkṣayanti

Sentence: 7 sā vā eṣarg { anuṣṭug ^ anuṣtubh }

Sentence: 8 vāg { anuṣṭug ^ anuṣtubh }

Sentence: 9 yad etayarcā dīkṣayati vācaivainaṁ sarvayā dīkṣayati

Sentence: 10 viśve devasya netur ity āha sāvitry ṝtena

Sentence: 11 marto vṛṇīta sakhyam //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 ity āha pitṛdevatyaitena

Sentence: 2 viśve rāya iṣudhyasīty āha vaiśvadevy ṝtena

Sentence: 3 dyumnam vṛṇīta puṣyasa ity āha pauṣṇy ṝtena

Sentence: 4 sā vā eṣark sarvadevatyā

Sentence: 5 yad etayarcā dīkṣayati sarvābhir evainam devatābhir dīkṣayati

Sentence: 6 saptākṣaram prathamam padam aṣṭākṣarāṇi trīṇi

Sentence: 7 yāni trīṇi tāny aṣṭāv upa yanti

Sentence: 8 yāni catvāri tāny aṣṭau

Sentence: 9 yad aṣtākṣarā tena //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 gāyatrī

Sentence: 2 yad ekādaśākṣarā tena { triṣṭug ^ triṣṭubh }

Sentence: 3 yad dvādaśākṣarā tena jagatī sāvā eṣark sarvāṇi chandāṁsi

Sentence: 4 yad etayarcā dīkṣayati sarvebhir evainam chandobhir dīkṣayati

Sentence: 5 saptākṣaram prathamam padam \\

Sentence: 6 saptapadā śakvarī

Sentence: 7 paśavaḥ śakvarī

Sentence: 8 paśūn evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 9 ekasmād akṣarād anāptam prathamam padam \\

Sentence: 10 tasmād yad vāco ‘nāptam tan manuṣyā upa jīvanti

Sentence: 11 pūrṇayā juhoti

Sentence: 12 pūrṇa iva hi prajāpatiḥ

Sentence: 13 prajāpater āptyai

Sentence: 14 nyūnayā juhoti

Sentence: 15 nyūnād dhi prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata prajānāṁ sṛṣṭyai //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ṛksāme vai devebhyo yajñāyātiṣṭhamāne kṛṣṇo rūpam kṛtvāpakramyātiṣṭhatām \\

Sentence: 2 tṝ ‘manyanta

Sentence: 3 yam vā ime upāvartsyataḥ sa idam bhaviṣyatīti te upāmantrayant te ahorātrayor mahimānam apanidhāya devān upāvartetām

Sentence: 4 eṣa vā ṛco varṇo yac chuklam kṛṣṇājinasya \\

Sentence: 5 eṣa sāmno yatkṛṣṇam

Sentence: 6 ṛksāmayoḥ śilpe stha ity āha \\

Sentence: 7 ṛksāme evāva rundhe \\

Sentence: 8 eṣaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 vā ahno varṇo yac chuklam kṛṣṇājinasyaiṣa rātriyā yat kṛṣṇam yad evainayos tatra nyaktam tad evāva runddhe

Sentence: 2 kṛṣṇājinena dīṣayati brahmaṇo vā etad rūpam yat kṛṣṇājinam brahmaṇaivainam dīkṣayati \\

Sentence: 3 imām dhiyaṁ śikṣamāṇasya devety āha yathāyajur evaitat \\

Sentence: 4 garbho vā eṣa yad dīkṣita ulbam vāsaḥ prorṇute tasmāt //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 garbhāḥ prāvṛtā jāyante

Sentence: 2 na purā somasya krayād aporṇvīta yat purā somasya krayād aporṇvīta garbhāḥ prajānām parāpātukāḥ syuḥ

Sentence: 3 krīte some ‘porṇute jāyata eva tad atho yathā vasīyāṁsam pratyaporṇute tādṛg eva tad

Sentence: 4 aṅgirasaḥ suvargam lokam yanta ūrjam vy abhajanta tato yad atyaśiṣyata te śarā abhavann ūrg vai śarā yac charamayī //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 mekhalā bhavaty ūrjam evāva runddhe

Sentence: 2 madhyataḥ sam nahyati madhyata evāsmā ūrjam dadhāti tasmān madhyata ūrjā bhuñjate \\

Sentence: 3 ūrdhvam vai puruṣasya nābhyai medhyam avācīnam amedhyam yan madhyataḥ samnahyati medhyam caivāsyāmedhyam ca vyāvartayati \\

Sentence: 4 indro vṛtrāya vajram prāharat sa tredhā vy abhavat sphyas tṛtīyaṁ rathas tṛtīyam yūpas tṛtīyam //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 yṝ ‘ntaḥśarā aśīryanta te śarā abhavan tac charāṇāṁ śaratvam

Sentence: 2 vajro vai śarāḥ kṣut khalu vai manuṣyasya bhrātṛvyo yac charamayī mekhalā bhavati vajreṇaiva sākṣāt kṣudham bhrātṛvyam madhyato ‘pa hate

Sentence: 3 trivṛd bhavati trivṛd vai prāṇas trivṛtam eva prāṇam madhyato yajamāne dadhāti

Sentence: 4 pṛthvī bhavati rajjūnām vyāvṛttyai

Sentence: 5 mekhalayā yajamānam dīkṣayati yoktreṇa patnīm mithunatvāya //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 yajño dakṣiṇām abhy adhyāyat tāṁ sam abhavat tad indro ‘cāyat so ‘manyata yo vā ito janiṣyate sa idam bhaviṣyatīti tām prāviśat tasyā indra evājāyata

Sentence: 2 so ‘manyata

Sentence: 3 yo vai mad ito ‘paro janiṣyate sa idam bhaviṣyatīti tasyā anumṛśya yonim āchinat sā sūtavaśābhavat tat sūta vaśāyai janma //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 tāṁ haste ny aveṣṭayata tām mṛgeṣu ny adadhāt sā kṛṣṇaviṣāṇābhavad indrasya yonir asi mā mā hiṁsīr iti kṛṣṇaviṣāṇām pra yachati sayonim eva yajñam karoti sayonim dakṣiṇāṁ sayonim indraṁ sayonitvāya

Sentence: 2 kṛṣyai tvā susasyāyā ity āha tasmād akṛṣṭapacyā oṣadhayaḥ pacyante

Sentence: 3 supippalābhyas tvauṣadhībhya ity āha tasmād oṣadhayaḥ phalam gṛhṇanti

Sentence: 4 yad dhastena //

Verse: 8

Sentence: 1 kaṇḍūyeta pāmanambhāvukāḥ prajāḥ syur yat smayeta nagnambhāvukāḥ

Sentence: 2 kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kaṇḍūyate ‘pigṛhya smayate prajānām gopīthāya

Sentence: 3 na purā dakṣiṇābhyo netoḥ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇām ava cṛted yat purā dakṣiṇābhyo netoḥ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇām avacṛted yoniḥ prajānām parāpātukā syāt \\

Sentence: 4 nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇām prāsyati yonir vai yajñasya cātvālam yoniḥ ṛṣṇaviṣāṇā yonāv eva yonim dadhāti yajñasya sayonitvāya //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 vāg vai devebhyo ‘pākrāmad yajñāyātiṣṭhamānā sā vanaspatīn prāviśat saiṣā vāg vanaspatiṣu vadati yā dundubhau yā tūṇave yā vīṇāyām \\

Sentence: 2 yad dīkṣitadaṇḍam prayachati vācam evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 3 audumbaro bhavaty ūrg vā udumbara ūrjam evāva runddhe

Sentence: 4 mukhena sammito bhavati mukhata evāsmā ūrjam dadhāti tasmān mukhata ūrjā bhuñjate //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍam pra yachati maitrāvaruṇo hi purastād ṛtvigbhyo vācam vibhajati tām ṛtvijo yajamāne prati ṣṭhāpayanti

Sentence: 2 svāhā yajñam manasety āha manasā hi puruṣo yajñam abhigachati

Sentence: 3 svāhā dvyāvāpṛthivyībhyām ity āha dyāvāpṛthivyor hi yajñaḥ

Sentence: 4 svāhoror antarikṣād ity āhāntarikṣe hi yajñaḥ svāhā yajñam vātād ārabha ity āhāyam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 vāva yaḥ pavate sa yajñas tam eva sākṣād ā rabhate

Sentence: 2 muṣṭī karoti vācam yachati yajñasya dhṛtyai \\

Sentence: 3 adīkṣiṣṭāyam brāhmaṇa iti trir upāṁśv āha devebhya evainam prāha trir uccair ubhayebhya evainam devamanuṣyebhyaḥ prāha

Sentence: 4 na purā nakṣatrebhyo vācam vi sṛjet \\

Sentence: 5 tasmāt sakṛd unnīya nāparam unnayeta

Sentence: 6 dadhnon nayeta \\

Sentence: 7 etad vai paśūnāṁ rūpam \\

Sentence: 8 rūpeṇaiva paśūn ava runddhe //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yajño devebhyo nilāyata viṣṇū rūpam kṛtvā

Sentence: 2 sa pṛthivīm prāviśat

Sentence: 3 tam devā hastānt saṁrabhyaichan

Sentence: 4 tam indra uparyupary aty akrāmat

Sentence: 5 so ‘bravīt

Sentence: 6 ko māyam uparyupary aty akramīd iti \\

Sentence: 7 aham durge hantety atha kas tvam iti \\

Sentence: 8 aham durgād āharteti

Sentence: 9 so ‘bravīt \\

Sentence: 10 durge vai hantāvocathā varāho ‘yam vāmamoṣaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 saptānām girīṇām parastād vittam vedyam asurāṇām bibharti tam jahi yadi durge hantāsīti

Sentence: 2 sa darbhapuñjīlam udvṛhya saptagirīn bhittvā tam ahan \\

Sentence: 3 so ‘bravīt \\

Sentence: 4 durgād vā āhartāvocathā etam ā hareti

Sentence: 5 tam ebhyo yajña eva yajñam āharat \\

Sentence: 6 yat tad vittam vedyam asurāṇām avindanta tad ekam vedyai veditvam

Sentence: 7 asurāṇām //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vā iyam agra āsīt \\

Sentence: 2 yāvad āsīnaḥ parāpaśyati tāvad devānām \\

Sentence: 3 te devā abruvan \\

Sentence: 4 astv eva no ‘syām apīti

Sentence: 5 kiyad vo dāsyāma iti

Sentence: 6 yāvad iyaṁ salāvṛkī triḥ parikrāmati tāvan no datteti

Sentence: 7 sa indraḥ salāvṛkī rūpam kṛtvemām triḥ sarvataḥ pary akrāmat

Sentence: 8 tad imām avindanta

Sentence: 9 yad imām avindanta tad vedyai veditvam //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 sā vā iyaṁ sarvaiva vedis \\

Sentence: 2 iyati śakṣyāmīti tvā avamāya yajante

Sentence: 4 daśadaśa sam padyante

Sentence: 5 daśākṣarā { virād ^ virāj }

Sentence: 6 annam { virād ^ virāj }

Sentence: 7 virājaivānnādyam ava runddhe \\

Sentence: 8 ud dhanti

Sentence: 9 yad evāsyā amedhyam tad apa hanti \\

Sentence: 10 ud dhanti

Sentence: 11 tasmād oṣadhayaḥ parā bhavanti

Sentence: 12 barhi stṛṇāti

Sentence: 13 tasmād oṣadhayaḥ punar ā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 14 uttaram barhiṣa uttarabarhi stṛṇāti

Sentence: 15 prajā vai barhir yajamāna uttarabarhis \\

Sentence: 16 yajamānam evāyajamānād uttaram karoti

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yad vā anīśāno bhāram ādatte vi vai sa liśate

Sentence: 2 yad dvādaśa sāhnasyopasadaḥ syus tisro ‘hīnasya yajñasya viloma kriyeta

Sentence: 3 tisra eva sāhnasyopasado dvādaśāhīnasya yajñasya savīryatvāyātho saloma kriyate

Sentence: 4 vatsasyaika stano bhāgī hi so ‘thaikaṁ stanam vratam upaity atha dvāv atha trīn atha catura etad vai //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 kṣurapavi nāma vratam yena pra jātān bhrātṛvyān nudate prati janiṣyamāṇān atho kanīyasaiva bhūya upaiti

Sentence: 2 caturo ‘gre stanān vratam upaity atha trīn atha dvāv athaikam etad vai sujaghanam nāma vratam tapasyaṁ suvargyam atho praiva jāyate prajayā paśubhis \\

Sentence: 3 yavāgū rājanyasya vratam krūreva vai yavāgūḥ krūra iva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 rājanyo vajrasya rūpaṁ samṛddhyai \\

Sentence: 2 āmikṣā vaiśyasya pākayajñasya rūpam puṣṭyai

Sentence: 3 payo brāhmaṇasya tejo vai brāhmaṇas tejaḥ payas tejasaiva tejaḥ paya ātman dhatte \\

Sentence: 4 atho payasā vai garbhā vardhante garbha iva khalu vā eṣa yad dīkṣito yad asya payo vratam bhavaty ātmānam eva tad vardhayati

Sentence: 5 trivrato vai manur āsīd dvivratā asurā ekavratāḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 devās \\

Sentence: 2 prātar madhyamdine sāyam tan manor vratam āsīt pākayajñasya rūpam puṣṭyai

Sentence: 3 prātaś ca sāyam cāsurāṇām nirmadhyam kṣudho rūpam tatas te parābhavan

Sentence: 4 madhyamdine madhyarātre devānām tatas tṝ ‘bhavant suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 5 yad asya madhyamdine madhyarātre vratam bhavati madhyato vā annena bhuñjate madhyata eva tad ūrjam dhatte bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai

Sentence: 6 bhavaty ātmanā //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati

Sentence: 2 garbho vā eṣa yad dīkṣito yonir dīkṣitavimitam yad dīkṣito dīkṣitavimitāt pravased yathā yoner garbha skandati tādṛg eva tan na pravastavyam ātmano gopīthāya \\

Sentence: 3 eṣa vai vyāghraḥ kulagopo yad agnis tasmād yad dīkṣitaḥ pravaset sa enam īśvaro ‘nūtthāya hantor na pravastavyam ātmano guptyai

Sentence: 4 dakṣiṇataḥ śaya etad vai yajamānasyāyatanaṁ sva evāyatane śaye \\

Sentence: 5 agnim abhyāvṛtya śaye devatā eva yajñam abhyāvṛtya śaye //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 purohaviṣi devayajane yājayed yam kāmayeta \\

Sentence: 2 upainam uttaro yajño named abhi suvargam lokam jayed iti \\

Sentence: 3 etad vai purohavir devayajanam yasya hotā prātaranuvākam anubruvann agnim apa ādityam abhi vipaśyati \\

Sentence: 4 upainam uttaro yajño namaty abhi suvargam lokam jayati \\

Sentence: 5 āpte devayajane yājayed bhrātṛvyavantam

Sentence: 6 panthām vādhisparśayet kartam vā

Sentence: 7 yāvan nānase yātavai //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 na rathāyaitad vā āptam devayajanam

Sentence: 2 āpnoty eva bhrātṛvyam nainam bhrātṛvya āpnoti \\

Sentence: 3 ekonnate devayajane yājajet paśukāmam

Sentence: 4 ekonnatād vai devayajanād aṅgirasaḥ paśūn asṛjanta \\

Sentence: 5 antarā sadohavirdhāne unnataṁ syāt \\

Sentence: 6 etad vā ekonnatam devayajanam

Sentence: 7 paśumān eva bhavati

Sentence: 8 tryḥnnate devayajane yājayet suvargakāmam \\

Sentence: 9 tryḥnnatād vai devayajanād aṅgirasaḥ suvargam lokam āyan \\

Sentence: 10 antarāhavanīyam ca havirdhānam ca //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 unnataṁ syād antarā havirdhānam ca sadaś cāntarā sadaś ca gārhapatyam ca \\

Sentence: 2 etad vai tryḥnnatam devayajanam \\

Sentence: 3 suvargam eva lokam eti

Sentence: 4 pratiṣṭhite devayajane yājayet pratiṣṭhākāmam

Sentence: 5 etad vai pratiṣṭhitam devayajanam yat sarvataḥ samam

Sentence: 6 praty eva tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 7 yatrānyāanyā oṣadhayo vyatiṣaktāḥ syus tad yājayet paśukāmam

Sentence: 8 etad vai paśūnāṁ rūpam \\

Sentence: 9 rūpeṇaivāsmai paśūn //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ava runddhe

Sentence: 2 paśumān eva bhavati

Sentence: 3 nirṛtigṛhīte devayajane yājayed yam kāmayeta

Sentence: 4 nirṛtyāsya yajñam grāhayeyam iti \\

Sentence: 5 etad vai nirṛtigṛhītam devayajanam yat sadṛśyai satyā ṛkṣam \\

Sentence: 6 nirṛtyaivāsya yajñam grāhayati

Sentence: 7 vyāvṛtte devayajane yājayed vyāvṛtkāmam yam pātre vā talpe vā mīmāṁseran

Sentence: 8 prācīnam āhavanīyāt pravaṇaṁ syāt pratīcīnam gārhapatyād etad vai vyāvṛttam devayajanam \\

Sentence: 9 vi pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇā vartate

Sentence: 10 nainam pātre na talpe mīmāṁsante

Sentence: 11 kāryṝ devayajane yājayed bhūtikāmam \\

Sentence: 12 kāryo vai puruṣas \\

Sentence: 13 bhavaty eva //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 tebhya uttaravediḥ siṁhī rūpam kṛtvobhayān antarāpakramyātiṣṭhat

Sentence: 2 te devā amanyanta

Sentence: 3 yantarān vā iyam upāvartsyati ta idam bhaviṣyantīti

Sentence: 4 tām upāmantrayanta

Sentence: 5 sābravīd

Sentence: 6 varam vṛṇai sarvān mayā kāmān vy aśnavatha pūrvām tu māgner āhutir aśnavatā iti

Sentence: 7 tasmād uttaravedim pūrvām agner vyāghārayanti

Sentence: 8 vārevṛtaṁ hy asyai

Sentence: 9 śamyayā pari mimīte //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 mātraivāsyai sātho yuktenaiva yuktam ava runddhe

Sentence: 2 vittāyanī me ‘sīty āha

Sentence: 3 vittā hy ṝnān āvat

Sentence: 4 tiktāyanī me ‘sīty āha

Sentence: 5 tiktān hy ṝnān āvat

Sentence: 6 avatān mā nāthitam ity āha

Sentence: 7 nāthitān hy ṝnān āvad

Sentence: 8 avatān mā vyathitam ity āha

Sentence: 9 vyathitān hy ṝnān āvad

Sentence: 10 vider agnir nabho nāma //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 agne aṅgira iti trir harati

Sentence: 2 ya evaiṣu lokeṣv agnayas

Sentence: 3 tān evāva runddhe tūṣṇīm caturthaṁ haraty

Sentence: 4 aniruktam evāva runddhe

Sentence: 5 siṁhīr asi mahiṣīr asīty āha

Sentence: 6 siṁhīr hy ṝṣā rūpam kṛtvobhayān antarāpakramyātiṣṭhad

Sentence: 7 uru prathasvoru te yajñapatiḥ prathatām ity āha

Sentence: 8 yajamānam eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prathayati

Sentence: 9 dhruvā //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 asīti saṁ hanti dhṛtyai devebhyaḥ śundhasvadevebhyaḥ śumbhasvety ava cokṣati pra ca kirati śuddhyai \\

Sentence: 2 indraghoṣas tvā vasubhiḥ purastāt pātv ity āha digbhya evainām prokṣati

Sentence: 3 devāṁś ced uttaravedir upāvavartīhaiva vi jayāmahā ity asurā vajram udyatya devān abhy āyanta tān indraghoṣo vasubhiḥ purastād apa //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 anudata manojavāḥ pitṛbhir dakṣiṇataḥ pracetā rudraiḥ paścād viśvakarmādityair uttarato

Sentence: 2 yad evam uttaravedim prokṣati digbhya eva tad yajamāno bhrātṛvyān praṇudata

Sentence: 3 indro yatīnt sālāvṛkebhyaḥ prāyachat tān dakṣiṇata uttaravedyā ādan

Sentence: 4 yat prokṣaṇīnām ucchiṣyeta tad dakṣiṇata uttaravedyai ni nayed

Sentence: 5 yad eva tatra krūram tat tena śamayati

Sentence: 6 yam dviṣyāt tam dhyāyec chucaivainam arpayati

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 sottaravedir abravīt

Sentence: 2 sarvān mayā kāmān vy aśnavatheti

Sentence: 3 te devā akāmayanta \\

Sentence: 5 te ‘juhavuḥ

Sentence: 6 siṁhīr asi sapatnasāhī svāheti

Sentence: 13 tṝ ‘juhavuḥ

Sentence: 14 siṁhīr asy ā vaha devān devayate //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 yajamānāya svāheti

Sentence: 3 pañca kṛtvo vyāghārayati

Sentence: 4 pañcākṣarā paṅktiḥ

Sentence: 5 pāṅkto yajñas \\

Sentence: 6 yajñam evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 12 tān eva tena prīṇāti

Sentence: 13 pautudravān paridhīn pari dadhāti \\

Sentence: 14 eṣām //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 lokānām vidhṛtyai \\

Sentence: 2 agnes trayo jyāyāṁso bhrātara āsan

Sentence: 3 te devebhyo havyam vahantaḥ prāmīyānta

Sentence: 4 so ‘gnir abibhet \\

Sentence: 5 ittham vāva sya ārtim āriṣyatīti

Sentence: 6 sa nilāyata

Sentence: 7 sa yām vanaspatiṣv avasat tām pūtudrau yām oṣadhīṣu tāṁ sugandhitejane yām paśuṣu tām petvasyāntarā śṛṅge

Sentence: 8 tam devatāḥ pariṣam aichan

Sentence: 9 tam anv avindan

Sentence: 10 tam abruvan //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 upa na ā vartasva havyam no vaheti

Sentence: 2 so ‘bravīt \\

Sentence: 3 varam vṛṇai yad eva gṛhītasyāhutasya bahiḥparidhi skandāt tan me bhrātṛṇām bhāgadheyam asad iti

Sentence: 4 tasmād yad gṛhītasyāhutasya bahiḥparidhi skandati teṣām tad bhāgadheyam tān eva tena prīṇāti

Sentence: 5 so ‘manyata \\

Sentence: 6 asthanvanto me pūrve bhrātaraḥ prāmeṣatāsthāni śātayā iti

Sentence: 7 sa yāni //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 asthāny aśātayata tat pūtudrv abhavat \\

Sentence: 2 yan māṁsam upamṛtam tad gulgulu yad etānt sambhārānt sambharaty agnim eva tat sam bharati \\

Sentence: 3 agneḥ purīṣam asīty āha \\

Sentence: 4 agner hy ṝtat purīṣam yat sambhārās \\

Sentence: 5 atho khalv āhus \\

Sentence: 6 ete vāvainam te bhrātaraḥ pari śere yat pautudravāḥ paridhaya iti //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 baddham ava syati

Sentence: 2 varuṇapāśād evaine muñcati

Sentence: 3 pra ṇenekti medhye evaine karoti

Sentence: 4 sāvitriyarcā hutvā havirdhāne pra vartayati

Sentence: 5 savitṛprasūta evaine pra vartayati

Sentence: 6 varuṇo vā eṣa durvāg ubhayato baddho yad akṣaḥ

Sentence: 7 sa yad utsarjed yajamānasya gṛhān abhyutsarjet

Sentence: 8 suvāg deva duryāṁ ā vadety āha

Sentence: 9 gṛhā vai duryāḥ

Sentence: 10 śāntyai

Sentence: 11 patnī //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 upānakti

Sentence: 2 patnī hi sarvasya mitram

Sentence: 3 mitratvāya

Sentence: 4 yad vai patnī yajñasya karoti mithunam tat \\

Sentence: 5 atho patniyā evaiṣa yajñasyānvārambhonavachittyai

Sentence: 6 vartmanā vā anvitya yajñaṁ rakṣāṁsi jighāṁsanti

Sentence: 7 vaiṣṇavībhyām ṛgbhyām vartmanor juhoti

Sentence: 8 yajño vai viṣṇus \\

Sentence: 9 yajñād eva rakṣāṁsy apa hanti

Sentence: 10 yad adhvaryur anagnāv āhutim juhuyād andho ‘dhvaryuḥ syād rakṣāṁsi yajñaṁ hanyuḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 hiraṇyam upāsya juhoti \\

Sentence: 2 agnivaty eva juhoti

Sentence: 3 nāndho ‘dhvaryur bhavati na yajñaṁ rakṣāṁsi ghnanti

Sentence: 4 prācī pretam adhvaram kalpayantī ity āha

Sentence: 5 suvargam evaine lokam gamayati \\

Sentence: 6 atra ramethām varṣman pṛthivyā ity āha

Sentence: 7 varṣma hy ṝtat pṛthivyā yad devayajanam \\

Sentence: 8 śiro vā etad yajñasya yad dhavirdhānam \\

Sentence: 9 divo vā viṣṇav uta vā pṛthivyāḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ity āśīrpadayarcā dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya methīm ni hanti

Sentence: 2 śīrṣata eva yajñasya yajamāna āśiṣo ‘va runddhe

Sentence: 3 daṇḍo vā auparas tṛtīyasya havirdhānasya vaṣaṭkāreṇākṣam achinat \\

Sentence: 4 yat tṛtīyam chadir havirdhānayor udāhriyate tṛtīyasya havirdhānasyāvaruddhyai

Sentence: 5 śiro vā etad yajñasya yad dhavirdhānam \\

Sentence: 6 viṣṇo rarāṭam asiviṣṇoḥ pṛṣṭham asīty āha

Sentence: 7 tasmād etāvaddhā śiro viṣyūtam \\

Sentence: 8 viṣṇoḥ syūr asi viṣṇor dhruvam asīty āha

Sentence: 9 vaiṣṇavaṁ hi devatayā havirdhānam \\

Sentence: 10 yam prathamam granthim grathnīyāt yat tam na visraṁsayed amehenādhvaryuḥ pra mīyeta

Sentence: 11 tasmāt sa visrasyaḥ //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ity abhrim ā datte prasūtyai \\

Sentence: 2 aśvinor bāhubhyām ity āha \\

Sentence: 3 aśvinau hi devānām adhvaryū āstām

Sentence: 4 pūṣṇo hastābhyām ity āha yatyai

Sentence: 5 vajra iva vā eṣā yad abhrir abhrir asi nārir asīty āha śāntyai

Sentence: 6 kāṇḍekāṇḍe vai kriyamāṇe yajñaṁ rakṣāṁsi jighāṁsanti

Sentence: 7 parilikhitaṁ rakṣaḥ parilikhitā arātaya ity āha rakṣasām apahatyai //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 idam ahaṁ rakṣaso grīvā api kṛntāmi yo ‘smān dveṣṭi yam ca vayam dviṣma ity āha dvau vāva puruṣau yam caiva dveṣṭi yaś cainam dveṣṭi tayor evānantarāyam grīvāḥ kṛntati

Sentence: 2 dive tvāntarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tvety āhaibhya evainam lokebhyaḥ prokṣati

Sentence: 3 parastād arvācīm prokṣati tasmāt //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 parastād arvācīm manuṣyā ūrjam upa jīvanti

Sentence: 2 krūram iva vā etat karoti yat khanaty apo ‘va nayati śāntyai

Sentence: 3 yavamatīr ava nayaty ūrg vai yava ūrg udumbara ūrjaivorjaṁ sam ardhayati

Sentence: 4 yajamānena sammitaudumbarī bhavati yāvān eva yajamānas tāvatīm evāsminn ūrjam dadhāti

Sentence: 5 pitṛṇāṁ sadanam asīti barhir ava stṛṇāti pitṛdevatyam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 hy ṝtad yan nikhātam \\

Sentence: 2 yad barhir anavastīrya minuyāt pitṛdevatyā nikhātā syād barhir avastīrya minoty asyām evainām minoty atho svāruham evainām karoti \\

Sentence: 3 ud divaṁ stabhānāntarikṣam pṛṇety āhaiṣām lokānām vidhṛtyai

Sentence: 4 dyutānas tvā māruto minotv ity āha dyutāno ha sma vai māruto devānām audumbarīm minoti tenaiva //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 enām minoti

Sentence: 2 brahmavanim tvā kṣatravanim ity āha yathāyajur evaitat \\

Sentence: 3 ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī ā pṛṇethām ity audumbaryām juhoti dyāvāpṛthivī eva rasenānakti \\

Sentence: 4 āntam anvavasrāvayaty āntam eva yajamānam tejasānakti \\

Sentence: 5 aindram asīti chadir adhi ni dadhāty aindraṁ hi devatayā sadas \\

Sentence: 6 viśvajanasya chāyety āha viśvajanasya hy ṝṣā chāyā yat sadas \\

Sentence: 7 navachadi //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 tejaskāmasya minuyāt trivṛtā stomena sammitam tejas trivṛt tejasvy ṝva bhavati \\

Sentence: 2 ekādaśachadīndriyakāmasyaikādaśākṣarā tṛṣṭug indriyam triṣṭug indriyāvy ṝva bhavati

Sentence: 3 pañcadaśachadi bhrātṛvyavataḥ pañcadaśo vajro bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai

Sentence: 4 saptadaśachadi prajākāmasya saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāpater āptyai \\

Sentence: 5 ekaviṁśatichadi {F pratiṣṭhākāmasyaikaviṁśa} {W pratiṣṭhākamasyaikaviṁśa} {GOLS pratiṣṭhākamasyaikaviṁśas} stomānām pratiṣṭhā pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 6 udaram vai sada ūrg udumbaro madhyata audumbarīm minoti madhyata eva prajānām ūrjam dadhāti tasmāt //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 madhyata ūrjā bhuñjate

Sentence: 2 yajamānaloke vai dakṣiṇāni chadīṁṣi bhrātṛvyaloka uttarāṇi dakṣiṇāny uttarāṇi karoti yajamānam evāyajamānād uttaram karoti tasmād yajamāno ‘yajamānād uttaras \\

Sentence: 3 antarvartān karoti vyāvṛttyai tasmād araṇyam prajā upa jīvanti

Sentence: 4 pari tvā girvaṇo gira ity āha yathāyajur evaitat \\

Sentence: 5 indrasya syūr asīndrasya dhruvam asīty āhaindraṁ hi devatayā sadas \\

Sentence: 6 yam prathamam granthim grathnīyād yat tam na visraṁsayed amehenādhvaryuḥ pra mīyeta tasmāt sa visrasyaḥ //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 śiro vā etad yajñasya yad dhavirdhānam prāṇā uparavās \\

Sentence: 2 havirdhāne khāyante

Sentence: 3 tasmāc chīrṣan prāṇās \\

Sentence: 4 adhastāt khāyante

Sentence: 5 tasmād adhastāc chīrṣṇaḥ prāṇās \\

Sentence: 6 rakṣohaṇo valagahano vaiṣṇavān khanāmīty āha

Sentence: 7 vaiṣṇavā hi devatayoparavās \\

Sentence: 8 asurā vai niryanto devānām prāṇeṣu valagān ny akhanan

Sentence: 9 tān bāhumātre ‘nv avindan

Sentence: 10 tasmād bāhumātrāḥ khāyante \\

Sentence: 11 idam aham tam valagam ud vapāmi //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yam naḥ samāno yam asamāno nicakhānety āha

Sentence: 2 dvau vāva puruṣau yaś caiva samāno yaś cāsamānas \\

Sentence: 3 yam evāsmai tau valagam nikhanastas tam evod vapati

Sentence: 4 sam tṛṇatti

Sentence: 5 tasmāt samtṛṇṇā antarataḥ prāṇās \\

Sentence: 6 na sam bhinatti

Sentence: 7 tasmād asambhinnāḥ prāṇās \\

Sentence: 8 apo ‘va nayati

Sentence: 9 tasmād ārdrā antarataḥ prāṇās \\

Sentence: 10 yavamatīr ava nayati //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ūrg vai yavaḥ

Sentence: 2 prāṇā uparavāḥ

Sentence: 3 prāṇeṣv evorjam dadhāti

Sentence: 4 barhir ava stṛṇāti

Sentence: 5 tasmāl lomaśā antarataḥ prāṇās \\

Sentence: 6 ājyena vyāghārayati

Sentence: 7 tejo vā ājyam

Sentence: 8 prāṇā uparavāḥ

Sentence: 9 prāṇeṣv eva tejo dadhāti

Sentence: 10 hanū vā ete yajñasya yad adhiṣavaṇe

Sentence: 11 na sam tṛṇatti \\

Sentence: 12 asamtṛṇṇe hi hanū

Sentence: 13 atho khalu dīrghasome samtṛdye

Sentence: 14 dhṛtyai

Sentence: 15 śiro vā etad yajñasya yad dhavirdhānam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 prāṇā uparavā hanū adhiṣavaṇe jihvā carma grāvāṇo dantā mukham āhavanīyo nāsikottaravedir udaraṁ sadas \\

Sentence: 2 yadā khalu vai jihvayā datsv adhi khādaty atha mukham gachati

Sentence: 3 yadā mukham gachaty athodaram gachati

Sentence: 4 tasmād dhavirdhāne carmann adhi grāvabhir abhiṣutyāhavanīye hutvā pratyañcaḥ paretya sadasi bhakṣayanti

Sentence: 5 yo vai virājo yajñamukhe doham veda

Sentence: 6 duha evainām

Sentence: 7 iyam vai { virāṭ ^ virāj }

Sentence: 8 tasyai tvak carmodho ‘dhiṣavaṇe stanā uparavā grāvāṇo vatsā ṛtvijo duhanti somaḥ payas \\

Sentence: 9 ya evam veda duha evainām //

## Chapter: 3

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 cātvālād dhiṣṇiyān upa vapati

Sentence: 2 yonir vai yajñasya cātvālam yajñasya sayonitvāya

Sentence: 3 devā vai yajñam parājayanta

Sentence: 4 tam āgnīdhrāt punar apājayan \\

Sentence: 5 etad vai yajñasyāparājitam yad āgnīdhram \\

Sentence: 6 yad āgnīdhrād dhiṣṇiyān viharati yad eva yajñasyāparājitam tata evainam punas tanute

Sentence: 7 parājityeva khalu vā ete yanti ye bahiṣpavamānaṁ sarpanti

Sentence: 8 bahiṣpavamāne stute //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 āha \\

Sentence: 2 agnīd agnīn vi hara barhi stṛnāhi puroḍāśāṁ alam kurv iti

Sentence: 3 yajñam evāpajitya punas tanvānā yanti \\

Sentence: 4 aṅgārair dve savane vi harati śalākābhis tṛtīyam \\

Sentence: 5 saśukratvāya \\

Sentence: 6 atho sam bharaty evainad \\

Sentence: 7 dhiṣṇiyā vā amuṣmiṁ loke somam arakṣan

Sentence: 8 tebhyo ‘dhi somam āharan

Sentence: 9 tam anvavāyan tam pary aviśan

Sentence: 10 ya evam veda vindate //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 pariveṣṭāram \\

Sentence: 2 te somapīthena vy ārdhyanta

Sentence: 3 te deveṣu somapītham aichanta

Sentence: 4 tān devā abruvan

Sentence: 5 dvedve nāmanī kurudhvam atha pra vāpsyatha na veti \\

Sentence: 6 agnayo vā atha dhiṣṇiyās

Sentence: 7 tasmād dvināmā brāhmaṇo ‘rdhukas

Sentence: 8 teṣām ye nediṣṭham paryaviśan te somapītham prāpnuvann āhavanīya āgnīdhrīyo hotrīyo mārjālīyas

Sentence: 9 tasmāt teṣu juhvati \\

Sentence: 10 atihāya vaṣaṭ karoti

Sentence: 11 vi hi //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ete somapīthenārdhyanta

Sentence: 2 devā vai yāḥ prācīr āhutīr ajuhavur ye purastād asurā āsan tāṁs tābhiḥ prāṇudanta

Sentence: 3 yāḥ pratīcīr ye paścād asurā āsan tāṁs tābhir apānudanta

Sentence: 4 prācīr anyā āhutayo hūyante pratyaṅṅ āsīno dhiṣṇiyān vyāghārayati

Sentence: 5 paścāc caiva purastāc ca yajamāno bhrātṛvyān pra ṇudate

Sentence: 6 tasmāt parācīḥ prajāḥ pra vīyante pratīcīḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 jāyante

Sentence: 2 prāṇā vā ete yad dhiṣṇiyās \\

Sentence: 3 yad adhvaryuḥ pratyaṅ dhiṣṇiyān atisarpet prāṇānt sam karṣet

Sentence: 4 pramāyukaḥ syāt \\

Sentence: 5 nābhir vā eṣā yajñasya yad dhotā \\

Sentence: 6 ūrdhvaḥ khalu vai nābhyai prāṇo ‘vāṅ apānas \\

Sentence: 7 yad adhvaryuḥ pratyaṅ hotāram atisarped apāne prāṇam dadhyāt pramāyukaḥ syāt \\

Sentence: 8 nādhvaryur upa gāyet \\

Sentence: 9 vāgvīryo vā adhvaryus \\

Sentence: 10 yad adhvaryur upagāyed udgātre //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 vācaṁ sam pra yached upadāsukāsya vāk syāt \\

Sentence: 2 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 3 nāsaṁsthite some ‘dhvaryuḥ pratyaṅk sado ‘tīyād atha kathā dākṣiṇāni hotum eti yāmo hi sa teṣām kasmā aha devā yāmam vāyāmam vānu jñāsyantīti \\

Sentence: 4 uttareṇāgnīdhram parītya juhoti dākṣiṇāni

Sentence: 5 na prāṇānt sam karṣati

Sentence: 6 ny anye dhiṣṇiyā upyante nānye

Sentence: 7 yān nivapati tena tān prīṇāti

Sentence: 8 yān na nivapati yad anudiśati tena tān //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 suvargāya vā etāni lokāya hūyante yad vaisarjanāni

Sentence: 2 dvābhyām gārhapatye juhoti

Sentence: 3 dvipād yajamānaḥ

Sentence: 4 pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 5 āgnīdhre juhoti \\

Sentence: 6 antarikṣa evā kramate \\

Sentence: 7 āhavanīye juhoti

Sentence: 8 suvargam evainam lokam gamayati

Sentence: 9 devān vai suvargam lokam yato rakṣāṁsy ajighāṁsan

Sentence: 10 te somena rājñā rakṣāṁsy apahatyāptum ātmānam kṛtvā suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 11 rakṣasām anupalābhāyā \\

Sentence: 12 āttaḥ somo bhavaty atha //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 vaisarjanāni juhoti rakṣasām apahatyai

Sentence: 2 tvaṁ soma tanūkṛdbhya ity āha

Sentence: 3 tanūkṛd dhy { ṝṣa ^ ṝṣas }

Sentence: 4 dveṣobhyo ‘nyakṛtebhya ity āha \\

Sentence: 5 anyakṛtāni hi rakṣāṁsi \\

Sentence: 6 uru yantāsi varūtham ity āha \\

Sentence: 7 uru ṇas kṛdhīti vāvaitad āha

Sentence: 8 ṣāṇo aptur ājyasya vetv ity āha \\

Sentence: 9 aptum eva yajamānam kṛtvā suvargam lokam gamayati

Sentence: 10 rakṣasām anupalābhāya \\

Sentence: 11 ā somam dadate //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ā grāvṇa ā vāyavyāny ā droṇakalaśam

Sentence: 2 ut patnīm ā nayanti \\

Sentence: 3 anv anāṁsi pra vartayanti

Sentence: 4 yāvad evāsyāsti tena saha suvargam lokam eti

Sentence: 5 nayavatyarcāgnīdhre juhoti

Sentence: 6 suvargasya lokasyābhinītyai

Sentence: 7 grāvṇo vāyavyāni droṇakalaśam āgnīdhra upa vāsayati

Sentence: 8 vi hy ṝnam tair gṛhṇate

Sentence: 9 yat sahopavāsayed apuvāyeta

Sentence: 10 saumyarcā pra pādayati

Sentence: 11 svayā //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 evainam devatayā pra pādayati \\

Sentence: 2 adityāḥ sado ‘sy adityāḥ sada ā sīdety āha

Sentence: 3 yathāyajur evaitat \\

Sentence: 4 yajamāno vā etasya purā goptā bhavati \\

Sentence: 5 eṣa vo deva savitaḥ soma ity āha

Sentence: 6 savitṛprasūta evainam devatābhyaḥ sam pra yachati \\

Sentence: 7 etat tvaṁ soma devo devān upāgā ity āha

Sentence: 8 devo hy ṝṣa san //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 devān upaiti \\

Sentence: 2 idam aham manuṣyo manuṣyān ity āha

Sentence: 3 manuṣyo hy ṝṣa san manuṣyān upaiti

Sentence: 4 yad etad yajur na brūyād aprajā apaśur yajamānaḥ syāt

Sentence: 5 saha prajayā saha rāyas poṣeṇety āha

Sentence: 6 prajayaiva paśubhiḥ sahemam lokam upāvartate

Sentence: 7 namo devebhya ity āha

Sentence: 8 namaskāro hi devānām \\

Sentence: 9 svadhā pitṛbhya ity āha

Sentence: 10 svadhākāro hi //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 pitṛṇām

Sentence: 2 idam aham nir varuṇasya pāśād ity āha

Sentence: 3 varuṇapāśād eva nir mucyate \\

Sentence: 4 agne vratapate \\

Sentence: 5 ātmanaḥ pūrvā tanūr ādeyety āhuḥ

Sentence: 6 ko hi tad veda yad vasīyānt sve vaśe bhūte punar vā dadāti na veti

Sentence: 7 grāvāṇo vai somasya rājño malimlusenā

Sentence: 8 ya evam vidvān grāvṇa āgnīdhra upavāsayati nainam malimlusenā vindati //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 vaiṣṇavyarcā hutvā yūpam achaiti vaiṣṇavo vai devatayā yūpaḥ svayaivainam devatayāchaity

Sentence: 2 aty anyān agām nānyān upāgām ity āhāti hy anyān eti nānyān upaity arvāk tvā parair avidam parovarair ity āhārvāg ghy ṝnam parair vindati parovarais tam tvā juṣe //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 vaiṣṇavam devayajyāyā ity āha devayajyāyai hy ṝnam juṣate

Sentence: 2 devas tvā savitā madhvānaktv ity āha tejasaivainam anakty oṣadhe trāyasvainaṁ svadhite mainaṁ hiṁsīr ity āha vajro vai svadhitiḥ śāntyai

Sentence: 3 svadhiter vṛkṣasya bibhyataḥ prathamena śakalena saha tejaḥ parā patati yaḥ prathamaḥ śakalaḥ parāpatet tam apy ā haret satejasam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 evainam ā haratīme vai lokā yūpāt prayato bibhyati divam agreṇa mālekhīr antarikṣam madhyena mā hiṁsīr ity āhaibhya evainam lokebhyaḥ śamayati

Sentence: 2 vanaspate śatavalśo vi rohety āvraścane juhoti tasmād āvraścanād vṛkṣāṇām bhūyāṁsa ut tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 3 sahasravalśā vi vayaṁ ruhemety āhāśiṣam evaitām ā śāste \\

Sentence: 4 anakṣasaṅgam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vṛśced yad akṣasaṅgam vṛśced adhaīṣam yajamānasya pramāyukaṁ syād

Sentence: 2 yam kāmayetāpratiṣṭhitaḥ syād ity āroham tasmai vṛśced eṣa vai vanaspatīnām apratiṣṭhitopratiṣṭhita eva bhavati

Sentence: 3 yam kāmayetāpaśuḥ syād ity aparṇam tasmai śuṣkāgram vṛśced eṣa vai vanaspatīnām apaśavyo ‘paśur eva bhavati

Sentence: 4 yam kāmayeta paśumānt syād iti bahuparṇam tasmai bahuśākham vṛśced eṣa vai //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 vanaspatīnām paśavyaḥ paśumān eva bhavati

Sentence: 2 pratiṣṭhitam vṛścet pratiṣṭhākāmasyaiṣa vai vanaspatīnām pratiṣṭhito yaḥ same bhūmyai svād yone rūḍhaḥ praty eva tiṣṭhati yaḥ pratyaṅṅ upanatas tam vṛścet sa hi medham abhy upanataḥ

Sentence: 3 pañcāratnim tasmai vṛśced yam kāmayetopainam uttaro yajño named iti pañcākṣarā paṅktiḥ pāṅkto yajña upainam uttaro yajñaḥ //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 namati

Sentence: 2 ṣaḍaratnim pratiṣṭhākāmasya ṣaḍ vā ṛtava ṛtuṣv eva prati tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 3 saptāratnim paśukāmasya saptapadā śakvarī paśavaḥ śakvarī paśūn evāva runddhe

Sentence: 4 navāratnim tejaskāmasya trivrītā stomena sammitam tejas trivīt tejasvy ṝva bhavati \\

Sentence: 5 ekādaśāratnim indriyakāmasyaikādaśākṣarā tṛṣṭug indriyam triṣṭug indriyāvy ṝva bhavati

Sentence: 6 pañcadaśāratnim bhrātṛvyavataḥ pañcadaśo vajro bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai

Sentence: 7 saptadaśāratnim prajākāmasya saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāpater āptyai \\

Sentence: 8 ekaviṁśatyaratnim pratiṣṭhākāmasyaikaviṁśa stomānām pratiṣṭhā pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 9 aṣṭāśrir bhavaty aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī tejo gāyatrī gāyatrī yajñamukham tejasaiva gāyatriyā yajñamukhena sammitaḥ //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 pṛthivyai tvāntarikṣāya tvā dive tvety āhaibhya evainam lokebhyaḥ prokṣati

Sentence: 2 parāñcam prokṣati parāṅ iva hi suvargo lokaḥ

Sentence: 3 krūram iva vā etat karoti yat khanaty apova nayati śāntyai yavamatīr ava nayaty ūrg vai yavo yajamānena yūpaḥ sammito yāvān eva yajamānas tāvatīm evāsminn ūrjam dadhāti //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pitṛṇāṁ sadanam asīti barhir ava stṛṇāti pitṛdevatyaṁ hy ṝtad yan nikhātam yad barhir anavastīrya minuyāt pitṛdevatyo nikhātaḥ syād barhir avastīrya minoty asyām evainam minoti

Sentence: 2 yūpaśakalam avāsyati satejasam evainam minoti

Sentence: 3 devas tvā savitā madhvānaktv ity āha tejasaivainam anakti

Sentence: 4 supippalābhyas tvauṣadhībhya iti caṣālam prati //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 muñcati tasmāc chīrṣata oṣadhayaḥ phalam gṛhṇanty

Sentence: 2 anakti tejo vā ājyam yajamānenāgniṣṭhāśriḥ sammitā yad agniṣṭhām aśrim anakti yajamānam eva tejasānakty

Sentence: 3 āntam anakty āntam eva yajamānam tejasānakti

Sentence: 4 sarvataḥ pari mṛśaty aparivargam evāsmin tejo dadhāty

Sentence: 5 ud divaṁ stabhānāntarikṣam pṛṇety āhaiṣām lokānām vidhṛtyai

Sentence: 6 vaiṣṇavyarcā //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 kalpayati vaiṣṇavo vai devatayā yūpaḥ svayaivainam devatayā kalpayati

Sentence: 2 dvābhyām kalpayati dvipād yajmānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 3 yam kāmayeta tejasainam devatābhir indriyeṇa vy ardhayeyam ity agniṣṭhām tasyāśrim āhavanīyād ittham vettham vāti nāvayet tejasaivainam devatābhir indriyeṇa vy ardhayati

Sentence: 4 yam kāmayeta tejasainam devatābhir indriyeṇa sam ardhayeyam iti //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 agniṣṭhām tasyāśrim āhavanīyena sam minuyāt tejasaivainam devatābhir indriyeṇa sam ardhayati

Sentence: 2 brahmavanim tvā kṣatravanim ity āha yathāyajur evaitat

Sentence: 3 pari vyayaty ūrg vai raśanā yajamānena yūpaḥ sammito yajamānam evorjā sam ardhayati

Sentence: 4 nābhidaghne pari vyayati nābhidaghna evāsmā ūrjam dadhāti tasmān nābhidaghna ūrjā bhuñjate

Sentence: 5 yam kāmayetorjainam //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 vy ardhayeyam ity ūrdhvām vā tasyāvācīm vāvohed ūrjaivainam vyardhayati

Sentence: 2 yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syād ity avācīm avohed vṛṣṭim eva ni yachati yadi kāmayetāvarṣukaḥ syād ity ūrdhvām ud ūhed vṛṣṭim evod yachati

Sentence: 3 pitṛṇām nikhātam manuṣyāṇām ūrdhvam nikhātād ā raśanāyā oṣadhīnāṁ raśanā viśveṣām //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 devānām ūrdhvaṁ raśanāyā ā caṣālād indrasya caṣālaṁ sādhānām atiriktaṁ sa vā eṣa sarva devatyo yad yūpo yad yūpam minoti sarvā eva devatāḥ prīṇāti

Sentence: 2 yajñena vai devāḥ suvargam lokam āyan tṝ ‘manyanta manuṣyā no ‘nvābhaviṣyantīti te yūpena yopayitvā suvargam lokam āyan tam ṛṣayo yūpenaivānu prājānan tad yūpasya yūpa tvam //

Verse: 8

Sentence: 1 yad yūpam minoti suvargasya lokasya prajñātyai

Sentence: 2 purastān minoti purastād dhi yajñasya prajñāyate ‘prajñātaṁ hi tad yad atipanna āhur idam kāryam āsīd iti sādhyā vai devā yajñam aty amanyanta tān yajño nāspṛśat tān yad yajñasyātiriktam āsīt tad aspṛśad atiriktam vā etad yajñasya yad agnāv agnim mathitvā praharaty atiriktam etat //

Verse: 9

Sentence: 1 yūpasya yad ūrdhvam caṣālāt teṣām tad bhāgadheyam tān eva tena prīṇāti

Sentence: 2 devā vai saṁsthite some pra srucoharan pra yūpam tṝ ‘manyanta yajñaveśasam vā idam kurma iti te prastaraṁ srucāṁ niṣkrayaṇam apaśyant svarum yūpasya saṁsthite some pra prastaraṁ harati juhoti svarum ayajñaveśasāya

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 sādhyā vai devā asmiṁ loka āsan

Sentence: 2 nānyat kim cana miṣat

Sentence: 3 tṝ ‘gnim evāgnaye medhāyālabhanta

Sentence: 4 na hy anyad ālambhyam avindan

Sentence: 5 tato vā imāḥ prajāḥ prājāyanta

Sentence: 6 yad agnāv agnim mathitvā praharati prajānām prajananāya

Sentence: 7 rudro vā eṣa yad agnir yajamānaḥ paśus \\

Sentence: 8 yat paśum ālabhyāgnim manthed rudrāya yajamānam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 api dadhyāt

Sentence: 2 pramāyukaḥ syāt \\

Paragraph: 1
