Sentence: 1 evaiṣa mitrāya ca saha gṛhyātā iti

Sentence: 2 tasmān maitrāvaruṇaḥ saha gṛhyate

Sentence: 3 tasmād rājñā rājānam aṁśabhuvā ghnanti vaiśyena vaiśyaṁ śūdreṇa sūdram \\

Sentence: 4 na vā idam divā na naktam āsīd avyāvṛttam \\

Sentence: 5 te devā mitrāvaruṇāv abruvan \\

Sentence: 6 idam no vi vāsayatam iti

Sentence: 7 tāv abrūtām \\

Sentence: 8 varam vṛṇāvahā eka evāvat pūrvo {F graho} {W graho} gṛhyātā iti

Sentence: 9 tasmād aindravāyavaḥ pūrvo maitrāvaruṇād gṛhyate

Sentence: 10 prāṇāpānau hy ṝtau yad upāṁśvantaryāmau

Sentence: 11 mitro ‘har ajanayad varuṇo rātrim \\

Sentence: 12 tato vā idam vy auchat \\

Sentence: 13 yan maitrāvaruṇo gṛhyate vyḥṣṭyai //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yajñasya śiro ‘chidyata

Sentence: 2 te devā aśvināv abruvan

Sentence: 3 bhiṣajau vai stha idam yajñasya śiraḥ prati dhattam iti

Sentence: 4 tāv abrūtām \\

Sentence: 5 varam vṛṇāvahai graha eva nāv atrāpi gṛhyatām iti

Sentence: 6 tābhyām etam āśvinam agṛhṇan

Sentence: 7 tato vai tau yajñasya śiraḥ praty adhatām \\

Sentence: 8 yad āśvino gṛhyate yajñasya niṣkṛtyai

Sentence: 9 tau devā abruvan \\

Sentence: 10 apūtau vā imau manuṣyacarau //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 bhiṣajāv iti

Sentence: 2 tasmād brāhmaṇena bheṣajam na kāryam apūto hy ṝṣo ‘medhyo yo { bhiṣak ^ bhiṣaj }

Sentence: 3 tau bahiṣpavamānena pavayitvā tābhyām etam āśvinam agṛhṇan

Sentence: 4 tasmād bahiṣpavamāne stuta āśvino gṛhyate

Sentence: 5 tasmād evam viduṣā bahiṣpavamāna upasadyaḥ pavitram vai bahiṣpavamāna ātmānam eva pavayate

Sentence: 6 tayos tredhā bhaiṣajyam vi ny adadhus \\

Sentence: 7 agnau tṛtīyam apsu tṛtīyam brāhmaṇe tṛtīyam \\

Sentence: 8 tasmād udapātram //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 upanidhāya brāhmaṇam dakṣiṇato niṣādya bheṣajam kuryāt \\

Sentence: 2 yāvad eva bheṣajam tena karoti samardhukam asya kṛtam bhavati

Sentence: 3 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 4 kasmāt satyād ekapātrā dvidevatyā gṛhyante dvipātrā hūyanta iti

Sentence: 5 yad ekapātrā gṛhyante tasmād eko ‘ntarataḥ prāṇo dvipāttrā hūyante tasmād dvaudvau bahiṣṭāt prāṇāḥ

Sentence: 6 pāṇā vā ete yad dvidevatyāḥ paśava iḍā yad iḍām pūrvām dvidevatyṝbhya upahvayeta //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 paśubhiḥ prāṇān antar dadhīta pramāyukaḥ syāt \\

Sentence: 2 dvidevatyān bhakṣayitveḍām upa hvayate

Sentence: 3 prāṇān evātman dhitvā paśūn upa hvayate

Sentence: 4 vāg vā aindra vāyavaś cakṣur maitrāvaruṇaḥ śrotram āśvinaḥ

Sentence: 5 purastād aindravāyavam bhakṣayati tasmāt purastād vācā vadati

Sentence: 6 purastān maitrāvaruṇam tasmād purastāc cakṣuṣā paśyati sarvataḥ praihāram āśvinam tasmāt sarvataḥ śrotreṇa śṛṇoti

Sentence: 7 prāṇā vā ete yad dvidevatyāḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 ariktāni pātrāṇi sādayati

Sentence: 2 tasmād ariktā antarataḥ prāṇā yataḥ khalu vai yajñasya vitatasya na kriyate tad anu yajñaṁ rakṣāṁsy ava caranti

Sentence: 3 yad ariktāni pātrāṇi sādayati kriyamāṇam eva tad yajñasya śaye rakṣasām ananvavacārāya

Sentence: 4 dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyottarasyām vartanyāṁ sādayati vācy ṝva vācam dadhāti \\

Sentence: 5 ā tṛtīyasavanāt pari śere yajñasya samtatyai

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 bṛhaspatir devānām purohita āsīc chaṇḍāmarkāv asurāṇām

Sentence: 2 brahmaṇvanto devā āsan brahmaṇvanto ‘surās

Sentence: 3 tṝ ‘nyo’nyam nāśaknuvann abhibhavitum \\

Sentence: 4 te devāḥ śaṇḍāmarkāv upāmantrayanta

Sentence: 5 tāv abrūtām \\

Sentence: 6 varam vṛṇāvahai grahāv eva nāv atrāpi gṛhyetām iti

Sentence: 7 tābhyām etau śukrāmanthināv agṛhṇan

Sentence: 8 tato devā abhavan parāsurās \\

Sentence: 9 yasyaivam viduṣaḥ śukrāmanthinau gṛhyete bhavaty ātmanā parā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 asya bhrātrivyo bhavati

Sentence: 2 tau devā apanudyātmana indrāyājuhavus \\

Sentence: 3 apanuttau śaṇḍāmarkau sahāmuneti brūyād yam dviṣyāt \\

Sentence: 4 yam eva dveṣṭi tenainau sahāpa nudate

Sentence: 5 sa prathamaḥ samkṛtir viśvakarmety evaināv ātmana indrāyājuhavus \\

Sentence: 6 indro hy ṝtāni rūpāṇi karikrad acarat \\

Sentence: 7 asau vā ādityaḥ śukraś candramā manthī \\

Sentence: 8 apigṛhya prāñcau niḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 krāmatas

Sentence: 2 tasmāt prāñcau yantau na paśyanti

Sentence: 3 pratyañcāv āvṛtya juhutas

Sentence: 4 tasmāt pratyañcau yantau paśyanti

Sentence: 5 cakṣuṣī vā ete yajñasya yac chukrāmanthinau nāsikottaravedis \\

Sentence: 6 abhitaḥ parikramya juhutas

Sentence: 7 tasmād abhito nāsikām cakṣuṣī

Sentence: 8 tasmān nāsikayā cakṣuṣī vidhṛte

Sentence: 9 sarvataḥ pari krāmato rakṣasām apahatyai

Sentence: 10 devā vai yāḥ prācīr āhutīr ajuhavur ye purastād asurā āsan tāṁs tābhiḥ pra //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 anudanta

Sentence: 2 yāḥ pratīcīr ye paścād asurā āsan tāṁs tābhir apānudanta

Sentence: 3 prācīr anyā āhutayo hūyante pratyañcau śukrāmanthinau

Sentence: 4 paścāc caiva purastāc ca yajamāno bhrātṛvyān pra ṇudate

Sentence: 5 tasmāt parācīḥ prajāḥ pra vīyante pratīcīr jāyante

Sentence: 6 śukrāmanthinau vā anu prajāḥ pra jāyante ‘ttrīś cādyāś ca

Sentence: 7 suvīrāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhi śukraḥ śukraśociṣā //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 suprajāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhi manthī manthiśociṣety āha \\

Sentence: 2 etā vai suvīrā yā attrīs \\

Sentence: 3 etāḥ suprajā yā ādyās \\

Sentence: 4 ya evam vedāttry asya prajā jāyate nādyā

Sentence: 5 prajāpater akṣy aśvayat

Sentence: 6 tat parāpatat

Sentence: 7 tad vikaṅkatam prāviśat

Sentence: 8 tad vikaṅkate nāramata

Sentence: 9 tad yavam prāviśat

Sentence: 10 tad yave ‘ramata

Sentence: 11 tad yavasya //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 yavatvam \\

Sentence: 2 yad vaikaṅkatam manthipātram bhavati saktubhiḥ śrīṇāti prajāpater eva tac cakṣuḥ sam bharati

Sentence: 3 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 4 kasmāt satyān manthipātraṁ sado nāśnuta iti \\

Sentence: 5 ārtapātraṁ hīti brūyāt \\

Sentence: 6 yad aśnuvītāndho ‘dhvaryuḥ syād ārtim ārchet

Sentence: 7 tasmān nāśnute //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 devā vai yad yajñe ‘kurvata tad asurā akurvata

Sentence: 2 te devā āgrayaṇāgrān grahān apaśyan

Sentence: 3 tān agṛhṇata

Sentence: 4 tato vai te ‘gram pary āyan

Sentence: 5 yasyaivam viduṣa āgrayaṇāgrā grahā gṛhyante ‘gram eva samānānām pary eti

Sentence: 6 rugṇavatyarcā bhrātṛvyavato gṛhṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 7 bhrātṛvyasyaiva ruktvāgraṁ samānānām pary eti

Sentence: 8 ye devā divy ekādaśa sthety āha //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 etāvatīr vai devatās tābhya evainaṁ sarvābhyo gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 2 eṣa te yonir viśvebhyas tvā devebhya iti āha

Sentence: 3 vaiśvadevo hy ṝṣa devatayā

Sentence: 4 vāg vai devebhyyo ‘pākrāmad yajñāyātiṣṭhamānā te devā vācy apakrāntāyām tūṣṇīm grahān agṛhṇata sāmanyata vāg antar yanti vai meti sāgrayaṇam praty āgachat

Sentence: 5 tad āgrayaṇasyāgrayaṇatvam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 tasmād āgrayaṇe vāg vi sṛjyate

Sentence: 2 yat tūṣṇīm pūrve grahā gṛhyante yathā tsārī \\

Sentence: 3 iyati ma ākha iyati nāpa rātsyāmīty upāvasṛjaty evam eva tad adhvaryur āgrayaṇam gṛhītvā yajñam ārabhya vācam vi sṛjate

Sentence: 4 trir him karoty udgātṝn eva tad vṛṇīte

Sentence: 5 prajāpatir vā eṣa yad āgrayaṇo yad āgrayaṇam gṛhītvā himkaroti prajāpatir eva //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 tat prajā abhi jighrati

Sentence: 2 tasmād vatsam jātam gaur abhi jighrati \\

Sentence: 3 ātmā vā eṣa yajñasya yad āgrayaṇaḥ savanesavane ‘bhi gṛhṇāty ātmann eva yajñaṁ sam tanoti \\

Sentence: 4 upariṣṭād ā nayati reta eva tad dadhāti \\

Sentence: 5 adhastād upa gṛhṇāti pra janayaty eva tat \\

Sentence: 6 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 7 kasmāt satyād gāyatrī kaniṣṭhā chandasāṁ satī sarvāṇi savanāni vahatīti \\

Sentence: 8 eṣa vai gāyatriyai vatso yad āgrayaṇas tam eva tad abhinivartaṁ sarvāṇi savanāni vahati

Sentence: 9 tasmād vatsam apākṛtam gaur abhi ni vartate //

## Chapter: 5

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 indro vṛtrāya vajram ud ayachat

Sentence: 2 sa vṛtro vajrād udyatād abibhet

Sentence: 3 so ‘bravīt \\

Sentence: 4 mā me pra hār asti vā idam mayi vīryam tat te pra dāsyāmīti

Sentence: 5 tasmā ukthyam prāyachat

Sentence: 6 tasmai dvitīyam ud ayachat

Sentence: 7 so ‘bravīt \\

Sentence: 8 mā me pra hār asti vā idam mayi vīryam tat te pra dāsyāmīti //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 tasmā ukthyam eva prāyachat

Sentence: 2 tasmai tṛtīyam ud ayachat

Sentence: 3 tam viṣṇur anv atiṣṭhata

Sentence: 4 jahīti

Sentence: 5 so ‘bravīt \\

Sentence: 6 mā me pra hār asti vā idam mayi vīryam tat te pra dāsyāmīti

Sentence: 7 tasmā ukthyam eva prāyachat

Sentence: 8 tam nirmāyam bhūtam ahan

Sentence: 9 yajño hi tasya māyāsīt \\

Sentence: 10 yad ukthyo gṛhyata indriyam eva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 tad vīryam yajamāno bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte \\

Sentence: 2 indrāya tvā bṛhadvate vayasvata ity āha \\

Sentence: 3 indrāya hi sa tam prāyachat

Sentence: 4 tasmai tvā viṣṇave tvety āha

Sentence: 5 yad eva viṣṇur anvatiṣṭhata

Sentence: 6 jahīti tasmād viṣṇum anvābhajati

Sentence: 7 trir nir gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 8 trir hi sa tam tasmai prāyachat \\

Sentence: 9 eṣa te yoniḥ punarhavir asīty āha

Sentence: 10 punaḥpunaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 hy asmān nirgṛhṇāti

Sentence: 2 cakṣur vā etad yajñasya yad ukthyas

Sentence: 3 tasmād ukthyaṁ hutaṁ somā anvāyanti

Sentence: 4 tasmād ātmā cakṣur anv eti

Sentence: 5 tasmād ekam yantam bahavo ‘nu yanti

Sentence: 6 tasmād eko bahūnām bhadro bhavati

Sentence: 7 tasmād eko bahvīr jāyā vindate

Sentence: 8 yadi kāmayetādhvaryus \\

Sentence: 9 ātmānam yajñayaśasenārpayeyam ity antarāhavanīyam ca havirdhānam ca tiṣṭhann ava nayet //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 ātmānam eva yajñayaśasenārpayati

Sentence: 2 yadi kāmayeta

Sentence: 3 yajamānam yajñayaśasenārpayeyam ity antarā sadohavirdhāne tiṣṭhann ava nayet \\

Sentence: 4 yajamānam eva yajñayaśasenārpayati

Sentence: 5 yadi kāmayeta

Sentence: 6 sadasyān yajñayaśasenārapayeyam iti sada ālabhyāva nayet

Sentence: 7 sadasyān eva yajñayaśasenārpayati //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 āyur vā etad yajñasya yad dhruvas \\

Sentence: 2 uttamo grahāṇām gṛhyate tasmād āyuḥ prāṇānām uttamam

Sentence: 3 mūrdhānam divo aratim pṛthivyā ity āha

Sentence: 4 mūrdhānam evainaṁ samānānām karoti

Sentence: 5 vaiśvānaram ṛtāya jātam agnim ity āha

Sentence: 6 vaiśvānaraṁ hi devatayāyus \\

Sentence: 7 ubhayatovaiśvānaro gṛhyate

Sentence: 8 tasmād ubhayataḥ prāṇās \\

Sentence: 9 adhastāc copariṣṭāc ca \\

Sentence: 10 ardhino ‘nye grahā gṛhyante ‘rdhī dhruvas

Sentence: 11 tasmād //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ardhy avāṅ prāṇo ‘nyeṣām prāṇānām

Sentence: 2 upopte ‘nye grahāḥ sādyante ‘nupopte dhruvas

Sentence: 3 tasmād asthnānyāḥ prajāḥ pratitiṣṭhanti māṁsenānyās \\

Sentence: 4 asurā vā uttarataḥ pṛthivīm paryācikīrṣan

Sentence: 5 tām devā dhruveṇādṛṁhan

Sentence: 6 tad dhruvasya dhruvatvam \\

Sentence: 7 yad dhruva uttarataḥ sādyate dhṛtyai \\

Sentence: 8 āyur vā etad yajñasya yad dhruva ātmā hotā

Sentence: 9 yad dhotṛcamase dhruvam avanayaty ātmann eva yajñasya //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 āyur dadhāti

Sentence: 2 purastād ukthasyāvanīya ity āhuḥ

Sentence: 3 purastād dhy āyuṣo bhuṅkte

Sentence: 4 madhyato ‘vanīya ity āhus \\

Sentence: 5 madhyamena hy āyuṣo bhuṅkte \\

Sentence: 6 uttarārdhṝ ‘vanīya ity āhus \\

Sentence: 7 uttamena hy āyuṣo bhuṅkte

Sentence: 8 vaiśvadevyām ṛci śasyamānāyām ava nayati

Sentence: 9 vaiśvadevyo vai prajāḥ

Sentence: 10 prajāsv evāyur dadhāti //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yajñena vai devāḥ suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 2 tṝ ‘manyanta

Sentence: 3 manuṣyā no ‘nvābhaviṣyantīti

Sentence: 4 te samvatsareṇa yopayitvā suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 5 tam ṛṣaya ṛtugrahair evānu prājānan

Sentence: 6 yad ṛtugrahā gṛhyante suvargasya lokasya prajñātyai

Sentence: 7 dvādaśa gṛhyante

Sentence: 8 dvādaśa māsāḥ samvatsaraḥ

Sentence: 9 samvatsarasya prajñātyai

Sentence: 10 saha prathamau gṛhyete sahottamau

Sentence: 11 tasmād dvaudvāv ṛtū

Sentence: 12 ubhayatomukham ṛtupātram bhavati

Sentence: 13 kaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 hi tad veda yata ṛtūnām mukham

Sentence: 2 ṛtunā preṣyeti ṣaṭ kṛtva āha

Sentence: 3 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 4 ṛtūn eva prīṇāti \\

Sentence: 5 ṛtubhir iti catus \\

Sentence: 6 catuṣpada eva paśūn prīṇāti

Sentence: 7 dviḥ punar ṛtunāha

Sentence: 8 dvipada eva prīṇāti \\

Sentence: 9 ṛtunā preṣyeti ṣaṭ kṛtva āhartubhir iti catus

Sentence: 10 tasmāc catuṣpādaḥ paśava ṛtūn upa jīvanti

Sentence: 11 dviḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 punar ṛtunāha

Sentence: 2 tasmād dvipādaś catuṣpadaḥ paśūn upa jīvanti \\

Sentence: 3 ṛtunā preṣyeti ṣaṭ kṛtva āhartubhir iti catur dviḥ punar ṛtunāha \\

Sentence: 4 ākramaṇam eva tat

Sentence: 5 setum yajamānaḥ kurute suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai

Sentence: 6 nānyo’nyam anu pra padyeta

Sentence: 7 yad anyo ‘nam anuprapadyetartur ṛtum anu pra padyetartavo mohukāḥ syuḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 prasiddham evādhvaryur dakṣiṇena pra padyate prasiddham pratiprasthātottareṇa

Sentence: 2 tasmād ādityaḥ ṣaṇ māso dakṣiṇenaiti ṣaḍ uttareṇa \\

Sentence: 3 upayāmagṛhīto ‘si saṁsarpo ‘sy aṁhaspatyāya tvety āha \\

Sentence: 4 asti trayo daśo māsa ity āhus

Sentence: 5 tam eva tat prīṇāti //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 suvargāya vā ete lokāya gṛhyante yad ṛtugrahās \\

Sentence: 2 jyotir indrāgnī

Sentence: 3 yad aindrāgnam ṛtupātreṇa gṛhṇāti jyotir evāsmā upariṣṭād dadhāti

Sentence: 4 suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai \\

Sentence: 5 ojobhṛtau vā etau devānām yad indrāgnī

Sentence: 6 yad aindrāgno gṛhyata oja evāva runddhe

Sentence: 7 vaiśvadevaṁ śukrapātreṇa gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 8 vaiśvadevyo vai prajās \\

Sentence: 9 asāv ādityaḥ śukas \\

Sentence: 10 yad vaiśvadevaṁ śukrapātreṇa gṛhṇāti tasmād asāv ādityaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 sarvāḥ prajāḥ pratyaṅṅ ud eti

Sentence: 2 tasmāt sarva eva manyate

Sentence: 3 mām praty ud agād iti

Sentence: 4 vaiśvadevaṁ śukrapātreṇa gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 5 vaiśvadevyo vai prajās \\

Sentence: 6 tejaḥ śukras \\

Sentence: 7 yad vaiśvadevaṁ śukrapātreṇa gṛhṇāti prajāsv eva tejo dadhāti //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 indro marudbhiḥ sāmvidyena mādhyamdine savane vṛtram ahan

Sentence: 2 yan mādhyamdine savane marutvatīyā gṛhyante vārtraghnā eva te yajamānasya gṛhyante

Sentence: 3 tasya vṛtram jaghnuṣa ṛtavo ‘muhyant sa ṛtupātreṇa marutvatīyān agṛhṇāt

Sentence: 4 tato vai sa ṛtūn prājānāt \\

Sentence: 5 yad ṛtupātreṇa marutvatīyā gṛhyanta ṛtūnām prajñātyai

Sentence: 6 vajram vā etam yajamāno bhrātṛvyāya pra harati yan marutvatīyā ud eva prathamena //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yachati pra harati dvitīyena stṛṇute tṛtīyena \\

Sentence: 2 āyudham vā etad yajamānaḥ saṁs kurute yan marutvatīyā dhanur eva prathamo jyā dvitīya iṣus tṛtīyaḥ

Sentence: 3 praty eva prathamena dhatte vi sṛjati dvitīyena vidhyati tṛtīyena \\

Sentence: 4 indro vṛtraṁ hatvā parām parāvatam agachat \\

Sentence: 5 apārādham iti manyamānaḥ

Sentence: 6 sa harito ‘bhavat

Sentence: 7 sa etān marutvatīyān ātmasparaṇān apaśyat

Sentence: 8 tān agṛhṇīta //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 prāṇam eva prathamenāspṛṇutāpānam dvitīyenātmānam tṛtīyenātmasparaṇā vā ete yajamānasya gṛhyante yan marutvatīyāḥ

Sentence: 2 prāṇam eva prathamena spṛṇute ‘pānam dvitīyenātmānam tṛtīyena \\

Sentence: 3 indro vṛtram ahan

Sentence: 4 tam devā abruvan

Sentence: 5 mahān vā ayam abhūd yo vṛtram avadhīd iti

Sentence: 6 tan mahendrasya mahendratvam \\

Sentence: 7 sa etam mahendram uddhāram ud aharata vṛtraṁ hatvānyāsu devatāsv adhi

Sentence: 8 yan mahendro gṛhyata uddhāram eva tam yajamāna ud dharate ‘nyāsu prajāsv adhi

Sentence: 9 śukrapātreṇa gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 10 yajamānadevatyo vai mahendras tejaḥ śukro yan māhendraṁ śukrapātreṇa gṛhṇāti yajamāna eva tejo dadhāti //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Verse: 2

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 rudram antar āyan \\

Sentence: 3 te dvidevatyān prāpadyanta

Sentence: 5 tasmād api vadhyam prapannam na prati pra yachanti

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 mithunam

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 eṣa vai vivasvān ādityo yad upāṁśusavanaḥ

Sentence: 6 vṛṣṭim evāva runddhe

Sentence: 7 yadi tājak praskanded varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāt \\

Sentence: 8 yadi ciram avarṣukas \\

Sentence: 9 na sādayati \\

Sentence: 10 asannād dhi prajāḥ prajāyante

Sentence: 11 nānu vaṣat karoti

Sentence: 12 yad anuvaṣaṭkuryād rudram prajā anvavasṛjet \\

Sentence: 13 na hutvānv īkṣeta

Sentence: 14 yad anvīkṣeta cakṣur aysa pramāyukaṁ syāt

Sentence: 15 tasmān nānvīkṣyaḥ //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 janayati

Sentence: 2 some somam abhi gṛhṇāti

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prāṇo vā eṣa yad upāṁśus \\

Sentence: 3 prajāpatir vā eṣa yad āgrayaṇaḥ prāṇa upāṁśuḥ patnīḥ prajāḥ pra janayanti

Sentence: 4 yad upāṁśupātreṇa pātnīvatam āgrayaṇād gṛhṇāti prajānām prajananāya

Sentence: 5 tasmāt prāṇam prajā anu pra jāyante

Sentence: 6 devā vā itaitaḥ patnīḥ suvargam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 lokam ajigāṁsan

Sentence: 2 te suvargam lokam na prājānan

Sentence: 3 ta etam pātnīvatam apaśyan

Sentence: 4 tam agṛhṇata

Sentence: 5 tato vai te suvargam lokam prājānan

Sentence: 6 yat pātnīvato gṛhyate suvargasya lokasya prajñātyai

Sentence: 7 sa somo nātiṣṭhata strībhyo gṛhyamāṇas

Sentence: 8 tam ghṛtam vajram kṛtvāghnan

Sentence: 9 tam nirindriyam bhūtam agṛhṇan

Sentence: 10 tasmāt striyo nirindriyā adāyādīr api pāpāt puṁsa upastitaram //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 vadanti

Sentence: 4 iyam vā upayāmas

Sentence: 5 tasmād imām prajā anu pra jāyante

Sentence: 6 bṛhaspatisutasya ta ity āha

Sentence: 7 brahma vai devānām bṛhaspatis \\

Sentence: 9 indo ity āha

Sentence: 10 reto vā indus \\

Sentence: 11 reta eva tad dadhāti \\

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 āha

Sentence: 2 prajā vā indriyam

Sentence: 3 prajā evāsmai pra janayati \\

Sentence: 12 sa patnīḥ prāpadyata

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 vadhyam prapannam na prati pra yachanti

Sentence: 3 na sādayati \\

Sentence: 4 asannād dhi prajāḥ prajāyante

Sentence: 5 nānu vaṣaṭ karoti

Sentence: 6 yad anuvaṣaṭkuryād rudram prajā anvavasṛjet \\

Sentence: 8 upāṁśv anu vaṣaṭ karoti

Sentence: 9 na rudram prajā anvavasṛjati śāntam agnīt somam bhakṣayati \\

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 neṣṭaḥ patnīm udānayety āha \\

Sentence: 2 agnīd eva neṣṭari reto dadhāti neṣṭā patniyām

Sentence: 3 udgātrā sam khyāpayati

Sentence: 4 prajāpatir vā eṣa yad udgātā

Sentence: 5 prajānām prajananāya \\

Sentence: 6 apa upa pra vartayati

Sentence: 7 reta eva tat siñcati \\

Sentence: 8 ūruṇopa pra vartayati \\

Sentence: 9 ūruṇā hi retaḥ sicyate

Sentence: 10 nagnamkriyorum upa pra vartayati

Sentence: 11 yadā hi nagna ūrur bhavaty atha mithunī bhavatas \\

Sentence: 12 atha retaḥ sicyate \\

Sentence: 13 atha prajāḥ pra jāyante //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 indro vṛtram ahan

Sentence: 2 tasya śīrṣakapālam ud aubjat

Sentence: 5 sa hāriyojano ‘bhavat

Sentence: 6 tam vy acikitsat \\

Sentence: 7 juhavānī3 mā hauṣā3m iti

Sentence: 11 so ‘gnir abravīt \\

Sentence: 13 tam dhānābhir aśrīṇāt //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 taṁ śṛtam bhūtam ajuhot

Sentence: 2 yad dhānābhir hāriyojanaṁ śrīṇāti śṛtatvāya

Sentence: 3 śṛtam evainam bhūtam juhoti

Sentence: 4 bahvībhiḥ śrīṇāti \\

Sentence: 5 etāvatīr evāsyāmuṣmiṁ loke kāmadughā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 6 atho khalv āhus \\

Sentence: 7 etā vā indrasya pṛśnayaḥ kāmadughā yad dhāriyojanīr iti

Sentence: 8 tasmād bahvībhiḥ śrīṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 9 ṛksāme vā indrasya harī somapānau

Sentence: 10 tayoḥ paridhaya ādhānam \\

Sentence: 11 yad aprahṛtya paridhīñ juhuyād antarādhānābhyām //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ghāsam pra yachet

Sentence: 2 prahṛtya paridhīñ juhoti nirādhānābhyām eva ghāsam pra yachati \\

Sentence: 3 unnetā juhoti

Sentence: 4 yātayāmeva hy ṝtarhy adhvaryuḥ svagākṛtas \\

Sentence: 5 yad adhvaryur juhuyād yathā vimuktam punar yunakti tādṛg eva tat \\

Sentence: 6 śīrṣann adhinidhāya juhoti

Sentence: 7 śīrṣato hi sa samabhavat \\

Sentence: 8 vikramya juhoti

Sentence: 9 vikramya hīndro vṛtram ahan \\

Sentence: 10 samṛddhyai

Sentence: 11 paśavo vai hāriyojanīs \\

Sentence: 12 yat sambhindyād alpāḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 enam paśavo bhuñjanta upa tiṣṭheran

Sentence: 2 yan na sambhindyād bahava enam paśavo ‘bhuñjanta upa tiṣṭheran

Sentence: 4 ubhayam karoti

Sentence: 5 bahava evainam paśavo bhuñjanta upa tiṣṭhante \\

Sentence: 7 ya eva tatra somapīthas tam evāva rundhate \\

Sentence: 8 uttaravedyām ni vapati

Sentence: 9 paśavo vā uttaravediḥ

Sentence: 10 paśavo hāriyojanīḥ

Sentence: 11 paśuṣv eva paśūn prati ṣṭhāpayanti //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 grahān vā anu prajāḥ paśavaḥ pra jāyante \\

Sentence: 2 upāṁśvantaryāmāv ajāvayaḥ

Sentence: 3 śukrāmanthinau puruṣās \\

Sentence: 4 ṛtugrahān ekaśaphās \\

Sentence: 5 ādityagraham gāvas \\

Sentence: 6 ādityagraho bhūyiṣṭhābhir ṛgbhir gṛhyate

Sentence: 7 tasmād gāvaḥ paśūnām bhūyiṣṭhās \\

Sentence: 8 yat trir upāṁśuṁ hastena vigṛhṇāti

Sentence: 9 tasmād dvau trīn ajā janayaty athāvayo bhūyasīḥ

Sentence: 10 pitā vā eṣa yad āgrayaṇaḥ putraḥ kalaśas \\

Sentence: 11 yad āgrayaṇa upadasyet kalaśād gṛhṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 12 yathā pitā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 putram kṣita upadhāvati tādṛg eva tat \\

Sentence: 2 yat kalaśa upadasyed āgrayaṇād gṛhṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 3 yathā putraḥ pitaram kṣita upadhāvati tādṛg eva tat \\

Sentence: 4 ātmā vā eṣa yajñasya yad āgrayaṇas \\

Sentence: 5 yad graho vā kalaśo vopadasyed āgrayaṇād gṛhṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 6 ātmana evādhi yajñam niṣ karoti \\

Sentence: 7 avijñāto vā eṣa gṛhyate yad āgrayaṇas \\

Sentence: 8 sthālyā gṛhṇāti vāyavyṝna juhoti tasmāt //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 garbheṇāvijñātena brahmahā \\

Sentence: 2 avabhṛtham ava yanti

Sentence: 3 parā sthālīr asyanty ud vāyavyāni haranti

Sentence: 4 tasmāt striyam jātām parāsyanty ut pumāṁsaṁ haranti

Sentence: 5 yatpurorucam āha yathā vasyasa āharati tādṛg eva tat \\

Sentence: 6 yad graham gṛhṇāti yathā vasyasa āhṛtya prāha tādṛg eva tat \\

Sentence: 7 yat sādayati yathā vasyasa upanidhāyāpakrāmati tādṛg eva tat \\

Sentence: 8 yad vai yajñasya sāmnā yajuṣā kriyate śithilam tat \\

Sentence: 9 yad ṛcā tad dṛḍham

Sentence: 10 purastādupayāmā yajuṣā gṛhyanta upariṣṭādupayāmā ṛcā yajñasya dhṛtyai //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prānyāni pātrāṇi yujyante nānyāni

Sentence: 2 yāni parācīnāni prayujyante ‘mum eva tair lokam abhi jayati

Sentence: 3 parāṅ iva hy asau lokas \\

Sentence: 4 yāni punaḥ prayujyanta imam eva tair lokam abhi jayati

Sentence: 5 punaḥpunar iva hy ayam lokaḥ

Sentence: 6 prānyāni pātrāṇi yujyante nānyāni

Sentence: 7 yāni parācīnāni prayujyante tāny anv oṣadhayaḥ parā bhavanti

Sentence: 8 yāni punaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 prayujyante tāny anv oṣadhayaḥ punar ā bhavanti

Sentence: 2 prānyāni pātrāṇi yujyante nānyāni

Sentence: 3 yāni parācīnāni prayujyante tāny anv āraṇyāḥ paśavo ‘raṇyam apa yanti

Sentence: 4 yāni punaḥ prayujyante tāny anv grāmyāḥ paśavo grāmam upāvayanti

Sentence: 5 yo vai grahāṇām nidānam veda nidānavān bhavati \\

Sentence: 6 ājyam ity uktham tad vai grahāṇām nidānam \\

Sentence: 7 yad upāṁśu śaṁsati tat //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 upāṁśvantaryāmayos \\

Sentence: 2 yad uccais tad itareṣām grahāṇām

Sentence: 3 etad vai grahāṇām nidānam \\

Sentence: 4 ya evam veda nidānavān bhavati

Sentence: 5 yo vai grahāṇām mithunam veda pra prajayā paśubhir mithunair jāyate

Sentence: 6 sthālībhir anye grahā gṛhyante vāyavyair anye \\

Sentence: 7 etad vai grahāṇām mithunam \\

Sentence: 8 ya evam veda pra prajayā paśubhir mithunair jāyate \\

Sentence: 9 indras tvaṣṭuḥ somam abhīṣahāpibat

Sentence: 10 sa viṣvaṅ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vy ārchat

Sentence: 2 sa ātmann āramaṇam nāvindat

Sentence: 3 sa etān anusavanam puroḍāśān apaśyat

Sentence: 4 tān nir avapat

Sentence: 5 tair vai sa ātmann āramaṇam akuruta

Sentence: 6 tasmād anusavanam puroḍāśā nir upyante

Sentence: 7 tasmād anusavanam puroḍāśānām prāśnīyād ātmann evāramaṇam kurute nainaṁ somo ‘ti pavate

Sentence: 8 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 9 narcā na yajuṣā paṅktir āpyate ‘tha kim yajñasya pāṅktatvam iti

Sentence: 10 dhānāḥ karambhaḥ parivāpaḥ puroḍāśaḥ payasyā

Sentence: 11 tena paṅktir āpyate

Sentence: 12 tad yajñasya pāṅktatvam //

## Chapter: 6

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 suvargāya vā etāni lokāya hūyante yad dākṣiṇāni

Sentence: 2 dvābhyām gārhapatye juhoti

Sentence: 4 pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 5 āgnīdhre juhoti \\

Sentence: 9 saurībhyām ṛgbhyām gārhapatye juhoti \\

Sentence: 10 amum evainam lokaṁ samārohayati

Sentence: 11 nayavatyarcāgnīdhre juhoti

Sentence: 12 suvargasya lokasyābhinītyai

Sentence: 13 divam gacha suvaḥ pateti hiraṇyam //

Verse: 2

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 aiti somacyutam ity āha

Sentence: 6 satyam vā ṛtam \\

Sentence: 8 yajñasya pathā suvitā nayantīr ity āha

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ṛṣim ārṣeyam ity āha \\

Sentence: 3 tasmād evam āha

Sentence: 4 vi suvaḥ paśya vy antarikṣam ity āha

Sentence: 5 suvargam evainam lokam gamayati

Sentence: 6 yatasva sadasyair ity āha

Sentence: 8 asmaddātrā devatrā gachata madhumatīḥ pra dātāram ā viśatety āha

Sentence: 9 vayam iha pradātāraḥ smo ‘smān amutra madhumatīr ā viśateti //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 vāvaitad āha

Sentence: 2 hiraṇyam dadāti

Sentence: 3 otir vai hiraṇyam \\

Sentence: 4 jyotir eva purastād dhatte

Sentence: 5 suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai \\

Sentence: 6 agnīdhe dadāti \\

Sentence: 7 agnimukhān evartūn prīṇāti

Sentence: 8 brahmaṇe dadāti

Sentence: 9 prasūtyai

Sentence: 11 ātmā vā eṣa yajñasya yad dhotā \\

Sentence: 12 ātmānam eva yajñasya dakṣiṇābhiḥ sam ardhayati //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 samiṣṭayajūṁṣi juhoti

Sentence: 2 yajñasya samiṣṭyai

Sentence: 3 yad vai yajñasya krūram yad viliṣṭam yad atyeti yan nātyeti yad atikaroti yan nāpi karoti tad eva taiḥ prīṇāti

Sentence: 4 nava juhoti

Sentence: 5 nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ

Sentence: 6 puruṣeṇa yajñaḥ sammitas \\

Sentence: 7 yāvān eva yajñas tam prīṇāti

Sentence: 8 ṣaḍ ṛgmiyāṇi juhoti

Sentence: 9 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 10 ṛtūn eva prīṇāti

Sentence: 11 trīṇi yajūṁṣi //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 traya ime lokās \\

Sentence: 2 imān eva lokān prīṇāti

Sentence: 3 yajña yajñam gacha yajñapatim gachety āha

Sentence: 4 yajñapatim evainam gamayati

Sentence: 5 svām yonim gachety āha

Sentence: 6 svām evainam yonim gamayati \\

Sentence: 7 ṣa te yajño yajñapate sahasūktavākaḥ suvīra ity āha

Sentence: 8 yajamāma eva vīryam dadhāti

Sentence: 9 vāsiṣṭho ha sātyahavyo devabhāgam papracha

Sentence: 10 yat sṛñjayān bahuyājino ‘yīyajo yajñe //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 yajñam praty atiṣṭhipā3 yajñapatā3v iti

Sentence: 2 sa hovāca

Sentence: 3 yajñapatāv iti

Sentence: 4 satyād vai sṛñjayāḥ parā babhūvur iti hovāca yajñe vāva yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhāpya āsīd yajamānasyāparābhāvāyeti

Sentence: 5 devā gātuvido gātum vittvā gātum itety āha

Sentence: 6 yajña eva yajñam prati ṣṭhāpayati

Sentence: 7 yajamānasyāparābhāvāya //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 avabhṛthayajūṁṣi juhoti

Sentence: 2 yad evārvācīnam ekahāyanād enaḥ karoti tad eva tair ava yajate \\

Sentence: 3 apo ‘vabhṛtham avaiti \\

Sentence: 4 apsu vai varuṇaḥ

Sentence: 5 sākṣād eva varuṇam ava yajate

Sentence: 6 vartmanā vā anvitya yajñaṁ rakṣāṁsi jighāṁsanti

Sentence: 7 sāmnā prastotānvavaiti

Sentence: 8 sāma vai rakṣohā

Sentence: 9 rakṣasām apahatyai

Sentence: 10 trir nidhanam upaiti

Sentence: 11 traya ime lokās \\

Sentence: 12 ebhya eva lokebhyo rakṣāṁsi //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 apa hanti

Sentence: 2 puruṣaḥpuruṣo nidhanam upaiti

Sentence: 3 puruṣaḥpuruṣo hi rakṣasvī

Sentence: 4 rakṣasām apahatyai \\

Sentence: 5 uruṁ hi rājā varuṇaś cakārety āha

Sentence: 6 pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 7 śatam te rājan bhiṣajaḥ sahasram ity āha

Sentence: 8 bheṣajam evāsmai karoti \\

Sentence: 9 abhiṣṭhito varuṇasya pāśa ity āha

Sentence: 10 varuṇapāśam evābhi tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 11 barhir abhi juhoti \\

Sentence: 12 āhutīnām pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 13 atho agnivaty eva juhoti \\

Sentence: 14 apabarhiṣaḥ prayājān //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 yajati

Sentence: 2 prajā vai barhiḥ

Sentence: 3 prajā eva varuṇapāśān muñcati \\

Sentence: 4 ājyabhāgau yajati

Sentence: 5 yajñasyaiva cakṣuṣī nāntar eti

Sentence: 6 varuṇam yajati

Sentence: 7 varuṇapāśād evainam muñcati \\

Sentence: 8 agnīvaruṇau yajati

Sentence: 9 sākṣād evainam varuṇapāśān muñcati \\

Sentence: 10 apabarhiṣāv anūyajau yajati

Sentence: 11 prajā vai barhiḥ

Sentence: 12 prajā eva varuṇapāśān muñcati

Sentence: 13 caturaḥ prayājān yajati dvāv anūyājau

Sentence: 14 ṣaṭ sam padyante

Sentence: 15 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ṛtuṣv eva prati tiṣṭhati \\

Sentence: 2 avabhṛtha nicaṅkuṇety āha

Sentence: 3 yathoditam eva varuṇam ava yajate

Sentence: 4 samudre te hṛdayam apsv antar ity āha

Sentence: 5 samudrehy antar varuṇaḥ

Sentence: 6 sam tvā viśantv oṣadhīr utāpa ity āha \\

Sentence: 7 adbhir evainam oṣadhībhiḥ samyañcam dadhāti

Sentence: 8 devīr āpa eṣa vo garbha ity āha

Sentence: 9 yathāyajur evaitat

Sentence: 10 paśavo vai //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 somas \\

Sentence: 2 yad bhindūnām bhakṣayet paśumānt syād varuṇas tv ṝnam gṛhṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 3 yan na bhakṣayed apaśuḥ syān nainam varuṇo gṛhṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 4 upaspṛśyam eva paśumān bhavati nainam varuṇo gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 5 pratiyuto varuṇasya pāśa ity āha

Sentence: 6 varuṇapāśād eva nir mucyate \\

Sentence: 7 apratīkṣam ā yanti varuṇasyāntarhityai \\

Sentence: 8 edho ‘sy edhiṣīmahīty āha

Sentence: 9 samidhaivāgnim namasyanta upāyanti

Sentence: 10 tejo ‘si tejo mayi dhehīty āha

Sentence: 11 teja evātman dhatte //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 sphyena vedim ud dhanti rathākṣeṇa vi mimīte yūpam minoti trivṛtam eva vajraṁ sambhṛtya bhrātṛvyāya pra harati stṛtyai

Sentence: 2 yad antarvedi minuyād devalokam abhi jayed yad bahirvedi manuṣyalokam vedyantasya samdhau minoty ubhayor lokayor abhijityai \\

Sentence: 3 uparasammitām minuyāt pitṛlokakāmasya raśanasammitām manuṣyalokakāmasya caṣālasammitām indriyakāmasya sarvānt samān pratiṣṭhākāmasya ye trayo madhyamās tānt samān paśukāmasyaitān vai //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 anu paśava upa tiṣṭhante paśumān eva bhavati

Sentence: 2 vyatiṣajed itarān prajayaivainam paśubhir vyatiṣajati

Sentence: 3 yam kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād iti gartamitam tasya minuyād uttarārdhyam varṣiṣṭham atha hrasīyāṁsam eṣā vai gartamid yasyaivam minoti tājak pra mīyate

Sentence: 4 dakṣiṇārdhyam varṣiṣṭham minuyāt suvargakāmasyātha hrasīyāṁsam ākramaṇam eva tat setum yajamānaḥ kurute suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 yad ekasmin yūpe dve raśane parivyayati tasmād eko dve jāye vindate yan naikāṁ raśanām dvayor yūpayoḥ parivyayati tasmān naikā dvau patī vindate

Sentence: 2 yam kāmayeta stry asya jāyetety upānte tasya vyatiṣajet stry ṝvāsya jāyate

Sentence: 3 yam kāmayeta pumān asya jāyetety āntam tasya pra veṣṭayet pumān evāsya //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 jāyate \\

Sentence: 2 asurā vai devān dakṣiṇata upānayan tān devā upaśayenaivāpānudanta tad upaśayasyopaśayatvam yad dakṣiṇata upaśaya upaśaye bhrātṛvyāpanuttyai

Sentence: 3 sarve vā anye yūpāḥ paśumanto ‘thopaśaya evāpaśus tasya yajamānaḥ paśur yan na nirdiśed ārtim ārched yajamāno ‘sau te paśur iti nir diśed yam dviṣyād yam eva //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 dveṣṭi tam asmai paśum nir diśati

Sentence: 2 yadi na dviṣyād ākhus te paśur iti brūyān na grāmyān paśūn hinasti nāraṇyān

Sentence: 3 prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata so ‘nnādyena vy ārdhyata sa etām ekādaśinīm apaśyat tayā vai so ‘nnādyam avārunddha yad daśa yūpā bhavanti daśākṣarā virāḍ annam virāḍ virājaivānnādyam ava runddhe //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 ya ekādaśa stana evāsyai sa duha evainām tena

Sentence: 2 vajro vā eṣā sam mīyate yad ekādaśinī seśvarā purastāt pratyañcam yajñaṁ sammarditor yat pātnīvatam minoti yajñasya praty uttabdhyai sayatvāya //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata sa riricāno ‘manyata sa etām ekādaśinīm apaśyat tayā vai sa āyur indriyam vīryam ātmann adhatta prajā iva khalu vā eṣa sṛjate yo yajate sa etarhi riricāna iva yad eṣaikādaśinī bhavaty āyur eva tayendriyam vīryam yajamāna atman dhatte

Sentence: 2 praivāgneyena vāpayati mithunaṁ sārasvatyā karoti retaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 saumyena dadhāti pra janayati pauṣṇena bārhaspatyo bhavati brahma vai devānām bṛhaspatir brahmaṇaivāsmai prajāḥ pra janayati vaiśvadevo bhavati vaiśvadevyo vai prajāḥ prajā evāsmai pra janayatīndriyam evaindreṇāvarunddhe viśam mārutenaujo balam aindrāgnena prasavāya sāvitro nirvaruṇatvāya vāruṇas \\

Sentence: 2 madhyata aindram ā labhate madhyata evendriyam yajamāne dadhāti //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 purastād aindrasya vaiśvadevam ālabhate vaiśvadevam vā annam annam eva purastād dhatte tasmāt purastād annam adyata aindram ālabhya mārutam ā labhate viḍ vai maruto viśam evāsmā anu badhnāti

Sentence: 2 yadi kāmayeta yo ‘vagataḥ so ‘pa rudhyatām yo ‘paruddhaḥ so ‘va gachatv ity aindrasya loke vāruṇam ā labheta vāruṇasya loka aindram //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 ya evāvagataḥ so ‘pa rudhyate yo ‘paruddhaḥ so ‘va gachati

Sentence: 2 yadi kāmayeta prajā muhyeyur iti paśūn vyatiṣajet prajā eva mohayati

Sentence: 3 yad abhivāhato ‘pām vāruṇam ālabheta prajā varuṇo gṛhṇīyād dakṣiṇata udañcam ā labhate ‘pavāhato ‘pām prajānām avaruṇagrāhāya //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 indraḥ patniyā manum ayājayat tām paryagnikṛtām ud asṛjat tayā manur ārdhnod yat paryagnikṛtam pātnīvatam utsṛjati yām eva manur ṛddhim ārdhnot tām eva yajamāna ṛdhnoti

Sentence: 2 yajñasya vā apratiṣṭhitād yajñaḥ parā bhavati yajñam parābhavantam yajamāno ‘nu parā bhavati yad ājyeṇa pātnīvataṁ saṁsthāpayati yajñasya pratiṣṭhityai yajñam pratitiṣṭhantam yajamāno ‘nu prati tiṣṭhati \\

Sentence: 3 iṣṭam vapayā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 bhavati aniṣṭam vaśayātha pātnīvatena pra carati tīrtha eva pra caraty atho etarhy evāsya yāmas

Sentence: 2 tvāṣṭro bhavati tvaṣṭā vai retasaḥ siktasya rūpāṇi vi karoti tam eva vṛṣāṇam patnīṣv api sṛjati so ‘smai rūpāṇi vi karoti //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ghnanati vā etat somam yad abhiṣuṇvanti

Sentence: 2 yat saumyo bhavati yathā mṛtāyānustaraṇīm ghnanti tādṛg eva tat \\

Sentence: 3 yad uttarārdhe vā madhye vā juhuyāt devatābhyaḥ samadam dadhyād dakṣiṇārdhe juhoty eṣā vai pitṛṇām dik svāyām eva diśi pitṝn niravadayate \\

Sentence: 4 udgātṛbhyo haranti sāmadavatyo vai saumyo yad eva sāmnaś chambaṭkurvanti tasyaiva sa śāntis \\

Sentence: 5 ava //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 īkṣante pavitram vai saumya ātmānam eva pavayante

Sentence: 2 ya ātmānam na paripaśyed itāsuḥ syād abhidadim kṛtvāvekṣeta tasmin hy ātmānam paripaśyaty atho ātmānam eva pavayate

Sentence: 3 yo gatamanāḥ syāt so ‘vekṣeta yan me manaḥ parāgatam yad vā me aparāgatam / rājñā somena tad vayam asmāsu dhārayāmasīti mana evātman dādhāra //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 na gatamanā bhavati \\

Sentence: 2 apa vai tṛtīyasavane yajñaḥ krāmatījānād anījānam abhy āgnāvaiṣṇavyarcā ghṛtasya yajaty agniḥ sarvā devatā viṣṇur yajño devatāś caiva yajñam ca dādhāra \\

Sentence: 3 upāṁśu yajati mithunatvāya

Sentence: 4 brahmavādino vadanti mitro yajñasya svṅṣṭam yuvate varuṇo duriṣṭam kva tarhi yajñaḥ kva yajamāno bhavatīti yan maitrāvaruṇīm vaśām ālabhate mitreṇaiva //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 yajñasya svṅṣṭaṁ śamayati varuṇena duriṣṭam nārtim ārchati yajamānas \\

Sentence: 2 yathā vai lāṅgaleno ‘rvarām prabhindanty evam ṛksāme yajñam pra bhintto yan maitrāvaruṇīm vaśām ālabhate yajñāyaiva prabhinnāya matyam anvavāsyati śāntyai

Sentence: 3 yātayāmāni vā etasya chandāṁsi ya ījānaś chandasām eṣa raso yad vaśā yan maitrāvaruṇīm vaśām ālabhate chandāṁsy eva punar ā prīṇāty ayātayāmatvāyātho chandaḥsv eva rasam dadhāti //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 devā vā indriyam vīryam vy abhajanta

Sentence: 2 tato yad atyaśiṣyata tad atigrāhyā abhavan

Sentence: 3 tad atigrāhyāṇām atigrāhyatvam \\

Sentence: 4 yad atigrāhyā gṛhyanta indriyam eva tad vīryam yajamāna ātman dhatte

Sentence: 5 teja āgneyenendriyam aindreṇa brahmavarcasaṁ sauryeṇa \\

Sentence: 6 upastambhanam vā etad yajñasya yad atigrāhyāś cakre pṛṣṭhāni

Sentence: 7 yat pṛṣṭhye na gṛhṇīyāt prāñcam yajñam pṛṣṭhāni saṁ śṛṇīyus \\

Sentence: 8 yad ukthyṝ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 gṛhṇīyāt pratyañcam yajñam atigrāhyāḥ saṁ śṛṇīyus \\

Sentence: 2 viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe grahītavyā yajñasya savīryatvāya

Sentence: 3 prajāpatir devebhyo yajñān vyādiśat

Sentence: 4 sa priyās tanūr apa ny adhatta

Sentence: 5 tad atigrāhyā abhavan

Sentence: 6 vitanus tasya yajña ity āhur yasyātigrāhyā na gṛhyanta iti \\

Sentence: 7 apy agniṣṭome grāhītavyā yajñasya satanutvāya

Sentence: 8 devatā vai sarvāḥ sadṛśīr āsan

Sentence: 9 tā na vyāvṛtam agachan

Sentence: 10 te devāḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 eta etān grahān apaśyan

Sentence: 2 tān agṛhṇata \\

Sentence: 3 āgneyam agnir aindram indraḥ sauryaṁ sūryas

Sentence: 4 tato vai tṝ ‘nyābhir devatābhir vyāvṛtam agachan

Sentence: 5 yasyaivam viduṣa ete grahā gṛhyante vyāvṛtam eva pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇa gachati \\

Sentence: 6 ime lokā jyotiṣmantaḥ samāvadvīryāḥ kāryā ity āhus \\

Sentence: 7 āgneyenāsmiṁ loke jyotir dhatta aindreṇāntarikṣe \\

Sentence: 8 indravāyū hi sayujau

Sentence: 9 sauryeṇāmuṣmiṁ loke //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 jyotir dhatte

Sentence: 2 jyotiṣmanto ‘smā ime lokā bhavanti samāvadvīryān enān kurute \\

Sentence: 3 etān vai grahān bambāviśvavayasāv avittām \\

Sentence: 4 tābhyām ime lokāḥ parāñcaś cārvāñcaś ca prābhus \\

Sentence: 5 yasyaivam viduṣa ete grahā gṛhyante prāsmā ime lokāḥ parāñcaś cārvāñcaś ca bhānti //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 devā vai yad yajñe ‘kurvata tad asurā akurvata

Sentence: 2 te devā adābhye chandāṁsi savanāni sam asthāpayan

Sentence: 3 tato devā abhavan parāsurās \\

Sentence: 4 yasyaivam viduṣo ‘dābhyo gṛhyate bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati

Sentence: 5 yad vai devā asurān adābhyenādabhnuvan tad adābhyasyādābhyatvam \\

Sentence: 6 ya evam veda dabhnoty eva bhrātṛvyam nainam bhrātṛvyo dabhnoti //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 eṣā vai prajāpater atimokṣiṇī nāma tanūr yad adābhyas \\

Sentence: 2 upanaddhasya gṛhṇāty atimuktyai \\

Sentence: 3 ati pāpmānam bhrātṛvyam mucyate ya evam veda

Sentence: 4 ghnanti vā etat somam yad abhiṣuṇvanti

Sentence: 5 some hanyamāne yajño hanyate yajñe yajamānas \\

Sentence: 6 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 7 kim tad yajñe yajamānaḥ kurute yena jīvant suvargam lokam etīti

Sentence: 8 jīvagaho vā eṣa yad adābhyas \\

Sentence: 9 anabhiṣutasya gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 10 jīvantam evainaṁ suvargam lokam gamayati

Sentence: 11 vi vā etad yajñam chindanti yad adābhye saṁsthāpayanti \\

Sentence: 12 aṁśūn api sṛjati yajñasya samtatyai //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 devā vai prabāhug grahān agṛhṇata

Sentence: 2 sa etam prajāpatir aṁśum apaśyat

Sentence: 3 tam agṛhṇīta

Sentence: 4 tena vai sa ārdhnot \\

Sentence: 5 yasyaivam viduṣo ‘ṁśur gṛhyata ṛdhnoty eva

Sentence: 6 sakṛdabhiṣutasya gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 7 sakṛd dhi sa tenārdhnot \\

Sentence: 8 manasā gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 9 mana iva hi prajāpatiḥ

Sentence: 10 prajāpater āptyai \\

Sentence: 11 audumbareṇa gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 12 ūrg vā udumbaras \\

Sentence: 13 ūrjam evāva runddhe

Sentence: 14 catuḥsrakti bhavati

Sentence: 15 dikṣu //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 eva prati tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 2 yo vā aṁśor āyatanam vedāyatanavān bhavati

Sentence: 3 vāmadevyam iti sāma tad vā asyāyatanam manasā gāyamāno gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 4 āyatanavān eva bhavati

Sentence: 5 yad adhvaryur aṁśum gṛhṇan nārdhayed ubhābhyām nardhyetādhvaryave ca yajamānāya ca

Sentence: 6 yad ardhayed ubhābhyām ṛdhyeta \\

Sentence: 7 anavānam gṛhṇāti saivāsyarddhis \\

Sentence: 8 hiraṇyam abhi vy aniti \\

Sentence: 9 amṛtam vai hiraṇyam āyuḥ prāṇa āyuṣaivāmṛtam abhi dhinoti

Sentence: 10 śatamānam bhavati

Sentence: 11 śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyas \\

Sentence: 12 āyuṣy evendriye prati tiṣṭhati //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatir devebhyo yajñān vyādiśat

Sentence: 2 sa riricāno ‘manyata

Sentence: 3 sa yajñānāṁ ṣoḍaśadhendriyam vīryam ātmānam abhi sam akkhidat

Sentence: 4 tat ṣoḍaśy abhavat

Sentence: 5 na vai ṣoḍaśī nāma yajño ‘sti

Sentence: 6 yad vāva ṣoḍaśaṁ stotraṁ ṣoḍaśaṁ śastram tena ṣoḍaśī

Sentence: 7 tat ṣoḍaśinaḥ ṣoḍaśitvam \\

Sentence: 8 yat ṣoḍaśī gṛhyata indriyam eva tad vīryam yajamāna ātman dhatte

Sentence: 9 devebhyo vai suvargo lokaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 na prābhavat

Sentence: 2 ta etaṁ ṣoḍaśinam apaśyan

Sentence: 3 tam agṛhṇata

Sentence: 4 tato vai tebhyaḥ suvargo lokaḥ prābhavat \\

Sentence: 5 yat ṣoḍaśī gṛhyate suvargasya lokasyābhijityai \\

Sentence: 6 indro vai devānām ānujāvara āsīt

Sentence: 7 sa prajāpatim upādhāvat

Sentence: 8 tasmā etaṁ ṣoḍaśinam prāyachat

Sentence: 9 tam agṛhṇīta

Sentence: 10 tato vai so ‘gram devatānām pary ait \\

Sentence: 11 yasyaivam viduṣaḥ ṣoḍaśī gṛhyate //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 agram eva samānānām pary eti

Sentence: 2 prātaḥsavane gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 3 vajro vai ṣoḍaśī

Sentence: 4 vajraḥ prātaḥsavanam \\

Sentence: 5 svād evainam yoner ni gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 6 savanesavane ‘bhi gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 7 savanātsavanād evainam pra janayati

Sentence: 8 tṛtīyasavane paśukāmasya gṛhṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 9 vajro vai ṣoḍaśī paśavas tṛtīyasavanam \\

Sentence: 10 vajreṇaivāsmai tṛtīyasavanāt paśūn ava runddhe

Sentence: 11 nokthyṝ gṛhṇīyāt

Sentence: 12 prajā vai paśava ukthāni

Sentence: 13 yad ukthyṝ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 gṛhṇīyāt prajām paśūn asya nir dahet \\

Sentence: 2 atirātre paśukāmasya gṛhṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 3 vajro vai ṣoḍaśī

Sentence: 4 vajreṇaivāsmai paśūn avarudhya rātriyopariṣṭāc chamayati \\

Sentence: 5 apy agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyat \\

Sentence: 6 vyāvṛtkāmo hi rājanyo yajate

Sentence: 7 sāhna evāsmai vajram gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 8 sa enam vajro bhūtyā inddhe nir vā dahati \\

Sentence: 9 ekaviṁśaṁ stotram bhavati pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 10 harivac chasyate \\

Sentence: 11 indrasya priyam dhāma //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 upāpnoti

Sentence: 2 kanīyāṁsi vai deveṣu chandāṁsy āsañ jyāyāṁsy asureṣu

Sentence: 3 te devāḥ kanīyasā chandasā jyāyaś chando ‘bhi vy aśaṁsan

Sentence: 4 tato vai te ‘surāṇām lokam avṛñjata

Sentence: 5 yat kanīyasā chandasā jyāyaś chando ‘bhi viśaṁsati bhrātṛvyasyaiva tal lokam vṛṅkte

Sentence: 6 ṣaḍ akṣarāṇy ati recayanti

Sentence: 7 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 8 ṛtūn eva prīṇāti

Sentence: 9 catvāri pūrvāṇy ava kalpayanti //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 catuṣpada eva paśūn ava runddhe dve uttare dvipada evāva runddhe \\

Sentence: 2 anuṣṭubham abhi sam pādayanti

Sentence: 3 vāg vā { anuṣṭup ^ anuṣṭubh }

Sentence: 4 tasmāt prāṇānām vāg uttamā

Sentence: 5 samayāviṣite sūrye ṣoḍaśina stotram upākaroti \\

Sentence: 6 etasmin vai loka indro vṛtram ahan \\

Sentence: 7 sākṣād eva vajram bhrātṛvyāya pra harati \\

Sentence: 8 aruṇapiśamgo ‘śvo dakṣiṇā \\

Sentence: 9 tad vai vajrasya rūpam \\

Sentence: 10 samṛddhyai //

## Book: 7

## Chapter: 1

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajananam jyotir agnir devatānām jyotir virāṭ chandasām jhotis \\

Sentence: 2 virāḍ vāco ‘gnau sam tiṣṭhate

Sentence: 3 virājam abhi sam padyate

Sentence: 4 tasmāt taj jyotir ucyate

Sentence: 5 dvau stomau prātaḥsavanam vahato yathā prāṇaś cāpānaś ca

Sentence: 6 dvau mādhyamdinaṁ savanam yathā cakṣuś ca śrotram ca

Sentence: 7 dvau tṛtīyasavanam yathā vāk ca pratiṣṭhā ca

Sentence: 8 puruṣasammito vā eṣa yajño ‘sthūriḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yam kāmam kāmayate tam etenābhy aśnute

Sentence: 2 sarvaṁ hy asthuriṇābhyaśnute \\

Sentence: 3 agniṣṭomena vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata

Sentence: 4 tā agniṣṭomenaiva pary agṛhṇāt

Sentence: 5 tāsām parigṛhītānām aśvataro ‘ty apravata

Sentence: 6 tasyānuhāya reta ādatta

Sentence: 7 tad gardabhe ny { amārṭ ^ amārj }

Sentence: 8 tāsām parigṛhītānām aśvataro ‘ty apravata

Sentence: 9 tasyānuhāya reta ādatta

Sentence: 10 tad gardabhe ny { amārṭ ^ amārj }

Sentence: 11 tasmād gardabho dviretās \\

Sentence: 12 atho āhus \\

Sentence: 13 vaḍabāyām ny amārḍ iti

Sentence: 14 tasmād vaḍabā dviretās \\

Sentence: 15 atho āhus \\

Sentence: 16 oṣadhīṣu //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ny amārḍ iti

Sentence: 2 tasmād oṣadhayo ‘nabhyaktā rebhanti \\

Sentence: 3 atho āhuḥ

Sentence: 4 prajāsu ny amārḍ iti

Sentence: 5 tasmād yamau jāyete

Sentence: 6 tasmād aśvataro na pra jāyata āttaretā hi

Sentence: 7 tasmād barhiṣy anavakḷptaḥ

Sentence: 8 sarvavedase vā sahasre vāvakḷptas \\

Sentence: 9 ati hy apravata

Sentence: 10 ya evam vidvān agniṣṭomena yajate prājātāḥ prajā janayati pari prajātā gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 11 tasmād āhus \\

Sentence: 12 jyeṣṭhayajña iti //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 prajāpatir vāva jyeṣṭhaḥ

Sentence: 2 sa hy ṝtenāgre ‘yajata

Sentence: 3 prajāpatir akāmayata

Sentence: 4 pra jāyeyeti

Sentence: 5 sa mukhatas trivṛtam nir amimīta

Sentence: 6 tam agnir devatānv asṛjyata gāyatrī chando rathamtaraṁ sāma brāhmaṇo manuṣyāṇām ajaḥ paśūnām \\

Sentence: 7 tasmāt te mukhyās \\

Sentence: 8 mukhato hy asṛjyanta \\

Sentence: 9 uraso bāhubhyām pañcadaśam nir amimīta

Sentence: 10 tam indro devatānv asṛjyata triṣṭup chando bṛhat //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 sāma rājanyo manuṣyāṇām aviḥ paśūnām \\

Sentence: 2 tasmāt te vīryāvantas \\

Sentence: 3 vīryād dhy asṛjyanta

Sentence: 4 madhyataḥ saptadaśam nir amimīta

Sentence: 5 tam viśve devā devatā anv asṛjyanta jagatī chando vairūpaṁ sāma vaiśyo manuṣyāṇām gāvaḥ paśūnām \\

Sentence: 6 tasmāt ta ādyās \\

Sentence: 7 annadhānād dhy asṛjyanta

Sentence: 8 tasmād bhūyāṁso ‘nyebhyas \\

Sentence: 9 bhūyiṣṭhā hi devatā anv asṛjyanta

Sentence: 10 patta ekaviṁśam nir amimīta

Sentence: 11 tam anuṣṭup chandaḥ //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 anv asṛjyata vairājaṁ sāma śūdro manuṣyāṇām

Sentence: 2 aśvaḥ paśūnām \\

Sentence: 3 tasmāt tau bhūtasamkrāmiṇāv aśvaś ca śūdraś ca

Sentence: 4 tasmāc chūdro yajñe ‘navakḷptas \\

Sentence: 5 na hi devatā anv asṛjyata

Sentence: 6 tasmāt pādāv upa jīvataḥ

Sentence: 7 patto hy asṛjyetām

Sentence: 8 prāṇā vai trivṛt \\

Sentence: 9 ardhamāsāḥ pañcadaśaḥ

Sentence: 10 prajāpatiḥ saptadaśas

Sentence: 11 traya ime lokās \\

Sentence: 12 asāv āditya ekaviṁśas \\

Sentence: 13 etasmin vā ete śritā etasmin pratiṣṭhitās \\

Sentence: 14 ya evam vedaitasminn eva śrayata etasmin prati tiṣṭhati //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prātaḥsavane vai gāyatreṇa chandasā tṛvṛte stomāya jyotir dadhad eti

Sentence: 2 trivṛtā brahmavarcasena pañcadaśāya jyotir dadhad eti

Sentence: 3 pañcadaśenaujasā vīryṝṇa saptadaśāya jyotir dadhad eti

Sentence: 4 saptadaśena prājāpatyena prajananenaikaviṁśāya jyotir dadhad eti

Sentence: 5 stoma eva tat stomāya jyotir dadhad eti \\

Sentence: 6 atho stoma eva stomam abhi pra ṇayati

Sentence: 7 yāvanto vai stomās tāvantaḥ kāmās

Sentence: 8 tāvanto lokās

Sentence: 9 tāvanti jyotīṁṣi \\

Sentence: 10 etāvata eva stomān etāvataḥ kāmān etāvato lokān etāvanti jyotīṁṣy ava runddhe //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 2 sa tvai yajeta yo ‘gniṣṭomena yajamāno ‘tha sarvastomena yajeteti

Sentence: 3 yasya trivṛtam antaryanti prāṇāṁs tasyāntaryanti

Sentence: 4 prāṇeṣu me ‘py asad iti khalu vai yajñena yajamāno yajate

Sentence: 5 yasya pañcadaśam antaryanti vīryam tasyāntar yanti

Sentence: 6 vīryṝ me ‘py asad iti khalu vai yajñena yajamāno yajate

Sentence: 7 yasya saptadaśam antaryanti //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 prajām tasyāntar yanti

Sentence: 2 prajāyām me ‘py asad iti khalu vai yajñena yajamāno yajate

Sentence: 3 yasyaikaviṁśam antaryanti pratiṣṭhām tasyāntar yanti

Sentence: 4 pratiṣṭhāyām me ‘py asad iti khalu vai yajñena yajamāno yajate

Sentence: 5 yasya triṇavam antaryanty ṛtūṁś ca tasya nakṣatriyām ca virājam antar yanti \\

Sentence: 6 ṛtuṣu me ‘py asan nakṣatriyāyām ca virājīti //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 khalu vai yajñena yajamāno yajate

Sentence: 2 yasya trayastriṁśam antaryanti devatās tasyāntar yanti

Sentence: 3 devatāsu me ‘py asad iti khalu vai yajñena yajamāno yajate

Sentence: 4 yo vai stomānām avamam paramatām gachantam veda paramatām eva gachati

Sentence: 5 trivṛd vai stomānām avamas trivṛt paramas

Sentence: 6 ya evam veda paramatām eva gachati //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 aṅgiraso vai sattram āsata

Sentence: 2 te suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 3 teṣāṁ haviṣmāṁś ca haviṣkṛc cāhīyetām \\

Sentence: 4 tāv akāmayetām \\

Sentence: 5 suvargam lokam iyāveti

Sentence: 6 tāv etam dvirātram apaśyatām \\

Sentence: 7 tam āharatām \\

Sentence: 8 tenāyajetām \\

Sentence: 9 tato vai tau ‘suvargam lokam aitām \\

Sentence: 10 ya evam vidvān dvirātreṇa yajate suvargam eva lokam eti

Sentence: 11 tāv aitām pūrveṇāhnāgachatām uttareṇa //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 abhiplavaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati gatir uttaram

Sentence: 2 jyotiṣṭomo ‘gniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati tejas tenāva runddhe

Sentence: 3 sarvastomo ‘tirātra uttaraṁ sarvasyāptyai sarvasyāvaruddhyai

Sentence: 4 gāyatram pūrvehant sāma bhavati

Sentence: 5 tejo vai gāyatrī

Sentence: 6 gāyatrī brahmavarcasam \\

Sentence: 7 teja eva brahmavarcasam ātman dhatte

Sentence: 8 traiṣṭubham uttare \\

Sentence: 9 ojo vai vīryam { triṣṭug ^ briṣṭubh }

Sentence: 10 oja eva vīryam ātman dhatte

Sentence: 11 rathamtaram pūrve //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ahant sāma bhavati \\

Sentence: 2 iyam vai rathamtaram

Sentence: 3 asyām eva prati tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 4 bṛhad uttare \\

Sentence: 5 asau vai bṛhat \\

Sentence: 6 amuṣyām eva prati tiṣṭhati

Sentence: 7 tad āhuḥ

Sentence: 8 kva jagatī cānuṣṭup ceti

Sentence: 9 vaikhānasam pūrve ‘hant sāma bhavati tena jagatyai naiti

Sentence: 10 ṣoḍaśy uttare tenānuṣṭubhas \\

Sentence: 11 athāhus \\

Sentence: 12 yat samānṝ ‘rdhamāse syātām anyatarasyāhno vīryam anu padyeteti \\

Sentence: 13 amāvāyāyām pūrvam ahar bhavaty uttarasminn uttaram \\

Sentence: 14 nānaivārdhamāsayor bhavatas \\

Sentence: 15 nānāvīrye bhavatas \\

Sentence: 16 haviṣmannidhanam pūrvam ahar bhavati haviṣkṛnnidhanam uttaram

Sentence: 17 pratiṣṭhityai //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 āpo vā idam agre salilam āsīt

Sentence: 2 tasmin prajāpatir vāyur bhūtvācarat

Sentence: 3 sa imām apaśyat

Sentence: 4 tām varāho bhūtvāharat

Sentence: 5 tām viśvakarmā bhūtvā vy { amārṭ ^ amārj }

Sentence: 6 sāprathata

Sentence: 7 sā pṛthivy abhavat

Sentence: 8 tat pṛthivyai pṛthivitvam \\

Sentence: 9 tasyām aśrāmyat prajāpatiḥ

Sentence: 10 sa devān asṛjata vasūn rudrān ādityān

Sentence: 11 te devāḥ prajāptim abruvan

Sentence: 12 pra jāyāmahā iti

Sentence: 13 so ‘bravīt //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yathāham yuṣmāṁs tapasāsṛkṣy evam tapasi prajananam ichadhvam iti

Sentence: 2 tebhyo ‘gnim āyatanam prāyachat \\

Sentence: 3 etenāyatanena śrāmyateti

Sentence: 4 tṝ ‘gnināyatanenāśrāmyan

Sentence: 5 te samvatsara ekām gām asṛjanta

Sentence: 6 tām vasubhyo rudrebhya ādityebhyaḥ prāyachan \\

Sentence: 7 etāṁ rakṣadhvam iti

Sentence: 8 tām vasavo rudrā ādityā arakṣanta

Sentence: 9 sā vasubhyo rudrebhya ādityebhyaḥ prājāyata trīṇi ca //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 śatāni trayastriṁśatam ca \\

Sentence: 2 atha saiva sahasratamy abhavat

Sentence: 3 te devāḥ prajāpatim abruvan \\

Sentence: 4 sahasreṇa no yājayeti

Sentence: 5 so ‘gniṣṭomena vasūn ayājayat

Sentence: 6 ta imam lokam ajayan

Sentence: 7 tac cādaduḥ

Sentence: 8 sa ukthyṝna rudrān ayājayat

Sentence: 9 tṝ ‘ntarikṣam ajayan

Sentence: 10 tac cādaduḥ

Sentence: 11 so ‘tirātreṇādityān ayājayat

Sentence: 12 tṝ ‘mum lokam ajayan

Sentence: 13 tac cādadus

Sentence: 14 tad antarikṣam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vyavairyata

Sentence: 2 tasmād rudrā ghātukās \\

Sentence: 3 anāyatanā hi

Sentence: 4 tasmād āhuḥ

Sentence: 5 śithilam vai madhyamam ahas trirātrasya vi hi tad avairyateti

Sentence: 6 traiṣṭubham madhyamasyāhna ājyam bhavati

Sentence: 7 samyānāni sūktāni śaṁsati

Sentence: 8 ṣoḍaśinaṁ śaṁsati \\

Sentence: 9 ahno dhṛtyā aśithilambhāvāya

Sentence: 10 tasmāt trirātrasyāgniṣṭoma eva prathamam ahaḥ syād athokthyo ‘thātirātras \\

Sentence: 11 eṣām lokānām vidhṛtyai

Sentence: 12 trīṇitrīṇi śatāny anūcīnāham avyavachinnāni dadāti //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 eṣām lokānām anu samtatyai

Sentence: 2 daśatam na vi chindyāt \\

Sentence: 3 virājam ned vichinadānīti \\

Sentence: 4 atha yā sahasratamy āsīt tasyām indraś ca viṣṇuś ca vyāyachetām \\

Sentence: 5 sa indro ‘manyata \\

Sentence: 6 anayā vā idam viṣṇuḥ sahasram varkṣyata iti

Sentence: 7 tasyām akalpetām \\

Sentence: 8 dvibhāga indras tṛtīye viṣṇus

Sentence: 9 tad vā eṣābhyanūcyate \\

Sentence: 10 ubhā jigyathur iti

Sentence: 11 tām vā etām achāvākaḥ //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 eva śaṁsati \\

Sentence: 2 atha yā sahasratamī sā hotre deyeti

Sentence: 3 hotāram vā abhyatiricyate

Sentence: 4 yad atiricyate hotānāptasyāpayitā \\

Sentence: 5 athāhus \\

Sentence: 6 unnetre deyeti \\

Sentence: 7 atiriktā vā eṣā sahasrasya \\

Sentence: 8 atirikta unnetartvijām

Sentence: 9 athāhuḥ

Sentence: 10 sarvebhyaḥ sadasyṝbhyo deyeti \\

Sentence: 11 athāhus \\

Sentence: 12 udākṛtyā sā vaśam cared iti \\

Sentence: 13 athāhus \\

Sentence: 14 brahmaṇe cāgnīdhe ca deyeti //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 dvibhāgam brahmaṇe tṛtīyam agnīdhe \\

Sentence: 2 aindro vai brahmā vaiṣṇavo ‘gnīdh \\

Sentence: 3 yathaiva tāv akalpetām iti \\

Sentence: 4 athāhus \\

Sentence: 5 yā kalyāṇī bahurūpā sā deyeti \\

Sentence: 6 athāhus \\

Sentence: 7 yā dvirūpobhayataenī sā deyeti sahasrasya parigṛhītyai

Sentence: 8 tad vā etat sahasrasyāyanam \\

Sentence: 9 sahasraṁ stotrīyāḥ

Sentence: 10 sahasram dakṣiṇāḥ

Sentence: 11 sahasrasammitaḥ suvargo lokaḥ

Sentence: 12 suvargasya lokasyābhijityai //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 somo vai sahasram avindat

Sentence: 2 tam indro ‘nv avindat

Sentence: 3 tau yamo nyāgachat

Sentence: 4 tāv abravīt \\

Sentence: 5 astu me ‘trāpīti \\

Sentence: 6 astu hī3 ity abrūtām \\

Sentence: 7 sa yama ekasyām vīryam pary apaśyat \\

Sentence: 8 iyam vā asya sahasrasya vīryam bibhartīti tāv abravīd iyam mamāstv etad yuvayor iti

Sentence: 9 tāv abrūtām \\

Sentence: 10 sarve vā etad etasyām vīryam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pari paśyāmo ‘ṁśam ā harāmahā iti

Sentence: 2 tasyām aṁśam āharanta

Sentence: 3 tām apsu prāveśayan \\

Sentence: 4 somāyodehīti

Sentence: 5 sā rohiṇī piṅgalaikahāyanī rūpam kṛtvā trayastriṁśatā ca tribhiś ca śataiḥ sahodait \\

Sentence: 6 tasmād rohiṇyā piṅgalayaikahāyanyā somam krīṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvān rohiṇyā piṅgalayaikahāyanyā somam krīṇāti trayastriṁśatā caivāsya tribhiś ca //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 śataiḥ somaḥ krīto bhavati

Sentence: 2 sukrītena yajate

Sentence: 3 tām apsu prāveśayan \\

Sentence: 4 indrāyodehīti

Sentence: 5 sā rohiṇī lakṣmaṇā paṣṭhauhī vārtraghnī rūpam kṛtvā trayastriṁśatā ca tribhiś ca śataiḥ sahodait

Sentence: 6 tasmād rohiṇīm lakṣmaṇām paṣṭhauhīm vārtraghnīm dadyāt \\

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvān rohiṇīm lakṣmaṇām paṣṭhauhīm vārtraghnīm dadāti trayastriṁśac caivāsya trīṇi ca śatāni sā dattā //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 bhavati

Sentence: 2 tām apsu prāveśayan

Sentence: 3 yamāyodehīti

Sentence: 4 sā jaratī mūrkhā tajjaghanyā rūpam kṛtvā trayastriṁśatā ca tribhiś ca śataiḥ sahodait

Sentence: 5 tasmāj jaratīm mūrkhām tajjaghanyām anustaraṇīm kurvīta

Sentence: 6 ya evam vidvāñ jaratīm mūrkhām tajjaghanyām anustaraṇīm kurute trayastriṁśac caivāsya trīṇi ca śatāni sāmuṣmiṁ loke bhavati

Sentence: 7 vāg eva sahasratamī

Sentence: 8 tasmāt //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 varo deyaḥ

Sentence: 2 sā hi varaḥ

Sentence: 3 sahasram asya sā dattā bhavati

Sentence: 4 tasmād varo na pratigṛhyaḥ

Sentence: 5 sā hi varaḥ

Sentence: 6 sahasram asya pratigṛhītam bhavati \\

Sentence: 7 iyam vara iti brūyāt \\

Sentence: 8 athānyām brūyāt \\

Sentence: 9 iyam mameti

Sentence: 10 tathāsya tat sahasram apratigṛhītam bhavati \\

Sentence: 11 ubhayataenī syāt

Sentence: 12 tad āhus \\

Sentence: 13 anyataenī syāt sahasram parastād etam iti

Sentence: 14 yaiva varaḥ //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 kalyāṇī rūpasamṛddhā sā syāt

Sentence: 2 sā hi varaḥ

Sentence: 3 samṛddhyai

Sentence: 4 tām uttareṇāgnīdhram paryāṇīyāhavanīyasyānte droṇakalaśam ava ghrāpayet \\

Sentence: 5 ā jighra kalaśam mahy urudhārā payasvaty ā tvā viśantv indavaḥ samudram iva sindhavaḥ

Sentence: 6 sā mā sahasra ā bhaja prajayā paśubhiḥ saha punar mā viśatād rayir iti

Sentence: 7 prajayaivainam paśubhī rayyā sam //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 ardhayati

Sentence: 2 prajāvān paśumān rayimān bhavati ya evam veda

Sentence: 3 tayā sahāgnīdhram paretya purastāt pratīcyām tiṣṭhantyām juhuyāt \\

Sentence: 4 ubhā jigyathur na parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraś canainoḥ /

Sentence: 5 indraś ca viṣṇo yad apaspṛdhethām tredhā sahasram vi tad airayethām iti

Sentence: 6 tredhāvibhaktam vai trirātre sahasram \\

Sentence: 7 sāhasrīm evainām karoti

Sentence: 8 sahasrasyaivainām mātrām //

Verse: 8

Sentence: 1 karoti

Sentence: 2 rūpāṇi juhoti

Sentence: 3 rūpair evaināṁ sam ardhayati

Sentence: 4 tasyā upotthāya karṇam ā japet \\

Sentence: 5 iḍe rante ‘dite sarasvati priye preyasi mahi viśruty etāni te aghniye nāmāni

Sentence: 6 sukṛtam mā deveṣu brūtād iti

Sentence: 7 devebhya evainam ā vedayati \\

Sentence: 8 anv enam devā budhyante //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 sahasratamyā vai yajamānaḥ suvargam lokam eti

Sentence: 2 sainaṁ suvargam lokam gamayati

Sentence: 3 sā mā suvargam lokam gamayety āha

Sentence: 4 suvargam evainam lokam gamayati

Sentence: 5 sā mā jyotiṣmantam lokam gamayety āha

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 mā pratiṣṭhām gamaya prajayā paśubhiḥ saha punar mā viśatād rayir iti prajayaivainam paśubhī rayyām prati ṣṭhāpayati

Sentence: 2 prajāvān paśumān rayimān bhavati ya evam veda

Sentence: 3 tām agnīdhe vā brahmaṇe vā hotre vodgātre vādhvaryave vā dadyāt

Sentence: 4 sahasram asya sā dattā bhavati

Sentence: 5 sahasram asya pratigṛhītam bhavati yas tām avidvān //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 pratigṛhṇāti

Sentence: 2 tām prati gṛhṇīyāt \\

Sentence: 3 ekāsi na sahasram

Sentence: 5 ekā mā bhūtā viśa mā sahasram iti \\

Sentence: 6 ekām evainām bhūtām prati gṛhṇāti na sahasram ya evam veda

Sentence: 7 syonāsi suṣadā suśevā syonā mā viśa suṣadā mā viśa suśevā mā viśa //

## Chapter: 2

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 sādhyā vai devāḥ suvargakāmā etaṁ ṣaḍrātram apaśyan

Sentence: 2 tam āharan

Sentence: 3 tenāyajanta

Sentence: 4 tato vai te suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 5 ya evam vidvāṁsaḥ ṣaḍrātram āsate suvargam eva lokam yanti

Sentence: 6 devasattram vai ṣaḍrātraḥ

Sentence: 7 pratyakṣaṁ hy ṝtāni pṛṣṭhāni

Sentence: 8 ya evam vidvāṁsaḥ ṣaḍrātram āsate sākṣād eva devatā abhyārohanti

Sentence: 9 ṣaḍrātro bhavati

Sentence: 10 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ

Sentence: 11 ṣāṭ pṛṣṭhāni //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pṛṣṭhair evartūn anvārohanty ṛtubhiḥ samvatsaram \\

Sentence: 2 te samvatsara eva prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 3 bṛhadrathamtarābhyām yanti \\

Sentence: 4 iyam vāva rathamtaram asau bṛhat \\

Sentence: 5 ābhyām eva yanti \\

Sentence: 6 atho anayor eva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 7 ete vai yajñasyāñjasāyanī srutī

Sentence: 8 tābhyām eva suvargam lokam yanti

Sentence: 9 trivṛd agniṣṭomo bhavati

Sentence: 10 teja evāva rundhate

Sentence: 11 pañcadaśo bhavati \\

Sentence: 12 indriyam evāva rundhate

Sentence: 13 saptadaśaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 bhavati \\

Sentence: 2 annādyasyāvaruddhyai \\

Sentence: 3 atho praiva tena jāyante \\

Sentence: 4 ekaviṁśo bhavati pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 5 atho rucam evātman dadhate

Sentence: 6 triṇavo bhavati vijityai

Sentence: 7 trayastriṁśo bhavati

Sentence: 8 pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 9 sadohavirdhānina etena ṣaḍrātreṇa yajeran \\

Sentence: 10 āśvatthī havirdhānam cāgnīdhram ca bhavatas

Sentence: 11 tad dhi suvargyam \\

Sentence: 12 cakrīvatī bhavataḥ

Sentence: 13 suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai \\

Sentence: 14 ulūkhalabudhno yūpo bhavati

Sentence: 15 pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 16 prāñco yānti

Sentence: 17 prāṅ iva hi suvargaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 lokaḥ

Sentence: 2 sarasvatyā yānti \\

Sentence: 3 eṣa vai devayānaḥ panthās

Sentence: 4 tam evānvārohanti \\

Sentence: 5 ākrośanto yānti \\

Sentence: 6 avartim evānyasmin pratiṣajya pratiṣṭhām gachanti

Sentence: 7 yadā daśa śatam kurvanty athaikam utthānam \\

Sentence: 8 śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyas \\

Sentence: 9 āyuṣy evendriye prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 10 yadā śataṁ sahasram kurvanty athaikam utthānam \\

Sentence: 11 sahasrasammito vā asau lokas \\

Sentence: 12 amum eva lokam abhi jayanti

Sentence: 13 yadaiṣām pramīyeta yadā vā jīyerann athaikam utthānam \\

Sentence: 14 tad dhi tīrtham //

Sentence: 2 paśumānt syām iti

Sentence: 4 tenāyajata

Sentence: 5 tena vai sa yāvanto grāmyāḥ paśavas tān avārunddha

Sentence: 6 ya evam vidvānt saptarātreṇa yajate yāvanta eva grāmyāḥ paśavas tān evāva runddhe

Sentence: 8 sapta grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ saptāraṇyāḥ sapta chandāṁsi \\

Sentence: 9 ubhayasyāvaruddhyai

Sentence: 10 trivṛd agniṣṭomo bhavati

Sentence: 11 tejaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 evāva runddhe

Sentence: 2 pañcadaśo bhavati \\

Sentence: 3 indriyam evāva runddhe

Sentence: 4 saptadaśo bhavati \\

Sentence: 5 annādyasyāvaruddhyai \\

Sentence: 6 atho praiva tena jāyate \\

Sentence: 7 ekaviṁśo bhavati

Sentence: 8 pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 9 atho rucam evātman dhatte

Sentence: 10 triṇavo bhavati

Sentence: 11 vijityai

Sentence: 12 pañcaviṁśo ‘gniṣṭomo bhavati prajāpater āptyai

Sentence: 15 sarvasyābhijityai

Sentence: 16 yat pratyakṣam pūrveṣv ahaḥsu pṛṣṭhāny upeyuḥ pratyakṣam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 viśvajiti yathā dugdhām upasīdaty evam uttamam ahaḥ syāt \\

Sentence: 2 naikarātraś cana syāt \\

Sentence: 3 bṛhadrathantare pūrveṣv ahaḥsūpa yanti \\

Sentence: 4 iyam vāva rathamtaram asau bṛhat \\

Sentence: 5 ābhyām eva na yanty atho anayor eva prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 6 yat pratyakṣam viśvajiti pṛṣṭhāny upayanti yathā prattām duhe tādṛg eva tat //

Sentence: 12 aṣṭarātro bhavati

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata

Sentence: 2 tāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ kṣudham ny āyan \\

Sentence: 3 sa etam navarātram apaśyat

Sentence: 4 tam āharat

Sentence: 5 tenāyajata

Sentence: 6 tato vai prajābhyo ‘kalpata

Sentence: 7 yarhi prajāḥ kṣudham nigacheyus tarhi navarātreṇa yajeta \\

Sentence: 8 ime hi vā etāsām lokā akḷptā athaitāḥ kṣudham ni gachanti \\

Sentence: 9 imān evābhyo lokān kalpayati

Sentence: 10 tān kalpamānān prajābhyo ‘nu kalpate

Sentence: 11 kalpante //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 asmā ime lokā ūrjam prajāsu dadhāti

Sentence: 2 trirātreṇaivemam lokam kalpayati trirāttreṇāntarikṣam trirātreṇāmum lokam \\

Sentence: 3 yathā guṇe guṇam anvasyaty evam eva tal loke lokam anv asyati dhṛtyā aśithilambhāvāya

Sentence: 4 jyotir gaur āyur iti jñātā stomā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 5 iyam vāva jyotir antarikṣam gaur asāv āyus \\

Sentence: 6 eṣv ṝva lokeṣu prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 7 jñātram prajānām //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 gachati

Sentence: 2 navarātro bhavati \\

Sentence: 3 abhipūrvam evāsmin tejo dadhāti

Sentence: 4 yo jyogāmayāvī syāt sa navarātreṇa yajeta

Sentence: 5 prāṇā hi vā etasyādhṛtās \\

Sentence: 6 athaitasya jyog āmayati prāṇān evāsmin dādhāras \\

Sentence: 7 ata yadītāsur bhavati jīvaty eva //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatir akāmayata

Sentence: 2 pra jāyeyeti

Sentence: 3 sa etam daśahotāram apaśyat

Sentence: 4 tam ajuhot

Sentence: 5 tena daśarātram asṛjata

Sentence: 6 tena daśarātreṇa prājāyata

Sentence: 7 daśarātrāya dīkṣiṣyamāṇo daśahotāram juhuyāt \\

Sentence: 8 daśahotraiva daśarātraṁ sṛjata

Sentence: 9 tena daśarātreṇa pra jāyate

Sentence: 10 vairājo vā eṣa yajño yad daśarātras \\

Sentence: 11 ya evam vidvān daśarātreṇa yajate virājam eva gachati

Sentence: 12 prājāpatyo vā eṣa yajño yad daśarātraḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ya evam vidvān daśarātreṇa yajate praiva jāyate \\

Sentence: 2 indro vai sadṛṅ devatābhir āsīt

Sentence: 3 sa na vyāvṛtam agachat

Sentence: 4 sa prajāpatim upādhāvat

Sentence: 5 tasmā etam daśarātram prāyachat

Sentence: 6 tam āharat

Sentence: 7 tenāyajata

Sentence: 8 tato vai so ‘nyābhir devatābhir vyāvṛtam agachat \\

Sentence: 9 ya evam vidvān daśarātreṇa yajate vyāvṛtam eva pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇa gachati

Sentence: 10 trikakud vai //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 eṣa yajño yad daśarātraḥ

Sentence: 2 kakut pañcadaśaḥ kakud ekaviṁśaḥ kakut trayastriṁśas \\

Sentence: 3 ya evam vidvān daśarātreṇa yajate trikakud eva samānānām bhavati

Sentence: 4 yajāmanaḥ pañcadaśo yajamāna ekaviṁśo yajamānas trayastriṁśaḥ pura itarās \\

Sentence: 5 abhicaryamāṇo daśarātreṇa yajeta

Sentence: 6 devapurā eva pary ūhate

Sentence: 7 tasya na kutaś canopāvyādho bhavati

Sentence: 8 nainam abhicarant stṛṇute

Sentence: 9 devāsurāḥ samyattā āsan

Sentence: 10 te devā etāḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 devapurā apaśyan yad daśarātras

Sentence: 2 tāḥ pary auhanta

Sentence: 3 teṣām na kutaś canopāvyādho ‘bhavat

Sentence: 4 tato devā abhavan parāsurās \\

Sentence: 5 yo bhrātṛvyavānt syāt sa daśarātreṇa yajeta

Sentence: 6 devapurā eva pary ūhate

Sentence: 7 tasya na kutaś canopāvyādho bhavati

Sentence: 8 bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati

Sentence: 9 stoma stomasyopastir bhavati

Sentence: 10 bhrātṛvyam evopastim kurute

Sentence: 11 jāmi vai //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 etat kurvanti yaj jyāyāṁsaṁ stomam upetya kanīyāṁsam upayanti

Sentence: 2 yad agniṣṭomasāmāny avastāc ca parastāc ca bhavanty ajāmitvāya

Sentence: 3 trivṛd agniṣṭomo ‘gniṣṭud āgneyīṣu bhavati

Sentence: 4 teja evāva runddhe

Sentence: 5 pañcadaśa ukthya aindrīṣu \\

Sentence: 6 indriyam evāva runddhe

Sentence: 7 trivṛd agniṣṭomo vaiśvadevīṣu

Sentence: 8 puṣṭim evāva runddhe

Sentence: 9 saptadaśo ‘gniṣṭomaḥ prājāpatyāsu tīvrasomas \\

Sentence: 10 annādyasyāvaruddhyai \\

Sentence: 11 atho praiva teha jāyate //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 ekaviṁśa ukthyaḥ saurīṣu pratiṣṭhiyai \\

Sentence: 2 atho rucam evātman dhatte

Sentence: 3 saptadaśo ‘gniṣṭomaḥ prājāpatyāsūpahavyas \\

Sentence: 4 upahavam eva gachati

Sentence: 5 triṇavāv agniṣṭomāv abhita aindrīṣu

Sentence: 6 vijityai

Sentence: 7 trayastriṁśa ukthyo vaiśvadevīṣu

Sentence: 8 pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 9 viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho ‘tirātro bhavati

Sentence: 10 sarvasyābhijityai //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ṛtavo vai prajākāmāḥ prajām nāvindanta

Sentence: 2 tṝ ‘kāmayanta

Sentence: 3 prajāṁ sṛjemahi prajām ava rundhīmahi prajām vindemahi prajāvantaḥ syāmeti

Sentence: 4 ta etam ekādaśarātram apaśyan

Sentence: 5 tam āharan

Sentence: 6 tenāyajanta

Sentence: 7 tato vai te prajām asṛjanta prajām avārundhata prajām avindanta prajāvanto ‘bhavan

Sentence: 8 ta ṛtavo ‘bhavan

Sentence: 9 tad ārtavānām ārtavatvam

Sentence: 10 ṛtūnām vā ete putrās

Sentence: 11 tasmāt //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ārtavā ucyante

Sentence: 2 ya evam vidvāṁsa ekādaśarātram āsate prajām eva sṛjante prajām ava rundhate prajām vindante prajāvanto bhavanti

Sentence: 3 jyotir atirātro bhavati

Sentence: 4 jyotir eva purastād dadhate

Sentence: 5 suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai

Sentence: 6 pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati

Sentence: 7 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ pṛṣṭhāni

Sentence: 8 pṛṣṭhair evartūn anvārohanty ṛtubhiḥ samvatsaram \\

Sentence: 9 te samvatsara eva prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 10 caturviṁśo bhavati

Sentence: 11 caturviṁśatyakṣarā gāyatrī //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 gāyatram brahmavarcasam \\

Sentence: 2 gāyatriyām eva brahmavarcase prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 3 catuścatvāriṁśo bhavati

Sentence: 4 catuṣcatvāriṁśadakṣarā { triṣṭug ^ triṣtubh }

Sentence: 5 indriyam { triṣṭup ^ triṣṭubh }

Sentence: 6 triṣṭubhy evendriye prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 7 aṣṭācatvāriṁśo bhavati \\

Sentence: 8 aṣṭācatvāriṁśadakṣarā jagatī

Sentence: 9 jāgatāḥ paśavas \\

Sentence: 10 jagatyām eva paśuṣu prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 11 ekādaśarātro bhavati

Sentence: 12 pañca vā ṛtava ārtavāḥ pañca \\

Sentence: 13 ṛtuṣv evārtaveṣu samvatsare pratiṣṭhāya prajām ava rundhate \\

Sentence: 14 atirātrāv abhito bhavataḥ

Sentence: 15 prajāyati parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 aindravāyavāgrān gṛhṇīyād yaḥ kāmayeta

Sentence: 2 yathāpūrvam prajāḥ kalperann iti

Sentence: 3 yajñasya vai k??ptim anu prajāḥ kalpante yajñasyākḷptim anu na kalpante

Sentence: 4 yathāpūrvam eva prajāḥ kalpayati

Sentence: 5 na jyāyāṁsam kanīyān ati krāmati \\

Sentence: 6 aindravāyavāgrān gṛhṇīyād āmayāvinaḥ

Sentence: 7 prāṇena vā eṣa vy ṛdhyate yasyāmayati

Sentence: 8 prāṇa aindravāyavaḥ

Sentence: 9 prāṇenaivainaṁ sam ardhayati

Sentence: 10 maitrāvaruṇāgrān gṛhṇīran yeṣām dīkṣitānām pramīyeta //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 prāṇāpānābhyām vā ete vy ṛdhyante yeṣām dīkṣitānām pramīyate

Sentence: 2 prāṇāpānau mitrāvaruṇau

Sentence: 3 prāṇāpānāv eva mukhataḥ pari harante \\

Sentence: 4 āśvināgrān gṛhṇītānujāvaras \\

Sentence: 5 aśvinau vai devānām ānujāvarau paścevāgram pary aitām

Sentence: 6 aśvināv etasyā devatā ya ānujāvaras

Sentence: 7 tāv evainam agram pari ṇayataḥ

Sentence: 8 śukrāgrān gṛhṇīta gataśrīḥ pratiṣṭhākāmas \\

Sentence: 9 asau vā ādityaḥ śukra eṣo ‘ntas \\

Sentence: 10 antam manuṣyaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 śriyai gattvā ni vartate \\

Sentence: 2 antād evāntam ā rabhate

Sentence: 3 na tataḥ pāpīyān bhavati

Sentence: 4 manthyagrān gṛhṇītābhicaran \\

Sentence: 5 ārtapātram vā etad yan manthipātram

Sentence: 6 mṛtyunaivainam grāhayati

Sentence: 7 tājag ārtim ārchati \\

Sentence: 8 āgrayaṇāgrān gṛhṇīta yasya pitā pitāmahaḥ puṇyaḥ syād atha tan na prāpnuyāt \\

Sentence: 9 vācā vā eṣa indriyeṇa vy ṛdhyate yasya pitā pitāmahaḥ puṇyaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 bhavaty atha tan na prāpnoti \\

Sentence: 2 ura ivaitad yajñasya vāg iva yad āgrayaṇas \\

Sentence: 3 vācaivainam indriyeṇa sam ardhayati

Sentence: 4 na tataḥ pāpīyān bhavati \\

Sentence: 5 ukthyāgrān gṛhṇītābhicaryamāṇaḥ

Sentence: 6 sarveṣām vā etat pātrāṇām indriyam yad ukthyapātram \\

Sentence: 7 sarveṇaivainam indriyeṇāti pra yuṅkte

Sentence: 8 sarasvaty abhi no neṣi vasya iti purorucam kuryāt \\

Sentence: 9 vāg vai //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 sarasvatī vācaivainam ati pra yuṅkte

Sentence: 2 mā tvat kṣetrāṇy araṇāni ganmety āha

Sentence: 3 mṛtyor vai kṣetrāṇy araṇāni

Sentence: 4 tenaiva mṛtyoḥ kṣetrāṇi na gachati

Sentence: 5 pūrṇān grahān gṛhṇīyād āmayāvinaḥ

Sentence: 6 prāṇān vā etasya śug ṛchati yasyāmayati

Sentence: 7 prāṇā grahāḥ

Sentence: 8 prāṇān evāsya śuco muñcati \\

Sentence: 9 uta yadītāsur bhavati jīvaty eva

Sentence: 10 pūrṇān grahān gṛhṇīyād yarhi parjanyo na varṣet

Sentence: 11 prāṇān vā etarhi prajānāṁ śug ṛchati yarhi parjanyo na varṣat

Sentence: 12 prāṇā grahāḥ

Sentence: 13 prāṇān eva prajānāṁ śuco muñcati

Sentence: 14 tājak pra varṣati //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 gāyatro vā aindravāyavas \\

Sentence: 2 gāyatram prāyaṇīyam ahar \\

Sentence: 3 tasmāt prāyaṇīye ‘hann aindravāyavo gṛhyate

Sentence: 4 sva evainam āyatane gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 5 traiṣṭubho vai śukras

Sentence: 6 traiṣṭubham dvitīyam ahar \\

Sentence: 7 tasmād dvitīye ‘hañ chukro gṛhyate

Sentence: 8 sva evainam āyatane gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 9 jāgato vā āgrayaṇas \\

Sentence: 10 jāgatam tṛtīyam ahar \\

Sentence: 11 tasmāt tṛtīye ‘hann āgrayaṇo gṛhyate

Sentence: 12 sva evainam āyatane gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 13 etad vai //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yajñam āpad yac chandāṁsy āpnoti

Sentence: 2 yad āgrayaṇaḥ śvo gṛhyate yatraiva yajñam adṛśan tata evainam punaḥ pra yuṅkte

Sentence: 3 jaganmukho vai dvitīyas trirātras \\

Sentence: 4 jāgata āgrayaṇas \\

Sentence: 5 yac caturthe ‘hann āgrayaṇo gṛhyate sva evainam āyatane gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 6 atho svam eva chando ‘nu paryāvartante

Sentence: 7 rāthamtaro vā aindravāyavas \\

Sentence: 8 rāthamtaram pañcamam ahar \\

Sentence: 9 tasmāt pañcame ‘han //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 aindravāyavo gṛhyate

Sentence: 2 sva evainam āyatane gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 3 bārhato vai śukras \\

Sentence: 4 bārhataṁ ṣaṣṭham ahar \\

Sentence: 5 tasmāt ṣaṣṭhe ‘hañ chukro gṛhyate

Sentence: 6 sva evainam āyatane gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 7 etad vai dvitīyam yajñam āpad yac chandāṁsy āpnoti

Sentence: 8 yac chukraḥ śvo gṛhyate yatraiva yajñam adṛśan tata evainam punaḥ pra yuṅkte

Sentence: 9 triṣṭuṅmukho vai tṛtīyas trirātras

Sentence: 10 traiṣṭubhaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 śukras \\

Sentence: 2 yat saptame ‘hañ chukro gṛhyate sva evainam āyatane gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 3 atho svam eva chando ‘nu paryāvartante

Sentence: 4 vāg vā āgrayaṇas \\

Sentence: 5 vāg aṣṭamam ahar \\

Sentence: 6 tasmād aṣṭame ‘hann āgrayaṇo gṛhyate

Sentence: 7 sva evainam āyatane gṛhṇāti

Sentence: 8 prāṇo vā aindravāyavaḥ

Sentence: 9 prāṇo navamam ahar \\

Sentence: 10 tasmān navame ‘hann aindravāyavo gṛhyate

Sentence: 11 sva evainam āyatane gṛhṇāti \\

Sentence: 12 etat //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 vai tritīyam yajñam āpad yac chandāṁsy āpnoti

Sentence: 2 yad aindravāyavaḥ śvo gṛhyate yatraiva yajñam adṛśan tata evainam punaḥ pra yuṅkte \\

Sentence: 3 atho svam eva chando ‘nu paryāvartante

Sentence: 4 patho vā ete dhy apathena yanti yṝ ‘nyenaindravāyavāt pratipadyante \\

Sentence: 5 antaḥ khalu vā eṣa yajñasya yad daśamam ahar

Sentence: 6 daśame ‘hann aindravāyavo gṛhyate

Sentence: 7 yajñasya //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 evāntam gatvāpathāt panthām api yanti \\

Sentence: 2 atho yathā vahīyasā pratisāram vahanti tādṛg eva tat \\

Sentence: 3 chandāṁsy anyo’nyasya lokam abhya adhyāyan

Sentence: 4 tāny etenaiva devā vy avāhayan \\

Sentence: 5 aindravāyavasya vā etad āyatanam yac caturtham ahar \\

Sentence: 6 tasminn āgrayaṇo gṛhyate

Sentence: 7 tasmād āgrayaṇasyāyatane navame ‘hann aindravāyavo gṛhyate

Sentence: 8 śukrasya vā etad āyatanam yat pañcamam //

Verse: 7

Sentence: 1 ahar \\

Sentence: 2 tasminn aindravāyavo gṛhyate

Sentence: 3 tasmād aindravāyavasyāyatane saptame ‘hañ chukro gṛhyate \\

Sentence: 4 āgrayaṇasya vā etad āyatanam yat ṣaṣṭham ahar \\

Sentence: 5 tasmaiñ chukro gṛhyate

Sentence: 6 tasmāc chukrasyāyatane ‘ṣṭame ‘hann āgrayaṇo gṛhyate

Sentence: 7 chandāṁsy eva tad vi vāhayati

Sentence: 8 pra vasyaso vivāham āpnoti ya evam veda \\

Sentence: 9 atho devatābhya eva yajñe samvidam dadhāti

Sentence: 10 tasmād idam anyo’nyasmai dadhāti //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatir akāmayata

Sentence: 2 pra jāyeyeti

Sentence: 3 sa etam dvādaśarātram apaśyat

Sentence: 4 tam āharat

Sentence: 5 tenāyajata

Sentence: 6 tato vai sa prājāyata

Sentence: 7 yaḥ kāmayeta

Sentence: 8 pra jāyeyeti

Sentence: 9 sa dvādaśarātreṇa yajeta

Sentence: 10 praiva jāyate

Sentence: 11 brahmavādino vadanti \\

Sentence: 12 agniṣṭomaprāyaṇā yajñā atha kasmād atirātraḥ pūrvaḥ pra yujyata iti

Sentence: 13 cakṣuṣī vā ete yajñasya yad atirātrau kanīnike agniṣṭomau

Sentence: 14 yat //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 agniṣṭomam pūrvam prayuñjīran bahirdhā kanīnike dadhyus

Sentence: 2 tasmād atirātraḥ pūrvaḥ pra yujyate

Sentence: 3 cakṣuṣī eva yajñe dhitvā madhyataḥ kanīnike prati dadhati

Sentence: 4 yo vai gāyatrīm jyotiḥpakṣām veda jyotiṣā bhāsā suvargam lokam eti

Sentence: 5 yāv agniṣṭomau tau pakṣau

Sentence: 6 ye ‘ntare ‘ṣṭāv ukthyāḥ sa ātmā \\

Sentence: 7 eṣā vai gāyatrī jyotiḥpakṣā

Sentence: 8 ya evam veda jyotiṣā bhāsā suvargam lokam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 eti

Sentence: 2 prajāpatir vā eṣa dvādaśadhā vihito yad dvādaśarātras \\

Sentence: 3 yāv atirātrau tau pakṣau

Sentence: 4 ye ‘ntare ‘ṣṭāv ukthyāḥ sa ātmā

Sentence: 5 prajāpatir vāvaiṣa sant sad dha vai sattreṇa spṛṇoti

Sentence: 6 prāṇā vai sat

Sentence: 7 prāṇān eva spṛṇoti

Sentence: 8 sarvāsām vā ete prajānām prāṇair āsate ye sattram āsate

Sentence: 9 tasmāt pṛchanti

Sentence: 10 kim ete sattriṇa iti

Sentence: 11 priyaḥ prajānām utthito bhavati ya evam veda //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 na vā eṣo ‘nyatovaiśvānaraḥ suvargāya lokāya prābhavat \\

Sentence: 2 ūrdhvo ha vā eṣa ātata āsīt

Sentence: 3 te devā etam vaiśvānaram pary auhant suvargasya lokasya prabhūtyai \\

Sentence: 4 ṛtavo vā etena prajāpatim ayājayan

Sentence: 5 teṣv ārdhnod adhi tat \\

Sentence: 6 ṛdhnoti ha vā ṛtvikṣu ya evam vidvān dvādaśāhena yajate

Sentence: 7 tṝ ‘sminn aichanta

Sentence: 8 sa rasam aha vasantāya prāyachat //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yavam grīṣmāyauṣadhīr varṣābhyo vrīhīñ charade māṣatilau hemantaśiśirābhyām \\

Sentence: 2 tenendram prajāpatir ayājayat

Sentence: 3 tato vā indra indro ‘bhavat

Sentence: 4 tasmād āhus \\

Sentence: 5 ānujāvarasya yajña iti

Sentence: 6 sa hy ṝtenāgre ‘yajata \\

Sentence: 7 eṣa ha vai kuṇapam atti yaḥ sattre pratigṛhṇāti puruṣakuṇapam aśvakuṇapam \\

Sentence: 8 gaur vā annam \\

Sentence: 9 yena pātreṇānnam bibhrati yat tan na nirṇenijati tato ‘dhi //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 malam jāyate \\

Sentence: 2 eka eva yajeta \\

Sentence: 3 eko hi prajāpatir ārdhnot \\

Sentence: 4 dvādaśa rātrīr dīkṣitaḥ syāt \\

Sentence: 5 dvādaśa māsāḥ samvatsaraḥ

Sentence: 6 samvatsaraḥ prajāpatiḥ

Sentence: 7 prajāpatir { vāvaiṣa ^ vāvaiṣas }

Sentence: 8 eṣa ha tvai jāyate yas tapaso ‘dhi jāyate

Sentence: 9 caturdhā vā etās tisrastisro rātrayo yad dvādaśo ‘pasadas \\

Sentence: 10 yāḥ prathamā yajñam tābhiḥ sam bharati

Sentence: 11 yā dvitīyā yajñam tābhir ā rabhate //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 yās tṛtīyāḥ pātrāṇi tābhir nir ṇenikte

Sentence: 2 yāś caturthīr api tābhir ātmānam antarataḥ śundhate

Sentence: 3 yo vā asya paśum atti māṁsaṁ so ‘tti

Sentence: 4 yaḥ puroḍāśam matiṣkaṁ { sa ^ sas }

Sentence: 5 yaḥ parivāpam purīṣaṁ { sa ^ sas }

Sentence: 6 ya ājyam majjānaṁ { sa ^ sas }

Sentence: 7 yaḥ somaṁ svedaṁ sas \\

Sentence: 8 api ha vā asya śīrṣaṇyā niṣpadaḥ prati gṛhṇāti yo dvādaśāhe pratigṛhṇāti

Sentence: 9 tasmād dvādaśāhena na yājyam pāpmano vyāvṛttyai //
