## Chapter: 3

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajavam vā etena yanti yad daśamam ahar \\

Sentence: 2 pāpāvahīyam vā etena bhavanti yad daśamam ahar

Sentence: 3 yo vai prajavam yatām apathena pratipadyate ya sthāṇuṁ hanti yo bhreṣam nyeti sa hīyate

Sentence: 4 sa yo vai daśame ‘hann avivākya upahanyate sa hīyate

Sentence: 5 tasmai ya upahatāya vyāha tam evānvārabhya sam aśnute \\

Sentence: 6 atha yo vyāha saḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 hīyate

Sentence: 2 tasmād daśame ‘hann avivākya upahatāya na vyucyam

Sentence: 3 atho khalv āhur

Sentence: 4 yajñasya vai samṛddhena devāḥ suvargam lokam āyan yajñasya vyṛddhenāsurān parābhāvayann iti

Sentence: 5 yat khalu vai yajñasya samṛddham tad yajamānasya yad vyṛddham tad bhrātṛvyasya

Sentence: 6 sa yo vai daśame ‘hann avivākya upahanyate sa evāti recayati

Sentence: 7 te ye bāhyā dṛśīkavaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 syus te vi brūyus \\

Sentence: 2 yadi tatra na vindeyur antaḥsadasād vyucyam \\

Sentence: 3 tad vyucyam eva \\

Sentence: 4 atha vā etat sarparājñiyā ṛgbhi stuvanti \\

Sentence: 5 iyam vai sarpato rājñī

Sentence: 6 yad vā asyām kim cārcanti yad ānṛcus teneyaṁ sarparājñī

Sentence: 7 te yad eva kim ca vācānṛcur yad ato ‘dhy arcitāraḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 tad ubhayam āptvāvarudhyot tiṣṭhāmeti

Sentence: 2 tābhir manasā stuvate

Sentence: 3 na vā imām aśvaratho nāśvatarīrathaḥ sadyaḥ paryāptum arhati

Sentence: 4 mano vā imāṁ sadyaḥ paryāptum arhati manaḥ paribhavitum

Sentence: 5 atha brahma vadanti

Sentence: 6 parimitā vā ṛcaḥ parimitāni sāmāni parimitāni yajūṁṣy athaitasyaivānto nāsti yad brahma

Sentence: 7 tat pratigṛṇata ā cakṣīta

Sentence: 8 sa pratigaraḥ //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 brahmavādino vadanti

Sentence: 2 kim dvādaśāhasya prathamenāhnartvijām yajamāno vṛṅkta iti

Sentence: 3 teja indriyam iti

Sentence: 4 kim dvitīyeneti

Sentence: 5 prāṇān annādyam iti

Sentence: 6 kim tṛtīyeneti

Sentence: 7 trīn imāṁ lokān iti

Sentence: 8 kim caturtheneti

Sentence: 9 catuṣpadaḥ paśūn iti

Sentence: 10 kim pañcameneti

Sentence: 11 pañcākṣarām paṅktim iti

Sentence: 12 kiṁ ṣaṣṭheneti

Sentence: 13 ṣaḍ ṛtūn iti

Sentence: 14 kiṁ saptameneti

Sentence: 15 saptapadāṁ śakvarīm iti //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 kim aṣṭameneti \\

Sentence: 2 aṣṭākṣarām gāyatrīm iti

Sentence: 3 kim navameneti

Sentence: 4 trivṛtaṁ stomam iti

Sentence: 5 kim daśameneti

Sentence: 6 daśākṣarām virājam iti

Sentence: 7 kim ekādaśeneti \\

Sentence: 8 ekādaśākṣarām tṛṣṭubham iti

Sentence: 9 kim dvādaśeneti

Sentence: 10 dvādaśākṣarām jagatīm iti \\

Sentence: 11 etāvad vā asti yāvad etat \\

Sentence: 12 yāvad evāsti tad eṣām vṛṅkte //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 eṣa vā āpto dvādaśāho yat trayodaśarātraḥ

Sentence: 2 samānaṁ hy ṝtad ahar yat prāyaṇīyaś codayanīyaś ca

Sentence: 3 tryatirātro bhavati

Sentence: 4 traya ime lokās \\

Sentence: 5 eṣām lokānām āptyai

Sentence: 6 prāṇo vai prathamo ‘tirātro vyāno dvitīyo ‘pānas tṛtīyaḥ

Sentence: 7 prāṇāpānodāneṣv evānnādye prati tiṣṭhanti sarvam āyur yanti ya evam vidvāṁsas trayodaśarātram āsate

Sentence: 8 tad āhus \\

Sentence: 9 vāg vā eṣā vitatā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yad dvādaśāhas

Sentence: 2 tām vi chindyur yan madhye ‘tirātram kuryur upadāsukā gṛhapater vāk syāt \\

Sentence: 3 upariṣṭāc chandomānām mahāvratam kurvanti samtatām eva vācam ava runddhe ‘nupadāsukā gṛhapater vāg bhavati

Sentence: 4 paśavo vai chandomā annam mahāvratam \\

Sentence: 5 yad upariṣṭāc chandomānām mahāvratam kurvanti paśuṣu caivānnādye ca prati tiṣṭhanti //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ādityā akāmayanta \\

Sentence: 2 ubhayor lokayor ṛdhnuyāmeti

Sentence: 3 ta etam caturdaśarātram apaśyan

Sentence: 4 tam āharan

Sentence: 5 tenāyajanta

Sentence: 6 tato vai ta ubhayor lokayor ārdhnuvann asmiṁś cāmuṣmiṁś ca

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvāṁsaś caturdaśarātram āsata ubhayor eva lokayor ṛdhnuvanty asmiṁś cāmuṣmiṁś ca

Sentence: 8 caturdaśarātro bhavati

Sentence: 9 sapta grāmyā oṣadhayaḥ saptāraṇyā ubhayīṣām avaruddhyai

Sentence: 10 yat parācīnāni prāṣṭhāni //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 bhavanty amum eva tair lokam abhi jayanti

Sentence: 2 yat pratīcīnāni pṛṣṭhāni bhavantīmam eva tair lokam abhi jayanti

Sentence: 3 trayastriṁśau madhyata stomau bhavataḥ sāmrājyam eva gachanti \\

Sentence: 4 adhirājau bhavato ‘dhirājā eva samānānām bhavanti \\

Sentence: 5 atirātrā vabhito bhavataḥ

Sentence: 6 parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatiḥ suvargam lokam ait

Sentence: 2 tam devā anv āyan

Sentence: 3 tān ādityāś ca paśavaś cānv āyan

Sentence: 4 te devā abruvan

Sentence: 5 yān paśūn upājīviṣma ta imṝ ‘nvāgmann iti

Sentence: 6 tebhya etam caturdaśarātram praty auhan

Sentence: 7 ta ādityāḥ pṛṣṭhaiḥ suvargam lokam ārohan tryahābhyām asmiṁ loke paśūn praty auhan

Sentence: 8 pṛṣṭhair ādityā amuṣmiṁ loka ārdhnuvan tryahābhyām asmin //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 loke paśavas \\

Sentence: 2 ya evam vidvāṁsaś caturdaśarātram āsata ubhayor eva lokayor ṛdhnuvanty asmiṁś cāmuṣmiṁś ca

Sentence: 3 pṛṣṭhair evāmuṣmiṁ loka ṛdhnuvanti tryahābhyām asmiṁ loke

Sentence: 4 jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho bhavati \\

Sentence: 5 iyam vāva jyotir antarikṣam gaur asāv āyus \\

Sentence: 6 imān eva lokān abhyārohanti

Sentence: 7 yad anyataḥ pṛṣṭhāni syur vivivadhaṁ syāt \\

Sentence: 8 madhye pṛṣṭhāni bhavanti savivadhatvāya //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ojo vai vīryam pṛṣṭhāni \\

Sentence: 2 oja eva vīryam madhyato dadhate

Sentence: 3 bṛhadrathamtarābhyām yanti \\

Sentence: 4 iyam vāva rathamtaram asau bṛhat \\

Sentence: 5 ābhyām eva yanti \\

Sentence: 6 atho anayor eva prati tiṣṭhani \\

Sentence: 7 ete vai yajñasyāñjasāyanī srutī

Sentence: 8 tābhyām eva suvargam lokam yanti

Sentence: 9 parāñco vā ete suvargam lokam abhyārohanti ye parācīnāni pṛṣṭhāny upayanti

Sentence: 10 pratyañ tryaho bhavati pratyavarūḍhyā atho pratiṣṭhiyai \\

Sentence: 11 ubhayor lokayor ṛddhvot tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 12 caturdaśaitās \\

Sentence: 13 tāsām yā daśa daśākṣarā virāḍ annam virāḍ virājaivānnādyam ava rundhate

Sentence: 14 yāś catasraś catasro diśo dikṣv ṝva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 15 atirātrāv abhito bhavataḥ parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 indro vai sadṛṅ devatābhir āsīt

Sentence: 2 sa na vyāvṛtam agachat

Sentence: 3 sa prajāpatim upādhāvat

Sentence: 4 tasmā etam pañcadaśarātram pāyachat

Sentence: 5 tam āharat

Sentence: 6 tenāyajata

Sentence: 7 tato vai so ‘nyābhir devatābhir vyāvṛtam agachat \\

Sentence: 8 ya evam vidvāṁsaḥ pañcadaśarātram āsate vyāvṛtam eva pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇa gachanti

Sentence: 9 jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho bhavati \\

Sentence: 10 iyam vāva jyotir antarikṣam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 gaur asāv āyus \\

Sentence: 2 eṣv ṝva lokeṣu prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 3 asattram vā etad yad achandomam \\

Sentence: 4 yac chandomā bhavanti tena sattram \\

Sentence: 5 devatā eva pṛṣṭhair ava rundhate paśūñ chandomais \\

Sentence: 6 ojasy eva vīryṝ paśuṣu prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 7 pañcadaśarātro bhavati

Sentence: 8 pañcadaśo vajras \\

Sentence: 9 vajram eva bhrātṛvyebhyaḥ pra haranti \\

Sentence: 10 atirātrāv abhito bhavatas \\

Sentence: 11 indriyasya parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 indro vai śithila ivāpratiṣṭhita āsīt

Sentence: 2 so ‘surebhyo ‘bibhet

Sentence: 3 sa prajāpatim upādhāvat

Sentence: 4 tasmā etam pañcadaśarātram vajram prāyachat

Sentence: 5 tenāsurān parābhāvya vijitya śriyam agachat \\

Sentence: 6 agniṣṭutā pāpmānam nir adahata pañcadaśarātreṇaujo balam indriyam vīryam ātmann adhatta

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvāṁsaḥ pañcadaśarātram āsate bhrātṛvyān eva parābhāvya vijitya śriyam gachanti \\

Sentence: 8 agniṣṭutā pāpmānam niḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 dahante pañcadaśarātreṇaujo balam indriyam vīryam ātman dadhate \\

Sentence: 2 etā eva paśavyāḥ

Sentence: 3 pañcadaśa vā ardhamāsasya rātrayas \\

Sentence: 4 ardhamāsaśaḥ samvatsara āpyate

Sentence: 5 samvatsaram paśavo ‘nu pra jāyante

Sentence: 6 tasmāt paśavyās \\

Sentence: 7 etā eva suvargyāḥ

Sentence: 8 pañcadaśa vā ardhamāsasya rātrayas \\

Sentence: 9 ardhamāsaśaḥ samvatsara āpyate

Sentence: 10 samvatsaraḥ suvargo lokas

Sentence: 11 tasmād suvargyās \\

Sentence: 12 jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho bhavati \\

Sentence: 13 iyam vāva jyotir antarikṣam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 gaur asāv āyus \\

Sentence: 2 imān eva lokān abhyārohanti

Sentence: 3 yad anyataḥ pṛṣṭhāni syur vivivadhaṁ syāt \\

Sentence: 4 madhye pṛṣṭhāni bhavanti savivadhatvāya \\

Sentence: 5 ojo vai vīryam pṛṣṭhāni \\

Sentence: 6 oja eva vīryam madhyato dadhate

Sentence: 7 bṛhadrathamtarābhyām yanti \\

Sentence: 8 iyam vāva rathamtaram asau bṛhat \\

Sentence: 9 ābhyām eva yanti \\

Sentence: 10 atho anayor eva prati tiṣṭhani \\

Sentence: 11 ete vai yajñasyāñjasāyanī srutī

Sentence: 12 tābhyām eva suvargam lokam //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 yanti

Sentence: 2 parāñco vā ete suvargam lokam abhyārohanti ye parācīnāni pṛṣṭhāny upayanti

Sentence: 3 pratyañ tryaho bhavati pratyavarūḍhyā atho pratiṣṭhiyai \\

Sentence: 4 ubhayor lokayor ṛddhvot tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 5 pañcadaśaitās

Sentence: 6 tāsām yā daśa daśākṣarā virāḍ annam virāḍ virājaivānnādyam ava rundhate

Sentence: 7 yāḥ pañca pañca diśaḥ dikṣv ṝva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 8 atirātrāv abhito bhavatas \\

Sentence: 9 indriyasya vīryasya prajāyati paśūnām parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatir akāmayata \\

Sentence: 2 annādaḥ syām iti

Sentence: 3 sa etaṁ saptadaśarātram apaśyat

Sentence: 4 tam āharat

Sentence: 5 tenāyajata

Sentence: 6 tato vai so ‘nnādo ‘bhavat \\

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvāṁsaḥ saptadaśarātram āsate ‘nnādā eva bhavanti

Sentence: 8 pañcāho bhavati

Sentence: 9 pañca vā ṛtavaḥ samvatsaras \\

Sentence: 10 ṛtuṣv eva samvatsare prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 11 atho pañcākṣarā paṅktiḥ

Sentence: 12 pāṅkto yajñas \\

Sentence: 13 yajñam evāva rundhate \\

Sentence: 14 asattram vā etat //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 yad achandomam \\

Sentence: 2 yac chandomā bhavanti tena sattram \\

Sentence: 3 devatā eva pṛṣṭhair ava rundhate paśūñ chandomais \\

Sentence: 4 ojasy eva vīryṝ paśuṣu prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 5 saptadaśarātro bhavati

Sentence: 6 saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ

Sentence: 7 prajāpater āptyai \\

Sentence: 8 atirātrāv abhito bhavatas \\

Sentence: 9 annādyasya parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 sā virāḍ vikramyātiṣṭhad brahmaṇā deveṣv annenāsureṣu

Sentence: 2 te devā akāmayanta \\

Sentence: 3 ubhayaṁ sam vṛñjīmahi brahma cānnam ceti

Sentence: 4 ta etā viṁśatiṁ rātrīr apaśyan

Sentence: 5 tato vai ta ubhayaṁ sam avṛñjata brahma cānnam ca brahmavarcasino ‘nnādā abhavan

Sentence: 6 ya evam vidvāṁsa etā āsata ubhayam eva sam vṛñjate brahma cānnam ca //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 brahmavarcasino ‘nnādā bhavanti

Sentence: 2 dve vā ete virājau

Sentence: 3 tayor eva nānā prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 4 viṁśo vai puruṣo daśa hastyā aṅgulayo daśa padyās \\

Sentence: 5 yāvān eva puruṣas tam āptvot tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 6 jyotir gaur āyur iti tryahā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 7 iyam vāva jyotir antarikṣam gaur asāv āyus \\

Sentence: 8 imān eva lokān abhyārohanti \\

Sentence: 9 abhipūrvam tryahā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 10 abhipūrvam eva suvargam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 lokam abhyārohanti

Sentence: 2 yad anyataḥ pṛṣṭhāni

Sentence: 3 madhye pṛṣṭhāni bhavanti savivadhatvāya //

Sentence: 4 ojo vai vīryam pṛṣṭhāni \\

Sentence: 5 oja eva vīryam madhyato dadhate

Sentence: 6 bṛhadrathamtarābhyām yanti \\

Sentence: 7 iyam vāva rathamtaram asau bṛhat \\

Sentence: 8 ābhyām eva yanti \\

Sentence: 9 atho anayor eva prati tiṣṭhani \\

Sentence: 10 ete vai yajñasyāñjasāyanī srutī

Sentence: 11 tābhyām eva suvargam lokam yanti

Sentence: 12 parāñco vā ete suvargam lokam abhyārohanti ye parācīnāni pṛṣṭhāny upayanti

Sentence: 13 pratyañ tryaho bhavati pratyavarūḍhyā atho pratiṣṭhiyai \\

Sentence: 14 ubhayor lokayor ṛddhvot tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 15 atirātrāv abhito bhavatas \\

Sentence: 16 brahmavarcasasyānnādyasya pari gṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 asāva ādityo ‘smiṁ loka āsīt

Sentence: 2 tam devāḥ pṛṣṭhaiḥ parigṛhya suvargam lokam agamayan

Sentence: 3 parair avastāt pary agṛhṇan divākīrtyṝna suvarge loke praty asthāpayan

Sentence: 4 paraiḥ parastāt pary agṛhṇan pṛṣṭhair upāvārohan \\

Sentence: 5 sa vā asāv ādityo ‘muṣmiṁ loke parair ubhayataḥ parigṛhītas \\

Sentence: 6 yat pṛṣṭhāni bhavanti suvargam eva tair lokam yajamānā yanti

Sentence: 7 parair avastāt pari gṛhṇanti divākīrtyṝna //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 suvarge loke prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 2 paraiḥ parastāt pari gṛhṇanti pṛṣṭhair upāvarohanti

Sentence: 3 yat pare parastān na syuḥ parāsuvargāl lokān niṣ padyeranñcaḥ

Sentence: 4 yad avastān na syuḥ prajā nir daheyus \\

Sentence: 5 abhito divākīrtyam paraḥsāmāno bhavanti

Sentence: 6 suvarga evaināṁ loka ubhayataḥ pari gṛhṇanti

Sentence: 7 yajamānā vai divākīrtyam \\

Sentence: 8 samvatsaraḥ paraḥsāmānas \\

Sentence: 9 abhito divākīrtyam paraḥsāmāno bhavanti

Sentence: 10 samvatsara evobhayataḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 2 pṛṣṭham vai divākīrtyam pārśve paraḥsāmānas \\

Sentence: 3 abhito divākīrtyam paraḥsāmāno bhavanti

Sentence: 4 tasmād bhitaḥ pṛṣṭham pārśve

Sentence: 5 bhūyiṣṭhā grahā gṛhyante

Sentence: 6 bhūyiṣṭhaṁ śasyate

Sentence: 7 yajñasyaiva tan madhyato granthim grathnanty avisraṁsāya

Sentence: 8 sapta gṛhyante

Sentence: 9 sapta vai śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ

Sentence: 10 prāṇān eva yajamāneṣu dadhati

Sentence: 11 yat parācīnāni pṛṣthāni bhavanty amum eva tair lokam abhyārohanti

Sentence: 12 yad imam lokam na //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 pratyavaroheyur ud vā mādyeyur yajamānāḥ pra vā mīyeran

Sentence: 2 yat pratīcīnāni pṛṣṭhāni bhavanti \\

Sentence: 3 imam eva tair lokam pratyavarohanti \\

Sentence: 4 atho asminn eva loke prati tiṣṭhanty anunmādāya \\

Sentence: 5 indro vā apratiṣṭhita āsīt

Sentence: 6 sa prajāpatim upādhāvat

Sentence: 7 tasmā etam ekaviṁśatirātram prāyachat

Sentence: 8 tam āharat

Sentence: 9 tenāyajata

Sentence: 10 tato vai sa praty atiṣṭhat \\

Sentence: 11 ye bhuyājino ‘pratiṣṭhitāḥ //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 syus ta ekaviṁśatirātram āsīran

Sentence: 2 dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṁśas \\

Sentence: 3 etāvanto vai devalokās

Sentence: 4 teṣv eva yathāpūrvam prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 5 asāv ādityo na vy arocata

Sentence: 6 sa prajāpatim upādhāvat

Sentence: 7 tasmā etam ekaviṁśati rātram prāyachat

Sentence: 8 tam āharat

Sentence: 9 tenāyajata

Sentence: 10 tato vai so ‘rocata

Sentence: 11 ya evam vidvāṁsa ekaviṁśatirātram āsate rocanta eva \\

Sentence: 12 ekviṁśatirātro bhavati

Sentence: 13 rug vā ekaviṁśas \\

Sentence: 14 rucam eva gachanty atho pratiṣṭhām eva

Sentence: 15 pratiṣṭhā hy ṝkaviṁśas \\

Sentence: 16 atirātrāv abhito bhavato brahmavarcasasya parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 11

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a arvāṅ yajñaḥ sam krāmatv amuṣmād adhi mām abhi / ṛṣīṇām yaḥ purohitaḥ //

Sentence: 2=b nirdevam nirvīram kṛtvā viṣkandham tasmin hīyatām yo ‘smān dveṣṭi śarīram yajñaśamalam kusīdam tasmint sīdatu yo ‘smān dveṣṭi //

Sentence: 3=c yajña yajñasya yat tejas tena sam krāma mām abhi / brāhmaṇān ṛtvijo devān yajñasya tapasā te savāham ā huve //

Sentence: 4=d iṣṭena pakvam upa //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 te huve savāham / sam te vṛñje sukṛtaṁ sam prajām paśūn //

Sentence: 2=e praiṣānt sāmidhenīr āghārāv ājyabhāgāv āśrutam pratyāśrutam ā śṛṇāmi te / prayājānūyājānt sviṣṭakṛtam iḍām āśiṣa ā vṛñje suvaḥ //

Sentence: 3=f agninendreṇa somena sarasvatyā viṣṇunā devatābhiḥ / yājyānuvākyābhyām upa te huve svāham yajñam ā dade te vaṣaṭkṛtam //

Sentence: 4=g stutaṁ śastram pratigaram graham iḍām āśiṣaḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ā vṛñje suvaḥ / patnīsamyājān upa te huve savāhaṁ samiṣṭayajur ā dade tava //

Sentence: 2=h paśūnt sutam puroḍāśānt savanāny ota yajñam / devānt sendrān upa te huve savāham agnimukhānt somavato ye ca viśve //

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 bhūtam bhavyam bhaviṣyad vaṣaṭ svāhā namas \\

Sentence: 3 gāyatrī triṣṭub jagatī vaṣaṭ svāhā namaḥ

Sentence: 5 agnir vāyuḥ sūryo vaṣaṭ svāhā namaḥ

Sentence: 7 annam kṛṣir vṛṣṭir vaṣaṭ svāhā namaḥ

Sentence: 8 pitā putraḥ pautro vaṣaṭ svāhā namas \\

Sentence: 9 bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar vaṣaṭ svāhā namaḥ //

Sentence: 2=b ā me graho bhavatv ā puroruk stutaśastre mā viśatāṁ samīcī / ādityā rudrā vasavo me sadasyāḥ sahasrasya mā bhūmā mā pra hāsīt //

Sentence: 3=c ā māgniṣṭomo viśatūkthyaś cātirātro mā viśatv āpiśarvaraḥ / tiroahniyā mā suhutā ā viśantu sahasrasya mā bhūmā mā pra hāsīt //

## Chapter: 4

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 bṛhaspatir akāmayata

Sentence: 2 śran me devā dadhīran gacheyam purodhām iti

Sentence: 3 sa etam caturviṁśatirātram apaśyat

Sentence: 4 tam āharat

Sentence: 5 tenāyajata

Sentence: 6 tato vai tasmai śrad devā adadhatāgachat purodhām \\

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvāṁsaś caturviṁśatirātram āsate śrad ebhyo manuṣyā dadhate gachanti purodhām \\

Sentence: 8 jyotir gaur āyur iti tryahā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 9 iyam vāva jyotir antarikṣam gaur asāv āyuḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 imān eva lokān abhyārohanti \\

Sentence: 2 abhipūrvam tryahā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 3 abhipūrvam eva suvargam lokam abhyārohanti \\

Sentence: 4 asattram vā etad yad achandomam \\

Sentence: 5 yac chandomā bhavanti tena sattram \\

Sentence: 6 devatā eva pṛṣṭhair ava rundhate paśūñ chandomais \\

Sentence: 7 ojo vai vīryam pṛṣṭhāni paśavaś chandomās \\

Sentence: 8 ojasy eva vīryṝ paśuṣu prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 9 bṛhadrathamtarābhyām yanti \\

Sentence: 10 iyam vāva rathamtaram asau bṛhat \\

Sentence: 11 ābhyām eva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 yanti

Sentence: 2 atho anayor eva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 3 ete vai yajñasyāñjasāyanī srutī

Sentence: 4 tābhyām eva suvargam lokam yanti

Sentence: 5 caturviṁśatirātro bhavati

Sentence: 6 caturviṁśatir ardhamāsāḥ samvatsaraḥ

Sentence: 7 samvatsaraḥ suvargo lokaḥ

Sentence: 8 samvatsara eva suvarge loke prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 9 atho caturviṁśatyakṣarā gāyatrī

Sentence: 10 gāyatrī brahmavarcasam \\

Sentence: 11 gāyatriyaiva brahmavarcasam ava rundhate \\

Sentence: 12 atirātrāv abhito bhavatas \\

Sentence: 13 brahmavarcasasya parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yathā vai manuṣyā evam devā agra āsan

Sentence: 2 tṝ ‘kāmayanta \\

Sentence: 3 avartim pāpmānam mṛtyum apahatya daivīṁ saṁsadam gachemeti

Sentence: 4 ta etam caturviṁśatirātram apaśyan

Sentence: 5 tam āharan

Sentence: 6 tenāyajanta

Sentence: 7 tato vai te ‘vartim pāpmānam mṛtyum apahatya daivīṁ saṁsadam agachan

Sentence: 8 ya evam vidvāṁsaś caturviṁśatirātram āsate ‘vartim eva pāpmānam apahatya śriyam gachanti

Sentence: 9 śrīr hi manuṣyasya //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 daivī saṁsad \\

Sentence: 2 jyotir atirātro bhavati

Sentence: 3 suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai

Sentence: 4 pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati

Sentence: 5 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ samvatsaras

Sentence: 6 tam māsā ardhamāsā ṛtavaḥ praviśya daivīṁ saṁsadam agachan

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvāṁsaś caturviṁśatirātram āsate samvatsaram eva praviśya vasyasīṁ saṁsadam gachanti

Sentence: 8 trayas trayastriṁśā avastād bhavanti trayas trayastriṁśāḥ parastāt

Sentence: 9 trayastriṁśair evobhavayoto ‘vartim pāpmānam apahatya daivīṁ saṁsadam madhyataḥ //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 gachanti

Sentence: 2 pṛṣṭhāni hi daivī saṁsad \\

Sentence: 3 jāmi vā etat kurvanti yat trayas trayastriṁśā anvañcas \\

Sentence: 4 madhye ‘nirukto bhavati tenājāmi \\

Sentence: 5 ūrdhvāni pṛṣṭhāni bhavanty ūrdhvāś chandomās \\

Sentence: 6 ubhābhyāṁ rūpābhyāṁ suvargam lokam yanti \\

Sentence: 7 asattram vā etad yad achandomam \\

Sentence: 8 yac chandomā bhavanti tena sattram \\

Sentence: 9 devatā eva pṛtṣṭhair ava rundhate paśūñ chandomais \\

Sentence: 10 ojo vai vīryam pṛṣṭhāni paśavaḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 chandomās \\

Sentence: 2 ojasy eva vīryṝ paśuṣu prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 3 trayas trayastriṁśā avastād bhavanti trayas trayastriṁśāḥ parastān madhye pṛṣṭhāni \\

Sentence: 4 uro vai trayastriṁśā ātmā pṛṣṭhāni \\

Sentence: 5 ātmana eva tad yajamānāḥ śarma nahyante ‘nārtyai

Sentence: 6 bṛhadrathamtarābhyām yanti \\

Sentence: 7 iyam vāva rathamtaram asau bṛhat \\

Sentence: 8 ābhyām eva yanti \\

Sentence: 9 atho anayor eva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 10 ete vai yajñasyāñjasāyanī srutī

Sentence: 11 tābhyām eva //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 suvargam lokam yanti

Sentence: 2 parāñco vā ete suvargam lokam abhyārohanti ye parācīnāni pṛṣṭhāny upayanti

Sentence: 3 pratyaṅ ṣaḍaho bhavati pratyavarūḍhyā atho pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 4 ubhayor lokayor ṛddhvot tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 5 trivṛto ‘dhi trivṛtam upa yanti stomānāṁ sampattyai prabhavāya

Sentence: 6 jyotir agniṣṭomo bhavati \\

Sentence: 7 ayam vāva sa kṣayas \\

Sentence: 8 asmād eva tena kṣayān na yanti

Sentence: 9 caturviṁśatirātro bhavati

Paragraph: 1

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 caturviṁśatir ardhamāsāḥ samvatsaraḥ

Sentence: 2 samvatsaraḥ suvargo lokaḥ

Sentence: 3 samvatsara eva suvarge loke prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 4 atho caturviṁśatyakṣarā gāyatrī

Sentence: 5 gāyatrī brahmavarcasam \\

Sentence: 6 gāyatriyaiva brahmavarcasam ava rundhate \\

Paragraph: 2

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 atirātrāv abhito bhavatas \\

Sentence: 2 brahmavarcasasya parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 3

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ṛkṣā vā iyam alomakāsīt

Sentence: 2 sākāmayata \\

Sentence: 3 oṣadhībhir vanaspatibhiḥ pra jāyeyeti

Sentence: 4 saitās triṁśataṁ rātrīr apaśyat

Sentence: 5 tato vā iyam oṣadhībhir vanaspatibhiḥ prājāyata

Sentence: 6 ye prajākāmāḥ paśukāmāḥ syus ta etā āsīran

Sentence: 7 praiva jāyante prajayā paśubhis \\

Sentence: 8 iyam vā akṣudhyat

Sentence: 9 saitām virājam apaśyat

Sentence: 10 tām ātman dhitvānnādyam avārunddhauṣadhīḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 vanaspatīn prajām paśūn

Sentence: 2 tenāvardhata

Sentence: 3 sā jemānam amhimānam agachat \\

Sentence: 4 ya evam vidvāṁsa etā āsate virājam evātman dhitvānnādyam ava rundhate

Sentence: 5 vardhante prajayā paśubhis \\

Sentence: 6 jemānam mahimānam gachanti

Sentence: 7 jyotir atirātro bhavati suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai

Sentence: 8 pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati

Sentence: 9 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ pṛṣṭhāni

Sentence: 10 pṛṣṭhair evartūn anvārohanty ṛtubhiḥ samvatsaram \\

Sentence: 11 te samvatsara eva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 2 trayastriṁśāt trayastriṁśam upa yanti yajñasya samtatyai \\

Sentence: 3 atho prajāpatir vai trayastriṁśaḥ prajāpatim evā rabhante pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 4 triṇavo bhavati vijityai \\

Sentence: 5 ekaviṁśo bhavati pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 6 atho rucam evātman dadhate

Sentence: 7 trivṛd agniṣṭud bhavati

Sentence: 8 pāpmānam eva tena nir dahante ‘tho tejo vai trivṛt teja evātman dadhate

Sentence: 9 pañcadaśa indrastomo bhavati \\

Sentence: 10 indriyam evāva //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 rundhate

Sentence: 2 saptadaśo bhavati \\

Sentence: 3 annādyasyāvaruddhyai \\

Sentence: 4 atho praiva tena jāyante \\

Sentence: 5 ekaviṁśo bhavati

Sentence: 6 rpatiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 7 atho rucam evātman dadhate

Sentence: 8 caturviṁśo bhavati

Sentence: 9 caturviṁśatir ardhamāsāḥ samvatsaraḥ

Sentence: 10 samvatsaraḥ suvargo lokaḥ

Sentence: 11 samvatsara eva suvarge loke prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 12 atho eṣa vai viṣūvān

Sentence: 13 viṣūvanto bhavanti ya evam vidvāṁsa etā āsate

Sentence: 14 caturviṁśāt pṛṣṭhāny upa yanti

Sentence: 15 samvatsara eva pratiṣṭhāya //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 devatā abhyārohanti

Sentence: 2 trayastriṁśāt trayastriṁśam upa yanti

Sentence: 3 trayastriṁśad vai devatās \\

Sentence: 4 devatāsv eva prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 5 triṇavo bhavati \\

Sentence: 6 ime vai lokās triṇavas \\

Sentence: 7 eṣv ṝva lokeṣu prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 8 dvāv ekaviṁśau bhavataḥ

Sentence: 9 pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 10 atho rucam evātman dadhate

Sentence: 11 bahavaḥ ṣoḍaśino bhavanti

Sentence: 12 tasmād bahavaḥ prajāsu vṛṣāṇas \\

Sentence: 13 yad ete stomā vyatiṣaktā bhavanti

Sentence: 14 tasmād iyam oṣadhībhir vanaspatibhir vyatiṣaktā //

Verse: 6

Sentence: 1 vyatiṣajyante prajayā paśubhir ya evam vidvāṁsa etā āsate \\

Sentence: 2 akḷptā vā ete suvargam lokam yanti \\

Sentence: 3 uccāvacān hi stomān upayanti

Sentence: 4 yad eta ūrdhvāḥ kḷptā stomā bhavanti kḷptā eva suvargam lokam yanty ubhayor ebhyo lokayoḥ kalpate

Sentence: 5 triṁśad etās

Sentence: 6 triṁśadakṣarā { virāḍ ^ virāj }

Sentence: 7 annam { virāḍ ^ virāj }

Sentence: 8 virājaivānnādyam ava rundhate \\

Sentence: 9 atirātrāv abhito bhavatas \\

Sentence: 10 annādyasya parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 prajāpatiḥ suvargam lokam ait

Sentence: 2 tam devā yenayena chandasānu prāyuñjata tena nāpnuvan

Sentence: 3 ta etā dvātriṁśataṁ rātrīr apaśyan

Sentence: 4 { dvātriṁśadakṣarānuṣṭug ^ dvātriṁśadakṣarānuṣṭubh }

Sentence: 5 ānuṣṭubhaḥ prajāpatiḥ

Sentence: 6 svenaiva chandasā prajāpatim āptvābhyāruhya suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvāṁsa etā āsate dvātriṁśad etās \\

Sentence: 8 { dvātriṁśadakṣarānuṣṭug ^ dvātriṁśadakṣarānuṣṭubh }

Sentence: 9 ānuṣṭubhaḥ prajāpatiḥ

Sentence: 10 svenaiva chandasā prajāptim āptvā śriyam gachanti //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 śrīr hi manuṣyasya suvargo lokas \\

Sentence: 2 dvātriṁśad etās \\

Sentence: 3 { dvātriṁśadakṣarānuṣṭug ^ dvātriṁśadakṣarānuṣṭubh }

Sentence: 4 vāg { anuṣṭup ^ anuṣṭubh }

Sentence: 5 sarvām eva vācam āpnuvanti

Sentence: 6 sarve vāco vaditāro bhavanti

Sentence: 7 sarve hi śriyam gachanti

Sentence: 8 jyotir gaur āyur iti tryahā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 9 iyam vāva jyotir antarikṣam gaur asāv āyur imān eva lokān abhyārohanti \\

Sentence: 10 abhipūrvam tryahā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 11 abhipūrvam eva suvargam lokam abhyārohanti

Sentence: 12 bṛhadrathamtarābhyām yanti //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 iyam vāva rathamtaram asau bṛhat \\

Sentence: 2 ābhyām eva yanti \\

Sentence: 3 atho anayor eva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 4 ete vai yajñasyāñjasāyanī srutī

Sentence: 5 tābhyām eva suvargam lokam yanti

Sentence: 6 parāñco vā ete suvargam lokam abhyārohanti ye parācas tryahān upayanti

Sentence: 7 pratyaṅ tryaho bhavati pratyavarūḍhyā atho pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 8 ubhayor lokayor ṛddhvot tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 9 dvātriṁśad etās

Sentence: 10 tāsām yās triṁśat triṁśadakṣarā virāḍ annam virāḍ virājaivānnādyam ava rundhate

Sentence: 11 ye dve ahorātre eva te ubhābhyāṁ rūpābhyāṁ suvargam lokam yanti \\

Sentence: 12 atirātrāv abhito bhavataḥ parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 dve vāva devasattre dvādaśāhaś ca trayastriṁśadahaś ca

Sentence: 2 ya evam vidvāṁsas trayastriṁśadaham āsate sākṣād eva devatā abhyārohanti

Sentence: 3 yathā khalu vai śreyān abhyārūḍhaḥ kāmayate tathā karoti

Sentence: 4 yady avavidhyati pāpīyān bhavati

Sentence: 5 yadi nāvavidhyati sadṛṅ

Sentence: 6 ya evam vidvāṁsas trayastriṁśadaham āsate vi pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇā vartante ‘harbhājo vā etā devā agra āharan //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ahar eko ‘bhajatāhar ekas

Sentence: 2 tābhir vai te prabāhug ārdhnuvan

Sentence: 3 ya evam vidvāṁsas trayastriṁśadaham āsate sarva eva prabāhug ṛdhnuvanti

Sentence: 4 sarve grāmaṇīyam prāpnuvanti

Sentence: 5 pañcāhā bhavanti

Sentence: 6 pañca vā ṛtavaḥ samvatsaras \\

Sentence: 7 ṛtuṣv eva samvatsare prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 8 atho pañcākṣarā paṅktiḥ

Sentence: 9 pāṅkto yajñas \\

Sentence: 10 yajñam evāva rundhate

Sentence: 11 trīṇy āśvināni bhavanti

Sentence: 12 traya ime lokās \\

Sentence: 13 eṣu //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 eva lokeṣu prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 2 atho trīṇi vai yajñasyendriyāṇi

Sentence: 3 tāny evāva rundhate

Sentence: 4 viśvajid bhavaty annādyasyāvaruddhyai

Sentence: 5 sarvapṛṣṭho bhavati

Sentence: 6 sarvasyābhijityai

Sentence: 7 vāg vai dvādaśāhas \\

Sentence: 8 yat purastād dvādaśāham upeyur anāptām vācam upeyur upadāsukaiṣām vāk syāt \\

Sentence: 9 upariṣṭād dvādaśāham upa yanty āptām eva vācam upa yanti tasmād upariṣṭād vācā vadāmas \\

Sentence: 10 avāntaram //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vai daśarātreṇa prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata

Sentence: 2 yad daśarātro bhavati prajā eva tad yajamānāḥ sṛjante \\

Sentence: 3 etāṁ ha vā udaṅkaḥ śaulbāyanaḥ sattrasyarddhim uvāca yad daśarātras \\

Sentence: 4 yad daśarātro bhavati sattrasyarddhyai \\

Sentence: 5 atho yad eva pūrveṣv ahaḥsu viloma kriyate tasyaivaiṣā śāntis \\

Sentence: 6 dvyanīkā vā etā rātrayo yajamānā viśvajit

Sentence: 7 sahātirātreṇa pūrvāḥ ṣoḍaśa sahātirātreṇottarāḥ ṣoḍaśa

Sentence: 8 ya evam vidvāṁsas trayastriṁśadaham āsata aiṣām dvyanīkā prajā jāyate \\

Sentence: 9 atirātrāv abhito bhavataḥ

Sentence: 10 parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ādityā akāmayanta

Sentence: 2 suvargam lokam iyāmeti

Sentence: 3 te suvargam lokam na prājānan na suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 4 ta etaṁ ṣaṭtriṁśadrātram apaśyan

Sentence: 5 tam āharan

Sentence: 6 tenāyajanta

Sentence: 7 tato vai te suvargam lokam prājānant suvargam lokam āyan

Sentence: 8 ya evam vidvāṁsaḥ ṣaṭtriṁśadrātram āsate suvargam eva lokam pra jānanti suvargam lokam yanti

Sentence: 9 jyotir atirātraḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 bhavati

Sentence: 2 jyotir eva purastād dadhate

Sentence: 3 suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai

Sentence: 4 ṣaḍahā bhavanti

Sentence: 5 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 6 ṛtuṣv eva prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 7 catvāro bhavanti

Sentence: 8 catasro diśas \\

Sentence: 9 dikṣv ṝva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 10 asattram vā etad yad achandomam \\

Sentence: 11 yac chandomā bhavanti tena sattram \\

Sentence: 12 devatā eva pṛṣṭhair ava rundhate paśūñ chandomais \\

Sentence: 13 ojo vai rīvyam pṛṣṭhāni paśavaś chandomās \\

Sentence: 14 ojasy eva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 vīryṝ prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 2 ṣaṭtriṁśadrātro bhavati

Sentence: 3 ṣaṭtriṁśadakṣarā bṛhatī

Sentence: 4 bārhatāḥ paśavas \\

Sentence: 5 bṛhatyaiva paśūn ava rundhate

Sentence: 6 bṛhatī chandasāṁ svārājyam āśnuta \\

Sentence: 7 aśnuvate svārājyam ya evam vidvāṁsaḥ ṣaṭtriṁśadrātram āsate suvargam eva lokam yanti \\

Sentence: 8 atirātrāv abhito bhavataḥ suvargasya lokasya parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 vasiṣṭho hataputro ‘kāmayata

Sentence: 2 vindeya prajām abhi saudāsān bhaveyam iti

Sentence: 3 sa etam ekasmānnapañcāśam apaśyat

Sentence: 4 tam āharat

Sentence: 5 tenāyajata

Sentence: 6 tato vai so ‘vindata prajām abhi saudāsān abhavat \\

Sentence: 7 ya evam vidvāṁsa ekasmānnapañcāśam āsate vindante prajām abhi bhrātṛvyān bhavanti

Sentence: 8 trayas trivṛto ‘gniṣṭomā bhavanti

Sentence: 9 vajrasyaiva mukahṁ saṁ śyanti

Sentence: 10 daśa pañcadaśā bhavanti

Sentence: 11 pañcadaśo vajraḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 vajram eva bhrātṛvyebhyaḥ pra haranti

Sentence: 2 ṣoḍaśimad daśamam ahar bhavati

Sentence: 3 vajra eva vīryam dadhati

Sentence: 4 dvādaśa saptadaśā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 5 annādyasyāvaruddhyai \\

Sentence: 6 atho praiva tair jāyante

Sentence: 7 pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati

Sentence: 8 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ

Sentence: 9 ṣaṭ pṛṣṭhāni

Sentence: 10 pṛṣṭhair evartūn anvārohanty ṛtubhiḥ samvatsaram \\

Sentence: 11 te samvatsara eva prati tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 12 dvādaśaikaviṁśā bhavanti

Sentence: 13 pratiṣṭhityai \\

Sentence: 14 atho rucam evātman //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 dadhate

Sentence: 2 bahavaḥ ṣoḍaśino bhavanti

Sentence: 3 vijityai

Sentence: 4 ṣaḍ āśvināni bhavanti

Sentence: 5 ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas \\

Sentence: 6 ṛtuṣv eva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 7 ūnātiriktā vā etā rātrayas \\

Sentence: 8 ūnās tad yad ekasyai na pañcāśad atiriktās tad yad bhūyasīr aṣṭācatvāriṁśatas \\

Sentence: 9 ūnāc ca khalu vā atiriktāc ca prajāpatiḥ prājāyata \\

Sentence: 10 ye prajākāmāḥ paśukāmāḥ syus ta etā āsīran

Sentence: 11 praiva jāyante prajayā paśubhis \\

Sentence: 12 vairājo vā eṣa yajño yad ekasmānnapañcāśas \\

Sentence: 13 ya evam vidvāṁsa ekasmānnapañcāśam āsate virājam eva gachanty annādā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 14 atirātrāv abhito bhavatas \\

Sentence: 15 annādyasya parigṛhītyai //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 samvatsarāya dīkṣiṣyamāṇā ekāṣṭakāyām dīkṣeran \\

Sentence: 2 eṣā vai samvatsarasya patnī yad ekāṣṭakā \\

Sentence: 3 etasyām vā eṣa eṭaṁ rātrim vasati

Sentence: 4 sākṣād eva samvatsaram ārabhya dīkṣante \\

Sentence: 5 ārtam vā ete samvatsarasyābhi dīkṣante ya ekāṣṭakāyām dīkṣante ‘ntanāmānāv ṛtū bhavatas \\

Sentence: 6 vyastam vā ete samvatsarasyābhi dīkṣante ya ekāṣṭakāyām dīkṣante ‘ntanāmānāv ṛtū bhavataḥ

Sentence: 7 phalgunīpūrṇamāse dīkṣeran

Sentence: 8 mukham vā etat //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 samvatsarasya yat phalgunīpūrṇamāsas \\

Sentence: 2 mukhata eva samvatsaram ārabhya dīkṣante

Sentence: 3 tasyaikaiva niryā yat sāmmeghye viṣūvānt sampadyate

Sentence: 4 citrāpūrṇamāse dīkṣeran

Sentence: 5 mukham vā etat samvatsarasya yac citrāpūrṇamāsas \\

Sentence: 6 mukhata eva samvatsaram ārabhya dīkṣante

Sentence: 7 tasya na kā cana niryā bhavati

Sentence: 8 caturahe purastāt paurṇamāsyai dīkṣeran

Sentence: 9 teṣām ekāṣṭakāyām krayaḥ sam padyate

Sentence: 10 tenaikāṣṭakām na chambaṭ kurvanti

Sentence: 11 teṣām //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 pūrvapakṣe sutyā sam padyate

Sentence: 2 pūrvapakṣam māsā abhi sam padyante

Sentence: 3 te pūrvapakṣa ut tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 4 tān uttiṣṭhata oṣadhayo vanaspatayo ‘nūt tiṣṭhanti

Sentence: 4=o ambe ambāly ambike na mā yabhati kaś cana / sasasty aśvakaḥ //

Sentence: 5=p mātā ca te pitā ca te ‘gram vṛkṣasya rohataḥ //

Sentence: 6 samudram vai //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 etṝ ‘navāram apāram pra plavante ye samvatsaram upayanti

Sentence: 2 yad bṛhadrathamtare anvarjeyur yathā madhye samudrasya plavam anvarjeyus tādṛk tat \\

Sentence: 3 anutsargam bṛhadrathamtarābhyām itvā pratiṣṭhām gachanti

Sentence: 4 sarvebhyo vai kāmebhyaḥ samdhir duhe

Sentence: 5 tad yajamānāḥ sarvān kāmān ava rundhate //

Paragraph: 4

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 samānya ṛco bhavanti

Sentence: 2 manuṣyaloko vā ṛcas \\

Sentence: 3 manuṣyalokād eva na yanti \\

Sentence: 4 anyadanyat sāma bhavati

Sentence: 5 devaloko vai sāma

Sentence: 6 devalokād evānyamanyam manuṣyalokam pratyavarohanto yanti

Sentence: 7 jagatīm agre upa yanti

Sentence: 8 jagatīm vai chandāṁsi pratyavarohanty āgrayaṇam grahā bṛhat pṛṣṭhāni trayastriṁśaṁ stomās

Sentence: 9 tasmāj jyāyāṁsam kanīyān pratyavarohati

Sentence: 10 vaiśvakarmaṇo gṛhyate

Sentence: 11 viśvāny eva tena karmāṇi yajamānā ava rundhate \\

Sentence: 12 ādityaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 gṛhyate \\

Sentence: 2 iyam vā aditis \\

Sentence: 3 asyām eva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 4 anyo’nyo gṛhyete mithunatvāya prajātyai \\

Sentence: 5 avānataram vai daśarātreṇa prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata

Sentence: 6 yad daśarātro bhavati prajā eva tad yajamānāḥ sṛjante \\

Sentence: 7 etāṁ ha vā udaṅkaḥ śaulbāyanaḥ sattrasyarddhim uvāca yad daśarātaś \\

Sentence: 8 yad daśarātro bhavati sattrasyarddhyai \\

Sentence: 9 atho yad eva pūrveṣv ahaḥsu viloma kriyate tasyaivaiṣā śāntiḥ //

Paragraph: 5

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yadi somau saṁsutau syātām mahati rātriyai prātaranuvākam upākuryāt

Sentence: 2 pūrvo vācam pūrvo devatāḥ pūrvaś chandāṁsi vṛṅkte vṛṣaṇvatīm pratipadam kuryāt

Sentence: 3 prātaḥsavanād evaiṣām indram vṛṅkte \\

Sentence: 4 atho khalv āhuḥ

Sentence: 5 savanamukhesavanamukhe kāryeti

Sentence: 6 savanamukhātsavanamukhād evaiṣām indram vṛṅkte

Sentence: 7 samveśāyopaveśāya gāyatriyās triṣṭubho jagatyā anuṣṭubhaḥ paṅktyā abhibhūtyai svāhā

Sentence: 8 chandāṁsi vai samveśa upaveśas \\

Sentence: 9 chandobhir evaiṣām //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 chandāṁsi vṛṅkte

Sentence: 2 sajanīyaṁ śasyam \\

Sentence: 3 vihavyaṁ śasyam

Sentence: 4 agastyasya kayāśubhīyaṁ śasyam

Sentence: 5 etāvad vā asti yāvad etat \\

Sentence: 6 yāvad evāsti tad eṣām vṛṅkte

Sentence: 7 yadi prātaḥsavane kalaśo dīryeta vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu stuvīran

Sentence: 8 yad vai yajñasyātiricyate viṣṇum tac chipiviṣṭam abhy ati ricyate

Sentence: 9 tad viṣṇuḥ śivipiṣṭo ‘tirikta evātiriktam dadhāti \\

Sentence: 10 atho atiriktenaivātiriktam āptvāva rundhate

Sentence: 11 yadi madhyamdine dīryeta vaṣaṭkāranidhanaṁ sāma kuryus \\

Sentence: 12 vaṣaṭkāro vai yajñasya pratiṣṭhā

Sentence: 13 pratiṣṭhām evainad gamayanti

Sentence: 14 yadi tṛtīyasavana etad eva //

Paragraph: 6

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ṣaḍahair māsānt sampādyāhar ut sṛjanti

Sentence: 2 ṣaḍahair hi māsānt sampaśyanti \\

Sentence: 3 ardhamāsair māsānt sampādyāhar ut sṛjanati \\

Sentence: 4 ardhamāsair hi māsānt sampaśyanti \\

Sentence: 5 amāvāyayā māsānt sampādyāhar ut sṛjanti \\

Sentence: 6 amāvāsyayā hi māsānt sampaśyanti

Sentence: 7 paurṇamāsyā māsānt sampādyāhar ut sṛjanti

Sentence: 8 paurṇamāsyā hi māsānt sampaśyanti

Sentence: 9 yo vai pūrṇa āsiñcati parā sa siñcati

Sentence: 10 yaḥ pūrṇād udacati //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 prāṇam asmint sa dadhāti

Sentence: 2 yat paurṇamāsyā māsānt sampādyāhar utsṛjanti samvatsarāyaiva tat prāṇam dadhati

Sentence: 3 tad anu sattriṇaḥ prāṇanti

Sentence: 4 yad ahar notsṛjeyur yathā dṛtir upanaddho vipataty evaṁ samvatsaro vi patet \\

Sentence: 5 ārtim ārcheyus \\

Sentence: 6 yat paurṇamāsyā māsānt sampādyāhar utsṛjanti samvatsarāyaiva tad udānam dadhati

Sentence: 7 tad anu sattriṇa ut //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 ananti

Sentence: 2 nārtim ārchanti

Sentence: 3 pūrṇamāse vai devānāṁ sutas \\

Sentence: 4 yat paurṇamāsyā māsānt sampādyāhar utsṛjanti devānām eva tad yajñena yajñam pratyavarohanti

Sentence: 5 vi vā etad yajñam chindanti yat ṣaḍahasamtataṁ santam athāhar utsṛjanti

Sentence: 6 prājāpatyam paśum ālabhante

Sentence: 7 prajāpatiḥ sarvā devatās \\

Sentence: 8 devatābhir eva yajñaṁ sam tanvanti

Sentence: 9 yanti vā ete savanād ye ‘haḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 utsṛjanti

Sentence: 2 turīyam khalu vā etat savanam yat sāmnāyyam \\

Sentence: 3 yat sāmnāyyam bhavati tenaiva savanān na yanti

Sentence: 4 samupahūya bhakṣayanti \\

Sentence: 5 etatsomapīthā hy ṝtarhi

Sentence: 6 yathāyatanam vā eteṣāṁ savanabhājo devatā gachanti ye ‘har utsṛjanti \\

Sentence: 7 anusavanam puroḍāśān nir vapanti

Sentence: 8 yathāyatanād eva savanabhājo devatā ava rundhate \\

Sentence: 9 ‘ṣṭākapālān prātaḥsavana ekādaśakapālān mādhyamdine savane dvādaśakapālāṁs tṛtīyasavane

Sentence: 10 chandāṁsy evāptvāva rundhate

Sentence: 11 vaiśvadevam carum tṛtīyasavane nir vapanti

Sentence: 12 vaiśvadevam vai tṛtīyasavanam \\

Sentence: 13 tenaiva tṛtīyasavanān na yanti //

Paragraph: 7

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 utsṛjyā3m notsṛjyā3m iti mīmāṁsante brahmavādinas

Sentence: 2 tad v āhus \\

Sentence: 3 utsṛjyam eveti \\

Sentence: 4 amāvāsyāyām ca paurṇamāsyām cotsṛjyam ity āhus \\

Sentence: 5 ete hi yajñam vahata iti

Sentence: 6 te tvāva notsṛjye ity āhur ye avāntaram yajñam bhejāte iti

Sentence: 7 yā prathamā vyaṣṭakā tasyām utsṛjyam ity āhus \\

Sentence: 8 eṣa vai māso viśara iti

Sentence: 9 nādiṣṭam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 ut sṛjeyus \\

Sentence: 2 yad ādiṣṭam utsṛjeyur yādṛśe punaḥ paryāplāve madhye ṣaḍahasya sampadyeta ṣaḍahair māsānt sampādya yat saptamam ahas tasminn ut sṛjyeyus

Sentence: 3 tad agnaye vasumate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam nir vapeyur aindram dadhīndrāya marutvate puroḍāśam ekādaśakapālam vaiśvadevam dvādaśakapālam

Sentence: 4 agner vai vasumataḥ prātaḥsavanam \\

Sentence: 5 yad agnaye vasumate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam nirvapati devatām eva tad bhāginīm kurvanti //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 savanam aṣṭābhir upa yanti

Sentence: 2 yad aindram dadhi bhavatīndram eva tad bhāgadheyān na cyāvayanti \\

Sentence: 3 indrasya vai marutvato mādhyamdinaṁ savanam \\

Sentence: 4 yad indrāya marutvate puroḍāśam ekādaśakapālam nirvapanti devatām eva tad bhāginīm kurvanti savanam ekādaśabhir upa yanti

Sentence: 5 viśveṣām vai devānām ṛbhumatām tṛtīyasavanam \\

Sentence: 6 yad vaiśvadevam dvādaśakapālam nirvapanti devatā eva tad bhāginīḥ kurvanti savanam dvādaśabhiḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 upa yanti

Sentence: 2 prājāpatyam paśum ā labhante

Sentence: 3 yajño vai prajāpatir yajñasyānanusargāya \\

Sentence: 4 abhivarta itaḥ ṣaṇ māso brahmasāmam bhavati

Sentence: 5 brahma vā abhivartas \\

Sentence: 6 brahmaṇaiva tat suvargam lokam abhivartayanto yanti

Sentence: 7 pratikūlam iva hītaḥ suvargo lokas \\

Sentence: 8 indra kratum na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā /

Sentence: 9 śikṣā no asmin puruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotir aśīmahīty amuta āyatāṁ ṣaṇ māso brahmasāmam bhavati \\

Sentence: 10 ayam vai loko jyotiḥ prajā jyotis \\

Sentence: 11 imam eva tal lokam paśyanto ‘bhivadanta ā yanti //

Paragraph: 8

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 devānām vā antam jagmuṣām indriyam vīryam apākrāmat

Sentence: 2 tat krośenāvā rundhata

Sentence: 3 tat krośasya krośatvam \\

Sentence: 4 yat krośena cātvālasyānte stuvanti yajñasyaivāntam gatvendriyam vīryam ava rundhate

Sentence: 5 sattrasyarddhyāhavanīyasyānte stuvanti \\

Sentence: 6 agnim evopadraṣṭāram kṛtvarddhim upa yanti

Sentence: 7 prajāpaterhṛdayena havirdhāne ‘nta stuvanti

Sentence: 8 premāṇam evāsya gachanti

Sentence: 9 ślokena purastāt sadasaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 stuvanty anuślokena paścāt \\

Sentence: 2 yajñasyaivāntam gatvā ślokabhājo bhavanti

Sentence: 3 navabhir adhvaryur ud gāyati

Sentence: 4 nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ

Sentence: 5 prāṇān eva yajamāneṣu dadhāti

Sentence: 6 sarvā aindriyo bhavanti

Sentence: 7 prāṇeṣv evendriyam dadhati \\

Sentence: 8 apratihṛtābhir ud gāyati

Sentence: 9 tasmāt puruṣaḥ sarvāṇy anyāni śīrṣṇo ‘ṅgāni praty acati

Sentence: 10 śira eva na

Sentence: 11 pañcadaśaṁ rathamtaram bhavatīndriyam evāva rundhate

Sentence: 12 saptadaśam //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 bṛhad annādyasyāvaruddhyai \\

Sentence: 2 atho praiva tena jāyante \\

Sentence: 3 ekaviṁśam bhadram dvipadāsu pratiṣṭhityai

Sentence: 4 patnaya upa gāyanti

Sentence: 5 mithunatvāya prajātyai

Sentence: 6 prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata

Sentence: 7 so ‘kāmayata \\

Sentence: 8 āsām ahaṁ rājyam parīyām iti

Sentence: 9 tāsāṁ rājanenaiva rājyam pary ait

Sentence: 10 tad rājanasya rājanatvam \\

Sentence: 11 yad rājanam bhavati prajānām eva tad yajamānā rājyam pari yanti

Sentence: 12 pañcaviṁśam bhavati prajāpateḥ //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 āptyai

Sentence: 2 pañcabhis tiṣṭhanta stuvanti devalokam evābhi jayanti

Sentence: 3 pañcabhir āsīnā manuṣyalokam evābhi jayanti

Sentence: 4 daśa sam padyante daśākṣarā { virāḍ ^ virāj }

Sentence: 5 annam { virāḍ ^ virāj }

Sentence: 6 virājaivānnādyam ava rundhate

Sentence: 7 pañcadhā viniṣadya stuvanti

Sentence: 8 pañca diśas \\

Sentence: 9 dikṣav ṝva prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 10 ekaikayāstutayā samāyanti digbhya evānnādyaṁ sam bharanti

Sentence: 11 tābhir udgātod gāyati

Sentence: 12 digbhya evānnādyam //

Verse: 5

Sentence: 1 sambhṛtya teja ātman dadhate

Sentence: 2 tasmād ekaḥ prāṇaḥ sarvāṇy aṅgāny avati \\

Sentence: 3 atho yathā suparṇa utpatiṣyañ chira uttamam kuruta evam eva tad yajamānāḥ prajānām uttamā bhavanti \\

Sentence: 4 āsandīm udgātā rohati sāmrājyam eva gachanti

Sentence: 5 pleṅkhaṁ hotā nākasyaiva pṛṣṭhaṁ rohanti

Sentence: 6 kūrcāv adhvaryur bradhnasyaiva viṣṭapam gachanti \\

Sentence: 7 etāvanto vai devalokās teṣv eva yathāpūrvam prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 8 atho ākramaṇam eva tat setum yajamānāḥ kurvate suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai //

Paragraph: 9

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 arkyṝṇa vai sahasraśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata

Sentence: 2 tābhya ilāmdenerām lūtām avārunddha

Sentence: 3 yad arkyam bhavati prajā eva tad yajamānāḥ sṛjante \\

Sentence: 4 ilāmdam bhavati prajābhya eva sṛṣṭābhya irām lūtām ava rundhate

Sentence: 5 tasmād yāṁ samāṁ sattraṁ samṛddham kṣodhukās tāṁ samām prajā iṣaṁ hy āsām ūrjam ādadate

Sentence: 6 yāṁ samām vyṛddham akṣodhukās tāṁ samām prajāḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 na hy āsām iṣam ūrjam ādadate \\

Sentence: 2 utkrodam kurvate

Sentence: 3 yathā bandhān mumucānā utkrodam kurvata evam eva tad yajamānā devabandhān mumucānā utkrodam kurvata iṣam ūrjam ātman dadhānās \\

Sentence: 4 vāṇaḥ śatatantur bhavati

Sentence: 5 śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyas \\

Sentence: 6 āyuṣy evendriye prati tiṣṭhanti \\

Sentence: 7 ājim dhāvanty anabhijitasyābhijityai

Sentence: 8 dundubhīnt samāghnanti

Sentence: 9 paramā vā eṣā vāg yā dundubhau

Sentence: 10 paramām eva //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 vācam ava rundhate

Sentence: 2 bhūmidundubhim ā ghnanti

Sentence: 3 yaivemām vāk praviṣṭā tām evāva rundhate \\

Sentence: 4 atho imām eva jayanti

Sentence: 5 sarvā vāco vadanti

Sentence: 6 sarvāsām vācām avaruddhyai \\

Sentence: 7 ārdre carman vyāyachete

Sentence: 8 indriyasyāvaruddhyai \\

Sentence: 9 ānyaḥ krośati prānyaḥ śaṁsati

Sentence: 10 ya ākrośati punāty evainānt { sa ^ sas }

Sentence: 11 yaḥ praśaṁsati pūteṣv evānnādyam dadhāti \\

Sentence: 12 ṛṣikṛtam ca //

Verse: 4

Sentence: 1 vā ete devakṛtam ca pūrvair māsair ava rundhate

Sentence: 2 yad bhūtechadāṁ sāmāni bhavanty ubhayasyāvaruddhyai

Sentence: 3 yanti vā ete mithunād ye samvatsaram upayanti \\

Sentence: 4 antarvedi mithunau sam bhavatas

Sentence: 5 tenaiva mithunān na yanti //

Paragraph: 10

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 carmāva bhindanti

Sentence: 2 pāpmānam evaiṣām ava bhindanti

Sentence: 3 māpa rātsīr māti vyātsīr ity āha

Sentence: 4 sampraty ṝvaiṣām pāpmānam ava bhindanti \\

Sentence: 5 udakumbhān adhinidhāya dāsyo mārjālīyam pari nṛtyanti pado nighnatīr idammadhum gāyantyas \\

Sentence: 6 madhu vai devānām paramam annādyam

Sentence: 7 paramam evānnādyam ava rundhate

Sentence: 8 pado ni ghnanti

Sentence: 9 mahīyām evaiṣu dadhati //

Verse: 1

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 kas tvā yunakti sa tvā yunaktu

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 agnaye gāyatrāya trivṛte rāthamtarāya vāsantāyāṣṭākapālas \\

Sentence: 2 indrāya traiṣṭubhāya pañcadaśāya bārhatāya graiṣmāyaikādaśakapālas \\

Sentence: 3 viśvebhyo devebhyo jāgatebhyaḥ saptadaśebhyo vairūpebhyo vārṣikebhyo dvādaśakapālas \\

Sentence: 4 mitrāvaruṇābhyām ānuṣṭubhābhyām ekaviṁśābhyām vairājābhyāṁ śāradābhyām payasyā

Sentence: 5 bṛhaspataye pāṅktāya triṇavāya śākvarāya haimantikāya caruḥ

Sentence: 6 savitra ātichandasāya trayastriṁśāya raivatāya śaiśirāya dvādaśakapālas \\

Sentence: 7 adityai viṣṇupatnyai carus \\

Sentence: 8 agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālas \\

Sentence: 9 anumatyai caruḥ

Sentence: 10 kāya ekakapālaḥ //

Paragraph: 15

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yo vā agnāv agniḥ prahriyate yaś ca somo rājā tayor eṣa ātithyam yad agnīṣomīyas \\

Sentence: 2 athaiṣa rudro yaś cīyate

Sentence: 3 yat samcite ‘gnāv etāni havīṁṣi na nirvapet \\

Sentence: 4 eṣa eva rudro ‘śānta upotthāya prajām paśūn yajamānasyābhi manyeta

Sentence: 5 yat samcite ‘gnāv etāni havīṁṣi nirvapati bhāgadheyenaivainaṁ śamayati nāsya rudro ‘śāntaḥ //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 upotthāya prajām paśūn abhi manyate

Sentence: 2 daśa havīṁṣi bhavanti

Sentence: 3 nava vai puruṣe prāṇā nābhir daśamī

Sentence: 4 prāṇān eva yajamāne dadhāti \\

Sentence: 5 atho daśākṣarā { virāḍ ^ virāj }

Sentence: 6 annam { virāḍ ^ virāj }

Sentence: 7 virājy evānnādye prati tiṣṭhati \\

Sentence: 8 ṛtubhir vā eṣa chandobhi stomaiḥ pṛṣṭhaiś cetavya ity āhus \\

Sentence: 9 yad etāni havīṁṣi nirvapaty ṛtubhir evainam chandobhi stomaiḥ pṛṣṭhaiś cinute

Sentence: 10 diśaḥ suṣuvāṇena //

Verse: 3

Sentence: 1 abhijityā ity āhus \\

Sentence: 2 yad etāni havīṁṣi nirvapati diśām abhijityai \\

Sentence: 3 etayā vā indram devā ayājayan tasmād indrasavas \\

Sentence: 4 etayā manum manuṣyās tasmān manusavas \\

Sentence: 5 yathendro devānām yathā manur manuṣyāṇām evam bhavati ya evam vidvān etayeṣṭyā yajate

Sentence: 6 digvatīḥ puro’nuvākyā bhavanti

Sentence: 7 sarvāsām diśām abhijityai //

Paragraph: 16

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika id rājā jagato babhūva / ya īśe asya dvipadaś catuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 2=b upayāmagṛhīto ‘si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭam gṛhṇāmi tasya te dyaur mahimā nakṣatrāṇi rūpam ādityas te tejas tasmai tvā mahimne prajāpataye svāhā //

Paragraph: 17

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣam yasya devāḥ / yasya chāyāmṛtam yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema //

Sentence: 2=b upayāmagṛhīto ‘si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭam gṛhṇāmi tasya te pṛthivī mahimauṣadhayo vanaspatayo rūpam agnis te tejas tasmai tvā mahimne prajāpataye svāhā //

Paragraph: 18

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 ā brahman brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasī jāyatām

Sentence: 2 āsmin rāṣṭre rājanya iṣavyaḥ śūro mahāratho jāyatām \\

Sentence: 3 dogdhrī dhenus \\

Sentence: 4 voḍhānaḍvān

Sentence: 5 āśuḥ saptiḥ

Sentence: 6 puramdhir yoṣā

Sentence: 7 jiṣṇū ratheṣṭhāḥ

Sentence: 8 sabheyo yuvā \\

Sentence: 9 āsya yajamānasya vīro jāyatām \\

Sentence: 10 nikāmenikāme naḥ parjanyo varṣatu

Sentence: 11 phalinyo na oṣadhayaḥ pacyantām \\

Sentence: 12 yogakṣemo naḥ kalpatām //

Paragraph: 19

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ākrān vājī pṛthivīm agnim yujam akṛta vājy arvākrān vājy antarikṣam vāyum yujam akṛta vājy arvā dyām vājy ākraṁsta sūryam yujam akṛta vājy arvā \\

Sentence: 2=b agnis te vājin yuṅṅ anu tvā rabhe svasti mā sam pāraya vāyus te vājin yuṅṅ anu tvā rabhe svasti mā sam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 pārayādityas te vājin yuṅṅ anu tvā rabhe svasti mā sam pāraya prāṇadhṛg asi prāṇam me dṛṁha vyānadhṛg asi vyānam me dṛṁhāpānadhṛg asy apānam me dṛṁha cakṣur asi cakṣur mayi dhehi śrotram asi śrotram mayi dhehy āyur asy āyur mayi dhehi //

Paragraph: 20

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 jajñi bījam \\

Sentence: 2 varṣṭā parjanyaḥ

Sentence: 3 paktā sasyam \\

Sentence: 4 supippalā oṣadhayaḥ

Sentence: 5 svadhicaraṇeyam \\

Sentence: 6 sūpasadano ‘gniḥ

Sentence: 7 svadhyakṣam antarikṣam \\

Sentence: 8 supāvaḥ pavamānaḥ

Sentence: 9 sūpasthānā dyauḥ

Sentence: 10 śivam asau tapan

Sentence: 11 yathāpūrvam ahorātre

Sentence: 12 pañcadaśino ‘rdhamāsās

Sentence: 13 triṁśino māsāḥ

Sentence: 14 kṛptā ṛtavaḥ

Sentence: 15 śāntaḥ samvatsaraḥ //

Paragraph: 21

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 āgneyo ‘ṣṭākapālaḥ

Sentence: 2 saumyaś caruḥ

Sentence: 3 sāvitro ‘ṣṭākapālaḥ

Sentence: 4 pauṣṇaś carus \\

Sentence: 5 raudraś carus \\

Sentence: 6 agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālo mṛgākhare yadi nāgachet \\

Sentence: 7 agnaye ‘ṁhomuce ‘ṣṭākapālaḥ

Sentence: 8 sauryam payas \\

Sentence: 9 vāyavya ājyabhāgaḥ //

Paragraph: 22

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 agnaye ‘ṁhomuce ‘ṣṭākapālas \\

Sentence: 2 indrāyāṁhomuca ekādaśakapālas \\

Sentence: 3 mitrāvaruṇābhyām āgomugbhyām payasyā

Sentence: 4 vāyosāvitra āgomugbhyām carus \\

Sentence: 5 aśvibhyām āgomugbhyām dhānās \\

Sentence: 6 marudbhya enomugbhyaḥ saptakapālas \\

Sentence: 7 viśvebhyo devebhya enomugbhyo dvādaśakapālas \\

Sentence: 8 anumatyai carus \\

Sentence: 9 agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālas \\

Sentence: 10 dyāvāpṛthivībhyām aṁhomugbhyām dvikapālaḥ //

Paragraph: 23

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 agnaye sam anamat pṛthivyai sam anamat \\

Sentence: 2 yathāgniḥ pṛthivyā samanamad evam mahyam bhadrāḥ samnatayaḥ sam namantu

Sentence: 3 vāyave sam anamad antarikṣāya sam anamat \\

Sentence: 4 yathā vāyur antarikṣeṇa

Sentence: 5 sūryāya sam anamad dive sam anamat \\

Sentence: 6 yathā sūryo divā

Sentence: 7 candramase sam anaman nakṣatrebhyaḥ sam anamat \\

Sentence: 8 yathā candramā nakṣatrais \\

Sentence: 9 varuṇāya sam anamad adbhyaḥ sam anamat \\

Sentence: 10 yathā //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 varuṇo ‘dbhiḥ

Sentence: 2 sāmne sam anamad ṛce sam anamat \\

Sentence: 3 yathā sāmarcā

Sentence: 4 brahmaṇe sam anamat kṣatrāya sam anamat \\

Sentence: 5 yathā brahma kṣatreṇa

Sentence: 6 rājñe sam anamad viśe sam anamat \\

Sentence: 7 yathā rājā viśā

Sentence: 8 rathāya sam anamad aśvebhyaḥ sam anamat \\

Sentence: 9 yathā ratho ‘śvaiḥ

Sentence: 10 prajāpataye sam anamad bhūtebhyaḥ sam anamat \\

Sentence: 11 yathā prajāpatir bhūtaiḥ samanamad evam mahyam bhadrāḥ samnatayaḥ sam namantu //

Paragraph: 24

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1=a ye te panthānaḥ savitaḥ pūrvyāso ‘reṇavo vitatā antarikṣe / tebhir no adya pathibhiḥ sugebhī rakṣā ca no adhi ca deva brūhi //

Sentence: 2=b namo ‘gnaye pṛthivikṣite lokaspṛte lokam asmai yajamānāya dehi namo vāyave ‘ntarikṣakṣite lokaspṛte lokam asmai yajamānāya dehi namaḥ sūryāya divikṣite lokaspṛte lokam asmai yajamānāya dehi //

Paragraph: 25

Verse: 1

Sentence: 1 yo vā aśvasya medhyasya śiro veda śīrṣaṇvān medhyo bhavati \\

Sentence: 2 uṣā vā aśvasya medhyasya śiraḥ

Sentence: 3 sūryaś cakṣus \\

Sentence: 4 vātaḥ prāṇas \\

Sentence: 5 candramāḥ śrotram \\

Sentence: 6 diśaḥ pādau \\

Sentence: 7 avāntaradiśāḥ parśavas \\

Sentence: 8 ahorātre nimeṣas \\

Sentence: 9 ardhamāsāḥ parvāṇi

Sentence: 10 māsāḥ samdhānāni \\

Sentence: 11 ṛtavo ‘ṅgāni

Sentence: 12 samvatsara ātmā

Sentence: 13 raśmayaḥ keṣās \\

Sentence: 14 nakṣatrāṇi rūpam \\

Sentence: 15 tārakā asthāni

Sentence: 16 nabho māṁsāni \\

Sentence: 17 oṣadhayo lomāni

Sentence: 18 vanaspatayo vālās \\

Sentence: 19 agnir mukham \\

Sentence: 20 vaiśvānaro vyāttam //

Verse: 2

Sentence: 1 samudra udaram

Sentence: 2 antarikṣam pāyus \\

Sentence: 3 dyāvāpṛthivī āṇḍau

Sentence: 4 grāvā śepaḥ

Sentence: 5 somo retas \\

Sentence: 6 yaj jañjabhyate tad vi dyotate

Sentence: 7 yad vidhūnute tat stanayati

Sentence: 8 yan mehati tad varṣati

Sentence: 9 vāg evāsya { vāg ^ vāc }

Sentence: 10 ahar vā aśvasya jāyamānasya mahimā purastāj jāyate rātrir enam mahimā paścād anu jāyate \\

Sentence: 11 etau vai mahimānāv aśvam abhitaḥ sam babhūvatus \\

Sentence: 12 hayo devān avahad arvāsurān vājī gandharvān aśvo manuṣyān \\

Sentence: 13 samudro vā aśvasya yoniḥ samudro bandhuḥ //
